conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Hello, Mister Ward. How are you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I... I don't believe we know each other, do we? Have you just arrived?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Only recently. Declan Ward, Miss, pleased to meet you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And I you, Mister Ward. Were you meant to be here or did something bring you suddenly - oh blast, that shouldn't matter.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And now I've forgotten to say my name - Ivy McLeod.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll let you be, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Take care, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Sssh! Not so loudly!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, but look at me. I don't want things to be like this. I feel awful doing this to Victoria...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: As long as Miss Deane has... her evidence, we are not safe. We will be ruined if she decides to share it!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: So, I... All I can do is try and mitigate the damage. Even if that means... Oh, but I don't want to talk about it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Please, Mister Ward, you can't tell anyone. You can't, please. We will be doomed!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I'm sorry - you have me all flustered. I am host to the second sight, you see. I know things... Or, at least I should. It feels as if, since coming here, I am host to nothing any more.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I should have known you were going to be here - and be late - but it's just more proof that something is wrong...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She is more calm than I. What will I do without her? I do hope Miss Deane doesn't succeed in driving us apart...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Don't worry, Miss. I won't tell a soul. I hope Missus Lau is handling the situation well?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy conversation
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, but the only way I can see that happening is if we somehow get those awful materials and burn them - there is no other way to be free from that horrible woman's grasp.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: That's Miss Deane, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: In passing. She's trying to make her name as a spiritualist of some kind.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know her?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Though I don't know if she has a particular aptitude of any sort...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Photograph of Deane - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well, good luck to her. May she have the success she deserves.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sherry - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: That's very kind of you, but no thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sherry - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sherry - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sherry - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You know, I thought there might be more of us attending - with all the spiritualists in London.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I suppose this seems very far from home for some. Especially those who've never left the city.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I don't mind - it means there's many people here that I've never met, and some of them are very interesting. Don't you think?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is your opinion on the Grand Séance?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: A few! But no one's ever tried to tether a ghost before, not that I've seen.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've still not decided whether I'll actually go. I should like to see it, but I... I'm worried about it, too.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Séance flyer - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is your opinion on the Grand Séance?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Marriage talk - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did I hear, Miss, that you're looking to find yourself a suitor at this event?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Marriage talk - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh! I'm sorry, Mister Ward, but that's - you're embarrassing me, we hardly know each other. May we talk about something else?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The staff say Deane left - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The staff say Miss Deane left the event early.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The staff say Deane left - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Is that so? Maybe she wasn't so interested in this séance as she made out to be...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could swear there's been some strange things happening around this place...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It's getting close to Halloween, and with so many of us here, we're not exactly leaving the spirits in peace.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Even if we wanted to - which I do! I've seen some ghastly things. The mirrors especially, they...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's never there when I turn around, of course. But I swear his mouth opens a little wider whenever I spot him, and--

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I-I keep seeing a man behind me, you see.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ghosts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well, I keep my head bowed at the dressing room mirrors now. But the other day, I think I felt something wet cross the back of my neck...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The Séance's purpose - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you attended many séances before?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The Séance's purpose - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: A few! But no one's ever tried to tether a ghost before, not that I've seen.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The Séance's purpose - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've still not decided whether I'll actually go. I should like to see it, but I... I'm worried about it, too.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's leaving letter - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It turns out Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's leaving letter - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She did? For what?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's leaving letter - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Actually... That's none of my business, is it? Hm...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you tell me about this ability of yours, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Normally, I would joke that I knew you were going to ask that...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It's passed down by blood through Scottish families. It's not uncommon - a fair few people have the ability, at least a little bit.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It just so happens that I'm the only one of my family to have it to any measure, and it came in... very strong.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: The Second Sight... it gives a person... foreknowledge. Or just knowledge you couldn't possibly know. I get visions, mostly of things to come.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Or... I used to. Since arriving here, I've been cut off from it. Surely I should have seen warning of that?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But since coming here, it's... cloudy... and... well, I feel blinded in a way.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Sight - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I've put the cart before the horse. You don't even know what it is that I've lost, yet.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ritual markings - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across evidence of a ritual upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ritual markings - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Hm... I don't know much about rituals... It's not really my focus. I hope you're not going to ask me what it was for.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ritual markings - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: That does seem peculiar, though, doesn't it?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal saw Deane - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara tells me he saw Miss Deane on Tuesday night, and she looked as if she might have been drinking.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal saw Deane - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh? ...Well, I suppose it's not as if people aren't drinking at an event like this. He only saw her?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal saw Deane - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: He tells me he didn't want to intervene and risk offending her.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal saw Deane - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Ah, that's good of him... Well, I didn't see her, I can't speak to it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Bedroom skeleton key - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Why - why do you have that?!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange occurrences - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed any strange happenings around the manor?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange occurrences - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Mm... hm. Truth be told, I woke up last night to all the windows having been opened.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange occurrences - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: That wasn't what woke me, though. What woke me was a knocking on the underside of my bed. There was nothing there, of course, but...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange occurrences - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I didn't sleep much after that.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Statement, Mister Doyle - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Statement, Mister Doyle - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He did? Well, Miss Deane - she's been known to find herself an argument, I hear, but -

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Statement, Mister Doyle - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, but Mister Doyle has no business talking about it himself! Are we being listened in on?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mysterious figure - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw a figure in the window as I was walking back to the manor... Have you noticed anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mysterious figure - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Too shadowed to make out... but small in stature, like a young boy? I've seen him.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mysterious figure - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Another ghost, I suppose... I wonder what happened to him.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Dead End - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I took the trouble of seeing about where Miss Deane went when she left, and I've found that her trail seems to stop in the middle of the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Dead End - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Stop? I'm sorry, as in, you don't know where she is?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Dead End - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's as if she's vanished. I'd wager she never left the grounds at all.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Dead End - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh... Oh, I don't like her, but I'd never wish that upon her. Someone ought to see that she's alright.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Dead End - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: If I see anything, I shall tell you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hermetic Order - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order Of The Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hermetic Order - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: A little. I have had a couple of invitations to join them... but I've no interest in their sort of magic.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Silks - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, how kind of you. I'll put it with my others.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Silks - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Silks - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Silks - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You, Sir, have no idea.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hope you have some peace, now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: My sight, my second sight, is not quite back to me yet.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I don't need it to see how lucky I am.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I know Victoria acted... well, she acted... and she made mistakes.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: As did I - in chasing a husband without discussing it with her and what that could mean for... us.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And Darragh, dear sweet Darragh - he trained me in the sight, you know. How to manage it, how to hide it from others...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And, of course, you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: For him to be in this place when I needed him most... To have acted against Miss Deane and gotten us the key.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You found the materials and returned them to us.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You have given us a chance at a future together and we will never forget that.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Her haste might have broken my heart - but it bought my freedom too. Whether we make it through this or not, that is priceless.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I-I'm still coming to terms with it, I think. That someone so dear to me could break my trust.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But... I also know she wasn't entirely herself. And her haste bought my freedom too.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/resolution - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I don't know what comes next for us, but that is a priceless gift.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Bridge game - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Bridge game - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Me? Oh, ah, no. I was taking a nap. I think Victoria was there, though?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal statement, Bridge - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I asked Mister O'Meara if he was at the bridge game, and, strangely, he said he was nowhere at all.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal statement, Bridge - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, won't you leave him be? What harm could he have done? He probably just forgot he was there at all.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Chance - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara does seem upset about not helping Miss Deane on Tuesday... but I can't help but wonder if he's withholding something.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Second Chance - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Withholding-? Why, if it has anything to do with Miss Deane, he would tell you, I'm sure. It's the only decent thing to do.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara tells me that he wasn't at the bridge game, as it happens - that he was in the gardens with you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, how could-? Hush! Why would you even-?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I... Yes, Mister Ward, if you must know, we went on a walk. And it was only a walk, don't you get a single idea otherwise.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is your chaperone not supposed to accompany you for exactly that sort of thing?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Yes, she is, but I didn't want to - Victoria was not - it is none of your business at all!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I went for a walk in the gardens with Mister O'Meara, and we talked, and that is all. That is all! Are you happy, now?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Secret rendevouz - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...Please, do not tell the others. They will assume the worst of me.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Newspaper clipping - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems like Missus Joyce has an interest in the goings on in Dublin.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Newspaper clipping - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not only that, but she has circled... here, and here... the name of a Detective Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Newspaper clipping - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: How many Wards are there in Dublin, then? How many who come to parties asking questions?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Newspaper clipping - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: If we're in danger, I should have known. Shouldn't I? My head feels so strange...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drafted telegram - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears Missus Joyce sent for help - that she was worried about Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drafted telegram - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Have we reason to be worried about Miss Deane? Where is she, then, Detective? That you are still here, and haven't yet found her?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Entertainment schedule - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I caught a glimpse of the entertainment schedule for the week... there's a lot to do.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Entertainment schedule - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And I intend to do whatever catches my fancy. I feel... strange, but lighter than I have for a while.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Entertainment schedule - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I'm going to make the most of it!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Entertainment schedule - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Any events in particular you're interested in?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lan Fen's statement - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Lau mentioned that you've been having visions less frequently than you usually do.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lan Fen's statement - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She did? Well, she's right. It's the strangest thing.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lan Fen's statement - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: For years, I get flashes of - of things, of knowledge - every day, and full visions every few, and now - almost nothing.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lan Fen's statement - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And it's not as if this place is very calming. I don't know what it is.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lan Fen's statement - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I suppose I will enjoy the peace while I have it... If I can. It feels... I don't know. It's strange. I don't know if I like either option.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Talks schedule - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you plan on attending any of the talks that are going on?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Talks schedule - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think I might go to the one Mister Dupré is hosting.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Talks schedule - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I'm not really here to sit through talks, but that one does sound really quite interesting.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Trinkets - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, how pretty! Do you mean to give this to me?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Trinkets - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Trinkets - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Trinkets - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Trinkets - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you would like it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Trinkets - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I would - thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cigars - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, no. No, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cigars - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cigars - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cigars - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Laudanum - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, this might be useful. Thank you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Laudanum - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Laudanum - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Laudanum - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She's a darling for accompanying me in the first place, this is much more my sort of event than hers.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How would that be, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, Victoria isn't so much for mysticism, she's more interested in the sciences, but... well, I'm akin to the mystics.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would Missus Lau be your chaperone?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chaperone - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She is! I needed someone to vouch that I'm staying out of trouble.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Grimoire - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Hm, I wonder if there's anything about this sort of séance in here...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Grimoire - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Grimoire - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Grimoire - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The fae - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The fae - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/The fae - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But could it truly be them... inside the manor? The thought of that makes me very uncomfortable...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Artefacts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: How interesting. Do you mean for me to have this?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Artefacts - Ivy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Artefacts - Ivy

en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Artefacts - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Artefacts - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you would like it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Artefacts - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I would, as it happens. It feels... important, somehow. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Faith - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears there's quite a number of different faiths practised among the guests.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Faith - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It seems so! I don't think I'm keeping track.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Faith - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Even among the Protestant Christians, many of us are from different churches.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Protestant Faith - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism, Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Protestant Faith - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not any more than the next person, I don't think. And besides, I'm Church of Scotland, and I doubt you need to know anything about that...?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Catholic Faith - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know much about Catholicism, Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Catholic Faith - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not much... I'm Presbyterian, you see. I've never had to know anything about it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ettiene's Influence - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears Mister Toussaint has made quite the name for himself.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ettiene's Influence - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Indeed, he has. And for good work, at that. And Victoria likes him. And yet I do not want to speak with him.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ettiene's Influence - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: What if I misspeak - contradict myself - and it is taken as proof I am not genuine?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ettiene's Influence - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I cannot imagine seeing the things I see, and not being believed at all...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is it true that you were talking to Mister Hunter on Sunday morning?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: W-well why shouldn't I? Darragh all but helped raise me. It has been... just so nice to see him again.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Of course, people have all sorts of things to say about it. About what it means for my family.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: All completely untrue, of course! But, oh, rumours have a mind of their own, don't they?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: How do you know that? Anyway - why shouldn't I? Darragh all but helped raise me. It has been... just so nice to see him again.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It just - it has to be kept quiet, because people might have all sorts of things to say about it. About what it means for my family.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Surreptitious meeting - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: All completely untrue, of course! But it doesn't really do to invite rumour.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, I had the strangest dream the night I arrived here. Of a long hallway, leading to nothing but more doors.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You know, I've been reading about it. Hallways represent transitional spaces, because that's what they are, quite literally.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: They can mean moving from one thing onto another... a new stage in life, a new relationship, a new world view...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And locked doors? That's easy. They're barriers to overcome. But, really, don't take it too much to heart...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think everyone gets strange dreams around here. Right?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It was quite scary! I have never dreamt of anything like it before.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think everyone gets strange dreams around here. The first night I was here, I had this dream...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I saw somebody walking down these halls, dripping blood and molten iron. They were looking for something - a way out, maybe?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh! I've had the same. Victoria too. I think it's the atmosphere - everywhere looks the same, so of course it'll bubble up in one's dreams.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Strange dream - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: The symbols? I don't know so much about that - sigils, I think, but that is really outside of my practice.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Memento Mori - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know if there are a lot of deaths in the Quinn family?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Memento Mori - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Do I? Of course. The whole family is cursed! There's not many of them left at all, I hear... Miss Quinn might be one of the last.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Memento Mori - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I don't know the specifics of the curse, but I know it to be true. Bad luck like that doesn't come about naturally. The poor dear...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drugged Water Jug - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything about the drinking water here?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drugged Water Jug - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Water always tastes different when you go somewhere new, doesn't it?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Drugged Water Jug - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I thought it would be nicer here, but it's almost bitter.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hedonistic Gala - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do events like these usually have parties... such as last night's?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hedonistic Gala - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: For once I was glad that my sight was dulled. I saw quite enough as it was.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hedonistic Gala - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It was as if everyone took on the personas of their costumes.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hedonistic Gala - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And I was talking with - no, to - three ghosts for a while. I only realised that they were not answering me back.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Hedonistic Gala - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I even saw a giant at one point!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Hunter mentioned a photograph of the two of you, from many years back.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Does he recall it? Really?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I must show him - I have it still. With me, in fact.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He worked on my parents' land when I was little.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I use it as a bookmark so I never forget him - not that I ever could, of course!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I hadn't realised how much I missed him until I saw him again. This time, when I go, I will send letters.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is this you in this photograph with Mister Hunter, Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Where on earth did you find that? Surely Darragh didn't give it to you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It is me. I had forgotten about this photograph, but... I remember when it was taken. It was my brother behind the camera.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I thought the world of him then... And... do you know what? I still do.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's always been the sentimental sort, and he was insistent that I'd want it one day... but I gave it to Darragh when he left.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I hadn't realised how I missed him until I saw him again. This time, when I go, I will send letters.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Old Photograph - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I thought the world of him then... And... do you know what? I still do.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this symbol, Mis McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Should I? I don't think it means anything to me. Magical languages aren't my forté, you know.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Unknown Sigil - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this sigil about. A spiral, intersected with four lines - one on top, three below. Does that mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Unknown Sigil - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: That's curious... No, if it means something, I don't know what it is.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Unknown Sigil - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I'm not really one for magical languages, though. And it's certainly nothing Scottish. Perhaps you could ask someone else?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/freemasons - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/freemasons - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well... nothing at all. I think that's sort of the point, you know. I'm not allowed to know.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry to impose on your personal matters, but I must know - did you meet with Mister O'Meara last Tuesday around nine?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...Well, Sir, if you can promise your discretion on the matter, then yes, I can tell you that we did indeed meet then.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well - it's not any of your business - but-

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Since you're being polite... yes, I did. I just wanted to talk to him for a moment, without half a dozen people to bear witness.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I just wanted to apologise, Miss McLeod, for walking in on you and Mister O'Meara. It wasn't my intention.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh! No, it's--

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, it was a stupid idea, really. In all my haste to find a suitor, I should have known better...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you'll forgive me for saying so, Miss, you seem a very talented young woman - one with her whole life ahead of her. Why the rush?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I... I have to, Mister Ward. If I don't, then Miss De--

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Ivy meeting Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...It doesn't matter. What matters is, I must.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Curse - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, the Quinn family have a curse on them? What's it supposed to do?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Curse - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well, I didn't ask... but I think there must have been a Quinn, like Corentine, in our circles at least once before, because it's not an unknown quantity.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Curse - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: From what I've heard, it is supposed to drive them to early graves. The means, I don't know... but I've heard of illness, accident, murder...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Curse - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've no doubt Miss Quinn has overcome some odds to be here in the first place. Poor darling...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cathal's Journal - Ivy

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's Room - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's Room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Of course I do... don't, actually. I shouldn't have forgotten a thing like that...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's Room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She wasn't in my corridor, I remember that much. But still, how could I...?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Deane's Room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, how many more ways can I lose my mind?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The dream we're experiencing, it has a message buried inside it!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh? What of? Wait, did you...?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Images of home, for me. Dublin, my old pub, my... brother. Eamonn.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I knew it! Victoria and I experienced similar dreams. In mine, I saw my old mare standing in fields of heather... It must depend on what home means to you, I say, and how you see it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It left me with a longing to attend the séance... But then, the concept of home? The two seem unrelated.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Buried Messages - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: What if they're not? This dream must have a source, Mister Ward. Maybe for the source, they're not unrelated at all...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Altered Reality - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think that we're all sharing a dream, Miss McLeod, that is altering our realities. Or our perception of them, at least.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Altered Reality - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I wonder - could that be to blame for my dampened gift? Hmm...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Altered Reality - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Truly? But what on earth is it changing?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Altered Reality - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't quite pinpoint it, but I don't think it's permanent - yet.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Altered Reality - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I fear the longer we stay here, the harder it will become to tell what's real and what is not.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about lucid dreaming?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh yes. It's quite the wonder. It takes some training, but some music or other sleep aids can help get you there.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've never tried using an anchor to guide the dream, but I gather any concept can be used, as long as there is a physical totem for it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What if you wanted to... explore a dream?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh gosh. Now that's something! Do you have anything on hand that you'd associate with this dream?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I suppose I have a book, a journal really, that set me on this course in the first place. Would that work?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I can't say, Mister Ward, but there is a certain way to find out, and that is to try!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Lucid Dreaming - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I prefer unguided, myself - just a cosy space and some free time to explore my mind.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Shared Dreams - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think many of the guests are experiencing the same dream.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Shared Dreams - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh my. I knew Victoria and I had experienced similar dreams, but I had no idea the scale of it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Shared Dreams - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: How would that work? Something being cast out for people to pick up in their sleep? Or a larger dream that we're all tuning into?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Shared Dreams - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've done my fair bit of dream reading, but I've not heard of anything like that before.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail material on Livy - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I believe I've found the information Miss Deane had on you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail material on Livy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh! You have? Let me see!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail material on Livy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Mister Ward, you have no idea how relieved I am!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail material on Livy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have to get Victoria - and maybe - I'll find Darragh, too. He'll be around here somewhere. Just one moment!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cache of Stolen Documents - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found these documents, but I haven't a clue as to their owner. Might you recognise them?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Cache of Stolen Documents - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh! Goodness. I-I'm sorry, Mister Ward, I can't imagine who'd leave those lying around like that...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chimney Charm - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it - is it some kind of charm?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chimney Charm - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Yes, it looks like it. I vaguely recall seeing something of the sort in my childhood... in the stables, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Chimney Charm - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I don't make such things, so I'm not sure I can be of any use.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Yes. Darragh was the groundskeeper on my family estate when I was growing up. I've known him since I was very small.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You knew Mister Hunter before this event didn't you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I was so happy to see him here. I've always considered him a good friend. But we've been trying to be discreet - some people think it's improper.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think it's silly. I've met plenty of terrible men in far better standing. We're all just people, no matter our station, don't you agree Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And he was a tremendous help when my Second Sight came in. No one else really knew what to do with me.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It runs in bloodlines, you see - but I have it much more fiercely than anyone in my family's living memory.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Her relationship with Darragh - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I won't risk him his job, so... Discreet it is.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Wards of Protection - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Mister Hunter's always been so good to me. We'll wear these for the rest of the event, even just to set his mind at ease.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Wards of Protection - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Those charms look to be crafted with a great deal of care, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Wards of Protection - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Though... What about you, Mister Ward? What if Mister Hunter's right, and something bad is going to happen at the séance?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Wards of Protection - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll be alright, Miss - don't you worry.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Wards of Protection - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've already asked, but it seems there's simply no way to have a new ward ready at such short notice...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Witchcraft Components - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? Are they items for a ritual of some sort?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Witchcraft Components - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Hm... Well, perhaps not a ritual, but they could be used to make a charm of some sort.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Traces of drug - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been having trouble sleeping, Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Traces of drug - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well I... No, but I have been feeling a little out of sorts since we arrived here.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Traces of drug - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I usually do have trouble sleeping, but here I don't... Yet - I don't feel quite right in myself, either.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Traces of drug - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Maybe it was the journey here. Or the ghosts!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail letter - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're quite close to Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail letter - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, Victoria's a darling. She's my chaperone, but she's my friend before that.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail letter - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I - I'm sure I don't know what you mean.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Blackmail letter - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A very dear friend indeed I'd wager...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod... I don't know how to tell you this, but I think your visions might be fading because you are being drugged...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: What! Drugged!? By whom?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well, I hesitate to say this, but Missus Lau would be the person with easiest access to you...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Victoria? Drugging me? Oh, what a relief... Now I know you are wrong!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Sir... I appreciate your concerns, but however you came to that conclusion... I am afraid you are very much mistaken.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/She's being drugged - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I know and trust Victoria implicitly. She would not do anything that was not in my best interests.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: In tarot, what would a spread of 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' cards mean to you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well now! Let me see... The Hanged Man - he represents spiritual development and, em, patience, I believe.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Death doesn't mean death. Not really. In an abstract sense, yes, like how a part of you dies as you change and grow. But that's all. It's not a card to be scared of. Or maybe it is, but not in the way that most people would assume.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: The Ten of Pentacles is about family and sharing, and the security and peace one gets from that.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: As for their meaning together? I must admit, I don't really know. I work with the cards as a way to focus my own gifts. I honestly couldn't give a clear reading here - not while my sight is dulled.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/skerritt's cards - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Perhaps you should speak with one of the more accomplished readers?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how you're going to spend today?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You mean, other than the ball later?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think I'm going to go to Miss Mantovani's talk at 5pm. I would like to hear what she has to say.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Apart from that, I don't really know. Perhaps I'll get some fresh air... unless it gets too cold. As for Sunday...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you think you're going to spend the day?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...Well, they don't have any services that suit me, so I think I'll take a walk in the garden while Victoria is at church.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: After which I hope she'll join me out there for a walk.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And naturally, we'll want a good lunch at some stage too.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Timetable - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: We shouldn't attempt to raise the dead on empty stomachs - we'll need our focus for the séance!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Record - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about music used to help a person get to sleep?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Record - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I assume you don't mean lullabies? No, that would be a strange question.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Record - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've heard of it, certainly, but I've never tried it myself. Perhaps Doctor Callaghan might know something about it?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/jacket note - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Missus Lau know Miss Deane well? Would she have reason to try to meet with her?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/jacket note - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I... I don't see how that is any of your concern, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/jacket note - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: M-me? No, I'd want no part in any such meeting, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/jacket note - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You wouldn't happen to be meeting up with Miss Deane this weekend, would you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/gauge - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/gauge - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I cannot look at that without getting a headache.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/gauge - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I suspect if my powers were working properly, I would learn a great many terrible things from that device.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/gauge - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And in a way that, if nothing else, makes me glad that they are gone.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Lau's necklace... am I to understand that it's a mourning cameo?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It is, Mister Ward. For her late husband.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I never met him, you know. He died of malaria, and I did try to warn Victoria - I had seen it, you understand.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I... we were too late, of course. And, to listen to Victoria, the world lost a remarkable man because of it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Their bond... Oh, Mister Ward, it... Deep gentleness, deep love. Sometimes, I--

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I don't know if I'm doing it right, you see. Being there for her in all this.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Evidence Presents - Ivy/Mourning cameo - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I know I want to try.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Varley - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Varley, in your time here?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Varley - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, yes, almost as soon as we got here.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Varley - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's rather stern, isn't he? Though he was gentlemanly enough.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Varley - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Besides, I'd be stern too if I had to sleep in the basement all night.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Varley - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Mister Hunter says that's where all the staff stay - but I think they should get nice rooms like ours, don't you?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How did Missus Lau come to be your chaperone?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: That is, in itself, quite the story... And sometimes I don't know whether it is mine to tell.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I will give you this; I met Victoria at a party, some springtime do, and once I spoke with her, I felt I could have known her my whole life.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ... And, perhaps despite her better judgement, she likes me enough to keep my company.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She's a darling like that. I am - oh, I am immensely fond of her. Seldom do you meet a person like Victoria.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you made Mister Skerritt's acquaintance?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think I have met almost everyone here. Mister Skerritt introduced himself to me.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: So, yes, I've met him. He talked at me for a while, though he was rather rude to Victoria and so I stopped listening.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ... Perhaps, don't mention that I said that.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Corentine - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Corentine - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, the poet? I have! I've been meaning to find some of her poetry and read it for myself.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Corentine - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I think she's rather charming. Even if she is poor conversation when she's preoccupied with all that work.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Corentine - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I can't blame her... I think, perhaps, there's something after her... Though what exactly it is, I don't know.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Corentine - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It's times like these I truly feel the absence of my second sight.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had reason to talk to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She made a little conversation when we arrived, asking where we were from.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...And then she apologised for asking. I told her I didn't mind. I would be curious about visitors, too, if I never travelled.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well, I did try. But before I'd even had the chance, she cut me off with the nastiest glare.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Then she said to stop taking up all of Mister Hunter's time! He wasn't even in the room when she said that.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's very dear to me, you see, and yet we've hardly had a chance to speak since I've arrived...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have met the stable master?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have! Some time ago, in fact. Mister Hunter used to work on my family's estate. It's been lovely to see him again.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He introduced me to the horses. The manor has, oh, four? All beautiful. And Lottie will certainly poke her head out the stall if you pass by.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's always very kind with them. They say that's the sign of a good man, you know - kindness to those without power.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Either way, those horses are living the high life.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with the porter?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I believe Victoria did when we arrived. As for me... I... I don't recall. I don't believe so.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've seen him a few times, though, since then. I get the impression he is not... hm... very invested in the work.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I suppose it is mostly moving bags around, though, so... Who would be?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: The priest is always hounding him about something though - so I suspect there's at least one person on his back...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Miss McLeod.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, well! If I'm to be proper - I'm Ivy McLeod, first and only daughter of the Laird Robert McLeod.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not the only child, though. I've two brothers. I'd say for my sins, but I love them. But also, for my sins.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And I am, this seeming like the sort of place one can only say this, a host to the Second Sight... to a greater degree than any of my forbearers ever seemed to be.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can I ask where you're from, Miss? I notice there's nothing Irish in your accent.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And if "Laird" or my accent didn't give it away, I'm Scottish through and through. Though I admit I've been spending more time in London of late.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ivy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: There's a great number of mystics there, you see, and people inclined towards such things, and I'm wont to keep company with the sort.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: More than once... she's everywhere in London, amongst our sort.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: We've spoken once or twice, but I don't recall much. ...And I'm afraid if I say any more, I may be unkind.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Rather better we live our lives happily apart with paths uncrossed, then, no? Though, I do wonder...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Most women of her standing would be looking for a husband now. I wonder just how it is she manages not to need it...?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: More than once... she's everywhere in London, amongst our sort.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: We've spoken once or twice, but I don't recall much. ...And I'm afraid if I say any more, I may be unkind.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not that kindness ever seems to trouble her. Heaven forbid.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ... But that's another matter, and I shan't trouble you with it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was wondering - what do you make of Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: My, that's... certainly a question. She's... well. Oh, how do I put this?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You've read Hansel and Gretel, haven't you? About the two children lured and nearly eaten by a wicked witch?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh... Mister Ward. Do you remember how it ends?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I fear in my darkest nights, I only find peace when I imagine Miss Deane may one day meet the same fate.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're saying Miss Deane is a... wicked witch, of sorts?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Gretel pushes the witch into an oven, and she burns alive, no?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Evelyn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: So yes, we have met. I do not wish for it to happen again.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not by myself, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's a well-to-do man, yes, but I am a Lady.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Though... I suppose he is of the right age. And unspoken for.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have! He's a gentleman, and makes for such... interesting conversation.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I hope we'll have the opportunity to take a walk around the grounds, or something of the sort.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...I should like the chance to talk with him some more, I mean! Yes, I should.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Cathal - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It wouldn't... it wouldn't be right.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ines - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ines - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Only in passing. She's... unfamiliar to me, I suppose, but she seems perfectly pleasant.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ines - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: And frankly, I'd be downright disappointed if someone from so far away didn't seem unfamiliar to me!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ines - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: What else would all that distance be for, if everyone was the same the world over?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ettiene - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you happened to meet Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ettiene - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have, indeed. It turns out he speaks perfect English, and I'm so glad - it would embarrass us both to rely on my French.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ettiene - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But I suppose I could have guessed, as he publishes in English. Have you read his work?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ettiene - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I have.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ettiene - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Hmm, me neither. Not properly. It is... it is interesting, and worthy... and it is somewhat nerve-wracking to have him in our midst.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Dupré - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Dupré - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, I had to! He's from America!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Dupré - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's very pleasant. He said he's not in Ireland for the séance itself, but he thought he'd see it while he was here.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Dupré - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: So we were comparing notes - of a fashion - as to how we each understand a séance to work.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, a little. I think she still considers me more of a girl than a woman in my own right...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Though she did get word of my... "gift", because she asked me about it. For a novel, she said.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I don't know... Victoria seems to like her better. And Mister Dupré enjoys her company, I think - though he's nice to everyone.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Coventry - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Coventry - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh yes, a little.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Coventry - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: What an event to attend as your first of the sort...!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Coventry - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: There’s a noble bearing about him, though you wouldn't know by his outfit. I suppose a jeweller’s salary can only go so far.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Hazel - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Hazel - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have. She introduced herself, and said she was pleased to meet me, finally - that she'd heard my name before.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Hazel - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: People do talk, I suppose. Anyway, she had all sorts of questions about my Second Sight. I answered them as best I could, of course.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Hazel - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It's rare I meet anyone else like me in this sort of gathering - so, of course, people don't usually know how it works...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Hazel - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Sometimes I wish they did. Sometimes I wish... I don't know. Don't mind me.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He's not at all what I expected! I was worried he'd apply some scientific rigour to my sight but breezed past it as if it was the most normal thing in the world.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I was so relieved! I told him that it had waned since coming here and he offered to take my picture with that device of his.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: He said that if the cause was something supernatural it may well show up.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: There was nothing in the image, but I am still certain the problem is magical in nature.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ruairí - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Still, it was a lovely photo to get. After the séance I hope to ask him for one of myself and Victoria, both!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Carmela - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Carmela - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Spoken? Oh, yes - I'm afraid I rather cornered her at tea. I was more excited than I ought to be, perhaps, to talk to her.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Carmela - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: But she was lovely about it; she gave me a reading and talked to me for some time after.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Carmela - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: She gave me a lot to think on. I hope it was not too taxing for her, she seemed quite exhausted by the end of it all.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Blake - Ivy
