speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Blake - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have. I actually met him a few years ago. Would you believe my father hoped I might marry him after his wife passed?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Blake - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: The Marquess had no interest, but was very polite about it. If he remembers me from then, he has not mentioned it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I've not only not met him, I've never met anyone of the like before.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well, far be it from me to judge... Though I think being a little perplexed is fair game.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met with Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Fiadh  - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Fiadh  - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Did you know she has a second sight, too? Hers doesn't seem impacted by this place, though.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Fiadh  - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Maybe because she is from this area? Or maybe her well protects her?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Fiadh  - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I have, as it happens. I like her - talking to her is like talking to an aunt I didn't know I had.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, no... I suppose I could, but I don't know what I'd say. And I keep seeing him in the strangest places.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: The other day, I saw him shaking the basement hatch out in the stables. It was locked, of course, but still...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Arwa - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Arwa - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Very little. I'm sure - I'm sure she's perfectly decent, and I would talk to her more, but it makes my head hurt to look at her.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Arwa - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I don't know what that is. I've never had anything like it before.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Arwa - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I did try, once, and all I did was stumble over my words...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Saoirse - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Saoirse - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not about anything much more than the weather, really, but she seems nice.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Saoirse - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: You know, it's funny, but I feel as though we might have a bit in common.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Saoirse - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I couldn't say why - but I should like to speak with her more. It's a pity she seems so nervous of me...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Campbell - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Reverend Campbell?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Campbell - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, no. I'm from a different church, you see, so I don't know what we'd talk about.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Higgins - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to have seen a man outside the manor, a strong build, not a guest himself? Or staff, for that matter.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Higgins - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Higgins - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Who would that be?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If I understand correctly, there's a Master Blake somewhere around the place.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Yes, apparently so. He's a bit young to appear at an event like this, but I know there is some interest in his hand already.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Character Presents - Ivy/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not surprising, given he's the heir to the land, title, and fortune of the Blake family.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Proud bearing - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: For all that your visions must show you, you have managed to keep an air of innocence about you.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Proud bearing - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Thank you, Sir, though I fear my innocence is nearing its end.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Proud bearing - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Not because of this séance, but through the events surrounding it.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Proud bearing - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I begin to suspect that it ties in with my diminishing visions.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Bitten nails - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you nervous, Miss? You seem to have bitten your nails down.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/Bitten nails - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Oh, um, I was hoping no one would notice... Is it that obvious?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/White heather - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is that a heather you have pinned in your hair, Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/White heather - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It is! White Scottish heather. It's supposed to be for good luck.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Analysis Presents - (to) Ivy/White heather - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: When I was a wee girl, learning to live with my sight, it was braided into my hair to calm me after a bad vision. I guess it stuck.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Ah... Oh, hold on, I can't think. I see... Hm.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I've got you. Is it a vision?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I... it's not...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Nothing. I can't see any... It's like it wants me to see something, but I can't - whatever it is.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Should I be... concerned?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Ah - but there is no portent to be concerned about, which is... I have no idea, actually.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Well, that, -  but I meant, should I be concerned about you, sweetheart? Are you alright?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: I feel... I don't feel bad. I feel strange. Why can't I see like usual?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, visions
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, Ivy...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There really are ghosts in the manor, aren't there?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Have you seen something?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I've certainly seen something... I just can't decide what it was. But everyone seems very certain that the house is haunted.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: Well... it is. I really do think it is.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I feared as much. Then what can we do about it?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: It's not really our place to do anything about - but it will be alright, you'll see.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Eavesdrop, ghosts
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I... might make some extra offerings to my ancestors. Just to be sure.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Clothes
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A few nice dresses... nothing unusual.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Jewellery
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A collection of necklaces and bracelets. Some of them have precious gems in them.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Jewellery
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Best not to disturb these, I think.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Dress pins
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Clothes pins. In case anything needs refitting in a hurry, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Letter home
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A letter addressed to her mother, half written.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Letter home
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She's downplaying the strangeness of the event, but it's hard to say whether that's intentional, or if she's just that used to this sort of thing.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Insomnia remedy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Laudanum, it says, with lavender water. An insomnia remedy - but it's unopened.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Tarot
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A deck of tarot, wrapped up and stored in a box with a secure latch.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Perfume
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A small bottle of perfume... though I think this is Missus Lau's, not Miss McLeod's.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Book on dream imagery
speaker: Mister Ward
en: 'The Encyclopedia of the Symbology of Dreams'. Its spine is broken.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Water jug
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A jug of drinking water. But...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Water jug
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's something wrong. The water is slightly cloudy. Why?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Charm on doorhandle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears to be some sort of charm, made of stone and wood.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/Charm on doorhandle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wonder what it's for?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ivy's room/Ward's comments/White heather
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A small vase of dried white heather.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand Marquess Blake has a son.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: So I believe, but I cannot say I have met the boy.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Maybe he is shy. Maybe his father keeps him glued to his chair.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I cannot say.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the Marquess have a son?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He does, Sir. Keeps to his room, though, since Marchioness Blake passed away.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Best to leave him be.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand Marquess Blake has a son.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: In all this week, I might have thought we would see him around somewhere.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Maybe he is shy? Mi caro ragazzo - my son, Nicolò, he was very shy until he was ten or so.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Campbell
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I right in thinking there is a Master Blake?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Campbell
speaker: Reverend Campbell
en: Marquess Blake has a son, yes. Though it is seldom anyone but the Marquess sees him these days, I understand.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Campbell
speaker: Reverend Campbell
en: I have offered to speak with the boy, of course, but I'm told he refused.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Marquess Blake has a son, as I understand.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Do you think? I can't say I've seen him about... I don't think I have, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Suppose I wouldn't know.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Corentine
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you aware Marquess Blake has a son?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Corentine
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: I can't say I gave it much thought, but I assumed about as much. Though there have been no introductions, so I assume he is being kept away.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Corentine
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: I'd say that would be better for him, but in a place this haunted, I don't think not meeting us all is sparing him much ghostly activity.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Corentine
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: So it's that, or Marquess Blake doesn't think us desirable company for his heir. And we are just barely tolerated, so... that might be my ongoing theory.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I right in thinking Marquess Blake has a son?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye. By the name of Walter, I think. Can't say I see the boy much, though. He keeps to his room, so the ladies tell me.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Ó Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know if Marquess Blake has a son?

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Temporary folder/Walter Blake - Ó Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Can't say I'm the sort to keep track of that sort of thing! It wouldn't surprise me, though; he seems like the sort of man who would want an heir.

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ward in room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...Mister Ward? W-what are you doing here? I...

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ward in room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...Help. Help!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ward in room - Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod, please-

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ward in room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: HELP! HELP! DARRAGH, VICTORIA, SOMEBODY! PLEASE HELP!

conversation: Cast/Ivy Darroch/Ward in room - Ivy
speaker: Miss McLeod
en: ...Sir? W-what are you doing here? I...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I did. You would be the stable master, I take it?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, groundsman, too. I trust your trip was a pleasant one?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've had worse. The roads out here are more... robust than back east. Pleased to meet you. What should I call you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah now, a conversationalist! I wasn't expecting that. If I'm spoken to, as late, it's about that damned séance...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hunter, Sir. Darragh Hunter. And pleased to meet you, too. Though I didn't get your name.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's Declan Ward. You're against the séance, then?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Mister Ward, how are you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll be off.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Right you are.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Thank you, that will be all.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Right you are. I'll head back out to my horse, so.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well now. A new guest. You made your way here without my help, then.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah no. Not really. I just worry about her getting hurt. Them. You. The guests, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: That's about it. This whole event is bad news - and that Deane woman is worse.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's nothing I wouldn't do for Ivy, you know. A spell to keep her safe is nothing at all.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And it's not like it'll do Miss Deane any harm. I've no interest in that - not once Ivy is fine and well.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But there's only so much I can do. If you're looking into everyone's business - look, you make sure Ivy is safe again, and I'll break my charm.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You have my word. Just make sure whatever effect is being put on Ivy is lifted, and I'll lift mine on Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: If Miss Deane has bound Ivy's vision in some way, then she'll have to have put the components for it somewhere. That's how binding works - same as with my charm and the chimney.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I took this key from her one day, when she was out horse-riding.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You'll have better luck than me, I'd wager.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I see you're taking the horse and carriage out?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, we're missing a delivery. I've got to go chase up on it now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Knowing my luck, we'll be spending tomorrow morning hefting the stuff down to the basement.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, another guest, are you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have I caught you at a bad time?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, not so bad. I'm just going to chase up a missing delivery.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Knowing my luck, we'll be spending tomorrow morning hefting the stuff down to the basement.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But, ah, excuse me. I'm Mister Hunter. The groundsman and the stable master.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Pleased to meet you. I'm Declan Ward. Have they got you working hard?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah now, a conversationalist! I wasn't expecting that. If I'm spoken to, as late, it's about that damned séance...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But no, it'll be alright. Plenty to do, never too much. How can I help you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Anyway, Mister Ward, what can I do for you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah no. Not really. I just worry about her getting hurt. Them. You. The guests, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're against the séance, then?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: It looks like it belongs to the manor, but I don't recognise it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Darragh conversation
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Might it unlock something in those catacombs you mentioned?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Good god, but it's barren out here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: It's a sight better in the summer.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Halloween might be a special time of year, but not for sightseeing - not this close to winter.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But it's not so bad outside the grounds.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: You don't like the place?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I just wish there weren't walls in every direction.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Talking with Hazel after her arrival
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There, now, I've got your bag. You can head on in, Ma'am, the manager will have it all from here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's leaving letter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did Miss Deane happen to approach you on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's leaving letter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Deane? Ah, I recall her. Nice lass, talked to me at some length about the horses.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's leaving letter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Took one of them, Snowdrop, out for a hack a few days ago, y'see, and seemed to know her way around the technicals of it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's leaving letter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But I don't think I spoke to her on Tuesday. Why'd you ask?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's leaving letter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She left late the same day, is all. I was wondering if she'd made use of your carriage.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's leaving letter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, no. She must have sent a telegram into town requesting one. I didn't bring the carriage out at all that day.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Could I ask a favour?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well, I'll see what I can do. How can I help?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I need a telegram sent, but I wouldn't know how to do it myself.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Right you are. What do you need sent, and who's it to be addressed to?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm looking to contact the exchange to see if anyone called for a carriage on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Should be simple enough. Come with me.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Need another message sent, then?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how to work the telegraph machine?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I do. All staff have to. Do you need something sent?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Asking to write telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Not right now. I was merely curious.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram results - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Alright. They say...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram results - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hm. Nobody called for a carriage on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram results - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well... Does that answer your question?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram results - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It does. Thank you, Mister Hunter.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram results - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Very good. Well, if you need anything else, I'll be in the courtyard.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You've been here a while - have you experienced strange dreams since coming here?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...Aye. Not often, mind, but enough.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Sometimes I think I am taking the young Master to see his mother's grave.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But we're walking through the hedge maze - not the way you'd normally go, you see - and we come to a pit.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And the boy, he starts crying. I think he knows what's coming. I keep walking, right up to the pit.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And casual as you mind, I tip the lad in. And just watch him fall. Into the darkness. Until I wake.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/strange dreams - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...I have a bottle of brandy next to the bed for nights like that...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cash - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Don't you worry, we get paid well enough.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cash - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER MONEY ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cash - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP MONEY ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cash - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Photograph of Deane - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, I know her. Miss... Deane, was it? She's staying here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Luggage - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Mister Doyle will take that upstairs for you. Hopefully, he won't take long to get to it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/A Map of the Region - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And if you go walking early out East - there, you might see some deer this time of year.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/A Map of the Region - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about the area?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/A Map of the Region - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: If you get the time after the séance, it's worth taking a trip outside the grounds.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/A Map of the Region - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The scenery's something special, if the rain doesn't get you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/A Map of the Region - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ach, if you want to know about the county, or the towns and such, I wouldn't be the man to ask - I only go to Gauford for supplies every so often.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/A Map of the Region - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But if it's the land you wanted to know about, that I could help you with.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sherry - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hah! Not often we get tipped in something so fine.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sherry - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sherry - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sherry - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sherry - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you interested in this séance, yourself?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: It's something I'd rather keep out of. I'm not sure how many of these folks actually know what they're doing.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Better to let the dead lie, hm?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this séance? It has... an ambitious goal.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Séances are common enough, and I have no real issue with them. But this?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Between you and me, Mister Ward, it's about the worst idea I've ever heard. I'm not against magic, don't get me wrong, but I'm against this.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance flyer - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's nothing good to come of it. I'll have nothing to do with it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Marriage talk - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I overheard a conversation about one of the young ladies looking for a suitor here. Have you heard anything about it?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Marriage talk - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, if I did, Mister Ward, I wouldn't say so. No good having the staff gossiping about the guests.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Marriage talk - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But with that said, the young lady has my best wishes. Brave girl.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram for Ines - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Better take that to the front desk or the lady herself, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Courtyard statue - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The statue in front of the manor is something else.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Courtyard statue - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, the angel? He isn't, isn't he? Glowering down at us...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Courtyard statue - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: We've had more than one child start crying coming up the road to see it. But I don't know, I like him well enough.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Staff say Deane left - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was speaking to Mister Varley, and he tells me Miss Deane left.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Staff say Deane left - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, well, he'd know.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ghosts - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you get reports of... ghosts around the manor?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ghosts - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah. Aye, plenty. More, as of late.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ghosts - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Best to leave them be, Sir. Neither they, nor we, need the trouble.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Second Sight - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod claims to have an ability she calls the Second Sight. Would you know anything about that?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Second Sight - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, the gift of foresight. It's passed down through families back home. Not every generation gets it, mind.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Second Sight - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: If that girl tells you something's 'bout to happen, Mister Ward, you'd best heed her.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Second Sight - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There could be a lot depending on it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Freemasons - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Freemasons - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I think I'd have to be one to know much, Sir, and I'm not.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Another Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard mention of another Blake seen in London - would you happen to know him?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Another Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Another Blake? I've no idea.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Another Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've only been here a few years - I don't know the family well.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ines telegram soiled - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Better take that to the front desk or the lady herself, Sir... Perhaps have someone make her a clean copy.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ritual markings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found evidence of a ritual in one of the empty guest rooms.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ritual markings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: What are these folk getting up to? What's so important that they're hiding away with these things?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ritual markings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ach... Sorry, Sir. Don't mind me too much.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cathal saw Deane - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Apparently, Miss Deane was seen late on Tuesday night, wandering as if she were drunk...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cathal saw Deane - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: 'Seen'? Whoever it was ought to have seen that she was alright...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Waiting on a message - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Barbosa seems worried that a telegram she's been waiting on has been lost.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Waiting on a message - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well, if it's Doyle that's supposed to be collecting it, it might well have been.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Waiting on a message - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I worry about him, sometimes. Terrible company, though he is.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Waiting on a message - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He might well have lost it. I'll let one of the others know to look for it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Bedroom skeleton key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You had best give that back over, Mister Ward, before I have to take it from you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Strange occurences - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You've been here for some time, haven't you? Have you noticed any strange happenings around the place?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Strange occurences - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's too many to count. Nary a week goes by, I tell you...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Strange occurences - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But the one that really gives me chills is when I was sweeping the ballroom during the off-season, and I turned to find that the chairs...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Strange occurences - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...they'd been unpacked and arranged around me, like I had an audience.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Strange occurences - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Needless to say, I don't like the ballroom all that much.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you have to fix one of the stable doors recently?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hm? Oh, aye. Lottie got spooked and kicked the latch clean out of the door itself. She was in quite the mood. They all were, really.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's no spare stall, either, so I had to get one and fix it in place - it's too cold to leave them out in the pasture.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: When was this? Did something cause her to get spooked?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I did the fixing from Tuesday evening into the night, so it would have happened that day. Nothing happened that I can think of to set them off.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Wonderful creatures, horses, but not always clever. They'll frighten at just about anything. Rabbits, birds, puddles...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Murphy saw me, she was bringing food into the wee house, to the master I assume.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah... It was Tuesday just gone by.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Repaired stall door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Can't think what set them off. Wonderful creatures, horses, but not always clever. They'll frighten at just about anything. Rabbits, birds, puddles...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Locker key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: That's a key for the bathhouse lockers, isn't it? Best put that back where you found it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Locker key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Doyle - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday evening - a man. Did you hear about it?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Doyle - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He did, did he? Ach...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Doyle - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: No, I didn't hear anything about it. Tuesday evening... I was out at the stables. Not a lot to overhear out there.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Doyle - Darragh
speaker: Varley
en: Mister Doyle shouldn't be concerning himself with it, either, if I'm honest. It's a bad look for us staff.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious figure - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed someone in the window as I was heading back to the manor from the gardens... Does someone else live in the house?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious figure - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: That's not our business, Sir. Yours or mine.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Goibniu - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about Goibniu?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Goibniu - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I don't know the... hold on, the name might be familiar. Not many like that, after all.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Goibniu - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Was he not supposed to be one of the old Irish gods?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Goibniu - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Don't know a thing about him myself, though.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The old anvil - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there a story behind that old anvil?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The old anvil - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: If there is, I don't know it. Just that the thing's been there as long as the house, is no longer.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Goddess Brigit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Goddess Brigit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's a saint by that name, isn't there?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Goddess Brigit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I don't know anything about a goddess with the name. Or the saint, for that matter.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Dead End - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the hedge maze happen to have an extra exit...?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Dead End - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: An extra exit? No, just the one. How come? Did you lose someone in there?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Dead End - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: In... a manner of speaking. Miss Deane seems to have wandered in there, late on Tuesday, when she's thought to have checked out.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Dead End - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And now there's no sign of her at all. Her trail seems to end entirely.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Dead End - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You mean to tell me something happened to the woman? God Almighty...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hermetic Order - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the name the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hermetic Order - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Those folks? I don't concern myself with them.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hermetic Order - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Not that I've anything against them, mind you. It's just... not my business, and I've got no desire to make it so.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Front door policy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is the front door usually kept locked at night?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Front door policy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, after ten or so. Precious little need for it to remain open, after then, and it ensures it keeps the chill out.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Silks - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, well, thank you Sir. I'm sure I'll find some use for this.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Silks - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SILK ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Silks - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SILK ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Silks - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Bridge game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear there was a game of bridge on Tuesday evening.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Bridge game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Oh, aye? I wouldn't know. That sort of thing's for guests and the staff serving drinks.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Bridge game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And I, as I'm sure you can tell, am neither.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Bridge game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: No, I was still outside trying to get the stable door done before the night chill set in.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Staff area key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Where did you get that?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Staff area key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Suppose it doesn't change much. You'd best give that back, now, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/News clippings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/News clippings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Missus Joyce always did have a mind for other people's business...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/News clippings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Feel like I can say that, considering it might be for the better, here. If you are the same Ward as mentioned here, of course.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/News clippings - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I get the feeling you are, hm?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram draft - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram draft - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Let's see... Missus Joyce wanted to hire a detective on Miss Deane's behalf? Not a bad idea.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Telegram draft - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And a Detective Ward... A friend of yours, Sir? Let's say so.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Staff innocent - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that none of the staff can be responsible for Miss Deane's disappearance.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Staff innocent - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Is that right? That's a relief.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Staff innocent - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Maybe, knowing that, and between the lot of us, we'll know something that can help find her.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret rendevouz - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss McLeod skipped the bridge game in favour of a walk with Mister O'Meara... without her chaperone.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret rendevouz - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Without her...? But then, why have the chaperone here at all?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret rendevouz - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: That girl, I swear...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Entertainment schedule - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather the hotel's putting on quite a few things to entertain the guests this week.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Entertainment schedule - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, that's what I hear. Don't bother asking me the specifics, though - they only recruit me for that sort of thing when they need the furniture shifted or they want to trot the guests around the land.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Guests Requests - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand the guests have made a number of requests.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Guests Requests - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'd imagine they have, but I wouldn't know much about it. Usually, the other staff take care of that sort of thing, seeing as they're inside.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was talking to Missus Lau, and she mentioned that Miss McLeod's visions have been occurring less since they arrived here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Of all the places... why would they lessen here?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Somehow, that doesn't bode well. I should talk to her...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Locked bedrooms - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are the guest rooms always kept locked?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Locked bedrooms - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ... A strange question. Yes, they are.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Written complaint - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems like Missus Joyce is earning herself some ire.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Written complaint - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, that sounds about right.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Written complaint - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Now, there's not much to do around here. New people make life a bit more interesting, and I sympathise with her on that...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Written complaint - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But she does have a habit of getting a bit too involved.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Talks schedule - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the talks they're putting on?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Talks schedule - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Not too much, but I'll tell you this - not a single one of them can be a worse idea than the séance itself.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arrival conflict - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears that Father Sinnott was on the hotel grounds before he signed in... a day or two early, as it happens.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arrival conflict - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ... Is that right? I don't know what reason someone would have to be sneaking around here, but who knows what he's thinking?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arrival conflict - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'll keep an eye on him.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fetters - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about fetters? As in, a ghost's fetters.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fetters - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: This is séance getting to you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fetters - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But... for what it's worth - as I understand it, anyway, a fetter would be a ghost's unfinished business. Whatever it is keeping them around.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fetters - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Don't know that I would think to call them that myself, but I'd imagine the idea is the same.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Morrigan - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about the goddess known as the Morrigan?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Morrigan - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, now, that's not my area of expertise. But if I remember rightly, she has something to do with crows.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/The Morrigan - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She might like this place for that, hah - plenty of them about, these days.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/An Cailleach - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the An Cailleach?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/An Cailleach - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hm. Well, in Scotland, they're the spirits of storms, hard winters, that sort of thing.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/An Cailleach - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But I don't know what they might be here. Maybe you'd best ask a local.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Bridge Game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Was there a staff meeting on Tuesday evening?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Bridge Game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well, Mister Varley had a sitdown planned with myself and the housekeeper.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Bridge Game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Afterwards, Missus Joyce was complaining about something or other that he said.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Bridge Game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Wasn't anything of note, mind you, she just likes to complain now and then.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Bridge Game - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I got out of it on account of the stall door that needed fixing.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Laudanum - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've got no need for this.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Laudanum - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Laudanum - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Laudanum - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Portals - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: A portal? Like... a window?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Portals - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You'll think me a madman for asking this, but have you ever seen... a portal on the grounds?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Portals - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of... sorts... A portal, to another... how do I put this?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Portals - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: If you mean to say a portal to another world, then no, I've not seen nothing like that in my time here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Portals - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But if you saw one, or think you did, I'd believe it. This place has secrets, for sure - and it's selective about who it shows them to.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cigars - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well, that's good of you, Sir, thank you very much.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cigars - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGARS ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cigars - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGARS ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cigars - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Flowers - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Now, where did you get these at this time of the year?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Flowers - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Flowers - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Flowers - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Flowers - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You've got a good eye, Mister Ward. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sweet treats - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, I don't need them. I'm sure someone or other will be happy to liberate you of them, though.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sweet treats - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sweet treats - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sweet treats - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Artefacts - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Better I keep hold of it than some of the folks in the manor, I suppose...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Artefacts - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Artefacts - Darragh
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Artefacts - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ghost of Edward Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could have sworn I saw an apparition that looked just like Edward Blake himself.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ghost of Edward Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Is that right? With the way things are getting, I can't say I'm surprised.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ghost of Edward Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But of all the ghosts in this place... Edward Blake is one you might want to avoid.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There are tunnels beneath the house. Catacombs, really. Filled with skeletons.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There... No, there can't be. I'd know about something like that. I've been working here for years, I wouldn't have missed...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: How could I miss that?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: They say it is only a rumour, but I swear I've heard sobbing late at night over the east side of the building. That poor lass calling out to be with her man.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Missing Doors? Percival Blake and the missing lovers, right? What else could you have meant?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The door to Room 15, it's... missing?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: As in, it is not where it should be. Has it been walled over?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: No offence, Sir, but I understand the meaning of the word.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I, eh, I can go take a look later, if you want. But it's not the first time this has happened.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Some time ago, one of the Blakes supposedly walled up some young lovers after he was slighted. They were never found.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Missing Doors? Percival Blake and the missing lovers, right? What else could you have meant?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: They say it is only a rumour, but I swear I've heard sobbing late at night over the east side of the building. That poor lass calling out to be with her man.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Missing Door - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Anyway, I'll take a look, but maybe one of your magical lot got some inspiration from him?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sigil - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across a sigil recently I haven't been able to identify. It's a spiral, with four lines intersecting it. Do you know anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sigil - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: A spiral, with...? Let me think...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sigil - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Nothing comes to mind. I don't think spirals are that common in that sort of thing... Hard to draw where you'd need them.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hedonistic Gala - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting a party like that. I had the impression Marquess Blake was rather more... austere.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hedonistic Gala - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He usually is. I don't know what possessed him to agree to it, let alone see it all arranged.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hedonistic Gala - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I never had the impression I knew him all that well, but it seems I know him even less than I thought.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you meet with Miss McLeod this morning?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You have a habit of listening in on private conversations, Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well... No, I didn't mean anything by it. I just saw you and thought it was nice. My apologies - is it a matter of secrecy?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Look, I think of Ivy as all but my daughter. I helped raise her when she was just a young lass with scary dreams and a Second Sight so strong that no one else knew what to do with her.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But she's a noblewoman, and I'm a servant, and people don't take kindly to others overstepping their station in either direction.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you meet with Miss McLeod this morning?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You have a habit of finding out things people would rather try and keep to themselves, don't you, Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But I suppose there's no good lying about it. Yes, I spoke to Miss McLeod this morning.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't understand - why would that be a matter of secrecy?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah... Look, I think of Ivy as all but my daughter. I helped raise her when she was just a young lass with scary dreams and a Second Sight so strong that no one else knew what to do with her.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But she's a noblewoman, and I'm a servant, and people don't take kindly to others overstepping their station in either direction.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: So, we keep it to ourselves. All the better not to embarrass her Laird father, or her, or make myself look disrespectful. Y'see?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Secret Meeting - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah... No, don't worry yourself. People usually do mean something by it is all, so you've caught me unawares.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy child - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Murphy was telling me about her daughter.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy child - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She was? It's seldom Miss Murphy talks to people about that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy child - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She must have decided you're the trustworthy sort. It's an awful business, but there's not much any of us can do.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy child - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I do hope she gets to see her little girl again someday...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Letter to the manager - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across a letter Mister Varley received from the local Bishop, a reply to an inquiry he had.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Letter to the manager - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Is that so? I don't know what- ...Ah.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Letter to the manager - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You're treading delicate ground there, Mister Ward. And I'm not sure it's my place to speak on it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Old Photo - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod mentioned she has a photograph of the two of you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Old Photo - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She does, does she? God bless that girl for keeping it all this time. Must have been over a decade since that was taken.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Here - I've been seeing this symbol about the place. Does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Can't say I've ever seen one like it. I don't recognise its type, either.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mary Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of Marquess Blake's late wife?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mary Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I didn't know the woman, I'm afraid. I was hired on after her death.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mary Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Missus Joyce speaks well of her, though.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance's purpose - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this séance? It has... an ambitious goal.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance's purpose - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Séances are common enough, and I have no real issue with them. But this?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance's purpose - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Between you and me, Mister Ward, it's about the worst idea I've ever heard. I'm not against magic, don't get me wrong, but I'm against this.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Séance's purpose - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's nothing good to come of it. I'll have nothing to do with it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy crib - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know why there's a crib in the basement?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy crib - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Maybe I should keep what I know about this to myself... I don't have permission to be in the basement, after all.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy crib - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I do. It was given to Miss Murphy by her family while there was hope she'd still have the use of it.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Murphy crib - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've offered to store it away for her, of course, but she asked me not to.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hand carved rattle - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did I notice Miss Murphy with a rattle in her possession?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hand carved rattle - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, now... There's not a happy story to be found there, Mister Ward. I'd leave well enough be.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/hotel finances - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand the hotel's in some financial difficulty.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/hotel finances - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Mister Varley's doing his best, but these old houses take a lot of money to even keep upright, let alone turn a profit.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/hotel finances - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...Might be best you don't go spreading that around now, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/hotel finances - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Wouldn't want the guests to be distracted from the task at hand.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/parcel of money - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a parcel of Miss Deane's money stashed away in Missus Joyce's belongings.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/parcel of money - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Why were you-

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/parcel of money - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah. Well, that makes sense, I suppose. I'm not sure where she'd have found the money otherwise.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/parcel of money - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: That doesn't make any sense. Missus Joyce might be too interested in gossip, but she's not stupid... and she's not a thief, at that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/parcel of money - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Deane won't mind too much, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ivy meeting Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss McLeod slipped off to meet Mister O'Meara... without her chaperone.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ivy meeting Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Without her...? But then, why have the chaperone here at all?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ivy meeting Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: That girl, I swear... She's going about this all wrong...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Ivy meeting Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss McLeod intends to slip off and meet Mister O'Meara... without her chaperone.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's room - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Deane's room - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, I did some repair work on the chimney after she arrived. It was... Oh... I don't recall, sorry.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hiring telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hm... Somebody hired you to come here?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hiring telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: They're worried about Miss Deane leaving so suddenly.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Hiring telegram - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Does all seem to have happened quite suddenly... Well, in that case, Mister Ward, I'm glad to have you around.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Shadowy Figure - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever seen a large figure - much larger than a man - roaming the manor grounds?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Shadowy Figure - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: My guess? It's not a ghost. Maybe the spirit of a giant? Some Guid Folk, perhaps? Or something more - the old Irish gods once walked these parts, though I don't know much about that. Might the library have something of use?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Shadowy Figure - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, I've seen it. In the corner of the eye. Or, sometimes it's just a feeling of being watched. There's something there, sure enough.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/12 Ticket - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know if there are tickets for the luggage room, Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/12 Ticket - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Oh, aye. Helps the guests remember where they put their bags.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/12 Ticket - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: A bit fancy, but it works. I put up some numbered plaques in the luggage room just last year.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cache of Stolen Documents - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found these lying about the manor, but I've no idea what to do with them. Do they look familiar at all to you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cache of Stolen Documents - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...Strange thing to find just lying about, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Cache of Stolen Documents - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: It all seems to belong to Miss Deane at a glance. Otherwise, I couldn't tell you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious Object - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like someone's crammed something inside the luggage room vent.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious Object - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Now, who would go and do a thing like that?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Mysterious Object - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, well. When I have time I'll get a screwdriver from the stables and get that fixed. Thanks.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Miss Deane's Invitation - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wonder if Miss Deane was personally invited to this event?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Miss Deane's Invitation - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Mantovani was, if I've heard right.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Miss Deane's Invitation - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Can't say for sure on Miss Deane. I didn't hear it from the staff or from her and I suspect she'd have made it known.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Miss Deane's Invitation - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Not sure anyone would invite that trouble on themselves...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Treasure Map - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was wondering - does this riddle look at all familiar to you, Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Treasure Map - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hmm. Autumn? Well, there are those four statues in the gardens. The ones for the seasons.
