conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Treasure Map - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Not a bad place to start looking, I'd say.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wonder if it's true that Miss Deane comes from a powerful bloodline?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, it wouldn't surprise me. I wouldn't like it either, mind. Power's always cosying up to the wrong hands.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Coded Papers - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this note covered in dots. Do you have any idea what it could mean?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Coded Papers - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hah. I'm not sure what it's saying, but the paper whispers like it's got something to hide.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Blackmail material on Livy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found some documents Miss Deane had on Miss McLeod and Missus Lau after using the key you gave me for the catacombs. Do you make anything of that?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Blackmail material on Livy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I knew that Deane woman was trouble. We should bring this to Ivy and Missus Lau.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are those things you made for the ladies and yourself?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: All I know is charms, as such. Binds, wards, that sort. I can fold them into, well, charms.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The binding on Miss Deane, the charms for the ladies and myself.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: It's simple magic, Mister Ward, but old and powerful. It will keep the young ladies safe from harm.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Mine, eh, they need some form of emotional component to them.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I tried to make one for you, but, well. Grateful as I am, I don't really know you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I don't know Missus Lau, truthfully, but my love for Ivy seemed to extend to cover her.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I guess this is what makes magic different from science. With science you do the same thing twice and you should get the same result.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Magic isn't predictable like that. It's, ah, what would you call it - alive?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Some of why folk like myself or Fiadh think this séance is dangerous. They're not factoring in the magic of this place and how it feels about it all.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wards of Protection - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Mantovani, she's maybe thinking just too scientifically about it all...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs Key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Deane had this key on her. I had no idea what door it might work on but now I think maybe it's in those catacombs you mentioned?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs Key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Remind me what this is for?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Catacombs Key - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Deane had this key on her. Your guess is as good as mine as to what it opens. Looks like an old cell door or such.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Relationship with Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You knew Miss McLeod before this event?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Relationship with Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, Mister Ward, I did. From a previous posting. I worked for her family.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Relationship with Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Known her since she was a bairn. She's like a daughter to me. I've always done my best to look after her when others couldn't.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Witchcraft components - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about witchcraft and magic, Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Witchcraft components - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye. Well, I wouldn't call it witchcraft, but I have my own way of things.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Witchcraft components - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's a long tradition in Scotland of knowing how to bring a person good fortune or ward off evil. Things you can make to that effect, and the like.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Chimney Charm - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds, what do you make of it?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Chimney Charm - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Did you, now? Well, it wouldn't do much good just lying about, it'd need to be hidden somewhere close to the person it was intended for.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Chimney Charm - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: At least... I imagine that's how these things work.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Would the key I gave you unlock something down there, do you think? Worth a look?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I wonder if that key...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...no, nevermind.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across this map. I think it might be of an underground complex?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across this map. I think it might be of the catacombs below the manor?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Catacombs? What?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: A complex? No, that doesn't seem right. I'd have known...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Map of Catacombs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I still can't believe there are catacombs here...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Drugged water jug - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything odd about Miss McLeod's behaviour since she's been here?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Drugged water jug - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She's not been well at all since she arrived... Headaches, her second sight being cloudy... This whole event has people in an odd state, if you ask me.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Drugged water jug - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've overheard her complaining about a loss of "sight", but it's not my place to pry.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Drugged water jug - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'm confident the matter is resolved now, Sir. She'll be right in no time.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fae - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Certainly, I've seen enough to know to leave scraps out for them. I keep a good bottle of brandy in my room to offer up when the horses are unwell. It's worked so far.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fae - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Fae - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The Guid Folk, we call them back in Scotland. Same idea, even if the specifics change.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Statement - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley said he was in a meeting with Missus Joyce when the bridge game was held. Does that sound right to you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Statement - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, it does. Missus Joyce was complaining about something or other that he said, afterwards.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Varley Statement - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Wasn't anything of note, mind you, she just likes to complain now and then.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Vase Drawing- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, it looks like... That's the one Lady Wilhelmina's holding in the painting in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Vase Drawing- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Never seen it in person though.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Vase Drawing- Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this vase, at all?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Melody- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Can't say I recognise the tune, but I'm not really the musical sort.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Melody- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Maybe if you tried it on an instrument, it'd come back to you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Arwas Melody- Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard this song recently, that I just cannot place. Does it sound familiar to you?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wilhelmina Blake- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've heard the story, but only secondhand. Off she went one day in the middle of the night, and never told a soul where she was going.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wilhelmina Blake- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There's still a collection of her belongings down in the basement. I reckon no one knew what to do with them.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wilhelmina Blake- Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of Wilhelmina Blake?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Wilhelmina Blake- Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: They say no one ever saw her again. God knows where she went, or what happened to her...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Saint Brigid's Cross - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has a member of staff been placing Saint Brigid's crosses about the manor?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Saint Brigid's Cross - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, that'd be Missus Joyce. Helps keep her nerves calm in all this chaos, I think.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/blake manor - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about Blake Manor?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/blake manor - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hmmm, what can I tell you? Well, not much wants to grow here. I'll say that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/blake manor - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I can get a few plants to bloom in pots, but in the ground? There's a reason I keep things simple.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/blake manor - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Might be the water, but what's in that well out back is some of the best tasting water I've ever had, so I don't know.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, we've a delivery all morning, so that will have me down in the basement to unload.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Then I might see about getting a moment or two to rest below decks before the séance goes on.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Thankfully, Mister Varley doesn't need me for the ball tonight. Then tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you think you're going to spend the day?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You know what they say, no rest for the wicked. I'll be tending to the horses most of the morning and working the garden in the late afternoon.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how you're going to spend the weekend?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...But I have to tend to the gardens for a little while at 11am, so I will step out for that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Timetable - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'm glad those charms are made. I feel better for the girls. Girls. Ha. Ivy is a woman now, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Hunter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You said you were repairing the stable door on Tuesday evening?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Hunter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, it would have been Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/Statement, Mister Hunter - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Had to do it right when it was broken. Saved me from making up another stall. I think I missed some meetings for it... The horses have my best interests in mind, hah!

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/ghost at firepit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever seen a woman's ghost by the firepit?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/ghost at firepit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, I caught a glimpse of something alright.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/ghost at firepit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Only recent, mind. She's not been there long. That I know.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/ghost at firepit - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss Mantovani is spending a lot of time out there - attuning to the site, or something. Maybe you should talk to her?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/grimoire - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you make out any of this?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/grimoire - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hmm, no. I can read some Scots Gaelic, but only enough to know this isn't it. That's Irish, I'd say. Old Irish at that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/traces of drugs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything odd about Miss McLeod's behaviour since she's been here?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/traces of drugs - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She's not been well at all since she arrived... Headaches, her second sight being cloudy... This whole event has people in an odd state, if you ask me.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/cigar burn - hunter
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know what caused the damage to the library armchair?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/cigar burn - hunter
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You'd need to ask one of the others about that. I don't much concern myself with what takes place inside. I'm sure Mister Varley would know what happened.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/gauge - darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well, I'm not a technical-minded man, but the parts the Marquess has been getting in are both strange and confusing.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/gauge - darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed a strange device in the atrium. What is that for?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/gauge - darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: They seem to be, if you'll forgive me, far more... mystical than your average component.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/washer woman - darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: When was this, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/washer woman - darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could have sworn I saw a woman washing something in the fountain...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/washer woman - darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Late on Friday night. When I arrived.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/washer woman - darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well... that seems unlikely to me, Sir. The girls are dedicated but not that much...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/washer woman - darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Late last night. When I arrived.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, safe and happy. And should this séance turn south, well - I've put everything I have into those charms. With some luck, we'll be safe.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod is safe, now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: You know, you'd not tell from looking at me now, but when I was a younger man, I cut a fine cloth.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Could dance, too.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en:
I've never sired. 
No children.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The girls would make up any auld excuse to come by the stables I trained in back home.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Bent spoons, pots that looked recently bashed in, the odd bit of broken jewellery...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I took it all for granted. I figured they'd wait - every one of them.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But young 'uns and young love don't live past spring.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: They all summered and moved on - soon they had husbands, then wee uns of their own.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Just didn't work out that way for me.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: It was November 2nd, 1884, when I heard Missus McLeod's screaming from the big house.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I grabbed something - hoof clippers, I think - and ran. Figured it was a robbery.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Instead, I found her hunched over wee Ivy. The child was having a seizure.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Then she sat bolt upright and said - and I'll never forget it - she said "Pappy's gonna die tonight".

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Pappy being what she called her mother's father.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The next day a constable came to the house, his hat under his arm - there had been an incident in the Star Theatre the night before.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Some drunk wrongly sounded the alarm over a small fire. Fourteen people died in their attempts to escape - including Pappy.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I, ah, well, I happened to be part of a group of fellows that are... more open to the stranger side of life.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And long, long story short, it was agreed that if I could help the girl with her gift - though her mother did not consider it that - then none of her siblings, nor her father needed to know.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: A grand man, Mister McLeod, but God-fearing to the extent that his wife worried he would turn out his only daughter.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And so, I trained her. In secret, of course. From the age of six until I left for here, some three years past.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She is the closest thing I have, or will have, to a daughter in this world, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: There is nothing - nothing - I wouldn't do or give to keep her safe.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: God willing, someday you'll have children and know a love so strong.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Evidence Presents - Darragh/resolution - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Because until then, you cannot understand how much I appreciate what you have done here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Varley - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Varley - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Hah! Did he say something? No, he wouldn't.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Varley - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: We don't get along, he and I. Don't see eye-to-eye, as my father used to say.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Varley - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But he's fair enough, and we don't see each other much, so there's not much trouble to be had.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Skerritt - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have met Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Skerritt - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The older gent with the cane? We spoke when I was giving him a lift to the place.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Skerritt - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He took it on himself to explain the workings of the séance to me... I wasn't about to tell him I already understood the thing.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Corentine - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had cause to meet Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Corentine - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I believe I saw her on one of the nicer afternoons, though she didn't stop to talk.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Corentine - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I think she was talking to the horses. Working something out, it sounded like. Thinking out loud, you know?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Corentine - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I hope she's alright - how a young woman like her gets scars like that, I don't know.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Caitlin - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How is it to work with Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Caitlin - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I can't say I much understand the woman. My way is to leave people to their own. And her, well, she's the opposite.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Caitlin - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I wouldn't mind much but she gets so riled up by whatever gossip she finds.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Caitlin - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And there's not a person who isn't breaking one of the rules in her big holy book of rules.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Seamus - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you speak much with Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Seamus - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He's not really one for talking. I worry about the boy.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Seamus - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I mean, I'm sure a lot of it is just sour grapes, but there's something about him...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Seamus - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...and the poor lad has night terrors. Always muttering about black angels or something. It's no wonder he always looks so tired.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She's a sweet lass. And a proper young lady, now, by all accounts.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, she's been by. She came to see the horses, and once she saw me, she stayed a while to talk.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ivy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I worked on her family's estate some years ago, you see. I almost didn't recognise her, she's grown up so much in the years since!

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinon on Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinon on Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Miss McLeod's chaperone? I was introduced.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinon on Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She seems a sound young lady - good to see someone in all this with their head firmly on their shoulders for some balance.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinon on Lan Fen - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: No offence, Sir. I take you to be the same.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Mister Hunter.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, I don't know that there's much to say... But I can give it a go. I'm Scottish born and raised, and I worked there until just a few years ago.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But a friend of my mother's family - she and her side being Irish - let me know that the manor here was looking for a stable master.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I could've stayed in Scotland and taken some other work, but I prefer a job out in the country. Always have. And so here I find myself.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You say you're the groundsman and stable master. That seems like a lot of work for one man.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Just as well I have the strength of two, then, right? Hah.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Nah, truth is I do what I can. There's not too much work in either, at least not at this time of year.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: We're often not as busy as we are now, so the carriage doesn't come out much.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And once the horses are all cared for... it would be gardening, but all the plants are dying back, now.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Darragh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Summer, on the other hand - summer's quite another story. I get by, though. Plants, at least, will wait when the horses won't.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye. I have...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Oh?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Doesn't do well to speak ill of the guests.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Was she a frequent visitor to the manor?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Can't say for sure but in the three years I've worked here, it was my first time meeting her.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Evelyn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And the last, I expect.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The young Irish fellow? Not really, but I've seen him about. Miss McLeod tells me he's a pleasant sort. I think he seems like he might benefit from some fresh air, getting out of an event like this for once.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But... Miss McLeod mentioned something about the young man and angels, though. I wouldn't know where to begin with that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Cathal - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But I suppose, you can't say there's anything strange about angel talk when you're all here to speak with ghosts, can you? Well, not much...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ines - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ines - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I have - she found me out here working and had all sorts of questions about the land around here.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ines - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Answered them as best I could, of course. Don't know why, especially, she wanted to know...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ines - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: ...but she's not going to do any harm with it, now, is she?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ettiene - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ettiene - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Oh, the Frenchman? I can't say I have, though Missus Lau speaks well of him, so I'll take her word for it. Just so long as he doesn't try and call Iv-...

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ettiene - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I mean, Miss McLeod - some sort of fraud. The young lady doesn't deserve that. She's got enough on her shoulders.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The American fellow? I found him lost in the hedge maze one day, looking for the firepit.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He had an urn under one arm and a spirit board under the other.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I brought him to it and left him be, but I don't think he found what he had hoped for.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I heard some - ack, I probably shouldn't be telling you this - but I heard some manic sobbing not long after.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'm only telling you, mind, in case you can talk to him as a fellow guest and, I dunno, help him with whatever demon he's carrying about the place.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Dupré - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'd do it but... That would me out of work, you understand.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on D'Arcy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on D'Arcy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, I don't believe I have, no.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on D'Arcy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Heard her shouting at somebody our by the stables once but she was alone.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on D'Arcy - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Maybe she has borrowed a ghost for her stay here, or maybe she has brought her own?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Coventry - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Coventry - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The soft-spoken gentleman? I have, but I don't think it was anything of consequence.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Coventry - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: For all his softness he carried his own bags - he's in good shape, I'll give him that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Hazel - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Hazel - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She would be the American lass, wouldn't she?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Hazel - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, we spoke, but it wasn't anything particular. I think she bemoaned the weather - though she tells me it gets much colder in New York.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Hazel - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I wasn't really listening, to be frank. Doyle had disappeared so I had to lug her large metal trunk to her room by myself.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Hazel - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'd say that thing weighs more than she does.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ruairí - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ruairí - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ruairí Callaghan, isn't it? Aye, I've spoken to him a bit. He seems a decent lad - good head on his shoulders, for the most part.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ruairí - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: And a doctor, at that! He's doing well for himself. His aunt speaks very highly of him - but not when he's within earshot, I've noticed.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Carmela - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Carmela - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Only in that she's discussed her plans for the séance and how she'd like the hedge maze set up for it. Our paths haven't crossed much outside of that.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Carmela - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Though I see her wandering the grounds, always underdressed for the weather - no wonder she is so dosed.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working for Marquess Blake?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Ah, I can't complain. Truth is, I don't have many dealings with him.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He doesn't like carriages - not surprising, given what happened to his wife and son - so he tends to stay on the manor grounds.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I get the odd compliment on the gardens when he sees me working. That's enough dealings for me.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ó Finn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ó Finn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Well, I said hello to him as he arrived and nodded in passing on the grounds. We've not had much other reason to cross paths.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Ó Finn - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But Miss Callaghan likes him, so he can't be too bad.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Fiadh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can I assume you've met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Fiadh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I have indeed. Wonderful woman. Got her head on her shoulders and the wits to match.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Fiadh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She's a good sort, Mister Ward. I think, should you need it, and should you let her, she'll do right by you.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Fiadh - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Never hurts to have someone with a good and steady heart on your side.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've seen him around the grounds now and then.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I asked, once, if he needed help. He threw question after question at me about the place - namely ruins on the grounds, or secret passages.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He was very disappointed with my answers.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: God knows what he is looking for but I tend the grounds, not the library.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Arwa - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Arwa - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, when I brought her in. She was friendly enough.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Arwa - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I've seen her around the grounds - all over them. Checking doors and the likes.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Arwa - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Less friendly, then. Like I'd caught her in the middle of something.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Saoirse - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Saoirse - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She seems a grand lass - though we don't see each other very often.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Saoirse - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: She works downstairs and, well, she can be skittish around fellas.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Saoirse - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Poor girl has a habit of attracting the wrong sorts of people.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Saoirse - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Not much I can do there but provide counsel. The odd time she'll listen.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Campbell - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What's your impression of Reverend Campbell?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Campbell - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: He comes by about once a week... Has done ever since I've been working here, I think.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Campbell - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: But I can't say I know the man well. Seems a decent sort, though, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Higgins - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen a man around these grounds, tall and wide in the shoulders?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Higgins - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Have I? I thought... I thought this place was playing tricks on me.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Higgins - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I suppose I've no idea. But I should... Shouldn't I?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Higgins - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Sometimes I hate this blasted place.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Walter Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of Walter Blake?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Walter Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The young master? He's a good lad. I take him for walks 'round the grounds from time to time, but he doesn't talk much.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Walter Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I'm told he's been quiet since the carriage accident that killed his mother and maimed him.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Character Presents - Darragh/Opinion on Walter Blake - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Before my time, all that, but he does like to go through her maze when I have him out. Misses her something awful, the poor lad.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Outdoor clothes - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it you don't have to dress up like the other staff.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Outdoor clothes - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Horses don't care whether you're wearing a suit, or anything otherwise. And almost everything else is easier to work in.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Outdoor clothes - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Besides, if I had to worry about keeping my clothes as pristine as the indoor staff wear their uniforms, I'd never get anything done.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Scent of sugar - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice there's a sugary smell about... Do you happen to have sugar cubes in your pockets?

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Scent of sugar - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: I do, and oats, as well. For the horses, obviously. Us staff do get better fare than that, hah!

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Scent of sugar - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: The horses trust me well enough, but it never hurts to have something to treat them with - especially when they're unsure of new people.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Relaxed Regard - Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your scarf - it's quite the fancy piece.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Relaxed Regard - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Aye, a gift from a young friend I'd not seen in years.

conversation: Cast/Darragh Hunter/Analysis Presents - (to) Darragh/Relaxed Regard - Darragh
speaker: Mister Hunter
en: Everyone's here to see the dead, but it's brought the living back to me.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I don't think we've met. Who might you be?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Hello. What brings you back?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: My name's Declan Ward, Miss...?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I am Missus Victoria Lau. How do you do?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Lau. A pleasure. Another séance attendee?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Indirectly only. I am Miss McLeod's chaperone. The event itself is not to my taste; I am here for her and her alone.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's all, Missus Lau.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Farewell, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Would you - please would you keep your voice down? I am not proud of this. I do not - Oh, God, I don't want to be doing this.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: This whole thing is repulsive. I tried to find the material Evelyn somehow has. Do you understand? But I couldn't find it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There didn't seem much option to me, then. I don't want to think what I might have to do...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have no doubt I am sinning against her, Mister Ward. I have no illusions of that. My hope is that it is the lesser of the evils I must subject her to...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: So you are right, of course. I have seen you asking questions. Your business is other people's business, I gather...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: In cases like this, sometimes I wish it wasn't.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You think I don't hear myself? How horrendous this all is? I do not want to be here, Mister Ward, considering these things...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I am doing what I think is best for Ivy. As for Miss Deane... You know I have not yet met with her, don't you? I meant to, but she never showed...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Despite what I think I might have to do, I haven't hurt her. And I won't have to consider her anymore at all, if...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: If... Perhaps you could make good use of this? Could you retrieve what Miss Deane has on us?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Then it can all be over. A little mercy on us, Sir, please. I do not deserve it, but Ivy does. And for all her sins, I do not want to hurt Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Do it for their sake, if not mine. I only want to be left in peace, that all this might be between myself and Ivy, and no one else...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That would mean the world.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But the more I consider my options, I realise that if Ivy knows what I am doing, she, she can't - I can't inflict her with it. I can't.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Perhaps you, with your keen eye and... wandering spirit, might know where it leads?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I believe she stashed it where she's made a mark on this map, but... I cannot tell where this is - it does not match anywhere I have found on the grounds.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ah. The man from this morning. The man from room... number 4.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Lan Fen conversation
speaker: Missus Lau

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Photograph of Deane - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Yes, that's Miss Evelyn Deane.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Photograph of Deane - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Photograph of Deane - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She's a guest here - though, come to think of it, I don't believe I've seen her in some time.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Séance flyer - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I'll believe it when I see it, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Séance flyer - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ... It just so happens that I've already seen some improbable things.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Séance flyer - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think the séance is going to be successful?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Marriage talk - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I overheard mention that your friend, Miss McLeod, is looking for a suitor.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Marriage talk - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Yes. Well. She is coming of that age, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Marriage talk - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And for a woman with her gift, finding a man more open to such things may make the rest of her days easier.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Marriage talk - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: If she must look, then this is as suitable a place to look as any.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Telegram for Ines - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ought you not to give this to Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Staff say Deane left - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The staff say that Miss Deane has left.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Staff say Deane left - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: They did? I wonder what for...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Staff say Deane left - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Hm. I ought to tell Ivy.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Manor contemporary history - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about this house? It seems to be very old.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Manor contemporary history - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I'm afraid I don't, but if you wanted to learn something about it, you might ask Mister Coventry, or Marquess Blake, if you can find him.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Manor contemporary history - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Mister Coventry seems to be some sort of historian, for his part... And I have to assume Marquess Blake would know something about the manor.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Manor contemporary history - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I hope that helps you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Manor contemporary history - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It does, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen any... strange occurrences around the manor, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Doesn't the event alone count as one? But, you mean the ghosts, don't you?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting you to believe in ghosts.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Well... I've seen some strange things. Ivy calls them ghosts, and I've no better explanation for them.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There was a woman upstairs in the atrium. I took her for another guest, but when I went up to say hello, she was just... gone...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I... I do believe that many things have rational explanations. And maybe Ivy's visions, and the young woman I saw, have a practical explanation.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ghosts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But for now, Mister Ward, in my own way, I do confess I believe in Ivy's visions... so while improbable, ghosts no longer seem impossible.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Séance's Purpose - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know if anything like this séance has been attempted before?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Séance's Purpose - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Inevitably, someone has tried it. I sometimes wish we were not so preoccupied with what comes next.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Séance's Purpose - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But perhaps it is our nature... When we are dissatisfied in this life, we demand answers from the yet unknown.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/The Séance's Purpose - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I suppose in the hopes that the unknown will reveal something we like better.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's leaving letter - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane - Evelyn Deane, that is - left a letter excusing herself.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's leaving letter - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: So that's where she went!

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's leaving letter - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That's curious... But I really don't know her well enough to judge just how curious...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Soiled Telegram - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: This is not for me, Mister Ward... and it is filthy.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your companion mentioned something called 'Second Sight'?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Really, it's what brings us here. I know it sounds outlandish, Mister Ward, but she is genuine.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Somehow, Ivy gains visions of the future, or knowledge she shouldn't know. I don't know how. I wish I did.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That's how I met her, you know. She pulled me aside at a party to give me a warning, a total stranger to her though I was.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She predicted my husband's passing. Perhaps if I had been more open, if I had listened, acted sooner...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: After his death, I had no question about her ability. She was there while I mourned and, in time, we became friends.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She mentioned it has weakened since coming here?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Second Sight - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Strangely enough, yes. I might have expected the opposite.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ritual markings  - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found evidence of a ritual being conducted upstairs. Do you know anything about that?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ritual markings  - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Upstairs? You mean, privately? I suppose it must have been, I haven't heard any mention of a ritual.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ritual markings  - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I'd call it strange, but what would I know of rituals? Perhaps that's how they're most often done.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bedroom skeleton key - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Just why do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange occurences - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard talk of ghosts, but I could swear this place is strange besides that.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange occurences - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I keep finding the contents of my pockets under my pillow. I don't know how that happens.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange occurences - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But if something is missing, I can find it under my pillow. This morning, it was the contents of my jewellery box.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Mister Doyle's Statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle said that he heard Miss Deane arguing with a man on Tuesday. Do you know anything about that?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Mister Doyle's Statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Miss Deane's affairs are her own... they're certainly not mine. I don't know anything about it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Mysterious Figure in the Window - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You've a good eye, haven't you, Missus Lau? Have you noticed a figure in the window at all?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Mysterious Figure in the Window - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh. I was rather hoping it was a figment of my imagination.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Mysterious Figure in the Window - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But then, suppose it isn't - who could that be?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Mysterious Figure in the Window - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...I am not yet so convinced as to immediately presume it's a ghost, so... it must be someone.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Dead End - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Deane visited the hedge maze on Tuesday... but there's been no sign of her since.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Dead End - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: What? I mean, I'm sorry? She's just... gone?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Dead End - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It does look that way.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Dead End - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Someone ought to look for her. But where would you start?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Silks - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Now this is very nice. That's very kind of you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Silks - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Silks - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Silks - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Silks - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/chaperpne - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You said you're Miss McLeod's chaperone, yes?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/chaperpne - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She needed someone to accompany her for this event, and I wanted to see Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/chaperpne - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That, and she's my closest friend. I had little reason to turn her down.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/chaperpne - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I've no skill like Ivy does, but I am interested in being here.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sherry - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sherry - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sherry - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Do you mean to give this to me?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sherry - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you'd like it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sherry - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I appreciate the gesture, but I wouldn't be a good chaperone without my wits about me.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sherry - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bridge game - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bridge game - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I was. It didn't go too terribly, either... Though I was more there for the conversation than for the game. I don't attend many gatherings of this kind, so it seemed like a good way to meet some of the others.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bridge game - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: A few. It was the first time I met our host, Marquess Blake. Along with him was Doctor Callaghan and his aunt, Fiadh. There was Miss Quinn and Barbosa, Missus D'Arcy, too, and... yes, Mister Coventry completed the set.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bridge game - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did many attend?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears that Miss McLeod and Mister O'Meara were taking a walk while the bridge game was on.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I-... I, ah... Is that so?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It is, isn't it? I can see it in your face. Ah, Ivy...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ DON'T GET INVOLVED. ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SOME ADVICE. ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: (Perhaps now isn't the time...)

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: (Perhaps I should say something...)

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Mister O'Meara would be sympathetic to Miss McLeod's supernatural inclination.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Marrying into a lower class would have Miss McLeod under less scrutiny in her personal life.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: If Miss McLeod were to marry Mister O'Meara, she would sacrifice many of her liberties.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could think of worse matches for Miss McLeod. Mister O'Meara is quite supernaturally inclined himself.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod might find that she has fewer eyes on what she gets up to, if she married out of her class.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: While they'd make quite a match, I imagine Miss McLeod would lose a lot of personal freedom, without her money.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If she wants a husband who would accept that, I'd imagine it would be him.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I try not to think about the possibility. To see oncoming death, and not have her husband listen...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You're right, I think. If there were a man to take her seriously, through and through, it would be Mister O'Meara.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Do you assume she has much to hide away? Hah!

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But I confess, you're right. It would be a terrible mess for her to marry Mister O'Meara, but afterwards...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Afterwards, who knows? She might be left in peace for once.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That is so. I think she knows that... but I also think it's hard for her to understand the whole of.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Secret rendevouz - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But money buys all sorts of grace. So much so, I think it is hard to realise just how much until it's gone.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bridge game Cathal statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara was strangely evasive when I asked him what he was up to while the bridge game was on...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Bridge game Cathal statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Is that so? Hm...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Staff area key - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I've seen the staff with similar keys. For what purpose do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/News clippings - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Missus Joyce has some plan in motion.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/News clippings - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Her... and others, it would seem. Or you would have found her by now, wouldn't you?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Telegram draft - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce, it seems, was sending for help.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Telegram draft - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: To a Detective Ward, it says so just here. So tell me, Mister Ward, now that you are here - will you find her?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Entertainment schedule - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's a lot to do around this place, this week.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Entertainment schedule - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Plenty. One couldn't attend every little thing. Or, you could, but then you'd never see a moment's peace.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Entertainment schedule - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Was there something more specific you were after, Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lan Fen statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You mentioned that Miss McLeod is having her visions less often since you arrived?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lan Fen statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She does seem to be. Not that they happen very often, but I would have thought she'd have had a couple by now...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lan Fen statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Instead, she comes over distracted the same way, but doesn't seem to see anything.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lan Fen statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I don't know whether to be relieved or concerned.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Written complaint - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The housekeeper has earned herself a complaint for prying.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Written complaint - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ah. Who was it, then? Missus Erickson, or Missus D'Arcy? They do seem to dislike her, I think...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Talks schedule - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think you'll attend any of the talks that are going on?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Talks schedule - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Maybe one or two... I know Ivy wants to go to the one Mister Dupré is hosting.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Talks schedule - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I might attend Miss Quinn's. We'll just have to see...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/cigar burn - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wonder who left those cigar burns on the library armchair?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/cigar burn - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh that? I believe Mister Skerritt is to blame. He dozed off while we played bridge last Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Laudanum - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Thank you. It never hurts to have something on hand...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Laudanum - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Laudanum - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Laudanum - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Laudanum - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: As a matter of fact, it rather hurts when you don't.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Trinkets - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, how nice. Is this a gift?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Trinkets - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Trinkets - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Trinkets - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Trinkets - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I suppose it is, if you like it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Trinkets - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I do. I shall put it somewhere safe. Thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cigars - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, no thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cigars - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cigars - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cigars - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/lucid dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about lucid dreaming?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/lucid dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: While dreams are an area of psychology, they're not my area of focus.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/lucid dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ivy, however, is very interested in dreams. Amateur as she is in the area, she knows more than I.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Grimoire - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ivy may be able to make something of this. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Grimoire - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Grimoire - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Grimoire - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I, em...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Lau, did you write this note?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Did she send you? Is that why we've not seen her recently, she's acting through you as a proxy?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What business do you have with Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: How many others is she blackmailing that she needs to hide behind a goon?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Jacket note - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You're... not working for her. I've said too much. Please excuse me, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Artefacts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Hm. This is interesting.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Artefacts - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Artefacts - Lan Fen
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Artefacts - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Artefacts - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Faith - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems there are a number of faiths practised amongst the guests.
