conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Faith - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I think so, although I don't know exactly how many. And it would seem impolite to ask, even if I did have a reason.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Protestant Faith - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Protestant Faith - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I don't believe I'm especially able to speak on the topic. I am Church of England, it's true... but I've made no particular study of religion.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Catholicism - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about Catholicism, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Catholicism - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I know a little, but certainly not enough to speak on the topic.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Campbell Statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was talking to the Reverend, and by his judgment, Marquess Blake hasn't been himself for quite some time.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Campbell Statement - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That's interesting. I mean, of course, I can't speak to it at all - but it is intriguing to know that perhaps Marquess Blake is not usually as we know him.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ettiene's Influence - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand Mister Toussaint is quite influential among these sorts of circles.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ettiene's Influence - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That's what I hear. I find him quite agreeable, for all the fear he inspires. He makes Ivy nervous, but I don't think there's any need.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ettiene's Influence - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: If Mister Touissant is worth his salt - which he does seem to be - he'll know there's nothing like pretence about Ivy.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Surreptitious meeting - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed Miss McLeod skipped the Sunday service to spend time outside talking to Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Surreptitious meeting - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There's nothing untoward about it, if that's what you're implying, Mister Ward. There are no plots or scandals.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Surreptitious meeting - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She remembers him very fondly from when he worked on her family's estate when she was a girl, and they have been catching up, that's all.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I had the strangest dream the night I arrived... Like I was trapped in the corridors of this place.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh God. I know those dreams. Wandering a long corridor, trying to find the way out through its many doors, a feeling that something else is there?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You know, I've drawn the symbols I saw there and showed Iv... Miss McLeod - and she has seen the very same ones in her dreams!

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Strange dream - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I'm sure we both saw it here amidst the decorations, or who knows where, but it's unsettling still.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Memento Mori - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard of many deaths in the Quinn family?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Memento Mori - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I've never met a member of the family personally before this event, but I have heard mention of something like that.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Memento Mori - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: They're infamous for terrible luck. Specifically, terrible luck that leads to an early grave one way or another.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Memento Mori - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Here and there, and, well - especially here, among the superstitious, you'll hear tell that they're outright cursed.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Memento Mori - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And, you know, considering it all... They really might be.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Freemasons - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Freemasons - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ah... Well, I don't know the name. So, nothing at all?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Box of pills - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of Quinine powder, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Box of pills - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...What makes you ask?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Box of pills - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, Missus Lau, I've gone blank as to what reason I had you and that powder in my mind...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Box of pills - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I see. Malaria killed my husband, so yes, I know Quinine.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Box of pills - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Thanks to Ivy, I got my hands on some, but it was too late. It did not save him.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Drugged Water Jug - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has Miss McLeod had trouble sleeping since she's arrived?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Drugged Water Jug - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Not to my knowledge.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Drugged Water Jug - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Forgive my asking, only she seems a little out of sorts during the day.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Drugged Water Jug - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ah, well... She did mention she's not been feeling quite herself.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Drugged Water Jug - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I think it's the travel, and the stories about this place... nothing to be concerned about, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the masked ball, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I am adding it to the list of unusual situations Ivy has gotten me into. Does "unusual situation" suffice? No, it doesn't, does it?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I am told the purpose was to attuned ourselves spiritually...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Do such things actually do anything to enhance your spiritual awareness...? I don't know if they do.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But I saw... things... Including an apparition I've seen elsewhere here - a woman who washes.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Hedonistic Gala - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: So maybe these events do work?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this symbol around... here, I made a copy. Does this mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Nothing at all. It looks like a rune, I suppose, but nothing that I've ever seen... not that I would be an authority.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Unknown Symbol - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've seen a symbol around - a spiral with four lines intersecting it. Does that mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Unknown Symbol - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: A spiral with four.... hm.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Unknown Symbol - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I don't believe I've seen the like, no.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's Room - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's Room - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Why do you think I would know that?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Deane's Room - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I mean... I have no dealings with her. I would have no reason to know...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Curse - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard the Quinn family were cursed some years ago...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Curse - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Some years ago... and so, I would not imagine Corentine Quinn deserves it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Curse - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There are plenty of unlucky stars to be born under, but that is an unusual one.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy meeting Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I stumbled upon Miss McLeod and Mister O'Meara meeting in secret to discuss marriage...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy meeting Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I... I, ah... Is that so?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy meeting Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It is, isn't it? I can see it in your face.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy meeting Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, Ivy... Not him, don't do that to us...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail material on Livy - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've managed to gain access to the room in the catacombs, as you requested. I found this stashed away there.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail material on Livy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, my goodness. You actually did it? I...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail material on Livy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...I suppose I'll have to come clean to her too. I hope she understands why I did what I did.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail material on Livy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I'm very grateful Mister Ward. We must tell Ivy right away. Mister Hunter, too, he's been very concerned about Ivy.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found these documents, but I can't for the life of me seem to find the owner. Might you recognise them?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Documents that- But how the...?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...I have the key right-- where did it go?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You know, I'm rather sick of games, Mister Ward. I've been toyed with enough for a lifetime.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: We share an inclination for room-searching, do we? Fine.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You stay out of my business with Evelyn Deane, and I won't ask why you were sneaking about my room.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Though if your business is Miss Deane - because, hah! It is, isn't it? She's in everyone's damn business-

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You might be interested to know that the cufflink you likely saw with this "finding" of yours, belongs to Mister Coventry.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: What do you make of that, Mister Ward? You might want to stick your nose into his affairs and leave mine well enough alone.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Cache of Stolen Documents - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Lau-

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Map of catacombs - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Remind me what you wanted me to do with this?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Map of catacombs - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I think this map shows where Miss Deane stashed the material she has on myself and Ivy.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Map of catacombs - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But I cannot for the life of me figure out where this place actually is - it's not the basement, I know that much.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Witchcraft components - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like components for a ritual or charm of some sort, at least to my eye.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Witchcraft components - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: They could be. That sort of thing is more Miss McLeod's area, to be honest with you. I'm sure you could ask her.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail letter from Deane to Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is it fair to say yourself and Miss McLeod are quite close?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail letter from Deane to Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Of course, sir. I'm her chaperone, and we spend quite a bit of time together.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail letter from Deane to Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Whatever you're implying, Mister Ward, I don't appreciate it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Blackmail letter from Deane to Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Some might say you're very, very close, if you catch my meaning?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Wards of Protection - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It was very kind of him to make these for us. He's always been so good to Ivy, I'm... a little honoured to be included, I think.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Wards of Protection - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Hunter has you well looked after.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy's relationship with Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Mmh. Precious little gets past you, I see, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy's relationship with Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter know each other quite well, I gather?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy's relationship with Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You're not wrong. He was the groundskeeper in her family's estate for years. She's known him since she was a child, and she thinks very highly of him.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy's relationship with Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Some people might think it improper, keeping a friendship with former staff, which is why they keep it quiet.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Ivy's relationship with Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But Mister Hunter has been nothing but kind to Miss McLeod. So why shouldn't she keep in touch?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Chimeny Charm - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found what I think is a charm on the grounds, made of a knotted piece of rope. Would you know anything about something like that?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Chimeny Charm - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Hm. Well, it could be a charm, but I wouldn't be the person to ask. Ivy might know.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how you're going to spend today?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you think you're going to spend the day?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I've convinced Ivy to spend some time in the library throughout the day. It's surprisingly expansive, from what I've seen so far.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I will be attending the church service at 11am, of course.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And then, of course, the ball. That should prove interesting. Then, on Sunday...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And before the séance, I will be attending the silent dinner at 8pm.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And, as fair tradeoff, she wishes to visit Lottie - one of the horses.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Timetable - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: After that... Well, you'll think me quite the bookworm, Mister Ward, but I'll be dragging Ivy to the library again.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this photograph, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Hm? I can't say I do, I...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, goodness. Is that a little Ivy? Oh, she's just adorable! What a stern little expression...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And so the gentleman would be... Mister Hunter. Mm, that's it - it seems obvious now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Technically, it's improper for a noblewoman and a servant to be so close, so this is information not best shared...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Old photograph - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But I am glad Ivy had Mister Hunter when she needed him. She was not well understood by her family.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lucid dreaming - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about lucid dreaming?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lucid dreaming - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It's a relatively new concept so I have only read about it. Supposedly, mastery of lucid dreaming allows you to control your dreams.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/Lucid dreaming - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It's an interesting idea, though I don't necessarily see the appeal.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/gauge - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/gauge - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Nothing. I am not that interested in the event or its showpieces, so I have not given it a second thought.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/washer woman - LF
speaker: Missus Lau

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/washer woman - LF
speaker: Mister Ward
en: On my arrival here, I thought I saw a woman washing something in the fountain...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/washer woman - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have seen her too. Though I saw her on entering the ladies' bathroom.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/washer woman - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She shrieked, and I fell back. When I stood, she was gone - save the shawl she was washing in the tub.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/washer woman - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There was no way she got past me. Another gift from this awful hotel.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Of course, I am thrilled with the outcome.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How are you feeling now that the situation is resolved?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But, I am... less thrilled with my behaviour.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I could blame a lot of it on Miss Deane, or this house, maybe even just the time of year or the event itself...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...but my training works against me here. I have to own my anger, frustration, and mistakes from this past week.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have some work to do to regain Ivy's trust, but I am happy I have the chance to do that. So, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have some work to do to regain Ivy's trust. It's possible I never will.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But even if I lose her, she will be free - and that is worth everything. So, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/reflection - LF
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You've given me the chance to become the person she deserves, and I may yet fail.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/shared dreams - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I fear many of the guests are experiencing the same dream.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/shared dreams - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...Similar dreams, maybe? We are all in the same place with the same people and same experiences - it is possible for our subconscious to pick up these same signals and try process them while we sleep, which could result...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/shared dreams - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, the same - almost moment to moment.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/shared dreams - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Then I would say you are a liar - if we were not in this strange place that seems to defy certain logic.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/shared dreams - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But since we are in this place, you might need to speak to somebody with more of a... magical bent to their studies?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The dreams, they contains a buried message!

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: All dreams do, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But this one is from an external source - it is guiding us to the séance.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...It is natural enough that we're dreaming of attending the event we're all here for.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But many guests are not here for it, they are here for other reasons - even they are having the same experience.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That is harder to explain away, I'll confess.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And yet... even I feel the compulsion...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You, yourself, are not really here for the séance. You are here to look after Miss McLeod.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Evidence Presents - Lan Fen/buried messages - lan fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But what does it all mean?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is Miss McLeod a close friend?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ivy is... she's undoubtedly something apart from the mundane, but she's sweet, clever, and without artifice.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She is, very much so. I... am intensely glad to have met her.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ivy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I think that's why I liked her in the first place. So, to answer your question, yes. She's very dear to me.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Varley - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the manager?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Varley - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Mister Varley? Only in passing. Which is, I suspect, the way it is for many people.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Varley - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He's been very good to Ivy and I, quick and thorough to see to any requests.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Varley - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He always seems quite concerned, though. I know running a hotel can be no easy feat - especially through an event like this, but still... I think it may be something else...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Skerritt - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has Mister Skerritt introduced himself to you?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Skerritt - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He did. Briefly.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Skerritt - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He was not very interested in talking to me, not with Ivy beside me.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Skerritt - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Or, more likely, at all.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Corentine - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the chance to speak with Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Corentine - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have. She's a strange sort, but quite affable if her attention holds.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Corentine - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have to wonder what she's working on. She's a poet, as I understand - but her research doesn't look like poetic work...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Caitlin - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had cause to speak with the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Caitlin - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She is clearly very eager to learn everything she can about the guests, and I am very eager for that not to happen.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Caitlin - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I asked for the younger girl, the cook, to take over the cleaning of my room and Ivy's.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Caitlin - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: There's nothing to find there, of course, but nonetheless, I don't want Missus Joyce trying.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Caitlin - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Thankfully, not much. And yet I still know more about her than I ever wanted to.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The groundskeeper's a pleasant sort, don't you think?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: From what little I know of him, I could say so. I couldn't sense any affectation to it, either.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He does seem to genuinely care for Ivy, and she is terribly fond of him, so I like him for that.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Darragh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I suspect there's nothing he wouldn't do for her.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Seamus - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the porter?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Seamus - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That poor man needs help. Whatever burden is on his shoulders, his attempts to drown it out do not seem to be working.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Seamus - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He should also stay away from Miss Deane. That woman is nothing but trouble.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about yourself, Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: You know, Mister Ward, some people tend not to ask me such things. I do appreciate it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I prefer to study the science of psychology. That is, the study of the human mind.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I confess, I'm not a spiritualist, and I have little interest in it.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: As for myself... I was born and raised in London, and have lived my entire life there.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Lan Fen - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: That is not to say I didn't travel - but I've never found reason to come to Ireland before.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Evelyn - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Evelyn - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have, unfortunately. We've been dealing with her for a while now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Evelyn - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is it unfortunate?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Evelyn - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I don't know if it was for her, but it certainly was for me. If only our paths had never crossed.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Evelyn - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I can't stand her. The less said about it, the better.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have, through Miss McLeod. A charming rogue, I suppose, but there's something there - a danger.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Cathal - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Given his injuries, the methods, and the rate at which he acquires them, he's possibly more of a risk to himself than anyone else, but you cannot be sure.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ines - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ines - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Now she is an interesting one - she does not seem the slightest bit interested in the events taking place.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ines - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: So why is she here? And what is she hiding?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ines - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: One to watch.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have. I had heard of him before, in passing, and thought he would be much more severe.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It turns out he makes for very pleasant conversation... and he was kind enough to recommend me some reading.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I mentioned I was... I hesitate to call myself a scholar, but I mentioned that I was interested in a field of my own.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He said he was pleased to see someone else following such a discipline, different though ours are, and was only happy to aid me.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ettiene - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It is seldom I meet a man so positively inclined to the whole idea. It's... surprisingly encouraging, somehow.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Dupré - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you by chance been introduced to Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Dupré - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have. I confess, it was Ivy who seemed to gain the most from speaking to him, but it was a pleasant experience all the same.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Dupré - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: He seems quite... practical, in a way that can be found wanting at events like this.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on D'Arcy - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on D'Arcy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I confess, I haven't read her work, and said the same to her - but she didn't seem to mind.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on D'Arcy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: "Leave that to the hysterical sort", she said. Hm! I'm almost convinced to read them now.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on D'Arcy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She is an interesting woman... I should like to keep contact after this event, though I have no reason to believe she would benefit from that arrangement.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on D'Arcy - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: We will just have to see.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Coventry - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Coventry - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Just a little. He made introductions. A charming man.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Coventry - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I couldn't help but feel like I was missing something, though.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Coventry - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Perhaps he was making moves on Ivy, and I was blind to it. Certainly, he does seem fond of a younger romance.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Hazel - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Hazel - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I have, though she spoke mostly to Ivy.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Hazel - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: ...I do not like the way she looks at her.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Hazel - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Mind her, Mister Ward - be wary. There is something about Missus Erickson I cannot trust.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: We were introduced over drinks just the other night. It's good to see a doctor amidst this gathering.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: And interesting, too, that he is both a formally recognised doctor and a magician without the exclusion of one or the other.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: We talked a while. He was more amenable to talking to me than I might have imagined.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: It's a commonly held belief that the sciences have no place for women among them - he doesn't seem, at least entirely, to hold that view.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ruairí - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: A result of his training under his aunt, no doubt. Hopefully, soon she will see what a good man he has become.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Carmela - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Carmela - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Ivy told me all about her. I don't know exactly what I was expecting, after that... but she seems like a good, decent woman.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Carmela - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Though perhaps for her reputation, I should call her inscrutable. Mystical.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Carmela - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Whichever she would prefer.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Blake - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with the Marquess, at all?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Blake - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: No. I played some bridge with him, but we never spoke beyond a greeting.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Blake - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: This will sound conspiratorial, Mister Ward, but it seemed to me that he had no interest in any of the guests who are of a less magical bent.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ó Finn - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ó Finn - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I can't say I have, yet. I rather wonder what I would talk to him about?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ó Finn - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I must confess that while I am usually a good read on people, he has me thrown. Maybe that is his intention?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Ó Finn - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: If I do manage to think of something, then I'm sure it will be quite the conversation.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Fiadh - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Fiadh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: What a dear. She admonished us for being here, but in a gentle way.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Fiadh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Then, she took our hands and told us everything would work out in the end.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Fiadh - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I don't know why, but I took great solace from that.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you made the acquaintance of Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: I expected more... misgiving, judgement, condemnation, even, from him.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: But he was polite and brief when we interacted. I got the impression he did not care about me, but not in a dismissive or derogatory way.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Arwa - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Arwa - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She's a historian, she said. And I don't disbelieve her... but there's something about her...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Arwa - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Something in her eyes and the way she moves her hands makes me think there's some other reason for her being here. Some preoccupation.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Arwa - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Something rather more current. Whatever it may be...

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Saoirse - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Saoirse - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: She's neither so talkative nor so interested in this event or its guests as Missus Joyce, so I asked for her to look after our rooms.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Saoirse - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Poor girl has such a sadness about her.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Reverend Campbell - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Reverend Campbell?

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Reverend Campbell - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: No, I don't believe I have.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Higgins - Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've seen a man around here, not one of the guests or staff? He's got quite the build.

conversation: Cast/Lan Fen Zhào/Character Presents - Lan Fen/Opinion on Higgins - Lan Fen
speaker: Missus Lau
en: Oh, I thought he might be a deliveryman. You mean to say he isn't? That's... curious.

conversation: Cast/Declan Ward/Conclusion barks/dreamer realisation

conversation: Cast/Declan Ward/Conclusion barks/dreamer realisation

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation

speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation
speaker: Father Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation
speaker: Father Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Sinnott conversation
speaker: Father Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Bridge Game  - Sinnott

en: No, I arrived the following day.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Bridge Game  - Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Talks schedule - Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Talks schedule - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: My mass will offer you another flavour of escape should you need it.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Talks schedule - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw you have a mass listed among all the talks taking place.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/events schedule - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I am on a mission from God, Mister Ward, and it does not involve 'entertainment'.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hiring telegram - Sinnott

en: [ LIE ]

en: More of a private eye. For those who feel they

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Photo of Miss Deane - Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Photo of Miss Deane - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Anybody in particular?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Photo of Miss Deane - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Vial of Poison - [name]

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Urn - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Cremation is... generally frowned upon as a burial rite here.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Urn - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I fail to see why, the vessel is irrelevant.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Urn - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré's friend was cremated - not something I've seen before. Choosing to be burnt rather than buried is beyond me.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Urn - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I hope his friend finds some peace in their next go-around.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letters from Mister Doyle  - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Why do you have these? They are none of your business.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letters from Mister Doyle  - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: *sigh*

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letters from Mister Doyle  - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Seamus was part of my flock. He came here for work and eventually removed himself from the church.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letters from Mister Doyle  - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And so our correspondence slowed, then stopped. It is his life, his choice.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Book of Glyphs  - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: An interesting book. Where did you find it?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Notes on Enochian Magic  - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: The language of the angels. It seems as if somebody is hoping to call one down while the veil is thinning. Interesting.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Syringe of Narcotics - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Missus Erickson dropped this? Why would she have it in the first place?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Dreams - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Others who have been here for longer confided their own uneasy nights since coming to this place - long corridors, sigil-bound entryways, and feelings of being trapped.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Dreams - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: A great sorrow is contained here, I think. Centuries of pain. If only it could be released, eh?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Dreams - [name]
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You haven't had any strange dreams since coming here, Father?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Dreams - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I have. On my first night here, I saw an angel flying towards the sun, but never reaching it. I could not see its face, but somehow I knew it to be weeping.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Angels - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Emanations of the one true God, Aeons are perhaps the only true conduit between this realm and the next.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Angels - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Sorry, angels are.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Angels - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about angels, Father?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Ah, yes, the reason for this gathering. This event promises a lot.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: It also promises to raise a lot of questions about faith should any of these claims prove to be true, even slightly.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What can a spirit tell us of Heaven and Hell? There is a reason they've been left to wander this mortal realm like a wispy Judas, after all. They've not seen the face of God.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Can you imagine, Mister Ward, how the average person would react to these things?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Not well, Mister Ward, not well.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What would a man of the cloth want from a séance of this sort?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: There is more to be done here than speaking with a memory from history.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Such pointless pursuits stop us from true freedom, true Ascension.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And now, I see I have already lost you...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What business does he have at a séance?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you don't mind my asking, Father, what has you at an event like this one?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: If I was to tell you, child, you would not, could not believe me.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Grand Séance - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: The truths I bring are too vast for the minds of most.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Guest sign-in times - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What a strange thing for you to have recorded.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Marraige talk - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Please, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Marraige talk - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: It's no concern of mine if she marries or spends the rest of her days living with her chaperone.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Marraige talk - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I have a few days' freedom from the gossiping of my congregation. Let me have it.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Edward Blake - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: There is no hell save for that which men like him create.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Haunted - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Even I have to admit that I try not to walk dark paths alone at this time of year.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Haunted - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: A place as old as this, with as much history and blood as has been spent here, doubtless has some dark sorrows stuck to it.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Freemasons - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: A pointless organisation. Power-hungry boys oblivious to any real truth.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Second Sight - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Miss McLeod's gift? I would like to speak with her, then. I've heard of it before, but never spoke to anyone thus blessed. I would like to know what secrets she is privy to.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Bedroom master key - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And why, pray tell, do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Occurances - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: This place is not without its, eh, unusual quirks. But there is not much here that I haven't encountered before elsewhere.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Occurances - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you experienced anything strange since coming here?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Occurances - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Yet.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Strange Occurances - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I am hopeful that something truly unique can be found here.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letter to manager - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Ah. Bishop Donegan is an unwavering man, one who enjoys the bit of faux power his title gives him. And the Magdalene Laundries give him plenty of that.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letter to manager - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: No, Mister Varley would be best off forgetting about this child. He'll get no answers from Donegan or the church.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letter to manager - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I wonder who the mother is. Or rather, I suppose it is rather obvious.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letter to manager - [name]
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this letter for Mister Varley - why would the bishop be writing to a hotel manager?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letter to manager - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: To think one serves God by punishing women for having children. That somehow, it is good and just to separate mother and child.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Letter to manager - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Like much of Catholicism, it does not line up well with the teachings of Jesus Christ.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Statement: Cathal - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And has she been seen since? I don't recall when I last saw her, but then again, I wasn't exactly looking for her either.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Ritual Markings - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen markings like these before, Father?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Ritual Markings - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: A sigil. It's not yours, I take it?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Ritual Markings - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, I've never seen anything like it before. I found it while exploring this place.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Ritual Markings - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Hmmm... I don't know what this one does, but be careful. If an occultist is leaving these around, they are likely up to no good.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mysterious figure in window - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: The Blake boy, yes? I'm told young Walter rarely leaves his room since the accident.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mysterious figure in window - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Certainly not when there are guests. He just sits up there, watching.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Fae - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Of course, I don't believe in them.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Fae - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Faith is an interesting and complex thing, yes?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Fae - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you hold any truck with the idea of the fae?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Fae - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: But, even I try not to walk dark paths alone at this time of year.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Bridget - [name]
speaker: Varley
en: To me, she's no Goddess. She's Saint Brigid, one of Ireland's patrons.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Arrival conflict - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Yes, I was here the night before I signed in. I wanted to get the lie of the land, so to speak, of who was here and what was happening.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Arrival conflict - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: The large man is Mister Higgins, a local man of the church, who accompanied me and with whom I stayed that night.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/The Old Gods - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Ah, the old pagan gods. I think of them as humanity's attempt to understand God's thirty-two aeons and their domains. Sorry, not aeons. angels...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Statement: Arwa - [name]
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Ah, yes, I was asking the groundsman to show me the graveyard. I find them to be fascinating places. Perhaps because of my line of work...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Father, I was wondering if I might ask something of you.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: ...I couldn't tell you without knowing what it is you'd ask of me.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The cook, Miss Murphy, has a little girl who was taken into custody by a Magdalene Laundry shortly after her birth.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She is anxious for news of her. I said I would ask on her behalf.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: ...There is so much suffering in this life, is there not? Why is it that God allows a child to be taken from her mother? Is that bond not God's plan? Is it not sacred?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I would end her suffering, all suffering,  in my own way.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What you ask is outside of my power or influence. At least as you would ask it.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What agents of the divine are we, that we would do something so vile?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Are we agents of the divine at all?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: But that is of no use to her, here, now. No, I'm sorry to say that she will not see that child again by conventional means, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: But we are surrounded by unconventional people, are we not? Maybe one of them has a way to see what cannot normally be seen?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/photo of Miss O'Connor's Child  - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Now, go with God and help that poor girl.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about exorcism?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I am a man of God. Of course I know how to expel the Devil and all his agents.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: But before you ask me to do one - not that one would suffice for this forsaken place - they require permission and great effort.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I have never put much stock in the former, but I have no time for the latter.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I suggest you find somebody well outside the reach of the Irish Catholic Church.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Exorcism - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: So, assuming you are on some form of mission from God, you would need to find another accomplice.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Cigar burns - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I do not smoke. It is a weakness of character, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the ball last night, Father?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I was. I assume you, too, ingested whatever we were given?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I did, but not knowingly.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: You may save your confessions. You saw then? The pretence was dropped - we saw through this Black Iron Prison and saw reality for the hell it really is!

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Would that they understood what we've witnessed, then we could all turn our efforts to freeing ourselves!

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hedonistic Gala - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Alas, for them, it was all party games, and so they remain lost.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Trying to talk with Sinnott - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I believe Miss Murphy wished to speak with you.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Trying to talk with Sinnott - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Well. Then she should do so. I am ready to receive her.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Trying to talk with Sinnott - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: But... I do not think she will ever be ready to come.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Badly Written Note - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this note outside your door, Father - does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Badly Written Note - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I am afraid I cannot make out much of it. Hopefully, whoever sent it will follow up by... more comprehensible means...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hauntings - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything to that effect?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Hauntings - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: It does seem to be harder for spirits to leave here. I suspect something of greater spiritual magnitude keeps them from leaving.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Deane's Room - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Deane's Room - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Miss Deane? I don't think I have met her. Certainly, I have no idea where she might be staying.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have spoken with Mister Doyle.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Oh?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I know you two were working on something here at the manor, but he has decided to remove himself from the task.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: He asked me to pass this message on to you.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I see... I suspected as much. I... knew him, you know. I married his parents and baptised him as a baby.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: He was a good boy, a devout boy. I asked him to help with... some church business, but I did not know what this place would do to him.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: He is changed. Lost. I see that now and accept I did that to him by sending him here. I understand and respect his need to be free.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Hopefully, he will return in time, on his own terms.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And your task?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I will try to carry on alone, I suppose. Humanity will not save itself, and Jesus had no company up on his cross.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Mister Doyle's Request - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: We shall see.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Shadowy Figure - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have seen a large, shadowy figure stalking the grounds - what do you make of this, Father?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Shadowy Figure - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Aha! I knew it! There is an Aeon here. How it got here, I do not know, but I shall find it!

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Shadowy Figure - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: *Ahem* You'll have to forgive me, child. I lost the run of myself for a moment. This place has us all on edge, no?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Martyr - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your task - have you decided what to do now?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Martyr - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Without Mister Doyle, it will be hard, but I shall have to carry on alone.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Martyr - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: He may have succumbed to the Demiurge's tricks but that is all the more reason to push on and free us all, no?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Martyr - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What choice does one really have?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/aeons - soinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about Aeons?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/aeons - soinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Aeons... The closest thing you likely know is an angel. On many levels, they are similar. Beings of creation sent by Monad - God - to build the universe.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic bible- Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have discovered a Gnostic bible, Father - would you know what that means?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic bible- Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Did you now...? Gnosticism is a... an old branch of Christianity. It bears many similarities, but its faithful know, believe they know, the true nature of reality.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic bible- Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And hope that the knowing of that truth will allow them to find a way to enter the Kingdom of Heaven - the true Kingdom of Heaven.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Death Certificate - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Death Certificate - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What else do you expect me to say, other than somebody has recently died?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Death Certificate - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: My condolences, et cetera, to Miss Barbosa.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic research - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I finally think I understand Gnosticism, Father.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic research - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Perhaps the topmost layer, child, but I am happy for you.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic research - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Next comes believing it, then the clarity and freedom that it brings.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/gnostic research - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: In time, you might find a way out.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Correspondence - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Mister Doyle? Outside of this event, this place?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Correspondence - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: What an odd question. What makes you ask that, I wonder? Hmmm...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Correspondence - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: *sigh*

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Correspondence - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Seamus was part of my flock. He came here for work and eventually removed himself from the church.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Correspondence - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And so our correspondence slowed, then stopped. It is his life, his choice.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/sinnott sequence - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Father, I found these symbols and was wondering if you knew what they might mean?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/sinnott sequence - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: These are... alchemical symbols. Used - in theory - to unlock the fundamental nature of the universe.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/doyle's lockbox - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is no way to safely discuss this with him.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/prison - soinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about the Black Iron Prison?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/prison - soinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/prison - soinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: All of this - life - is the Prison. This realm, filled with material trinkets and lurid flesh, built to distract us from the truth, from enlightenment.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/prison - soinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Hell is real, Mister Ward, and we are in it.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/aeon killing sigil - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This sigil, Father, what would you have me do with it?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/aeon killing sigil - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Carry on as you are. If you find the Aeon, release it. Save us all, child.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Coded Papers - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Father, I was wondering if the pattern on this paper means anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Coded Papers - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: ...No. But I would not toy with its creator, my son.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Coded Papers - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: They are hiding something, certainly. I suggest you don't find out what it is.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Perhaps something there can inform my sermon tomorrow morning. That is in the drawing room at 12pm, should you seek some... absolvement.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: With my mass done, I think I shall rest a while.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has anything piqued your interest this Saturday?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have anything planned this Sunday?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: The Marquess' talk on the manor at 11am seems of interest. Otherwise, I intend to check out the rot.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Rot?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Others call it history. It is inevitable in old houses like this. Bewitching.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I shall spend the day perusing the grounds. Let us see what story this rot tells.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And there is the silent dinner at 8pm. Perhaps a slightly Pagan tradition but a harmless one - I think I shall attend.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Other than that, I will spend the day blessing the halls before the séance at 9pm.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: As for Sunday...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Then Mister Coventry is talking about the region's history, and I plan to be there.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: And there is the silent dinner at 8pm. Perhaps a slightly Pagan tradition but a harmless one - I think I shall attend.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/Timetable - Sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: Other than that, I think I will rest. Certainly, I intend to be asleep by the time the séance begins.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/catacombs - sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What brought you to the catacombs?

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/catacombs - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: ...I suppose you have me over the proverbial barrel. You might think this very strange, Mister Ward, but I am searching for something...

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/catacombs - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: An entity called an aeon, though you might think of it as an angel of sorts. I believe one resides here on the grounds.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/catacombs - sinnott
speaker: Father Sinnott
en: I am hoping these catacombs will lead me to it.

conversation: Cast/Lorcan Sinnott/Evidence Presents - Sinnott/enochian - Sinnott
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Enochian magic?
