en: There is a well-stocked library, a bar, and a drawing room for relaxation, which includes a variety of games and records for your entertainment.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Sadly, the bathhouse is closed at this time of year. The water is too cold to heat.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Is there anything else out here?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there much to do outside the manor?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Refreshments can be requested on the patio. Many of our guests enjoy walking the grounds, and there is a Hedgemaze for your enjoyment. Mister Hunter also offers horse riding sessions, though I believe those are now booked out.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: But if you're asking if there is anything outside of the grounds, no. Gauford, the town you took the carriage from, is our closest point of contact.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'm afraid this is not Dublin.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I am sure you will find the hotel offers everything you could need during your stay with us.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/A Map of the Region - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Finally, we now have the telegraph room up and running again, should you wish to reach out to friends or family.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley, could I ask you to send a telegram on my behalf?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Certainly.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Who is the recipient, and what is the message?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The local carriage service, to ask if their services were employed by someone here late last Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ... I see.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Do you need another message sent?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I do not. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Do you need a telegram sent, Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Not right now, no.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Asking to write telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Follow me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Telegram results - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: There.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Telegram results - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The carriage service says that they received no message from us on Tuesday evening or night.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Telegram results - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: If that's all, I have work to do.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/washer woman - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I can assure you that our facility has a full laundry. Nothing is washed in the fountain.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/washer woman - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You will think me quite mad, Mister Varley, but I saw a woman washing something in the fountain.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/washer woman - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Perhaps you saw... a bean nigh?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/washer woman - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It would be fitting for the time of year and the gathering here - though unfortunate for whoever's clothes were being washed.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/washer woman - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...there are entries on the bean nigh in the library, along with many more potential apparitions.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like you've gone to some trouble with this event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: This séance is the first of its kind. It seemed prudent to put some expense into the event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you follow these sort of spiritualist beliefs yourself?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: No. I simply run the hotel. Such notions are beyond my station.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What makes this séance distinct from any other?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: A typical séance allows only limited communication with a ghost. Limited in that a medium is needed - a host, a device, et cetera.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It's believed that, at the right time of year, with the right collection of people gathered, a more direct form of communication could be achieved.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: As I say, that is the belief. Whether you believe it, Mister Ward, is up to you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you really suppose this séance will be distinct from any other?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Well, I simply run the hotel and would not be the best source for an in-depth explanation, but I will try my best.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance flyer - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: And so those people have been gathered here at Samhain, where and when the veil is thinnest, to see if that is true.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Signature - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw that a Miss Deane signed in about a week ago.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Signature - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I do not wish to discuss another guest's affairs, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Morse code book - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: We use such a guide to translate telegrams via the telegraph machine.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ines' Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Where did you find that?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ines' Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It had fallen to the floor in the lobby.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ines' Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I see. Well, I'll make sure that Miss Barbosa receives it.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Courtyard statue - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's quite the statue you have out in the courtyard.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Courtyard statue - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Indeed. It's been there almost as long as the house itself. Though what the subject is, I am unsure.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Blake family portraits - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The portraits in the hallway, they're all of the same Blake line?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Blake family portraits - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: They're of Marquess Blake's ancestors, yes.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Blake family portraits - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: If the ancestry intrigues you, you might ask the Marquess himself. He would know best.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Portrait of Edward Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Edward Blake was the one to build this manor, over two hundred years ago.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Leaving letter - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Leaving letter - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She did. She is, after all, free to do as she likes.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The staff say Deane left - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So Miss Deane isn't here anymore?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The staff say Deane left - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She left her payment and a letter excusing herself last Tuesday evening.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The staff say Deane left - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She didn't sign out in person?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The staff say Deane left - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I would assume she meant to, but had to leave at an hour when no one was attending the front desk.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manor contemporary history - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about the manor?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manor contemporary history - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Well, it was built in the mid 1600s on land awarded to Edward Blake for his part in the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manor contemporary history - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Marquess Jonathan Blake is the latest in the line to hold the title, with him and his son, young Master Walter, being the last two members of the line.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manor contemporary history - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It has since been passed down through the generations of the Blake family and has survived any number of tragedies.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manor contemporary history - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: That's all I could say, though I suspect there is more information in the library, should you care for more.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manor contemporary history - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It was the Marquess' initiative to open the manor as a hotel in 1870 to pull the place through the difficult post-famine years.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ghosts - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to get reports of... ghosts, from your guests?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ghosts - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: If you mean to tell me you've seen some waif wandering the halls, or a figure in the garden, you would not be the first.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ghosts - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The manor seems to inspire that sort of story.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance's purpose - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you really suppose this séance will be distinct from any other?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance's purpose - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: A typical séance allows only limited communication with a ghost.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance's purpose - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It is believed that, at the right time of year, with the right collection of people gathered, more direct communication could be achieved.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance's purpose - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ... As I say, that is the belief. Whether you believe it, Mister Ward, is up to you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Soiled telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Where did you get this? And what on Earth happened to it?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Soiled telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It was on the floor of the lobby. I assume it had fallen off the front desk.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Soiled telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: But where did the ink... Ugh. Thank you, Mister Ward. I'll... see about this.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Another Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: One of the other guests mentioned meeting another Blake in London. Would you happen to know of any of the Blake's relations in the city?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Another Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I wouldn't. The family's business is, with respect, not my concern.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Another Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Besides, I imagine there are a great many Blakes unrelated to this Blake family.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ritual markings - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, I found some evidence of a ritual upstairs. In the room that was Miss Deane's?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Ritual markings - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You did? Ugh, as if there weren't enough places for such things... I'll see that it's cleared up.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Cathal saw Deane - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara tells me he saw Miss Deane late Tuesday night, and that he had the impression she'd been drinking, at that.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Cathal saw Deane - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I cannot speak to what Mister O'Meara did or did not see... but I will not discuss any gossip about the guests.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Waiting on telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was speaking with Miss Barbosa, and she suspects the porter may have misplaced a telegram for her.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Waiting on telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I certainly hope that's not the case. I'll double-check that it's not around here somewhere just as soon as I'm able.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Bedroom skeleton key - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: For the love of - who gave you that?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange occurences - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been noticing some strange goings on around the manor...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange occurences - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Don't concern yourself. I suspect most occurrences are just a matter of exaggerated stories among the guests...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange occurences - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Anything else, is... Well, it's an old house, and no harm has ever come of its tricks.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Locker key - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this key?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Locker key - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: That's a key to one of the bathhouse lockers. Would you return it to reception, please?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mister Doyle Statement - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle tells me he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone last Tuesday evening.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mister Doyle Statement - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Did he, now? Mister Doyle should know better than to spread rumours about our guests.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mister Doyle Statement - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Perhaps I should remind him.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious figure - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does someone else live in the manor? Only I saw a figure in the window coming back to the house.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious figure - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The residents of the manor are none of the guests' concern, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Fae - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you entertain the idea of the fae at the hotel?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Fae - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: That would be a matter of personal belief.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Fae - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Certainly, the manor's history is tragic enough that if one wanted to, they could find proof to support the theory.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Fae - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...as a result, we do leave out milk and honey. Best to be safe.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I do not much concern myself with the old beliefs, so no.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The old anvil - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the old anvil on the grounds?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The old anvil - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Very little. It has been here as long as anyone can remember... but that's all that's really known.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The old anvil - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: How much is there to know about an anvil, after all?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Goddess Brigid - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the goddess known as Brigid?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Goddess Brigid - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I do not know much about the old beliefs, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/The Goddess Brigid - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Was there a goddess Brigid? I would recognise it as a Saint's name.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Dead end - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that, on Tuesday night, Miss Deane didn't actually leave - she wandered out into the hedge maze, and seemed to vanish from there.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Dead end - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: How does a woman just vanish, Mister Ward? You must be mistaken.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Dead end - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: So I would appreciate it if you kept theories like that to yourself. You are going to cause alarm.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me much about the catacombs under the manor.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Loosely. I've only read of them, despite my efforts to find a way in. They always seemed like it might draw more guests in.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I read a Norman Blake used dynamite to try to open them up in 1834. He died in the blast. I assume he took the entrance out with him, perhaps the entire structure?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Front door policy - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is the front door usually kept locked at night?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Front door policy - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Doors are locked at ten at night for guests' peace of mind.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Bridge Game _Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm told there was a bridge game the other evening. Did I miss out on much?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Bridge Game _Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes. One of the events that was run for the guests. As Marquess Blake was overseeing it himself, I took the opportunity to meet with the housekeeper and coordinate rotas for the following day. I'm afraid I have little else to tell you as a result.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/stall door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You would be best to speak with the stable master about stable matters.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/entertainment schedule - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes. The week's entertainment. Is there a particular time or event you are interested in?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/cigar burn - varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I see there has been some damage to one of your armchairs. A cigar burn?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/cigar burn - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Damage from one of your colleagues it appears, Sir. Some people do not consider, or perhaps care about, the cost of such repairs.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/cigar burn - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: No, Mister Ward. Miss Quinn reported it to me on Tuesday night, after the bridge game. Perhaps she saw the culprit herself, I didn't ask.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/cigar burn - varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You saw it happen?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/cigar burn - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Missus Joyce has done her best but I'm afraid we might need to employ the skills of an upholsterer once the event is finished.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/talks - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I am afraid I don't have any other information on these. You would need to talk with the speakers.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Fixed Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your telegraph machine seems to be functional.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Fixed Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Is that so? Mister Hunter must have slipped in unnoticed and fixed it.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Fixed Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Then you'll have to excuse me, I have messages to send ahead of tomorrow. I will be in the telegraph room should you need me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Fixed Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You shouldn't be waiting much longer for your room, I assure you. It will be ready by midnight at the latest.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: A missing door? Ah, you mean the rumours.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes, it's long been said that Percival Blake walled up a scullery girl after she refused his advances.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: But in the one-hundred-plus years since his passing, no hidden rooms or walled up bodies have been found.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Of course... the missing bodies were not found anywhere else either, so nothing can be entirely ruled out...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Percival Blake was documented as a jealous and bitterly angry man, so it is possible.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Then the same with her fiancé, who came looking for her.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Likely, they fled here for a better life in the, at that time, newly discovered America.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: There's more information on this and other topics in the library.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The door to Room 15, it's... missing?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Missing Door - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Certainly it pre-dates the manor becoming a hotel, so I suspect it was not our Room 15.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hedonistic Gala - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting the hotel to host such a... a party such as that one.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hedonistic Gala - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I understand it's not uncommon for such circles.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hedonistic Gala - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The Marquess was clear that this had to be on par with a London event - at all costs.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would I find you behind reception over the weekend should I need you?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Either here or in the office, for the most part, in which case ring the bell for my attention. There are a few exceptions...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I will be covering the bar for Mister Doyle at 7pm tomorrow evening, so if you need me at that time, that is where you will find me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: And naturally, I'll be overseeing the ball tomorrow evening at 9pm, too.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The silent dinner is at 8pm. While the staff will not be in attendance, I will be outside to... prepare you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I will be covering the bar for Mister Doyle at 7pm this evening, so if you need me at that time, that is where you will find me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: And naturally, I will be overseeing the ball at 9pm.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Finally, the séance is at 9pm and I shall be present.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Then on Sunday...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Then tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/timetable - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Finally, the séance is at 9pm - though I will be in the office working.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Unknown Sigil - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've seen a sort of rune around. It's a spiral with four lines intersecting it, one at the top, three below. Does that mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Unknown Sigil - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'm sure I don't know what that could be. I don't think... No, I don't know.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange Dreams - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've had the strangest dreams since coming here. Is that something many people report?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange Dreams - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I have heard it said.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange Dreams - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's not something you experience yourself?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange Dreams - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I have worked here for nearly twenty years, Mister Ward. I don't often sleep off the grounds, so I could not guess what a normal dream would be for me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Strange Dreams - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: When one spends so much time in a place, to dream of corridors and doors and windows is sadly quite normal.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter to Manager - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand you've been trying to contact the local bishop about the whereabouts of Miss Murphy's child?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter to Manager - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: For all the blasted good it's done...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter to Manager - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: STOLEN?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hotel Finances - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand the hotel is in some financial trouble.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hotel Finances - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It is a difficult task to keep an old house like this in good condition, let alone profitable.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hotel Finances - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'm hoping that with your discovery, that will now be a thing of the past.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Hotel Finances - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Even the business the Grand Séance has brought in does not make up for the cost of putting it on in the first place.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There was a parcel of Miss Deane's money among Missus Joyce's belongings.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: In ordinary circumstances, such a thing would be a sackable offence on Missus Joyce's part.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley
speaker: Varley
en: STOLEN?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: How did you-? No, rather, why did you-?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: But I think, considering the situation, that would be unfair to her.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/parcel of money - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You may give me that, Mister Ward, and I will speak with Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/crib - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there a particular reason there's a crib in the cook's office?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/crib - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes. But it's not one I feel it would be right to discuss with a relative stranger, Mister Ward... if it's all the same to you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Symbol - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this symbol around the place. Does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Symbol - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: No, I don't think... No. It doesn't.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mary Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about Mary Blake?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mary Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Marchioness Blake was a kind woman and a dedicated mother. Her death came as a deeply tragic shock to all of us at the manor.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mary Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The Marquess and his son were naturally never the same. No doubt that is the reason this séance is taking place, now.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Deane's Room - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Which room was Miss Deane assigned when she was staying here?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Deane's Room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She was in room... Hmmm... It seems I would need to check my records.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Deane's Room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She... had a southern view, I recall her complaining about the noise as new guests arrived.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Deane's Room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Though why that matters now that she is gone is beyond me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is the telegraph machine hard to repair?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You will find, Mister Ward, this house is filled with the brilliant and often eccentric contraptions of our age.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The Blakes have a long history of invention, innovation, and, sometimes, aimless tinkering.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Much to my frustration, the workings of this particular device make little sense. It's powered by a battery, of sorts, I believe, but how one makes it work is beyond me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You mentioned the telegraph machine is down?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It is. Likely, the storm shorted the battery.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Terrible timing. I tried to wire up the replacement, but have had no luck.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Broken Telegram - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'll have the groundsman look in the morning.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Shadowy Figure - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley, have you ever had reports of, well, ghosts of giants on the lands?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Shadowy Figure - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Reports? No. All those things - ghouls and giants - have entertaining sections in the library. Maybe there would be something of use to you there?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/12 Luggage Ticket - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you give out tickets for the luggage room, Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/12 Luggage Ticket - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: We do, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/12 Luggage Ticket - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know who owns the ticket for bay 12? I, ah, found a ticket on the floor and was hoping to track down the owner.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/12 Luggage Ticket - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Ah, I see. It belongs to Miss Deane, but unfortunately, her bags are already gone.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Object - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Someone seems to have put a strange object inside the luggage room vent.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Object - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...Did they? Well, I'm sure they had good reason for it, although I can't imagine what it might be.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Mysterious Object - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Thank you for bringing it to my attention. The groundsman will have the tools to deal with this, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Miss Deane's Invitation - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is it true that Miss Deane was specially invited to the manor?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Miss Deane's Invitation - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: If she was, I was not informed. Regardless, we're not liable to discuss that information with guests, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Treasure Map - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you, Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Treasure Map - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...It's certainly a riddle, Mister Ward. Hardly my domain.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Treasure Map - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I see mention of the garden, however. You might ask our groundskeeper.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Chimney Charm - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Chimney Charm - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Ah. My apologies Mister Ward, with all the activities, the cleaning schedule hasn't been as regular as usual.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Chimney Charm - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I couldn't say what it is. It looks like a figurine of some sort made out of sticks and horsehair - perhaps a toy Mister Hunter made for Master Walter?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Witchcraft components - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like they might be components for a ritual or charm of some sort.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Witchcraft components - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I don't know anything about either of those things, Sir, but it seems like something the, eh, pagans might know about?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Arwa's Melody - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I would say that you're free to use the piano in the drawing room, but it was moved last week - out of tune as it was.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Arwa's Melody - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Our finest piano is in storage but the Marquess refuses to move it upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Arwa's Melody - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Hisham told me about this melody she's heard...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Lady Wilhelmina - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...Yes, the centre of one of the odder occurrences from Blake Manor.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Lady Wilhelmina - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'm told she had a sudden and drastic change of character. One day, she was content with her life here. The next she was ordering a carriage to Gauford, taking just a small suitcase.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Lady Wilhelmina - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She never returned or sent for any of her belongings. They're all still down in the basement.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Lady Wilhelmina - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's a spectacular portrait you have of Wilhelmina Blake in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance contract - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'd imagine Miss Mantovani is being paid quite handsomely for this event... am I right?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance contract - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: There are more people claiming to be accomplished mediums than you might think...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance contract - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: But Mister Blake absolutely insisted that the Grand Séance be manned by the best of the best.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Séance contract - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: And it does so happen that the best of the best require paying for their skill.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Saint Brigid's Cross - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There are some beautiful Saint Brigid's crosses about the place.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Saint Brigid's Cross - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes. Missus Joyce has kindly been putting them up for us.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Telegram Discs - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I right in thinking that these are components for the telegraph machine?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Telegram Discs - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You are, but I'd ask you to put them back where you left them, for when I get Mister Hunter to look at it.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Water - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hope you don't mind, but I helped myself to the water that was by the fire.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Water - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Not at all; it is there for the guests' convenience.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter of complaint - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever received complaints about Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter of complaint - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She occasionally inspires some ire... But she's a good woman and works hard.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Letter of complaint - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: While I would prefer she keep to herself more, at present, I have no cause to dismiss her.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Hmmm, I believe Miss Hisham was drawing this, or something like it.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It looks similar to the vase Wilhelmina Blake holds in her portrait in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I have no idea, Sir. I've never seen the actual thing. Likely it is lost.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Where is that vase now?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/vase drawing - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Though I suppose it could have been put into the basement storage along with all her other items.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/rattle - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about a rattle I found?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/rattle - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/rattle - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Probably one of Master Blake's old toys. Nothing to worry yourself over, Sir. You can leave it at reception and I'll bring it across to him in the residence.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/letter to the manager - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Whoever you heard that from has no place to discuss such business. And neither do you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/letter to the manager - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have heard you received a letter from the bishop?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs map - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know what this is a map of?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs map - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It could be... the catacombs under the manor?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs map - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Does this... show a way in?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/catacombs map - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I've seen nothing official to compare it with. Just hand drawings of sections.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/resolution - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What will you do now?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/resolution - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: That all depends on what comes next.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/resolution - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I do not know what to expect from this event - if anything.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/resolution - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Perhaps we will see an influx of guests and everything will be okay.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/resolution - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: But if not, there is money there to keep the place afloat and its occupants safe.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/resolution - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Either way, I suspect we are all long due a holiday...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/gauge - varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is the purpose of the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/gauge - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: A meter for the event, Sir. Something to do with readiness for the séance.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/gauge - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It was custom-made, with no expense spared...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/gauge - varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The Marquess or, perhaps, Miss Mantovani, could explain it better for you.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manager's Research - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: STOLEN

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Evidence Presents - Varley/Manager's Research - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: STOLEN

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Varley - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about yourself, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Varley - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I am the manager here at the hotel.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Varley - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: With the utmost respect, Mister Ward, I think that's all you need to know.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Caitlin - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How is it, working with Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Caitlin - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She is a very attentive housekeeper, and perfectly agreeable to talk to.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Seamus - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Seamus - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: So long as he does his job, I cannot complain.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Seamus - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Do, please, let me know if he proves to be insufficient in his tasks.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Darragh - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you often have to work with Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Darragh - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Other than some direction, we rarely have to coordinate.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Darragh - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: He keeps the horses healthy, the carriage ready, and the grounds well. I could barely ask for more.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinon on Skerritt - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinon on Skerritt - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: No more than any other guest. I can only hope the gentleman finds our hotel to his satisfaction.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Corentine - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Corentine - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Of a fashion - she introduced herself upon asking for more writing paper.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Corentine - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I believe she is most frequently to be found in the library, if you're looking for her.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Corentine - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: And that would be all I am willing to discuss about the young lady.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ivy - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've spoken to Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ivy - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I introduced myself upon her arrival with Missus Lau. I cannot say we've spoken since.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ivy - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...Though it was good of her to patronise us, seeing as, I understand, she had to travel some distance to be here.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ivy - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: We're privileged to have a McLeod in attendance, certainly.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Lan Fen - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Other than introductions? She asked to have her room moved nearer to Miss McLeod's when they arrived, but nothing unusual.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Lan Fen - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Lan Fen - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She is the girl's chaperone, after all.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would that be usual for her?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry, but did you say Miss Deane departed already?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes. Tuesday night. Perhaps Wednesday morning.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Her letter said she had to leave on short notice.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Letter?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Ah... In truth, she took her luggage and left in the middle of the night. In the morning, we found only a letter and her payment at the front desk.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Evelyn - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I could not say, Sir. This was the first time she stayed here.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Cathal - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I presume you've met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Cathal - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Certainly, Sir. Him and many like him.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Cathal - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I had thought we would see a great many Mister O'Mearas at the event, but only the one, it seems.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ines - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much with Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ines - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I have, occasionally, but not much as she asks for very little.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ettiene - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ettiene - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Briefly. It is... interesting to know an event such as this would attract a known sceptic.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ettiene - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Other than that, I haven't anything to say.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Dupré - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Dupré - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I have met him insofar as I meet any guest.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Dupré - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Though I do appreciate he has chosen to stay with us, considering how far he has travelled.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on D'Arcy - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on D'Arcy - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: We have tried our best to make her feel welcome.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on D'Arcy - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I do hope she finds the hotel to her liking - it would be good to get the endorsement of a known author.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Coventry - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Coventry - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Some. He makes no efforts to hide it, so I feel it is okay to say that he is new to this kind of event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Coventry - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I deposited some books on the matter to his room. I hope they are of use.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Hazel - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much with Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Hazel - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: A very... inquisitive woman. Though not as much as yourself, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Hazel - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I suggested she check our library. Are you familiar with that facility?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ruairí - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ruairí - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Not formally, though I introduced myself when he and his aunt, Miss Callaghan, arrived.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Ruairí - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Of course, we would not expect a guest to work while they stay with us - but it is reassuring to have a doctor on the premises.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinon on Carmela - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinon on Carmela - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Insofar as business demands, of course. We're very lucky Miss Mantovani agreed to host the event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinon on Carmela - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Of course, for that sum of money, I do not see how she could refuse.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinon on Carmela - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: *Ahem* Forgive me.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Arwa - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Arwa - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It was good of her to travel so far to patronise us.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Arwa - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Her interest in the event is only outshone by her interest in the manor itself.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Fiadh - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Fiadh - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I do. She is a local, after all.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Fiadh - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Were she not so against this whole thing, she might have gotten the job to host the séance herself.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Fiadh - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Which would certainly have been more affordable... *Ahem*

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on O'Finn - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had cause to meet Mister Ó Finn before?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on O'Finn - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Well... he signed in. We met then.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on O'Finn - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I say signed, but... I suppose this scene takes all sorts.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How long have you worked for Marquess Blake?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The manor opened as a hotel in 1870. I came here as a young man and worked as a kitchen hand, then a porter. Eventually, I became the manager.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It was - and still is - one of the only secure jobs in the area.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: My grandfather had worked here as staff for the Blake family decades earlier and pushed me this way.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Walter Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I to believe there is a young Master Blake?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Walter Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It is not my place to discuss the Blake family, Mister Ward - but Marquess Blake does have a son, yes.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Walter Blake - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You can address any further questions about him to the Marquess himself.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Saoirse - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Murphy well?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Saoirse - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She is a fine young woman and a valuable member of our team, and I won't hear otherwise. We're very pleased to have her on staff.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Sinnott - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Presents - Varley/Opinion on Sinnott - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: He doesn't seem to be the especially talkative sort. I can appreciate that.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Hand on Pocket Watch - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you very busy, Sir? I notice you're holding your pocket watch, there...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Hand on Pocket Watch - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: These events do not run themselves. It's, and the manor's, success depend on tight scheduling.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Unhappy Expression - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you alright, Sir? You look rather... perturbed.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Unhappy Expression - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'm perfectly fine. My mind is on the hotel and event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Unhappy Expression - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Cracked Glasses - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to drop your glasses?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Cracked Glasses - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I... it is nothing, Sir. They are serviceable. I'll have them replaced after the event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Outdoor working clothes - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The groundskeeper, I take it, isn't held to the same standards of dress as the rest of the staff?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Outdoor working clothes - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Considering the nature of his work, it would be impractical.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Outdoor working clothes - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Besides, his duties rarely have him needed inside the hotel, so he is seen by guests less often.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Relaxed regard - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your groundskeeper is a friendly sort.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Relaxed regard - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Mm... so I've been told.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Relaxed regard - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You do not have to engage him in conversation, Mister Ward, if you do not want to.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Scent of whiskey - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I thought I caught the scent of whiskey talking to Mister Skerritt, earlier.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Scent of whiskey - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: You may well have done it, it's not of my concern one way or the other.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Cross around neck - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take Missus Joyce to be quite devout.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Cross around neck - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She is. Other than that, however, I do not feel it's my place to comment.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Open, eager pose - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce is quite the friendly sort.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Open, eager pose - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I assure you, you do not have engage her in conversation if you don't want to, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Sly, knowing smile
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Missus Joyce take interest in the guests?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Sly, knowing smile
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Rather too much, yes.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Sly, knowing smile
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Feel free to ignore her. Really.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Dressed well, not expensively - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've noticed, while Mister O'Meara is very well dressed, the fabric itself is quite modest.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Dressed well, not expensively - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Hm. If that's so, then I will only say I appreciate the young man's patronage of our hotel, considering.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Sunken, red eyes - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've noticed Mister Doyle is quite red around the eyes. Is he alright?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Sunken, red eyes - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I'd imagine it's an issue of lack of sleep, which is entirely his issue.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Shaky hands - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is Mister Doyle well? I've noticed his hands seem to shake.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Shaky hands - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Hm. As far as I know, he's fine. That's not out of the ordinary for him.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Notebook - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Mister Toussaint is seldom without that notebook of his.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Notebook - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Indeed. While he is well within his rights... I hope it doesn't disturb the other guests.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Notebook - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I can't say I was expecting someone to take minutes of the whole event.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Scent of antiseptic - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I get the scent of what I think is antiseptic off Doctor Callaghan.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Scent of antiseptic - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Well, the man is a doctor.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Scent of antiseptic - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: It's good to have one on the hotel grounds, on the off-chance the need for medical care should arise.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Dusty clothes - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Coventry seems to have caught himself on something... there's dust all over his clothes.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Dusty clothes - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Yes, well, we provide a laundry service, should he wish to avail of it.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Tense body language - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Erickson seems to be on edge.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Character Analysis - (to) Varley/Tense body language - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Perhaps the lady might benefit from a visit to the bathhouse, or a drink.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed a Miss Deane's name signing in, does that happen to be Evelyn Deane?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...It is. Rather, it was. I'm afraid she's not staying with us any longer.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Were you hoping to meet her?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I see you are busy for somewhere so remote. Though it seems quiet around here.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The séance has brought a great many visitors, it's true. Most have retired early to be ready for the weekend ahead.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was. She's left already?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Can I help with anything else?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Ah yes. The séance.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Indeed. The, eh, séance...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Why are you here? - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: She has, yes.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of chapter one
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Your room is ready.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of chapter one
speaker: Mister Varley
en: If you'd care to follow me...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of chapter one
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Mister Doyle has taken your luggage ahead.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of chapter one
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of chapter one
speaker: Mister Varley
en: The porter shall meet us there.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Taking you to your room
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Right this way, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Taking you to your room
speaker: Mister Varley
en: If you head up the stairs, the porter will show you to your room.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I can't believe it. I'd hoped it really existed, of course, but...

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I owe you a great debt, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wouldn't want to put another on you, I think you've already had your fair share.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I believe you've been given the blessings of the woman who hid the money, too. I think now you just need to put it to good use.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I most certainly will. Thank you. Sincerely.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Sir?

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Never risk another guest's life. Not for any reason. I will find out, and I will have this place shut down.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/End of quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: ...Understood.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Ward in room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Mr. Ward, this is a private office. I must ask you to leave.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Ward in room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: I don't recall inviting you here Mr Ward.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Ward in room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Mister Ward! Guests are not permitted in the manager's office. Kindly remove yourself.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/Ward in room - Varley
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Mister Ward, this is still my private quarters. I would kindly ask you not to enter this room.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/come to the office quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley, it appears you were right about that lost... cache.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/come to the office quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Hmmm. Let's discuss this further in my office.

conversation: Cast/Vincent Varley/after quest dialogue
speaker: Mister Varley
en: Now, if you would excuse me. I have plans to make. Perhaps I'd best work while the séance happens, to take advantage of the Marquess being distracted. Everything should be in order already, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, hello there! I don't recognise you... We haven't met before, have we?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: We haven't. I'm Declan Ward, Miss...?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Missus. Missus Erickson. Hazel, if ever we should get so friendly.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: And who are you, then? Are you new blood?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I suppose I am. Declan Ward, Missus Erickson, at your service.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Very pleased to meet you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Ward. What troubles you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I won't bother you anymore, Missus Erickson.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Goodbye, now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I... how could you possibly...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Can you... read minds? Or did you let yourself into my room to rifle through my belongings?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, I won't. I'll have my heart, my powers, my soul, and all you'll get by saying something is a nasty dealing with when I have them.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Bad news for both of us, then. You can't say anything without giving yourself up as a thief. And who would believe you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Whatever it is, you're no mystic, so there is no way you can understand. To know such secrets exist, such wonders to see.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: And to be kept from it by some... abnormality! What's the reason? I've put the work in, and nothing! Am I a soulless freak? Is that why?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Am I to be punished in this life and then again for eternity? Would you sit by and do nothing?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Stay out of this, Mister Ward, if you have any sense.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'm a medium by trade, so naturally I had to come to this gathering. I'm hoping to pick up some new skills before the end.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Again? What else could you possibly want with me?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Hazel conversation
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Ward - surely we have nothing left to discuss?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/OnQuestCompleted
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Now. I would really like to be left alone. I have a lot to think about.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hiring telegram - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: What's this?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hiring telegram - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'm sorry, do you mean to tell me a woman has gone missing at this thing?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hiring telegram - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Then what are we all doing here? Doesn't anyone care?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Money - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Come on, now, Mister Ward. What reason have you to give me that?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Photograph of Deane - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Photograph of Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: That's... I know her face, let's see...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Photograph of Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Annabelle... No, Evelyn. Evelyn Deane, isn't it? I think we've met, though I don't know her well.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Bottle of alcohol - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I've no need just now, Mister Ward, but thank you.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Since you are versed in the subject - can you explain what makes this séance different to any others?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Of course! Traditionally, a séance has a host, a medium. That medium acts as a vessel for the spirits to commune through.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What brings her to the Grand Séance?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Most of the people I've met here seem to have a particular interest in the supernatural. Would you be one of them?
