conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Ah-hah! I do. My poison is Spiritualism, Sir. Communing with the dead. Humanity has always been fascinated with the whole idea of what lies beyond death.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But there are some lucky few of us, with the right gifts and mentorship, that mean it is not impossible, as people would have you think. Not at all.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's said it will have more reach than one magician could ever dream of. And so, perhaps, more answers. Or so we hope.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I do love events like this... to be among like-minded company. Do keep an open mind, won't you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But... so often that only provides more questions. And this séance promises to be quite the landmark in the field!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Is she here for the Séance?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you attending the Séance?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: How could I not be? I wouldn't take myself to the middle of nowhere for just anything.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: And the Séance! I've been looking forward to this for weeks. What an event!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I've been to many a séance before, of course, but not one hosted by Miss Mantovani. And I hear there are some other interesting people here, too.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: So yes, I'm here for the Séance. How could I miss a thing like that?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems this event is a lot more welcoming than some other social events.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Not to put too fine a point on it... But the headline act wouldn't even be here if this were one of those 'Gentlemen's' events. Imagine!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Guests ask the ghost, and it communicates back through the medium - hence the name.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Here, Miss Mantovani intends to try a new technique that will allow us to talk to the ghost - and they to us - directly.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Séance advert - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: This is notable as it would remove any doubt from sceptics and so, could provide answers to some of the fundamental existential questions we humans have!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ines' telegram - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: This isn't for me, Mister Ward. Perhaps you should give it to the woman it's meant for.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Varley's statement - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: According to Mister Varley, Miss Deane left the event suddenly last Tuesday night.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Varley's statement - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Is that so? I'd be put-out, if I were a friend of hers...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Varley's statement - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I suppose, perhaps, she had some sort of family emergency...? Who's to say, really...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hauntings - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A few of the guests seem to believe this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything for yourself?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hauntings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Ward - we would not be here if it were not haunted!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hauntings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I, of course, have seen all manner of ghosts since coming here. I am sure you will soon, too. Don't worry, Mister Ward, they will make themselves known to you!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hauntings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: You know that I haven't, that I cannot.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Séance's Purpose - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you suppose the séance will be successful?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Séance's Purpose - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: In getting answers from someone since passed? I hope so, or what's it all for?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Leaving letter - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane left a letter, it turns out, as her way of leaving.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Leaving letter - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's very abrupt... I suppose she had something to see to.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Ah, this isn't for me. ...And thankfully so, the state it's in.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Who is it for? ...Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I would give it to her, then.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Freemasons - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Freemasons, Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Freemasons - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: No, which is exactly how they like it.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Freemasons - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I have nothing against a little secrecy in these matters... but to only accept men in their ranks? Ugh...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Second Sight - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you know anything about this tradition of the Second Sight?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Second Sight - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Ah, one of the guests is supposed to possess it. What's her name, the Scottish girl?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Second Sight - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Miss McLeod, I think. I've heard her name in London, though I understand she doesn't perform. Quite the gift, if what they say is true.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual markings - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There seems to be evidence of a ritual upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual markings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Upstairs? Why come all this way to an event like this, then hide away?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Skeleton key - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Why the- why the Hell do you have that?!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange occurences - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, I...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange occurences - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've had a few... strange things happen around me in this house. I don't suppose you've noticed anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange occurences - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Sometimes I see the windows fogging up, but only in the one place, as if someone's breathing on them from the other side.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange occurences - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: There's never anyone there.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mister Doyle's statement - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle tells me he overheard an argument Miss Deane had with someone.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mister Doyle's statement - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: There is usually an argument over something or other at these things...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mister Doyle's statement - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I wouldn't say it's necessarily a cause for concern.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mysterious figure - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Coming back from the gardens, I could have sworn I saw a figure in the window. I was wondering if you'd seen him too?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Mysterious figure - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I think so. A child of the family, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Tuatha Dé Danann -Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Tuatha Dé Danann, Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Tuatha Dé Danann -Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I do indeed. They were the old gods of Ireland, thought once to live in the country itself.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Tuatha Dé Danann -Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Although these days, it's said, they're no longer walking this place, and are instead in their "other" world.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Tuatha Dé Danann -Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: And it seems, at that, they have been forgotten.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Dead End - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that, when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she simply walked into the hedge maze... and after that, there's no sign of her.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Dead End - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But that... that doesn't make any sense! How can that be so?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Dead End - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I hope she's alright, wherever she is...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hermetic Order - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hermetic Order - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Do I! I would sure hope so.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hermetic Order - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Let's see, what can I tell you... We're a society of those interested in magic, especially the divine - what you'll hear called high magic.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hermetic Order - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Right now, the Egyptian style is in fashion.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hermetic Order - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: The society is based in London. You should see about it, you know, if ever you find yourself over there.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Bridge Game - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Bridge Game - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: No. My parents were obsessed with the game, so, naturally, I grew to despise it.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Entertainment schedule - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand there's quite the number of events planned for the week.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Entertainment schedule - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: None of them are half as exciting as an actual séance, but I suppose they haven't been half bad, considering.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Entertainment schedule - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Nothing on that list is half as exciting as an actual séance, but I suppose they had to kill the time until tomorrow evening somehow.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Entertainment schedule - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I sense there is a particular event, a time, that you are interested perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/News clippings - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce, it seems, has an interest in the gossip columns.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/News clippings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Not just the gossip columns, but a certain someone...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/News clippings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Ward, do you disguise your true intentions out of distrust, or for the sheer thrill?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/News clippings - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: You could have said! Surely, you don't think I did anything to hurt Miss Deane? I have no cause to at all. That poor girl.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Telegram draft - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Missus Joyce had the mind to send for a detective on Miss Deane's behalf.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Telegram draft - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I suppose something really has happened to Miss Deane, then? She hasn't just fled in some flight of fancy?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Telegram draft - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, I hope she's alright. But, here... Missus Joyce addressed it to a Detective Ward?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Telegram draft - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Why, is that you? Why the runaround, my good man? You could have said.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Locked doors - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems all the guest rooms are kept locked.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Locked doors - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well... yes. But what on earth possessed you to check? Have you no shame at all?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Written complaint - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems the housekeeper has upset some people with her prying...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Written complaint - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Someone finally said something about it? Thank God!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talks schedule - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think you'll attend any of these talks that are being put on?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talks schedule - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I expect so. Not the historical ones, I have no head for that. But the ones about magic, I will indeed be making time for.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Alcohol - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: If you're trying to get me drunk, Mister Ward, you very well ought to think again.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Alcohol - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Alcohol - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Alcohol - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Trinkets - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: How pretty. Thank you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Trinkets - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Trinkets - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Trinkets - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Cigars - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Come now, that's not something you offer a lady!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Cigars - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Cigars - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Cigars - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Laudanum - Hazel
speaker: Varley
en: And for what purpose do you suppose I would need this?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Laudanum - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Laudanum - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Laudanum - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/resolution - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/resolution - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What will you do after this?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/resolution - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: If you must discuss it... Now that I know I am forever doomed, I think I am done with this life.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/resolution - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I will return to New York and my husband and try to find some way to enjoy this joyless experience.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/resolution - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: He will be happy, I am sure. It will free some storage space for his golf trophies.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Flowers - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: You shouldn't have! Thank you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Flowers - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Flowers - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Flowers - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Grimoire - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Aha, there should be any number of interesting things in here...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Grimoire - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Grimoire - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Grimoire - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sweet treats - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I shouldn't... but I will.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sweet treats - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sweet treats - Hazel
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sweet treats - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well! I do think I shall be spending my afternoon in the Drawing Room.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Such an opportunity to commune with our fellows, don’t you think? Between the talks.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: If you ask me, though, Miss Mantovani’s talk at five is the only one worth attending - and so will be the only one I do attend!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I’m entirely skipping the one at three by… I've already forgotten what it is. I think I’ll take an afternoon nap then, instead.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, well, who can be bothered with plans when we’re conducting a séance this evening, Mister Ward? But yes...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: ...I suppose I’ll be in church at eleven and lunch at one. The Doctor's talk at three might be a tad silly but... he's easy on the eye and I love the Irish accent!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Otherwise… I’ll waste the day in the gardens and maze, I think, calming my nerves before the big event.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I hear that’s where they’re holding it, you know? The séance. I can hardly wait!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I want to get some rest in before the ball later!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: And as for Sunday? Ah yes...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I don't think I'd have another talk in me after that, so I'll nap at 5, instead.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/timetable - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'll be in my room at 9pm, too, when the séance takes place. I'm done with all that.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Faith - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There are quite the number of faiths practised among the guests, it seems.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Faith - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, I’m sure. All are welcome, it seems, so long as they believe in ghosts.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Catholic Faith - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Catholicism?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Catholic Faith - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: That is not a question I expected to be asked by an Irishman, Mister Ward!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Catholic Faith - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Where I am from, a great many of the people who call themselves Catholic are Irish.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Catholic Faith - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Besides, I don’t believe I’ll give you any sort of decent answer. The details of religion are not my forté.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Protestant Faith - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know, Missus Erickson, about Protestantism?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Protestant Faith - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I know it’s hard to speak on the topic as a whole.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Protestant Faith - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: There are so many denominations under that label, I would hardly know where to start!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ettiene's Influence - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I’ve gathered that Mister Toussaint is quite influential in these circles.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ettiene's Influence - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: He’s published several papers on the mechanisms charlatans use to ply their trade and taken down a number of very successful people in the process.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ettiene's Influence - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: He is, I think, admired for it.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange Dreams - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I had such a strange dream the night I got here. I was trapped in a corridor somewhere in the manor. Have you experienced similar?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Strange Dreams - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh well... of course, I have... But I... could not discuss something so... personal. I'm sorry. When you are as deeply attuned as I am, these things take their toll.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sylized ring - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this look familiar to you, Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sylized ring - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, of course. It's the symbol of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn. But you are not a member, so whose is it, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sylized ring - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That is what I am trying to ascertain. Is there any way to tell the owner from the item itself?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sylized ring - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, they are not stamped if that's what you mean? The crest is stylised, perhaps you can use that to find the owner?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sylized ring - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I don't know much about these things. I like to wear jewellery, Mister Ward, not make it.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Grand Séance - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the goals of this séance?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Grand Séance - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: What do I make of it? Why, Mister Ward, I can hardly contain myself!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/The Grand Séance - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: The secrets to the universe are mere hours away from us!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hedonistic Gala - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting a ball of that sort.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hedonistic Gala - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, these people, they're not all so dour as they let on, are they? But what a surprising way for you to find out!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hedonistic Gala - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: The drugs had an impact on me, of course, but I presume it was stronger, stranger in this place, at this time of year for anyone who can... see what I cannot.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hedonistic Gala - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Such parties are less unusual than you might imagine. There's quite a number in London and New York... but they are always some sort of surprise.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this symbol about the place. I made a sketch. Does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I don't believe this is anything from my traditions. Why don't you ask one of these Irishmen?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Unknown Sigil - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this sigil - a spiral with four lines intersecting it. Would you happen to know what it is?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Unknown Sigil - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Some sort of folk magic? I don't know.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Deane's Room - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Deane's Room - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: No. I've been trying to find her for a few days. She's a slippery one. If you find her or her room, do let me know...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Hazel's notes from her room
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't think it's wise to discuss this.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Enochian magic?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, it's not my area of expertise by any means, but I just refuse to disappoint.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's a method of communing with angels. Invented in, oh, 15-something or other.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It mostly involves summoning angels or the like through ritual. I believe we have an expert among us, as it happens, in the form of Mister O'Meara.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: That's what they say. I've heard he gets up to all that danger just to speak with his angel again. What a romantic idea.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I haven't asked him if that's true myself, yet, but that's the word about it. He's quite the thrill-seeker, whatever the reason, I know that.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian magic
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is it true that Mr O'Meara gets up to dangerous pastimes?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Confession
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Surely you can't actually mean to kill-

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Confession
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Lower your voice, and say nothing more about it, do you hear me?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Enochian magic?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, it's not my area of expertise by any means, but I just refuse to disappoint.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's a method of communing with angels. Invented - or, discovered, I guess - in, oh, 15-something or other.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It mostly involves summoning angels or the like through ritual. I believe we have an expert among us, as it happens, in the form of Mister O'Meara.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I've heard he gets up to all that danger just to speak with his angel again. What a romantic idea.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Enochian Magic - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I haven't asked him if that's true myself, yet, but that's the word about it. He's quite the thrill-seeker, whatever the reason, I know that.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Investigating Hazel's room - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't think it's wise to discuss this.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Eavesdropping on O'Finn -Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Studying the crash site?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Eavesdropping on O'Finn -Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Hmmm? Oh yes! The poor bird.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Eavesdropping on O'Finn -Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: As was mentioned, it is an omen. I thought perhaps it was best to see if anything could be learned in what remained of the incident.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Eavesdropping on O'Finn -Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Sadly the staff beat me to it, so there is not much to be seen here, I am afraid!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Suspicious lockbox - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I heard the staff mention you had a lockbox brought with you. It must be important to have brought a thing like that so far.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Suspicious lockbox - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh. Well, you know. There are secret... documents to be kept safe.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Suspicious lockbox - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: What is it to you, anyway?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talk down Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Please, Missus Erickson, I beg you to come to your senses.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talk down Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Stay out of this, Mister Ward, it does not concern you.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Talk down Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Stay out of this, Mister Ward, it does not concern you.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Burnt paper - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard it said that some people are simply devoid of magic. Have you heard of such a thing?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Burnt paper - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Pariahs... Yes, I have... heard of this. People for whom no amount of training will open the third eye.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Burnt paper - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's dreadful. Unfair, even. What did they do to be cursed so?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual pages - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think there could be a ritual that would allow a person to steal magic from another practitioner?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual pages - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: How could you...?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual pages - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: ...No, of course not.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/Ritual pages - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I wouldn't know, Mister Ward. I communicate with ghosts. I would have no business with such rituals.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's quite the turnout at this event. Any number of people skilled in the magical arts...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are there any you would recommend talking with, people who's skill you particularly admire?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh well. Miss Mantovani, of course. But she is so busy, she is hard to talk to.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Miss Deane is also a skilled practitioner, though I have not seen her in a few days.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So Miss Deane was one of these people who believed they could use magic?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Perhaps you should talk with the Callaghans?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/List of names - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Or, of course, me!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What would you make of these cards as a reading? 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' cards.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, that depends - who is the reading for and what is their question? You?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It is not for me. It is for Mister Skerritt.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Ah! Well, in that case - the Hanged Man and Death could be an awareness of being in his final years.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: With the Ten of Pentacles relating to what he'll leave behind. It is not reversed, so it suggests he will leave something behind, something of worth.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But that is in his future, or a possible future. If he were in front of me, I would tell him he needs to make a change or sacrifice to reach this outcome.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What kind of sacrifice?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'm not certain. An acknowledgement of sin, an end to indulgence, or the taking of a life. I am sure he would know which...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/skerritt's cards - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: ...Although, knowing him, it's almost certainly not the first two.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/gauge - hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/gauge - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, the measuring device? It's very impressive, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Evidence Presents - Hazel/gauge - hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I think it bodes well for the séance!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ivy - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She's an interesting sort. I've never met anyone with her ability before.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ivy - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Not exactly, anyway - not from some spontaneous effect of her bloodline.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ivy - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She seemed too tired to talk about it. Imagine! Seeing into the future, and finding it tiresome!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ivy - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Varley - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Varley? I tried asking him about the manor's history and hauntings but he sent me to the library instead.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Varley - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the manager at all?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Varley - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Too busy for guests, it seems...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Varley - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Doesn't he know who I am, what I do?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Lan Fen - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Lan Fen - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I have to wonder what someone who studies science wants with an event like this, but I suppose that's her prerogative...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Lan Fen - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I only wish she would stop looking at me the way she does...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Skerritt - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Skerritt - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, yes. He introduced himself to me. He was very interested to hear about my work, of course.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Skerritt - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: We've actually met before, but he doesn't seem to recall.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Corentine - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Corentine - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Once, before, in London. But she seems to like to keep to herself much of the time... and even more so, recently.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Corentine - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Grimoire magicians do like to study... Unlike us spiritualists, they find much of what they need in books.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Corentine - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Though I hear she does formulate her own magic these days.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Corentine - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Either way, I'm leaving her to it.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Caitlin - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Caitlin - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well... yes, though she mostly spoke to me.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Caitlin - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Why the housekeeper wants to know where I'm visiting from, and why I'm visiting, is beyond me.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Caitlin - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She seems convinced that, aside from not being "proper", my jewellery makes me a walking noise complaint.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Caitlin - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Truth be told, I think myself and this whole event are simply beyond her understanding.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Darragh - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the groundskeeper?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Darragh - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: We talked a little on the way up here, but nothing besides the most inconsequential small talk.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Darragh - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I couldn't say much else. He's rather too handsome for a married woman to be making idle conversation with. What would my husband say?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Seamus - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the porter?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Seamus - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, Mister Ward... Do you really expect the porter to show an interest in mysticism? Just from a glance, the complexities of it all would probably go right over his head!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ines - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ines - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I have. She's quite unafraid to speak her mind. That's always refreshing at these high-society events.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ines - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It makes for trouble, but that's refreshing, too.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ettiene - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ettiene - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Even before this event, I knew who he was. His reputation precedes him. To meet him is...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ettiene - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Ah, I don't know. Good riddance to the fakes he's found, but the man's too sceptical for his own good.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ettiene - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: The supernatural exists. Not everyone is lying. What does he gain from fixating on the people that do?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Cathal - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Cathal - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, that boy. He's absolutely fascinating. It's not often I get to talk to someone who has dealings with angels... He might even be the first.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Cathal - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I wonder if he might consider joining the Golden Dawn... They'd be more than happy to have him.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Cathal - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Even with his reputation for being a bit of a daredevil! Now that I say it aloud, I wonder if there is a link between his gift and his recklessness?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Dupré - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Dupré - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: We've talked a little. He'd all sorts of questions about what I do - claims to be particularly interested in the spiritualism of the dead.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Dupré - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I think he said he runs a funeral home, or something like that?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Dupré - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I wouldn't have thought that's a very lucrative job, but he seems to be doing quite well for himself, so I guess I would be wrong.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on D'Arcy - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on D'Arcy - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Not before this party - I haven't seen her in our circles before.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on D'Arcy - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She's an author, as it turns out. Writes those dark and dramatic sorts of novels. I might even have read one at some point...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on D'Arcy - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She seems surprisingly grounded, considering. Even a little sceptical. I wouldn't have expected that.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Coventry  - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Coventry  - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Yes but we didn't speak for long - I came here to talk to my peers, not potential punters.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Missus Erickson.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Why, what do you want to know?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I mean, let's see... I'm a spiritualist. You know that, don't you? Which is to say I communicate with the spirits of the dead.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I started off in the practice back home - New York has its own scene, you know - but I prefer London for its societies.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'm still based in New York, of course - there's to be no moving with my husband's job - but I do spend quite some time on this side of the pond.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Hazel - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: How's that for you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ruairí - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ruairí - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, yes. It's not so often that you meet a doctor at one of these things, but he said something about practising old magic, too.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ruairí - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'm looking forward to speaking with him more.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Carmela - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Carmela - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Met, oh no, not really. Well yes, but...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Carmela - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I've attended talks of hers before, but I'm too starstruck to really talk with her.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Carmela - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She's an inspiration and the reason I've come here.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Carmela - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But will I talk with her? I'm not sure I could bring myself to...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Blake - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Blake - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I have, though I can't say he seems much for conversation.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Blake - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: After all this effort, you'd think he might be a little more interested in his guests.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ó Finn - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Ó Finn - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: How could I not? I'm still not sure what compelled him to show up in ritual garb, but at least it's a talking point.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Fiadh - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you made Miss Callaghan's acquaintance?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Fiadh - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She's much too invested in everyone's business, I'm almost embarrassed for her.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Fiadh - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's not the sort of interest that makes friends, you know?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I have - but you know, I can't say I learned much at all.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: He's enigmatic, which doesn't surprise me - a man of the cloth here? Ha!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Is he here to cast fire and brimstone down on us for our sins?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Could he... Can he do that - actually, not metaphorically?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Sinnott - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh God...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Arwa - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Arwa - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I was so excited to learn more of Egyptian mysticism and the scene there, but she's much more a historian than a mystic.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Arwa - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Honestly I think I confounded her with my esoteric knowledge.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Saoirse - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with the cook, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Saoirse - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I don't believe I have. I'm not sure anyone has? Well, that's not true - I saw Miss Deane speaking with her, but I assume that was to ask the poor child to pour poison into somebody's meal!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Saoirse - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Em, not really, of course...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Did you know, Mister Ward, that certain animals have brightly-coloured patterns to warn off other creatures? That's what they're saying these days.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's too bad Miss Deane's not a frog.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: He was?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Ward, the poor boy asked her to marry him!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She said no, of course - and so publically too. What's a wolf to do with a lovesick puppy?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: No, I said she should be a frog. Presently, she's just a harlot.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Maybe it'd stop the likes of Mister O'Meara from chasing after her tail...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A wolf, then? Not a frog?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Deane - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Only this week - but her reputation precedes her.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Walter Blake - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met the Marquess' son?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Character Presents - Hazel/Opinion on Walter Blake - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: His son? I didn't know he had one! He can't be the social sort.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/White heather hairpin - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm almost impressed that Miss McLeod is wearing flowers in October.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/White heather hairpin - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I suppose they'll be preserved. And maybe some sort of charm...?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/White heather hairpin - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Or maybe she just really likes flowers. Who's to say? Her, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mourning Cameo - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the cameo Missus Lau is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mourning Cameo - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: What's to suppose? The poor woman's lost someone. A husband, I'd imagine.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mourning Cameo - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Perhaps that's why she would want to attend a séance...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Watchful expression - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Lau seems to have a careful eye on the proceedings...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Watchful expression - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She's got eyes that'll cut right through you, that's for sure. I can't say I find the experience pleasant.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mysterious crest on necktie - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know what the crest Mister Skerritt is wearing is?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mysterious crest on necktie - Skerritt
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Why, yes. He's a Freemason.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Mysterious crest on necktie - Skerritt
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Though he might not like you knowing that.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Open, eager pose - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce - the housekeeper - does seem interested in what's going on, even if she's not a part of it.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Open, eager pose - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Rather too interested, perhaps.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Sly, knowing smile - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you get the impression that the housekeeper might have some interest in the goings on amongst the guests?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Sly, knowing smile - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: She would do well to mind her own business. Have a little respect, maybe.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Dreamy Eyes - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Mister O'Meara seem distracted to you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Dreamy Eyes - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: You can't blame a man for having his head in the clouds at an event like this of all things, now, can you?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Shaky hands - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed Mister Doyle's hands shaking at all?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Shaky hands - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: You know, Mister Ward, if I have, I'm sure it wouldn't do anything for me to comment on it. It seems his own business, hm?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Society of Psychical Research symbol - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you recognise the symbol Mister Toussaint is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Society of Psychical Research symbol - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Ah... He's a member of the Society of Psychical Research. Some of them are just fine by me...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Society of Psychical Research symbol - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But I'm not sure I like the society as a whole. Still, it's not like you can stop them from being here.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Notebook in pocket - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Toussaint seems to always have that notebook of his on hand.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Notebook in pocket - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: He couldn't put it down for just a moment, could he? Heaven forbid he let us all relax a little...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Discerning gaze - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Toussaint seems to have quite the eye on things.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Discerning gaze - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: He has to keep an eye out for his work, I know, but for Heaven's sake - who acts normally when they're being watched like that?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Friendly expression - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré seems friendly.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Friendly expression - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, he's a good sort. I'd be put out if the only other American here wasn't up for conversation, so I'm lucky that he is.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Curious tattoo - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you know the meaning of Mister Dupré's tattoo?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Curious tattoo - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: That's, well...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Curious tattoo - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: That is his place to tell you, Mister Ward, not mine.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Large brooch - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know the crest Missus D'Arcy is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Large brooch - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I do, of course! She's a fellow member of the Golden Order.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Large brooch - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Though I don't recognise her face... She must only have joined recently.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Scent of antiseptic - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I do seem to catch the scent of antiseptic around Doctor Callaghan.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Scent of antiseptic - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: That's what it is! I couldn't place it... and I could do without it, honestly.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Tense body language - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you alright, Missus Erickson? You seem uncomfortable.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Tense body language - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: As if to comment on it will make me more comfortable? I'm fine, Mister Ward, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Necklace crest - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can I ask what the crest you're wearing symbolises?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Necklace crest - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I'm a member of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn. It's just a little way to let fellow members know they're among kin, you know?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Spiritual jewellery - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does your jewellery have a particular meaning at all?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Spiritual jewellery - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Oh, not in that there are symbols, or anything of that sort - but different colours and stones are thought to have magical correspondences.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Spiritual jewellery - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: It's almost standard as the mystic's attire. It lets people know exactly why I'm here and what I do.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Protestant Vestments - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it the Reverend’s only here for business, with how he’s dressed.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Protestant Vestments - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: I don’t imagine he approves of all this. Outside these walls, it’s really quite controversial.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Protestant Vestments - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: But we know better, don’t we?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Proud stature - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Marquess Blake carries himself with a lot of dignity.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Analysis Presents - (to) Hazel/Proud stature - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Well, so he should!

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Ward in room - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: ...Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Ward in room - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Hello, Missus Erickson.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Ward in room - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: Mister Varley? MISTER VARLEY! MIS-TER VAR-

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Ward in room - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, don't-

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/Ward in room - Hazel
speaker: Missus Erickson
en: ...Sir?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/ward post hazel confrontation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Good Lord. The woman is insane, desperate, or both. She must be stopped. Maybe Mister Toussaint will have some idea.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/PostQuest - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If this séance has attracted the likes of Missus Erickson, then Miss Deane may be in even more danger than I realised...

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/PostQuest - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was able to make her see sense but I doubt that’s enough to spare her from eternal damnation.

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/PostQuest - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She’s a fraud, an unrepentant sinner, with no regard for the harm caused by her pursuit of power. How many desperate people has she cheated to get this far?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/PostQuest - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can she atone for what she’s already done? That is, if she even realises she needs to?

conversation: Cast/Hazel Erickson/PostQuest - Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Regardless, she’s no longer my concern.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Good day.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hello, Sir. Anything I can do for you?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Hello. Declan Ward, Miss. Pleased to meet you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh! God bless you, Sir, it isn't often someone introduces themselves to the help.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Caitlin Joyce. I'm the housekeeper here.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: If there's anything you need, just come right to me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll be off, Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: God bless you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Nonsense! Lord knows, we could use someone normal at this damnable séance...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Thank you, Missus Joyce. I'll try not to be a bother.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ... Oh Lord. Oh, my sweet Lord, what is wrong with me?! Every moment the witch lives, I sin!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Even Abraham could kill his son for God, Sir! Why... why is it so hard to kill a damn witch?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Could you forgive yourself if it were easy? Is this truly what God intends? Think, Missus Joyce!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Y-You don't understand! She's just been so... kind. And I keep seeing her face.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Except there's wet red down her skull, and the squelch of bone mixed with the scent of iron, so thick you can taste it - and her hair is matted, she's crying and I just--

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But none of it happened! None of it has to!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No - we are godly. But not everyone needs to be godly to be good. Just because somebody is a mystic, that doesn't also mean they are monsters.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I-I want to believe that! But every time I try, it feels like I'm... questioning Him.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So try again. God is steadfast enough for questions, Missus Joyce - and He's good enough to love you when you seek answers. I have faith.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I... Oh, Sir. Oh, you're right, aren't you? I can't do it. I almost... How could I... Oh sweet Lord, forgive me!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Please, take this. It's Saint Brigid's cloth - a brat bhride for your protection. I pray the Lord keep you safe.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Then you're not...?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I-I mean it, Sir. I'll find a way to repent. I don't know how yet, but something will come up - I have faith that it will.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ... Doesn't it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: M-maybe... maybe He sent me an angel? To show me these people aren't savages.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Why the Marquess saw fit to risk our immortal souls, bringing that Satanism here, is beyond me! Why, I've half a mind to...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, don't mind me Sir - just getting crotchety in my old age!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Good. I know this is a lot. I'll be back to check on you, Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hiring telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Someone hired me to see about this young woman... Would you know anything about her?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hiring telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Me? No, no, I wouldn't, Sir. That's not... I'm just the housekeeper.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: All this magic, these strange faiths and secret societies - it's all still very new to me. I don't think I'll ever come around to accepting it all.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How are you feeling now?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But, I can see now that it's not all wicked. Some are just another way of looking at the world.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I don't understand or trust this magic, but my cousin in Dublin talks the same way about electricity...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...and I know that's just something that happens, and people with more schooling than I can make use of for all sorts.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: So if magic is just another part of nature, then God must have put it there. And I won't be scared of anything the good Lord provides us.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...and I know that's just our world changing, and people with more schooling than I can make better sense of it all.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: You know, something came over me when you threw that torch, Sir. In that moment, I...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/resolution - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Well, I just knew that being there with you and Mister Dupré, helping that poor girl, was the right thing - the godly thing - to do.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photo of Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know this woman?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photo of Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Her? Oh, that's Miss Deane. She was staying with us just until recently.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photo of Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Was she a frequent visitor?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photo of Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh no, this was her first time.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Luggage - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Mister Doyle will be along to collect that for you in just a moment, don't you worry, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the region - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about the surrounding area?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the region - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: There's not much, Sir, 'cept for the town you would've came through. Mister Hunter used to get supplies there.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the region - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Other than that, it's all windswept plains and the wild Atlantic. Would be romantic if it weren't so cold.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the region - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Now they do deliveries right to the stables! We're getting a big one this Sunday at twelve.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sherry - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, that's very kind of you, Sir!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sherry - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sherry - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sherry - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance Flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it you're not very pleased about this séance, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance Flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not very plea- Sir! I've worked here nearly my whole life, and this is the first time I've ever thought to leave.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance Flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: There's no good to come of disturbing those in Heaven. That's ungodly work.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance Flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'd be gone, if it didn't mean leaving poor Mister Varley and young Saoirse in the hands of these wretches.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's signature - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw Miss Deane had signed in about a week ago.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's signature - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh yes, I believe she got here a few days before this whole event started. Lovely girl.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's signature - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Supposed to be something of a social butterfly, from what I've gathered!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Marriage talk - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I couldn't help but overhear a conversation back in the library. Something about looking a suitable marriage candidates?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Marriage talk - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I had no idea there'd be such a thing at an event like this! Don't suppose you caught who it was having the conversation?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Marriage talk - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It was the young lady from Scotland, I believe.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Marriage talk - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, I know the girl you mean. I wonder which of the gentlemen she's likely to take a fancy to...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Morse code book - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: We use that to write telegrams. Or, Mister Varley and Mister Hunter do, anyway. I don't often use it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Telegram machine - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: If you want a telegram sent, you'd best ask one of the gentlemen on our staff, Sir. They use the machine more often.
