conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ines' telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What's that - did the young Brazilian lady get that reply she was waiting for?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ines' telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I don't know what it's about, but she's been fretting over it for the last day.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Regional research - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about all the research out in the library?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Regional research - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not a thing. I did see, when I was going past, that it's all about the local region.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Regional research - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But what that young woman wants with it, I've no idea.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked door - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice the guest rooms are locked.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, yes, Sir. If a room is occupied, then the guest is provided a key, and we keep the empty ones shut up.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked door - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You would have a master key, wouldn't you, for the sake of cleaning? Could I borrow it? I'm curious to see more of the house.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...No. No, Sir, I don't think I can allow that. It might be one thing if the rooms were empty, but...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked door - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's alright, I understand.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ritual markings - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found evidence of a ritual upstairs. Would you happen to know anything about that?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ritual markings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: These people... Nothing about that, Sir, other than now I have to go and see about cleaning it up!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cathal saw Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara says he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night... and that he had the impression she'd been drinking.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cathal saw Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: There's no shortage of that sort of thing here... but Miss Deane? I didn't think she was the sort!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cathal saw Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Just goes to show how people can surprise you!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Waiting on message - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think there's a chance Mister Doyle has mislaid a telegram? Miss Barbosa is still waiting on one, apparently.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Waiting on message - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, it wouldn't surprise me. I'll remind him next I see him.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Skeleton key - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What on Earth - is that mine? Mister Ward, give that back!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Strange occurences - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've noticed some strange happenings about this place...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Strange occurences - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I knew it, Sir. I warned the Marquess.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Strange occurences - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: This is what happens when you invite a gathering of the dark arts!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Strange occurences - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: We're turning our home into a snake pit? And for what reason, I ask?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Leaving letter - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you aware that Miss Deane signed out by means of a letter?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Leaving letter - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Yes. Some sort of urgent business to attend to, if I remember right - but no word on what it was...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Leaving letter - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Suppose she didn't fancy telling the specifics to just anybody.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane left - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been told Miss Deane left a little while ago.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane left - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That's right, Sir... Late Tuesday night or early Wednesday morning, it was... She must have been in an awful hurry.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghosts - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear tell that this manor is supposed to be haunted.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghosts - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, there's plenty of stories about the place, Sir. Especially the ones I heard as a girl - those were awful.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghosts - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any of your own?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghosts - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, the only stories we have are the ones we tell ourselves, Sir - and I try not to be a writer.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghosts - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Oh, I'm being silly. Whatever it is, it can't be stronger than the Lord.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghosts - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But sometimes, I get a terrible feeling of being watched...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Soiled telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Look at that state of that thing! Who did that?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Other Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the Blake family happen to have relatives in London?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Other Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: None that I know of, Sir, that's for certain.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Second Sight - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Miss McLeod's claim to foresight?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Second Sight - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I wouldn't know anything about it, Sir, other than it sounds near ungodly.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Second Sight - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The future's not for us to know... assuming she's telling the truth.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Second Sight - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'll say nothing about that. It's not my place to speak ill of a guest, and a lady, at that.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locker key - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hmm, that looks like one of the keys for the bathhouse lockers. Best you put it back where you found it - someone will need that.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locker key - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like someone dropped this key in the hedge maze, Missus Joyce. Might you know what it's for?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Statement, Mister Doyle - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle tells me that he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday evening.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Statement, Mister Doyle - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Is that right? I suppose some of the guests already know each other... I wonder what they were fighting about?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Statement, Mister Doyle - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, Sir, do you think it was that Coventry? Lord knows the poor girl was in his room often enough...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious figure - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: When I was walking back into the house, I could have sworn I saw someone in the window. Do you know who it might have been?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious figure - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Ah, now, there's no good to come of troubling yourself with that, Sir. I wouldn't mind it if I were you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Goibniu - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the god Goibniu?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Goibniu - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, I don't pay any mind to all that old gods nonsense, Sir. There's only one God we ought to concern ourselves with.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Fae - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the fae, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Fae - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Best to not invite the Fair Folk's attention at all, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Fae - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But if ever you do... Best be polite, and make sure you don't accept anything - or offer none besides.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: About the...? Oh! Oh, no, and I have no interest in it, if I'm to be honest, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: We know better these days, after all!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The old anvil - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the old anvil outside have a story?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The old anvil - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not one that I'd know of! Suppose no one ever felt like moving it, is all.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Goddess Bridget - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Goddess Bridget - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Dear Saint Brigid, Sir. May she bless us.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Goddess Bridget - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: You know, I think she's always been there for me. I never feel more at peace than when I feel her near.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dead End - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that Miss Deane never left the grounds... but there's no sign of her.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dead End - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But - how can that be? Where could she be if she didn't leave? Are you sure?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dead End - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sure. I'll need to look into it, see if I can find where she is...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dead End - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: You do that, Sir. Someone should.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Front door policy - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you lock the front doors at night?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Front door policy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That we do, Sir... Just in case anyone who shouldn't come wandering by.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/gauge - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Besides being unsightly? Who knows, Sir! I hope he takes it away once this whole ordeal is over and done with.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/gauge - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Could you tell me what the strange device in the atrium does?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Entertainment schedule - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand there's quite an array of entertainment scheduled for the week.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Entertainment schedule - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: There's plenty, Sir! You've missed a few, arriving when you have.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Entertainment schedule - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But rest assured, there'll be something you'll enjoy happening soon enough!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Entertainment schedule - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Did you have a fancy for anything in particular?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Bridge game - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand there was a bridge game held on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Bridge game - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Yes, yes - not that I'd know about it. I left some bottles and glasses out the night before, and saw myself out.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Bridge game - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: If they can flirt with the devil, they can pour their own drinks, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupré statement - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré tells me that he wasn't at the bridge game because Miss Mantovani was reading his tarot for him.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupré statement - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Ah, is that where he was? Well, it wouldn't be my choice of pastime, but I suppose it's not much in the face of a whole godforsaken séance...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Staff area key - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: You shouldn't have that, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found these old columns, with a name circled... My name, as it happens. You really put in the work to hire me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Some sinners are beyond redemption, Sir. But I'm certain others can still be saved.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Miss Deane is simply a butterfly caught in her web.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have to ask... why? You seem truly unnerved by this séance and all its guests. Why help Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I just have to pray that I'll know the difference between the forgivable and irredeemable...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Truly, Sir? I think I'm still trying to understand that for myself - even now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/News clippings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: How much of her nature is hers? How much of it is the devil's whispers in her ears? How... How do I know if a woman deserves to die, Detective?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Drafted telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I must apologise for prying, but I found this letter... It's rather like one I received a little while ago.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Drafted telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it you hired me, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Drafted telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That I did. I thought someone ought to look into where Miss Deane had gone, and you seem to do so well, back in Dublin.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Drafted telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's not my money I hired you with - it's what Miss Deane left behind in her room - but I don't imagine she'd mind.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Drafted telegram - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Without it, I wouldn't have been able to do anything for her. I hope that you can do more, Sir, now that you're here.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Staff innocent - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You mentioned that you don't think any of the staff could be responsible for Miss Deane's disappearance...?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Staff innocent - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I really don't. None of us have any reason, you see. Nobody knew her before she came here, and nobody stood to gain much at all.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Staff innocent - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Besides, nobody's been any stranger than they are usually - I've seen nothing out of sorts among us.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Staff innocent - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It should be that the others will help you, now, if you ask. Now that they know I brought you here.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, I had no idea Mister Varley was still on this! Not many would spare a thought for a mother in her place.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But sometimes the heart goes where it shouldn't, Sir - and when all's said and done, every child is a gift from God.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What our poor girl will do without him...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Poor girl?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter to the manager - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'll not say any more about it. It wouldn't be decent, you understand.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Guest requests - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand the guests have been making a number of requests.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Guest requests - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Ah, you can't mind it. It's our job to make their stay here an enjoyable one.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked doors - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are the bedroom doors all locked?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Locked doors - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'd imagine so - your room key will let you do that, so you can lock yours, too.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter of complaint - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I couldn't help overhearing that there have been some complaints about you, Missus Joyce... I'm sorry.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter of complaint - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I... W-well good!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter of complaint - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: If this lot were pleased with me, I wouldn't be a very good Catholic, now would I?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter of complaint - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But still... Is there anyone you can imagine going out of their way to do such a thing?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter of complaint - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hah - who wouldn't? It all comes down to that Mantovani though, Sir, mark my words!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Letter of complaint - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It doesn't matter which monkey squealed - they're all a part of her circus.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stall door - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems as if the stall door has been recently mended.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stall door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That'll be our Mister Hunter's work. He's quite the handyman.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Talks schedule - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these talks they're putting on?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Talks schedule - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: In my opinion, Sir, those talks are the most good you'll get out of this whole event. You might as well go.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/cigar burn on chair - caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Good heavens, Sir. When I tell you that I've done my wrists in trying to sew up that hole... Weren't it proper, I'd ring his neck!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/cigar burn on chair - caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, I mean... That is to say... No, I'd do it. Those are good chairs, and they'll only end up in the Master's house now. Such a waste.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/cigar burn on chair - caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know who caused it then?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/cigar burn on chair - caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like one of the chairs in the library has a cigar burn.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/cigar burn on chair - caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not exactly Sir, I heard about it Wednesday morning from Mister Varley. One of the bridge players must have seen it happen.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Laudanum - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'm sure this will come in handy somewhere. Thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Laudanum - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Laudanum - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Laudanum - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trinkets - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: How lovely! Thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trinkets - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trinkets - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trinkets - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cigars - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, no, this isn't my sort of thing.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cigars - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cigars - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Cigars - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Flowers - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Now, where did you find flowers so lovely as these at this time of year?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Flowers - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Flowers - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Flowers - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Flowers - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Just luck, I think. If you like them, please go ahead and keep them.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Flowers - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, how kind of you!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Grimoire - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'll have nothing to do with that sort of thing, Mister Ward. Nothing at all!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Grimoire - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Grimoire - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Grimoire - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sweet treats - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, well - I suppose I could be persuaded! Thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sweet treats - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ITEM ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sweet treats - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ITEM ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sweet treats - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Artefacts - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I have no use for this ungodly thing.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Artefacts - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Artefacts - Caitlin
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Artefacts - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems there's quite a number of faiths practised amongst the guests.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Maybe so, but I won't have anything to do with that. I know what I'm about!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Catholic Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Catholicism, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Catholic Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What do I know about it? Why, enough, I should think!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Catholic Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Surely you know enough, yourself?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Protestant Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Protestant Faith - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, I wouldn't be the person to ask about that, Sir. That would be the master's denomination, not mine.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Surreptitious meeting - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that while the Sunday services were being held, Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter were talking in the gardens.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Surreptitious meeting - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Now, is that so?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Surreptitious meeting - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Come to think of it, he mentioned once that he had been a mentor for a girl back in Scotland. Suppose that was the young lady herself?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Surreptitious meeting - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'd never have thought the girl in question would've been of such stock!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Campbell Statement - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The Reverend mentioned that Marquess Blake has been out of sorts.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Campbell Statement - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, he hasn't been himself since Marchioness Blake passed away, poor man...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Telegram machine disconnected - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems the telegraph machine's cord has been severed.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Telegram machine disconnected - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It will have been mice. If something goes wrong around here, it's always mice, one way or another.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Telegram machine disconnected - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The manor can't keep a cat, though - the things always run away!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Horses sick - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The horses have all taken ill.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Horses sick - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: All of them? Mister Hunter said as much, but I thought I'd misheard him! Poor creatures.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Front gates barred - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The front gates will no longer open. It's as if they've been barred.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Front gates barred - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It'll be that a tree has fallen down - Mister Hunter will see to it soon enough.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ms Callaghan's Perspective
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Ms Callaghan is concerned that the doctor's interest in the magic of high society is going to lead him astray from the heart of their practice.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ms Callaghan's Perspective
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What Ms Callaghan does, it's been around a long time. And she's a good, honest woman. I think, if I might say so, the doctor ought to mind her word.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Callaghan Dynamic - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of how Ms Callaghan and Doctor Callaghan get on?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Callaghan Dynamic - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Nothing good comes of stifling a man's pride, you know. Miss Callaghan's a good woman, but she might allow him a longer leash.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/The Callaghan Dynamic - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Or no leash at all, come to think of it! He's a doctor, for Heaven's sake. If he can't make his own decisions, then who of us can?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ruairí's perspective - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Doctor Callaghan's goal of joining the high-society magicians?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ruairí's perspective - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Quite frankly, I don't think there's any good to come of it. You can't blame a man for his ambition...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ruairí's perspective - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But I don't think there's anything worth finding among that sort of practice!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Secret Rendevous - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears that while the bridge game was being held, Miss McLeod and Mister O'Meara were talking in the gardens.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Secret Rendevous - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, now - they ought to know better, the both of them! There's no good to come of sneaking around. People will talk!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Secret Rendevous - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It sounds like Missus Lau isn't doing her job, if you ask me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Varley's bridge statement - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Thankfully, it's only a few of us to juggle. Once a week usually does the trick. Last Tuesday, we got it in while the bridge was on.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Varley's bridge statement - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather Mister Varley leans on you to help with the rotas?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Varley's bridge statement - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh aye. He's very good with a lot of the job, but remembering people's personals? Not so good.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghost of Edward Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Among the other apparitions here... I saw what I think must have been the ghost of Edward Blake.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghost of Edward Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It doesn't do to dwell on these things, Mister Ward, and I...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Ghost of Edward Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, let's just hope that he didn't take any notice of you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce, did you know there are catacombs under the manor?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's a spooky old house, Mister Ward! Can't say I'm surprised to hear it's even worse than I thought.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: How the master can leave a portrait out of that man after what he did to those two...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I won't go near the East Tower less'n I have to!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Even thinking about it gives me the chills. Please, can we speak of something else, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The door to Room 15, it's... missing? As if it's been walled up?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What? No, Sir. It's on my rota, sure!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missing Door - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Reminds me of... Oh, Sir - I wish you'd said nothing. You've brought back a terrible, sad story for me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sketches of strange symbol - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this symbol around the place - you don't happen to know anything about it, do you?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Sketches of strange symbol - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Can't say I do, Sir. I don't - and I won't! - have anything to do with this witchcraft.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance's purpose - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the intent of this Grand Séance?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Séance's purpose - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I can't see any good coming from it, Sir. If the good Lord wanted us to have the answers they're after, he'd have given us them from the start.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you take this parcel of money from Miss Deane's belongings?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, Sir - I hardly had the money to pay you out of my own pocket, now did I?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And Miss Deane was very well off, do you know. I can't imagine she'll mind the cost.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I suppose... You went to a lot of trouble to get this, didn't you? But you didn't even sign your name on my hiring letter.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, this event is very important for the hotel, Sir. If Mister Varley knew there were a detective snooping about the guests!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Parcel of money - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He's just going to have to put up with it now, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Key - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, this key will get me into the private wing of the manor?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Key - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It will indeed, Sir. ...Maybe best not to let anyone see you with it, eh?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hedonistic Gala - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't imagine you host many parties like that masked ball here.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hedonistic Gala - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: How Marquess Blake allowed it, I'm sure I don't know!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Hedonistic Gala - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'll speak no more of it, Sir, please. Shameful behaviour...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mary Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about Marchioness Blake?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mary Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, God rest her soul. She was a good woman, Mister Ward - gone from us too soon.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mary Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The Marquess just hasn't been the same since her passing. He idolised that woman.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mary Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And poor young Walter...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Unknown Sigil - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've... seen this sigil, somewhere around here. A spiral, with a line at the twelve o'clock mark, and three more at five, six, and seven.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Unknown Sigil - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen anything of the sort anywhere?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Unknown Sigil - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Can't say I have, Sir. Not something I'd know about, anyhow, sigils and the like!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there a particular reason there's a crib in the servant's quarters?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What-? How do you know about that? You have no business being in the servant's quarters!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, that's a sad story, there, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Varley
en: STOLEN?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It was meant for Miss Murphy's child, but she never did get to use it before the girl was taken from her.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's an awful business.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What-? How do you know about that?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/crib - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Please, Sir, leave it be. It's complicated enough as it is.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/hotel finances - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand the hotel's in some financial difficulty.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/hotel finances - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It takes more money than you'd think to keep a place like this running. Certainly, it's no easy task!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/hotel finances - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And, as it turns out, séances are expensive things to host. I don't know what Marquess Blake was thinking.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/hotel finances - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: All that stress on poor Mister Varley... Sure, they paid that Mantovani a fortune too!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's Room - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's Room - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Yes, of course, it was room... How odd. I can't remember now, but I was there just the other day. F-for cleaning, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's Room - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: This place, this event - it's all playing tricks with me...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Deane's Room - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Room... Oh... How odd. I was there the other day. Cleaning.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you experienced any strange dreams while sleeping here?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Please, Sir. I'd rather not...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, sometimes I think I'm walking through the gardens - truly believing it. Then, I have this urge to look back at the manor...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...and oh, Sir. I know not to look, but I can't fight it and I wish, how I wish that I could.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The windows - they're all black, save for those red eyes looking down on me. Every window, hiding a horrific figure...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/strange dreams - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Then, thank the Lord, I snap awake in tangled sheets.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard tell of a large, shadowy figure stalking the grounds?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, Sir, I couldn't really say. Sure, this place makes you see things, but you won't catch me looking harder 'n I need to!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Best bet might be to check the library?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What? It's a cruel thing, Sir, teasing a poor old housekeeper!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, don't say that! Please, Sir, if it's children's tales you're after, go hang about in the library.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Unfortunately, I'm... quite serious, Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Shadowy Figure - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, maybe I should... Thank you Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/12 Luggage Ticket - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you give out tickets for the luggage bays, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/12 Luggage Ticket - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: We do, Sir! With all the mix-ups, we had to start numbering the bays to help folks keep track.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious Object - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's strange, but I believe there's something lodged inside the luggage room vent?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious Object - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, for goodness-!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious Object - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Honestly, Sir, I wish some of these guests had half your consideration.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mysterious Object - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And it's no accident, mind! Mister Hunter's fighting fit, but even he can't pry it off without one of his tools.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Miss Deane's Invitation - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I heard Miss Deane was personally invited to the séance. She must be very well-respected.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Miss Deane's Invitation - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Goodness! If she were, Marquess Blake never mentioned it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Miss Deane's Invitation - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Between you and me, Sir, I hope he's ashamed of himself. Can you imagine? Inviting people into a cult...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Treasure Map - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A few of us are playing a game, Missus Joyce, and I fear this riddle has me beat. Does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Treasure Map - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, how exciting! Let's see here...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Treasure Map - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hmm, very clever. It's just an idea, but I would keep an eye out for statues, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Treasure Map - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Statues, you say...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Witchcraft components - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like components for a charm of some sort to me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Witchcraft components - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hm. I'd say those look a lot like the materials Mister Hunter uses to make his little good luck charms. Perhaps you could ask him about it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Witchcraft components - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like components for a charm of some sort.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Witchcraft components - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, good Lord, don't bring those near me, Sir! Who knows what darkness they hold?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Witchcraft components - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: If it's important, ask Mister Hunter. He's thicker-skinned about these things. Otherwise, burn them, Sir, please!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: One of Mister Hunter's little charms. Maybe he dropped it, eh?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: D-Don't just wave it around, Sir! It could be dangerous!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Mister Hunter's the man you want. Always studying up on this sort of thing, he is.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Chimney Charm - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: "Know thy enemy" - that's what he says.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mister Varley's Statement - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley mentioned he was in a staff meeting during the bridge game.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Mister Varley's Statement - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, yes, Sir - I was there too. Better that than serving drinks to blasphemers...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Angels - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you believe in angels, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Angels - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The Lord sends his messengers to care for each and every one of us, Sir - I'm certain.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Angels - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: On the days when my heart is full and my mind is free from cares, I give special thanks to them.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Exorcism - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anyone who could aid me in conducting an exorcism, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Exorcism - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Goodness me! I couldn't say, Sir - though I'm sure there are several people here in need of one.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Exorcism - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Whatever you do, don't ask that American man. They have some very funny ideas about exorcisms over there...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Silent Dinner - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you going to be at the silent dinner, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Silent Dinner - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Heavens, no! I've no choice in helping with the preparations, but you'll find me nowhere near it, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Silent Dinner - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'd be grateful if you'd attend, though. Lord knows we need someone to keep an eye on these sinners and their rituals...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Doyle's Doping - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hesitate to ask, but... would you mind keeping an eye on Mister Doyle? I fear he may have taken to self-medicating.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Doyle's Doping - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, that-!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Doyle's Doping - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Don't you worry, Sir, I'll set him straight. He's a good boy at heart, I promise you. Just needs a little guidance.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Doyle's Doping - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: At least he has Father Sinnott to help him along. Always together recently, them two - I'm sure it'll do Seamus some good.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Their Relationship - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear Mister Hunter is a family friend off Miss McLeod's.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Their Relationship - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He is, Sir! Oh, I do hope he's being careful. Who knows what she's up to?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Their Relationship - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's like he's a doting father with his blinkers on...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missus Joyce's Bible - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me, Missus Joyce, do you have a... favourite bible verse?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missus Joyce's Bible - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh! Well, if you must know, Sir, I'm quite partial to Leviticus. Good wisdom in any of his verses.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Missus Joyce's Bible - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I know the New Testament gets all the attention these days, but sometimes there's nothing like good old-fashioned justice...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Caitlin V Mantovani - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I correct in thinking you harbour a serious hatred for Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Caitlin V Mantovani - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hatre-! Sir, if there were a stronger word, I'd advise you to use it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Caitlin V Mantovani - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Without her, none of this would be happening. She's a spider! Drawing everyone here into her web!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Caitlin V Mantovani - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: At the end of the day, our guests are but poor lost sheep. She's the accursed shepherd leading them astray.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Handcarved Rattle - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You wouldn't happen to know anyone who's missing a hand-carved rattle, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Handcarved Rattle - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Missing a... Oh Sir. That might be Miss Murphy's. Bring it to me and I'll return it. I wouldn't want you upsetting the young girl needlessly.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Murphy has been confiding in me about her child, Missus Joyce. Do you know anything that could help her?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: P-please, Sir, keep your voice down!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Oh, that poor girl has been beside herself.  The Lord certainly works in mysterious ways, gifting her a child with a father like that.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But look, these things happen. I'll not condemn a girl simply for chasing her heart the wrong way.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Especially not one as kind and bright as our Saoirse.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Photograph of the Murphy Child - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not that you'd call him a father. Good riddance, I say! Why our Saoirse took a shining to him--

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Badly Written Note - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this note, Missus Joyce, but I can't make head nor tail of it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Badly Written Note - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Is that a note from... It's her handwriting, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Badly Written Note - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...O-oh, I - Goodness, Sir, I haven't a clue what it says! The scrawl is too messy! Far too messy, yes.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trying to speak to priest - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Murphy is rather eager to discuss something with Father Sinnott.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trying to speak to priest - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I... Do you know, I haven't a clue about that, Sir? But he is a priest. A spiritual teacher of sorts, no?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trying to speak to priest - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: P-perfectly normal for us to ask him all manner of things, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trying to speak to priest - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course... You've sought guidance from him as well, then?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Trying to speak to priest - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...That's between me and the Lord, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How long have you been working at the manor, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh! Well - really, most of my life, Sir. Though I only moved in here five years ago or so, after my dear husband passed.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I wasn't sure about it at first. I was all but shaking with nerves on my first day - we used to tell awful stories about this place as children, you know.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And coming up the road to see the place didn't help, I'll tell you that!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But I've worked here a long old time, now, and they haven't got me yet!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Blake Manor - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Thick fog, black windows and you'd swear there were living things in all the shadows...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this old map, but I am not sure which areas it covers.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: There's supposed to be a hidden trove of gold down there, didn't you know?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Honestly, the things people come up with...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this old map of the catacombs...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Map of the Catacombs - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Might be the old catacombs, Sir? I've always heard stories about those.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Research on Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Mister Varley has taken quite an interest in Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Research on Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, only professionally, Sir, of course! It's his job to know about the guests.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Research on Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I didn't mean-

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Research on Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: You should be ashamed of yourself, Sir! He's old enough to be her father.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Research on Deane - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, what I meant to say is... Oh, alright.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brat Bhride - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Forgive me, Missus Joyce, but what exactly is a Brat Bhride?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brat Bhride - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh - it's a special cloth, Sir. It's laid out at sunset on Saint Brigid's Feast Day, and brought back in before sunrise.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brat Bhride - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Saint Brigid blesses it as she travels the land that night, and sends the morning dew to fill it with healing and protection.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brat Bhride - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's kept me safe all these years, Sir. I truly hope it does the same for you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh! Well...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Let's see...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What does this weekend look like for you, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Any plans for today, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'll be cleaning around the atrium and bedroom corridors for most of the day.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: If I'm not there, I'll almost certainly be in the dining room! Lunch at one and dinner at seven, don't you forget.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: With so many guests about the place, I'll need to be there an hour before each, just to set the tables!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And then, of course, at eight, I'll be preparing for that wretched masked ball in the ballroom. As for tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Other than that, oh, and helping Saoirse with the dinner, I'll be in the ballroom much of the day, cleaning up after you lot...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I've mass in the drawing room at noon, of course, and lunch at one.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...and then I'll be joining Mister Dupré at the séance. Along with the spirit of his friend, Laura. Ha, now that's not a sentence I expected to hear myself say!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/timetable - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...before being forced to attend this awful séance. Oh, Lord, I hope this doesn't stop me getting into Heaven!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa drawing of Vase - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I do! Strange looking thing...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa drawing of Vase - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Apparently, it was around here somewhere, years ago. One of the Blake family - not living here now - it was hers.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa drawing of Vase - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Got it all the way over in Egypt if you'd believe that! We've a painting in the atrium of her holding it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa drawing of Vase - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you recognise this vase?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa's Melody - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Can't say I recognise the tune, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa's Melody - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But if you're looking for somewhere to play it, there are a few pianos in the manor.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa's Melody - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Of course, the finest piano we had was Lady Wilhelmina's, but that's down in storage with the rest of her things.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Arwa's Melody - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've had this melody stuck in my head for hours, and I don't know where it came from. Do you recognise it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Lady Wilhelmina - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Goodness, no - she was before my time! A kind Lady, quite the musician too. Spent all day playing the piano, from what I hear.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Lady Wilhelmina - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Anyway, an odd story that one, Sir. Up and left one day - no explanation, no letter, and left all her things behind.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Lady Wilhelmina - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: They've been stored down in the basement ever since. A shame - such a lovely piano gathering dust in there with all the old boxes...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Lady Wilhelmina - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you ever meet Lady Wilhelmina Blake?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear Mister Dupré is mourning the loss of his friend.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I... Goodness. I suppose grief truly finds us all, doesn't it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And what comfort is there in death for any of these people? A godless man can't pray for a loved one's soul.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: A tragedy, that's what it is, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce... You told me before that you wished to repent for your actions. Is that still true?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh yes, Mister Ward. It is.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: In that case... Mister Dupré is in desperate need of your help.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The spirit of his dearest friend has been trapped inside the manor, and only a worshipper of Saint Brigid can set her free.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Saint Brigid? But she...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I had no idea she cared for people such as them. The Lord truly does have a lot to teach me these days, doesn't He?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Third Aspect - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Yes, Mister Ward. Tell him I'm ready and willing to help. Whatever it takes, I'll be there.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brid - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of the Goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brid - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not that much, Mister Ward. I know she is what the pagan folk think of Saint Brigid of Kildare.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brid - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Now her, I know. The Mother Saint of Ireland. She's the saint of a good many things, from poetry and learning to blacksmithing and livestock.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brid - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: She could lay her hand to anything and master it. What a woman.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Brid - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Have you noticed her crosses around the house, Sir? The rushes - that's to protect you... the, eh, guest, I mean, from fire and other harm.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Saint Brigid's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've noticed someone's been putting Saint Brigid's crosses around the manor.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Saint Brigid's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, that'd be myself, Sir!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Saint Brigid's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: You know, they protect against flames. I thought...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Saint Brigid's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, I thought we could all use some protection, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Vandalised flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this lying about the atrium. Do you know anything about it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Vandalised flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Wouldn't know a thing about that, now, Sir...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Vandalised flyer - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...But they're not wrong, are they? There’s some fierce evil to some of that magic, I tell you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stone cross - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I accidentally stumbled into the broom closet recently and noticed a stone cross on the cleaning trolley.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stone cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: O-oh yes, Sir! That'd be mine, of course. It'd broken off an old statue that was being tossed out and... w-well, I thought it shouldn't go to waste.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stone cross - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course. It is a shame about those red stains though, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stone cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Ah that's only rust, Sir. I quite like it, to be honest with you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Stone cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: After all, Jesus must've bled when he died for our sins.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Detailed drawings - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise the vase drawn here?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Detailed drawings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, I'm not really one for that sort of... Wait.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/Detailed drawings - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Come to think of it, it looks a lot like the one Lady Wilhelmina is painted with. You can see her portrait in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/washer woman - caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What!? Mister Ward, if you are suggesting that the laundry work ain't quality, then I refute it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/washer woman - caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did I see you washing clothes last night in the fountain?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/washer woman - caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did I see you washing clothes in the fountain on Friday night?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/washer woman - caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Miss Murphy and I wash our knuckles to the bone cleaning and bleaching this place - and its linens!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Evidence Presents - Caitlin/washer woman - caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: In the fountain? God, give me strength...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Skerritt - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Skerritt - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...So many of these people, Sir - they're just victims of Mantovani's dark whispers.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Skerritt - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But that one, I think he came in rotten. Too much money, some people. The Lord was clear on moneylenders, was he not?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Corentine - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Corentine - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, all that time in the library can't be any good for her, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Corentine - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The poor girl can't possibly understand what dangers she's filling her head with. And why doesn't she have a chaperone?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Corentine - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's only proper for a young lady of her station, and I don't see any wedding ring... You have to wonder! It spells trouble, if you ask me...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ivy - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I assume you've met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ivy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Apparently, she's the daughter of a laird - which is the Scottish way of saying a lord, as I understand.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ivy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I wouldn't have thought you'd see proper girl like that among such devilish company as this. Just think of it!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Lan Fen - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have spoken with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Lan Fen - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Thank goodness for her, Sir. It does us good to have at least one guest with a solid head on her shoulders.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Lan Fen - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: One less person to keep an eye on!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Lan Fen - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: From what I can tell, there's not a magical bone in that girl's body.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Darragh - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you speak much with Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Darragh - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: When I can. I think it'd be gloomier around here without him.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Darragh - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not that he gets to spend much time indoors with us. I've no idea what keeps him out there so much, certainly it's not keeping the place pretty.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Darragh - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Hedges and gorse don't quite need much tending.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Darragh - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, but I don't envy him in the wintertime!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Varley - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Varley - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He keeps us right, that's for certain.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Varley - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Believe you me, Mister Ward, it's a rare day when you get a smile from that man.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Varley - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But I won't speak ill - he might be dour, but he's a good man.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Seamus - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Seamus - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That boy... Between you and me, Sir, he could do with half a mind more on his work.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Seamus - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Always has that look about him, too, like it's paining him to talk to you. Even more so with Miss Deane - I swear he was sweet on her.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Seamus - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He's a good lad though - good with Saoirse too. The poor girl's a nervous wreck now, but you should have seen her a year ago.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Seamus - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I think he's coaxing her out of her shell - slowly, mind. It'd be a dear thing if he weren't teaching her how to bicker too...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, tell me about yourself, Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, I don't know what's to say, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I came to work here not long after it opened as a hotel.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: The good Lord never saw fit to grace me with a husband or children, so the most of my life's in this place.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
