en: I've got a roof over my head, a warm bed in the women's dormitory, and food in my belly. Could be doing a lot worse for myself, I'd say!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Caitlin - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: My dear husband passed away some time ago, and the good Lord never saw fit to grace us with children, so most of my life's in this place.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ines - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've had a moment to speak with Miss Barbosa, have you?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ines - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That woman is hiding something, Sir - mark my words. Barely a word she has for me!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ines - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And why come all the way here from so far away?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ines - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But at least that Mantovani hasn't gotten her claws into her yet. Or at least, it looks that way...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Such a handsome lad! I can't believe he's mixed up in all this.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Either way, that poor thing is totally out of his depth - I'm sure of it.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I do hope that witch doesn't drag him any deeper into her snake pit.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And by witch you mean...?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Mantovani, Sir, of course! That accursed Mantovani...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Cathal - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I've heard he speaks with angels, Sir. I just hope they've been sent to him by God, and not the devil.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ettiene - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ettiene - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Yes, of course! A scholar, he is - not steeped in the dark arts like the rest of this lot.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ettiene - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Had all sorts of questions for me too, bless his soul. It's nice to have people like you and he appreciate my thoughts.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Me? Oh, well, she...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: She's just a good girl who fell in with the wrong crowd, Sir - mark my words. I've got a smell for these things.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Maybe that would make her think twice about going into Mister Coventry's room every other day.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: A little quiet time with God is all she needs.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But she seems like such a sweet girl. It's a sin we've allowed her to be at this ungodly thing.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Evelyn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I don't know her, of course - it's her first time coming to the hotel.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That man! He's here all the way from America, isn't he? Such a haunting figure he cuts...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: What madness could have possessed him to travel so far, I wonder?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on D'Arcy - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on D'Arcy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, yes. Her.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on D'Arcy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I don't know if she's a witch - but I suspect she couldn't be any more ungodly if she were.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on D'Arcy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: She's only recently widowed, I hear! And yet she spends all her time with that Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on D'Arcy - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's hardly proper, Sir...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Coventry - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Coventry - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well, perhaps I would have gotten the chance were he not so busy luring Miss Deane to his quarters...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Coventry - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Well. At least he has the decency to look ordinary. I can't understand what he wants with this séance, really!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Coventry - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I hope he comes to his senses and leaves.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Hazel - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Hazel - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I don't know about her, Sir. You can't trust a woman in that much jewellery.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Hazel - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, she thinks she's big fish among all these heathens but it's just talk, Sir, trust me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Hazel - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Mantovani's the real one to worry about...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ruairí - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ruairí - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's good to have such a distinguished, local gentleman among the guests, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ruairí - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He seems like a smart boy. I'm sure he'll come to his senses and drop all this dark business his aunt's gotten him into.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: As much as the help can meet a guest, Sir. She's quite a woman, though for better or worse, I don't know...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Has all the airs of a decent woman, though, at least.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Miss... Hah. Have I met- Hah!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Missus Joyce? Are you alright?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: ...Oh. O-oh, goodness, I am so sorry, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Did you need something?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, that's quite alright, Missus Joyce...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Carmela - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh. Oh yes, Sir, you just steer clear of that woman, Sir! That wretched, wretched woman, who... Sir, she...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Saoirse - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Saoirse - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, such a sweet girl. So much sadness in her short life.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Saoirse - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Too curious for her own good, though. I worry, seeing her wandering around with these heathens and her eager to fill a hole in her heart.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Arwa - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you made Miss Hisham's acquaintance?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Arwa - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: That woman... I trust her less than I'd trust the devil.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Arwa - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I've come into rooms - places you wouldn't expect a guest to be - to find her there! But she's not after the silverware or anything like that!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Arwa - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'm telling you, Sir, she's after something dark. Coming here from so far away - and for what?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Ah, Sir, it is good to have a man of the cloth here during all this.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I've got my crosses up but they can only do so much!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I feel so much safer with him here.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's like God himself sent him to keep my soul during all this!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Fiadh - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Fiadh - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's a crying shame, Sir. She should be looking out for that nephew of hers!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Fiadh - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Instead, she's guiding him down that dark path of witchcraft and blood offerings!

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ó Finn - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Ó Finn - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: He keeps his room tidy. Almost unslept in. Don't know what to make of him, really - but at least it's handy for me.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinon on Campbell - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know the Reverend, Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinon on Campbell - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Not any more than making him tea when he stops by to talk to the Marquess. He seems fine enough.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Higgins - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed someone around the grounds? A large man, not a guest or staff...?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Higgins - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Can't say I have. Has there been someone around?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Higgins - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, I don't like that one bit...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working for Marquess Blake?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, Sir, I'd like it a lot better if he hadn't decided to host this wretched séance.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I know he misses his wife, but this just doesn't seem like the right way to honour her memory.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I correct in thinking that the Marquess has a son?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Yes, Sir. But he's a quiet boy. Keeps to his room when there's guests in the manor.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But he's a sweet boy. Sometimes you forget he's the young master and not family of your own.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Been that way since the accident. Probably the same before, but that was a while back and he was younger then.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/Opinion on Walter Blake - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I assume he was hiding then too, just in his mother's petticoat. I don't really recall. He missed her something awful, the poor lad.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/UPDATED Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How are you and Mister Dupré getting on?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/UPDATED Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, Sir, it just isn't right. The man is stricken with grief! From all he's told me of Laura, I've never seen a friendship quite so special as that.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/UPDATED Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I've offered what comfort I can, the poor lamb. But I know from my Colm it'll be a lifelong ache.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/UPDATED Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: And how I spent all those days avoiding him when he first arrived, when all this time... Oh, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Character Presents - Caitlin/UPDATED Opinion on Dupré - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: It's just nice to have someone who understands.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/Open, eager pose - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's good to see a friendly face among all these strangers, Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/Open, eager pose - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh! Well, I'm glad you think so, Sir. Folks like you and me need to stick together around this lot.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/Sly, knowing smile - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have the impression, Missus Joyce, that little gets past you around here.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/Sly, knowing smile - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Oh, no more than any housekeeper, Sir. We get all sorts of little insights into the guests, you know...

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/brigit's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your necklace - at a distance, I assumed it was a resurrectix, but now I see it's a Saint Brigid's cross.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/brigit's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Yes, Sir. All my love to God, Jesus, and Mary - but I have a special place in my heart for Saint Brigid.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/brigit's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I keep her close to me as she protects us, Sir. From evil - and from fire too.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Analysis Presents - (to) Caitlin/brigit's Cross - Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: I'm glad my faith in you wasn't misplaced, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Without the means to look into what happened to the girl myself, there's not much I can do.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: But it's not right, Sir, for no one to do anything at all. I can't do much myself, you know, but I can get the staff to help you.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: They're a bit strange, in their own ways, but none of them would do a thing like this.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Come with me, Sir. We'll talk to them.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're the one who hired me?

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: Mantovani and her wretched séance were bound to get someone hurt sooner or later.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin womens dorm conversation
speaker: Missus Joyce
en: This wretched séance was bound to get someone hurt sooner or later.

conversation: Cast/Caitlin Joyce/Caitlin vandalised flyer
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It was Missus Joyce who vandalised the flyer! But why?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ora, who is this man? You are late to this event... but you have not missed the heart of it!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry if I startled you, Ma'am. I'm Declan Ward. Who might you be?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: My name? My name, Signor... is Carmela Mantovani.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Signor Ward. We meet again.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I am the mystic who will conduct this Grand Séance, who will channel the forces from the other side while the veil is lowered...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: ...and allow you all to speak with the dead.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Of course. *cough* Take care.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's all.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It is not just those of us speaking to ghosts who are uncovering secrets, is it, Signor?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have had time... to consider. To decide. This is not where I wanted to spend my last days...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But at least, this way, my death will have use. The last I have spent on this Grand Séance...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It will be something to be remembered. And this contract will serve my family well.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It is not perfect. But few things are.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Signor Ward, I have a favour I must ask of you.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: What should we discuss, Signor Ward?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela conversation
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: *cough* *cough*

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah. Signor Ward, yes?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... Yes. And you are?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: My name? My name, Signor... is Carmela Mantovani.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The same Carmela Mantovani who is hosting tomorrow evening's séance. The guest of honour, if you will.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The psychic? Is that how you know my name?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Aha! You flatter my abilities, Signor. No, I overheard the staff mention a new guest and worked the rest out.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I am something of the... detective, no?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Another example: I think perhaps you are here for a different reason. Something not like the others.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And why would you say that, madam?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You do not recognise me or my name. I would wager good money that no others came this far west without some idea of those details.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Come. Allow me to read your cards. Perhaps we can discover your real reason for attending. Maybe you will find a little direction along the way...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ ACCEPT THE READING ]

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ REFUSE THE READING ]

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Thank you madam, but no. I think perhaps I am more wary of your cards than I expected to be.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: After that display, how could I refuse?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Very wise, Signor. Perhaps a more traditional conversation instead, then?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Come closer then, Signor.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: A three card spread, Signor.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You see? I was not wrong. There is more for you here than a mere séance.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: One card for your past, one for your present, and one for your future.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Let us begin.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The Three of Swords.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The Tower.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh! Oh, the wind!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Indeed. Though I am unsure what all this means.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And now...Perhaps a more traditional conversation, sì?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Swords cover the intellectual realm. And this one in particular deals with heartbreak.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Major Arcana. These cards deal with big, life-changing affairs.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: As you can see, lightning, fire, destruction, and chaos are the purview of this card.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Love, perhaps? But also grief, sorrow. Perhaps even betrayal.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Surely your cards can tell you which?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: They're pieces of paper, Signor! They can't answer anything. They put you in front of questions that you may choose to ask yourself - or not.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: If this card, if these cards, are to mean anything, only you will know it.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That sounds... bad?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: What is 'bad'? This card would suggest that you are - or soon will be - in the middle of something significant and unavoidable.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: 'Bad' is not the right word. But neither is it 'good'...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What does that mean?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Everything means something, Signor. Normally a card is upright, or reversed.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: When upright, this card - the Wheel of Fortune - means good luck, prosperity.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Reversed it means, as you may suspect, bad luck and misfortune.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: On its side? I believe it means both are possible. I think your future - perhaps all of our futures - are very much in your hands.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: However you resolve your Tower - this here and now, your own reason for attending - it seems likely to affect us all...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It means, Signor, tread carefully but act decisively. So much hangs in the balance.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Signor Ward. You have come for a card reading, then?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you'd be so kind.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It is a kindness to give me an excuse to do so. I miss my old ways, sometimes.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/card reading in ch4
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Come. Shall I read your cards?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wish there was more I could do.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: As do I, Signor.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But this is how it is. I have pushed myself for so long.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I was young when I left my family for a better life - and I found it. I enjoyed the finest things with the finest company.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But for all my fame, I have little to show.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And faced with the end, I finally realise what wealth I had at home.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Like everyone in my position, I thought I would have more time. I thought I could go back, fix that which I broke.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: What a cliché I have become!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Maybe this is what the ghosts are trying to tell us? That our time is limited and we would do well to be more precious with it.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/conclusion - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: One way or the other, I am soon to find out...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photograph of Deane - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photograph of Deane - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I do. She is... Ah... Oh, Signorina Deane! We have spoken a little. She's somewhere around here.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/A Map of the Region - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/A Map of the Region - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Who here has need of this? Well, I suppose it might be useful if you wanted to go walking...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/A Map of the Region - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: If they could brave this weather, also.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance advert - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: True, I am. Though how a hotel so far from the civilised world heard of me, I do not know...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance advert - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Carmella Mantovani? So you are the person leading the séance?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance advert - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have some fame, yes, but this much? A surprise to me.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Alcohol - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I thought you might like this.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Alcohol - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah? Oh, no, I don't need it - but thank you for the offer.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Blake Family - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems the Blake family have quite the lineage.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Blake Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Well... If they don't want to speak to me themselves, alive or dead, then it's not my business to know.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Blake Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I'm not going to pry into my employer's private life... That wouldn't make me any friends.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement Mister Varley - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley said Miss Deane checked out some time ago.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement Mister Varley - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Did she? Hm. I suppose she had something to see to somewhere else.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hauntings - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think there are ghosts around this place?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hauntings - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You don't have a sense for them, then? There are more ghosts here than there are guests!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hauntings - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Even in my sleep, I hear them... *cough*

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hauntings - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is a reason this is the place we gather - so many years of tragedy and misery to trap so many souls.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hauntings - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The Blakes have not always been good people, I think. But this generation, they are different, sì?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Séance's Purpose - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it you've been to a great deal of séances.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Séance's Purpose - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Plenty. For loved ones that have passed, to speak to legends, just to speak with what is behind the veil...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Séance's Purpose - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I've never before tried to bind a ghost to this side. I will have my work cut out for me.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Leaving letter - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Leaving letter - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: She did? Well, Signorina Deane is always up to something or other...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Leaving letter - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Though... I am surprised she would miss such a thing as this.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/entertainment schedule - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: An entertaining week, certainly.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/entertainment schedule - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I think that perhaps you do not really care for my experiences? If you are seeking answers, you should consult the cards, Signor Ward.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/entertainment schedule - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Consult the cards? I see a bridge game happened on Tuesday night. Yes, perhaps that is useful. Is that... is that what you meant?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/entertainment schedule - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: If you found that useful, let's say... yes?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Second Sight - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Miss McLeod's Second Sight?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Second Sight - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Mm... I do not know it by the name. But she sees the future, doesn't she? Has visions.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Second Sight - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It wouldn't be something I'd want... Sometimes it is better not to know.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Mister O'Meara Statement - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night, and that she seemed to have been drinking.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Mister O'Meara Statement - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah, well, that's not my business, Signor.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Bedroom skeleton key - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Caro Dio! Put that back exactly where you found it, if you have any sense at all!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Doyle's Statement - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Apparently, Mister Doyle overheard Miss Deane arguing with a man on Tuesday evening.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Doyle's Statement - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Someone always argues with someone at these things... Especially when Signorina Deane is involved.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Doyle's Statement - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Thankfully, I have no concerns with her... but that is not common, I do not think.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Mysterious figure in window - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Walking back from the gardens, I could have sworn I saw someone watching me from an upstairs window.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Mysterious figure in window - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Is that so? It might be that it's another member of the family... Or perhaps it's just another ghost.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Dead End - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that Miss Deane walked into the hedge maze on Tuesday night, but there's no sign of her from there.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Dead End - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: So - you mean to say she did not sign out? But then, where could she be? Someone must look!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hermetic Order - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Hermetic Order Of The Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hermetic Order - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, they're one of the magical societies you'll find around London.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hermetic Order - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: They and I have never been interested in the same sort of magic, though, so I did not want to join.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Bridge game - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game the other night?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Bridge game - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Me? Ah, no - the only cards that interest me are the tarot. It was those I was reading while they played their game.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement, Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré tells me you were kind enough to give him a reading on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement, Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I do not know if it was a kindness, more... an excuse to practise something familiar.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement, Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But he is right - I read his cards for him.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Statement, Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I hope the reading helps him find the spirit he is seeking.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Exorcism - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about exorcisms, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Exorcism - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Exorcism? Oh, no, Signor. I talk with the dead. If I *cough* were to chase them away, I would be out of work!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Exorcism - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But there are many magicians here. Someone more versed in death is certain to know anything you could ask.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Dreams - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any strange dreams since arriving here?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Dreams - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: In a place like this? How could one not?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Dreams - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is a... force at work in the dreams here. You can feel, it, no? It is not another practitioner - it does not have that focus.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Dreams - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: What it is and what it wants, I do not know. *cough* Perhaps it will be our guest at the séance? Aha!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Dreams - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But the recurring one. The maze of corridors luring me to the séance? That is enticing.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sigil - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this symbol look familiar to you, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sigil - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I don't believe so!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sigil - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I must admit it doesn't feel like the kind of symbol I'd want to look at, Signor Ward.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photo of a child - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is a photo of Miss Murphy's child, who has been taken from her. Do you know of any magical means through which she might see her?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photo of a child - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Mio Dio! Taken from her? This is monstrous behaviour!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photo of a child - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I know of no way to help the poor girl...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Photo of a child - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah! Signorina Callaghan, she can do the scrying! You must go see her. At once!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Grand Séance - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're to be our guide for the séance, I understand? That's an impressive undertaking.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Grand Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah, it is but one among many, Signor Ward! Every party wants a cartomancer.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Grand Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Though I must tell you... there is something about the shadows. Too long, too many in the wrong place.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Grand Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I am sure it is just the amount of ghosts lining up to speak with us and not... something else.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/The Grand Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ha! Do not worry, this is good - what a night we will have to remember!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Talks schedule - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear you're one of the speakers for this event.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Talks schedule - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh yes, yes! I am speaking on the ghost, you see.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Talks schedule - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The one you'll summon?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Talks schedule - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Nono, more the nature of the ghost. I must educate, I must be...barriera. I must not dazzle without shielding from the glare, no?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Talks schedule - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Sprits are but the echoes of a heart, Signor Ward. I should not wish to see them break.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Marquess Blake seems to have spared no expense on this event.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I think I am worth the money, no?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I meant the ball last night.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah yes. The ball. I worry we might have provoked some spirits, but the Marquess insisted on the drugs.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Part of attuning ourselves to this place and its frequency.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Hedonistic Gala - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And the others, they seemed happy with the experience, no?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything out of place here, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, yes, Signor. The spiders, for one thing.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I saw a bird last Thursday. Little, little. All caught up in their webs.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I made a small grave for it beside the stables. But you know what I found the next day?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Don't tell me it was empty?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I found spiders. Littered across the grave, feathers through their bellies. Like, eh, offerings.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Strange Occurrences - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I never knew why people were scared of spiders. Never knew. There are worse things that chase them.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Ritual Markings - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I stumbled upon the evidence of a ritual being performed upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Ritual Markings - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You did? Hah! It's good to know that I'm not the one doing all the work around here.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Fetters - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about fetters, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Fetters - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: These are what binds us to this world after death. Their "unfinished business". Only for the dead, they say - sciocchezze! It starts with the living.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Fetters - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Always business. Always unfinished. Always something to do. Or what would be the point?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Fetters - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Why some can leave it behind and others not? That is down to the person's personality and the situation.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sketches of strange symbol - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do these sketches strike any chords with you?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sketches of strange symbol - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: ...Yes. Perhaps a D minor. Oh, a clear D Minor could dredge up visions of my darkest moments, Signor Ward.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Sketches of strange symbol - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I suspect this symbol does the same. I cannot say why. It is simply how it feels to look at it.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/well scrying - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather Miss Callaghan has learned a way to use well water to see over great distances?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/well scrying - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Hmph. Yes, and she makes it look easy, does she not?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/well scrying - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: To think, she has to keep such a wonderful secret so men in frocks do not take her to the flames!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/well scrying - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: So many of your people have lost loved ones to the Americas because of your famine. Imagine they could stay in touch!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/well scrying - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: With only an intention, she was able to guide me to see my famiglia.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Deane's room - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know where Miss Deane was staying when she was at the manor?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Deane's room - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Past tense? She has left? Now you say it, I have *cough* not seen her much lately. I had almost forgotten she was here...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Deane's room - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: As to her room... I have forgotten that, too. La Vita e Cosi.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Magical Grimoire - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this book, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Magical Grimoire - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The book? No. But its...feeling? Too familiar for my liking.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Magical Grimoire - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is powerful magic in those pages, Signor Ward. Fate-choosing magic.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Magical Grimoire - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I do not know it fully, but my cards don't like it, absolutely. They don't know which way to turn.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Someone told me Miss Deane was specially invited to the séance.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh... like me? They invited others? Oh, Signor Ward. Will I never be enough for these rich people?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Oh. I do not think...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh... Signor Ward, please. Of course, others were asked.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I wonder who else?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Myself, Signor Ó Finn, and now Signorina Deane.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Miss Deane's Invitation - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh... Signor Ward, please. I am making fun. What do I care who has been invited alongside me? I am still numero uno!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Coded Papers - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this page covered in strange dots. I was wondering if they might mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Coded Papers - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Hmm...I don't play much with this kind of magic, but it seems to me like a hidden message.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Coded Papers - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Whatever is beneath that pattern is something the caster would not want you to see, Signor...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Threatening Flier - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Someone mentioned you've been receiving threats. I'm so sorry to hear that.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Threatening Flier - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah! You mean my fans?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Threatening Flier - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Fans?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Threatening Flier - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: A fan is just a heart-obsessed, no? I treat all my fans with love.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Threatening Flier - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And also wear pointy shoes, in case they love me back wrong.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Conductor of the Séance - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So you are the mystic leading us in the Grand Séance?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Conductor of the Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Sì. While I began my career with the tarot - and I love it dearly - it does not provide the same show as a séance!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Conductor of the Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is nothing like it. To press your hand to the veil, and feel another on the other side... *cough* the spirits calling back...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Conductor of the Séance - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And this one! Where the veil will fall down like stage curtains! There will be nothing to compare, Signor, I assure you!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have family back home, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Yes, a big one! More uncles, aunts, cousins, nieces, and nephews than you could count!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: All in one another's pockets, knowing business and having opinions.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Labouring on the same farmlands, day in and out, with no hope for a better life.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I miss them. When I was young, it was a terrible life for me. But now, as I age?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I had hoped...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Family - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah, do not mind me, Signor Ward.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Health - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you feeling alright, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Health - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, why do you...? *cough* *cough*

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Health - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I'm alright. I'm fine! It is just a cough.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Carmela's Health - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Perhaps a cold from the weather. London is foggy, but here - it is just damp. To the bone.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Chiave del sigillo - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you remind me what this is for?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Chiave del sigillo - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The lockbox in my room, Signor Ward, the one that contains the money for my family - it can only be unlocked with a sigil. This sigil.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Chiave del sigillo - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You... are up to the task, sì?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Chiave del sigillo - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll see it done, Miss Mantovani.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Chiave del sigillo - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Good. I do not want to think the cards led me astray, not so close to the end...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance contract - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Forgive me if it's impolite to ask, but... am I right in thinking an event, such as this one, must pay quite well for you?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance contract - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Is it impolite? I suppose it may be, so you and I, Signor, we will keep it a secret.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance contract - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It does pay well, very well. Better than any I have hosted *cough* before, in fact! I did not come here for the weather alone!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Séance contract - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I think Marquess Blake was very anxious for it to happen, you see.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for the weekend?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, but I plan to spend much of my weekend giving readings in the hedge maze. When I am free, of course...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And of course... I *cough* *cough* - excuse me - have my talk today at five.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But mostly, my energies will be focused on preparing for the Silent Dinner and Grand Séance in the evening.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: After this, I am to meet Signorina Callaghan for dinner at seven. I think she intends to, how you say, chew my ear off about this whole weekend.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And there is the ball this evening. That will be quite the event, I'm sure!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And tomorrow?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/Timetable - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Again tomorrow I will spend some time giving readings in the maze.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What would you make of a reading made up of 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' cards?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: So... Let me see... Two Major Arcana in one spread - there is a lot going on, perhaps... turmoil in the recipient. First, the cards themselves:

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The Hanged Man, he represents sacrifice, new perspectives, higher learnings - this kind of thing. It is a card of great wisdom and personal growth.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Death - now this can, of course, mean death. But, rarely is this the case. It symbolises more of a... transformation or transition in life. A fork in the road of life, sì?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The Ten of Pentacles is for legacy and prosperity being passed down through generations.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It is hard to comment on a spread not knowing the recipient, their question, all this.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And are there other ways to read this?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Of course! There are many ways to interpret the cards! Take an extreme, for example.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Mind you, this is a shallow reading and only takes the face value of the cards into account, but shows how wide a range of interpretations there are, sì?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But a cold reading of this? I could take it to mean that somebody needs to make a sacrifice and undergo a transition to gain a new perspective. They do this, and they may find something they seek - a form of enduring happiness, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/skerritt's cards - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: In a literal way, these cards could mean a person must undertake the ultimate sacrifice - death. A legacy might be created, then, through the nature of the death itself. Or maybe the Hanged Man returns here, and new learning is left in their wake, which forms the legacy.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever seen a woman's ghost by the firepit?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have felt a presence, but no, I have not seen her.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She does look like her. I felt like she was trying to share something, something important with me.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Could you find a way to communicate with her, perhaps? She has manifested to you. Perhaps you have a better chance of understanding her.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How am I meant to reach her if you cannot?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You think about this all wrong. Because I cannot do it does not mean you cannot. Find something, a spirit board perhaps? Then see what she is trying to tell us.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Tell me, Signor - is this her?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... I think, yes?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Signor Dupré left this with me the other day. He is seeking a spirit - perhaps the one you have found?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: At first, I thought this was Signorina Deane, but he assures me she is not...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Take the picture. Maybe it will help you keep her in your mind.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/ghost at firepit - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Could you find a way to communicate with her, perhaps? She has manifested to you. Perhaps you have a better chance of understanding her.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/gauge - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know what the strange device in the atrium is for?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/gauge - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Certo! Is it not a measure of how successful we will be?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/gauge - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: This is what the Marquess tells me. I cannot recall what it measures. Ghosts or the veil or such? Ah, maledetta memoria, I do not know. Sorry.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: When I arrived here... I saw a woman washing what appeared to be your shawl in the fountain out front.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh? Are you sure - mine is dry, in my room?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think it was an omen.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah. A spectre of death, perhaps? She knows, then, that my end is near.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, do not look at me this way. It is of my own doing. I pushed myself too hard all these years.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/washer woman - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: This is my last séance. My last... anything. I have made peace with that.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The flyer you found on your door... Are you okay?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ha! Signor! This is not the first time that such a thing has happened!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I will give them marks for theatrics! Right through the eye, they stuck it!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So you are not worried?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: *cough* *cough*

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I am... not scared of death, Signor.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And this is but a scare tactic. They hope only to chase me off.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Anyone willing to go further would have gone there to begin with.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Evidence Presents - Carmela/flyer - carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: They would not have given a warning, surely...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You must be very fond of that tarot deck.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It shows in the wear, does it? However precious something is, however much you love it, time will change it.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It has served me well and has given me some very *cough*  interesting readings over the years.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You can have a reading yourself, if you so wish, Signor! You need only meet me when I am doing readings in the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: For such a special occasion, I wish to put the cards to good use, and it will be, as they say, on the house.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I will be offering readings all weekend in the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Worn tarot - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: This is a Visconti-Sforza deck, given to me by the woman who trained me as a child.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shadows under eyes - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You look tired, Miss Mantovani...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shadows under eyes - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah, oh... No, that's... *cough*

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shadows under eyes - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is a lot of... strange energy in this place. It is difficult to sleep in a place so... beset with spirits...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shaking hands - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you cold Miss? Your hands are shaking.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shaking hands - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, I wouldn't... Don't worry about that. I have been... *cough* *cough*

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Analysis Presents - (to) Carmela/Shaking hands - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You are right, of course, I should be wearing my shawl.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Skerritt - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Skerritt - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: He introduced himself to me, sì.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Skerritt - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: He was very excited. Giddy, almost, about his involvement, even though he has but a small role in the séance. It was not a fruitful conversation.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Corentine - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Corentine - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Briefly. If it were not for the death following her... I could like her.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Corentine - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But with the heavy veil she carries about her? I cannot help but feel sorrow for her and hers.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ivy - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ivy - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Sì. She also reads the cards so we found much to discuss over tea. Wonderful - a talented young woman.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ivy - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I gave her a reading. She is at the crossroads of living a true life, or not. I hope she finds a way to pick correctly.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Lan Fen - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Lan Fen - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Signora Lau, sì! Signorina McLeod introduced her to me. Her chaperone, I am told. She did not talk as much as Signorina McLeod did.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Lan Fen - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Still, she was very polite. I think, talk of magic is not so interesting to her - though she did pay some attention to her charge's cards.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Varley - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Varley - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But of course! He is my main point of contact for this event. Everything I ask for, he gets me.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Varley - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: We would have no séance without him. People say he is cold, but I see how much work he has to do behind the scenes.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I... do not think she likes me.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have done many events like this. Often, I meet a family member who is against my presence.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Why do you say that?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I think, to her, I am just a witch.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Caitlin - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Some cannot hide this. Signora Joyce, she hides it well enough.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Darragh - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the stable master?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Darragh - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: The grounds and maze are his domain, so of course we spoke!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Darragh - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I imagine there is no nook or cranny that he does not know secret ways in out of.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Doyle - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the porter?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Doyle - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: He is not so talkative, I find.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Doyle - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I should not have done so without his permission, but one day I did a reading about him - it was very... confused.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Doyle - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It was as if his past and present were unrelated. I wish I could ask him, but of course, I cannot.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Doyle - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Maybe this is the reason he does not talk so much?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ines - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ines - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: She is the girl from Brazil, sì? She is not here for the magic, so we talked about life in our countries.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ines - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Both our homes have been going through big changes these last few years. She has fled hers, I would return to mine, if only...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ettiene - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Touissant?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ettiene - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, yes! And meeting him here was not for the first time.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ettiene - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: He has... investigated me, you know? He was very polite about it, and it did not take long to conclude.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ettiene - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: After he... what would you call it, approved me? After that, my demand shot up!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ettiene - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I know some people do not like him - but I have never minded him. I like his company.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Cathal - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?
