conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Cathal - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have. We spoke briefly - he seems an... interesting young man.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Cathal - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is something... beautiful about him. Around him. Some... pale, shining haze.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Cathal - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I pulled a card for it - the Seven of Swords. Trickery and cunning. I hope Signor O'Meara will be... okay...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Ah, the man from America.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Yes, we have spoken. I didn't know his face, so I wanted - well, most of the new faces are from near here, are they not?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Dupré - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: A funeral director. What a thing to find here. And at this time. The universe, she is a wily one.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on D'Arcy - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on D'Arcy - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have not seen her before, but I know her name - I have a friend in London who adores her books.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on D'Arcy - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I am surprised to learn she is a member of the Golden Dawn. She does not seem very versed in all this. Perhaps she is new to the society?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on D'Arcy - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I wonder if there will be a séance in her next book?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Coventry - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Coventry - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I gave him a reading. He is lost, or was at least. Now he is, perhaps, found again. His future was more open than I expected for a man of his age. Bene per lui!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Hazel - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Hazel - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Here? Sì. It was not for the first time. We have crossed paths before, in London.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Hazel - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There and here she avoids me. Maybe I am stealing business from her?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Hazel - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Though, I think maybe she avoids me for another reason? I do not know, she does not show up in my cards.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ruairi - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ruairi - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have! I have never met him before this event, but I am so pleased to have done so here.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ruairi - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I think that we understand each other. I think, perhaps, I have made a friend. That is always a welcome surprise.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ruairi - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: His attempts to modernise certain practices are intriguing! What wonders this age brings with it!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ruairi - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I wish I could be around when he cracks it, so I could see and congratulate him on the achievement...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Evelyn - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Miss Deane, have you?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Evelyn - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: We have met. Not here, before in London - many times.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Evelyn - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: She flutters from person to person to suit her own agenda; I have seen the damage she has caused, so I stay away.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Evelyn - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: She cannot poison the flower she cannot land on.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, tell me about yourself, Miss Mantovani.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Hah! Oh, I always hate this. Ah... I am from the north of Italy, a farming community.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It was clear from a young age, I was... gifted. *cough* I would predict things, find lost items. This was cute...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: My nonna, she took me to see a strega - a witch.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I was taught the tarot and *cough* our folk magic. Italy has its own magic, of course.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Soon I was good enough that I made a name for myself...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Money and fame came not long after. Which is how I came to be here, sì?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Carmela - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: ...but once I heard the dead, the people of my town grew cold. Even some in mia famiglia grew distant.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have dealt with Marquess Blake, yes?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh yes, from the very beginning. It was he who reached out to me to come and host this event.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...You think he regrets inviting you?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: No, no. Nothing like that. I'm just not sure it was entirely him behind those eyes...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: He has been very welcoming. Ah, but...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It is his eyes, Signor. They scare me. Their intensity. I'm not always sure what is behind those eyes...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Though how he had heard of me, I do not know!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Is it just grief that drives him? Something more?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: There is a part of me that worries I am enabling something in him...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Fiadh - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you feel about Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Fiadh - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: We do not 'share eyes' on the matter of this event, but she is a good woman and skilled practitioner.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Fiadh - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I think elsewhere we could get on like a building on fire. Here, we are at odds.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Sinnott - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the Father yet?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Sinnott - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: That man needs some sun!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Sinnott - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I am a good Catholic girl; of course, I have met with him! How fortunate for us that, if the séance does not go well, at least we still have one way to gaze upon the dead!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Saoirse - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen Miss Murphy about the manor?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Saoirse - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Such a shy little thing. I think she wanted to ask me something, but could not work up the nerve.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Saoirse - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: If she is not careful, she will blink and end up replacing Signora Joyce in no time.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Saoirse - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: A life wasted washing sheets for strangers.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Arwa - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Arwa - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I tried, but did not get so far. She seems very driven by... something.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Arwa - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: She asked if I could divine the location of things, which, normally I can. But here, there is too much energy surrounding this place.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Arwa - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: It comes from every direction; It is overwhelming! I could not focus on any one person or thing in it all.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Arwa - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Since then, I wish I had asked what the 'thing' had been, at least.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ó Finn - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ó Finn - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Oh, I like him! Warm, solid type. Feet on the ground, laughs with the chest.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ó Finn - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Speaks his mind even when it's not welcome - perhaps especially then.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Ó Finn - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I can see why he was invited!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you like the Young Master?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have not met him. The Marquess wants him kept from all this business.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: No, best he is saved from the whole thing until a later age.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Though he would not say it, I suspect there is a hope that the Marchioness' ghost would appear.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Character presents - Carmela/Opinion on Walter Blake - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: That may be too much for the boy at this age. And if she did not appear, that would be too much in another way.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Ward in room - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And what is the meaning of this?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Ward in room - Carmela
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Mantovani-

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Ward in room - Carmela
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: You may save your words. I do not need cards to know what to do with you.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Signor Ward... I believe you to be a good man.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I will not survive this séance. Even if I hadn't already known it for myself... I have seen it in my cards.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I have resigned myself to this. I have reason for seeing this séance through.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And what a life it has given me! I have performed in the old world and the new. Every kind of party I have been to.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I even read for Queen Victoria, and through her granddaughter, I performed a séance for the Tsar.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I could not have asked for more!

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 1
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: My family... I left when I was young. When I realised this gift gave me a way out.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 2
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But I do not have much left. All I earned, I spent. I could always earn more.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 2
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But the time for that is at its end.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 2
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: I want to give something, some fraction of the comfort I have had.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 2
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: This event. It pays well. Too much, even. But at a time when I needed much.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 2
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: But now I fear I will be gone before I can get this money to them. Please, Signor, I will give you the secret to the lockbox in my room.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Per favore, you must go to my room and get my earnings.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: And let them know I am sorry that I left but that I loved them, always.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Take this symbol, it will open my lockbox. A key to my room, I suspect you already have.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: When the séance is done, please ensure my family gets the full amount.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: When the séance is done, when I am done - please, go to my room and ensure my family gets the full amount.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela end cutscene 3
speaker: Miss Mantovani
en: Grazie... Now, go...

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela Post Quest Reflection
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can hardly imagine how the other guests are going to react.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela Post Quest Reflection
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would they go through with the séance if they found out what it would do to Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela Post Quest Reflection
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I pray the Lord shows them compassion; they don’t own their complicity.

conversation: Cast/Carmela Mantovani/Carmela Post Quest Reflection
speaker: Mister Ward
en: At least Miss Mantovani has chosen to die on her own terms. It’s a luxury too few of us are afforded…

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Am I so easily read? Oh, dear. I'm not much for secrets, but I'd rather have some mystique.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: That's a disgrace, isn't it? I'm Cathal O'Meara.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Ah, you again. Did I introduce myself? No?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: You again?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Declan Ward.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, I suppose it is good to meet you. What do you need?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Another stranger, is it? They must have dredged the barrel to find so many unknowns.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Declan Ward. It's a pleasure. What brings you to the event?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Beyond the séance? If you must know, I guess I'm hoping the techniques used here can be repurposed to speak to... other things...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Cathal O'Meara, Sir. You?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll be off, Mister O'Meara.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Don't let me keep you.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Apparently that's not at all the case, as you've got me pinned. Ah, well.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It's true, after all. There's an angel somewhere about me, I know it, but I can only ever see it when I am - well, close to death.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: But, I can't continue on like this. I'm not entirely heartless. If something more permanent were to happen to me, my poor mother...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: If only I could speak with it, find out what it is it wants... But I never get more than a few moments, a few words...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: So, whatever it is behind that veil of life... Yes, I intend to seize the thing. To take ahold of it and get my answer, for better or worse.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: That's the idea, anyhow. But I cannot get to the thing, and I'm going absolutely spare trying to make it work.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Maybe... would you help me with it? While the veil is low, I mean, and with more eyes on it... This might be my best chance.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Come to my room and see if you can help - after all, your senses were sharp enough to figure me out!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal conversation
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Any joy, Mister Ward? The notes for the Babelstone are just here in my trunk...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Cathal finding Ward exiting Deane's room
