en: ...You did? What sort?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ritual markings - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm afraid I wouldn't know, myself.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ritual markings - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Hmm...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cathal saw Deane - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there anything else you can tell me about when you saw Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cathal saw Deane - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Let me think...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cathal saw Deane - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: No, I think I told you everything. I do hope she's alright...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cathal saw Deane - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She must be... right?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bedroom skeleton key - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: What... wait, why do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange occurences - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed any... strange events around this place?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange occurences - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I would say so... And I don't think I'm the only one. I've heard people talking about it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange occurences - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: But as for me? I had a glass of water by my bedside the other night, and I woke up in the night to find it boiling.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange occurences - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: The next day I thought I'd dreamed it - except, when I woke up that next morning, I found the glass empty, cracked, and blackened.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange occurences - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I sat and watched the entire thing evaporate. I didn't feel... scared or any of that. Not with my guardian there. When it was done, I went back to sleep.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane has left - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The staff tell me that Miss Deane left on Tuesday night.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane has left - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose, maybe she had something else to attend to...?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Statement, Mister Doyle - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle tells me he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Statement, Mister Doyle - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh? But what about?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Statement, Mister Doyle - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Do you think that has something to do with where she might be...? I hope not.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Mysterious figure - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed... someone watching from the upstairs windows?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Mysterious figure - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Should I have? I'm sure there's all sorts about the place...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Mysterious figure - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: There's more than just us here. I know that, even if I don't often see them for myself.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Goibniu - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Goibniu, Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Goibniu - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I might have heard the name somewhere before... but if I have, I don't recall anything about them. Sorry, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I don't believe in all that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: But...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: One night I was walking home through some fields - a way I often took before and knew well.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I found myself trapped. I could see the way out but no matter how far I walked, I could get no closer.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And I swear to you, I could hear laughter. Even felt a small hand touch me.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I offered up what was left of my hipflask by way of tribute and ran.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: They must have taken it, because I was finally out.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Fae - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Maybe they were fae, maybe something else. Regardless, I no longer walk home that way.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I've definitely heard the name... They were the old Irish gods, weren't they?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I don't remember where I... hm...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I don't think I remember very much. Maybe there's a book in the library that might help...?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Goddess Bridget - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Goddess Bridget - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I don't know much about any goddess at all, but I do know of Saint Brigid.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Goddess Bridget - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She's a patron saint of Ireland, along with all sorts of other things. Healing, protection, blacksmithing...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/The Goddess Bridget - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: They used to keep a fire burning in her honour, they say, over in Kildare.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Dead End - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that Miss Deane never left the grounds... instead, she wandered into the hedge maze after you saw her.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Dead End - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Where she went afterwards, though, I don't know. I intend to find out.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Dead End - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: So you're trying to find her? Good. I'm so glad someone is. I don't know what I could do to help... but if I can, I will.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Not yet. Something physical, I know that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Whatever it wants of me, I need to be healed.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have much understanding of what your angel wants of you?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I can feel my body recovering at an accelerated rate since pledging myself to it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I assume its intentions will become clear to me soon enough. But first the séance. Then a visit to my mother.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I have put her to worry for all too long. I need to assure her that what comes next is a divine quest and so, safe.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/resolution - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It's silly but that will put her at ease. The only challenge will be getting her to believe me. It is, admittedly, something of a change of character.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cash - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER MONEY ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cash - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP MONEY ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cash - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: For me? But, are you sure? I do have something in mind that would benefit from it...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cash - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cash - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: How kind of you Mister Ward. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sherry - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sherry - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sherry - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: No, no thank you. I shouldn't, I don't think it'll do me any good.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sherry - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bridge game - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you attend the bridge game, the other night?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bridge game - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: The bridge game? That was - Tuesday? I... did not.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bridge game - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: No, I was elsewhere. In my room, praying, I imagine. Yes, that would have been it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara, I have reason to believe Miss Deane might be in trouble, and if you know anything that would help, I need to hear it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you did not help her when you saw her on Tuesday, perhaps you could help now. Where were you during the bridge game?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I - I didn't -

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I was with Miss McLeod, in the gardens. We went for a walk. I'm not - I don't know anything more about Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And Miss McLeod - I suggested myself she bring Missus Lau, but she said she couldn't. I don't remember why, but -

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Second chance - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: But that's where I was. I just, I didn't want to say, it looks badly for Miss McLeod. But there was nothing unseemly to it, I swear!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bridge statement - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You must remember where you were during the bridge game. It sounds like it was early Tuesday evening?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Bridge statement - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose it - can't have been anything very important. I tend to forget things, you know? I've just... forgotten.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Secret rendevouz - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, you were with Miss McLeod during the bridge game?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Secret rendevouz - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Yes. ...It was nice. We just walked around the grounds and talked. The rain even held off for a bit.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Entertainment schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's quite the array of events going on, this week.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Entertainment schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Isn't there? More than I could ever attend, really.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Entertainment schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Anything in particular catch your eye?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Circled newspaper - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Circled newspaper - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Hm. It looks like someone's got an admirer. Can't say I've ever heard of a Detective Ward, though...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Circled newspaper - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Unless... unless... I think I've just figured it out, haven't I?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Staff key - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: That looks like it'd get you into almost anywhere here, probably.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drafted telegram - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears Missus Joyce has always been concerned about Miss Deane's disappearance.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drafted telegram - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: So concerned she hired a detective? Not just any detective, either. A famous detective.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drafted telegram - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well, famous isn't...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drafted telegram - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It's you! That's why you cared so much all this time. You have to find her, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Talks schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you going to attend any of the talks going on?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Talks schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: There's a few I think I'd like to go to...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Talks schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Doctor and Miss Callaghan's respectively, and maybe Miss Quinn's.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Talks schedule - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I've never really had much to do with ghosts, but I'd like to hear what she knows about them.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Fetters - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the concept of fetters?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Fetters - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, not as much as some of the others might. I'm not much for that discipline. But I believe they're the things that hold ghosts in this world.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Fetters - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose that's why they call them fetters, named for the old shackles used to transport prisoners.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Trinkets - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, it's pretty. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Trinkets - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Trinkets - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Trinkets - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cigars - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, well, thank you!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cigars - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cigars - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Cigars - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Ah, thank you. This might do me some good...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you use laudanum often, Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Are you about to tell me you're a doctor? You're not my doctor. My doctor is sick of me.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Laudanum - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I, ah... It's a bad habit, I know. But I'm not here to be cross-examined. I have some dangerous past-times. Injury is to be expected.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, the bar only opens in the evening, so I suppose I need other ways to entertain myself ‘til then.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I do hear the housekeeper serves drinks on the patio. Perhaps I’ll spend the morning there.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: When I get bored of that… Oh, there's lunch at one. Starving is less interesting than you'd think.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And Miss Callaghan’s talk at three seems liveable, so I’ll drop in on that. What else…

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh! Yes, I’ve promised Missus D’Arcy a rematch of pool in the bar at six. Now she makes a dull game fun.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I didn’t know you could misfire a ball that badly, but she certainly managed it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I should go to the mass at 12 and try absolve myself of some my sins. Not all of them, mind you, I don't want to be there all day.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Actually, I might visit the graveyard after that. Come to think of it, isn’t every graveyard visit a “near-death” experience? Yes? No? Oh, you could smile, at least...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose I’ll be in the bar in the evening. Though I’ve already run two circles around the drinks menu.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Then it’s lunch at one, dinner at eight. God, it really is all circles, isn’t it?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, drink…

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: As for tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Of course, I won't be missing the ball. Maybe a bit of real fun in this place for once.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Still, not long until the main event, eh? Even I should try to be sober for that...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/timetable - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Still, not long until the main event, eh? I'm nervous now. I'm not sure what Suibne wants from me. I hope not to let it down!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Grimoire - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, for me? Well, there might be something useful in here...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Grimoire - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Grimoire - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Grimoire - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/shadowy figure - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It doesn't mean much to me. Angelic beings are creatures of light - radiant and pure. I suppose the natural conclusion would be that you have something less Heavenly on your hands.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/shadowy figure - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw a shadowy figure stalking the grounds, twice the height of a man. Would that description mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Artefacts - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: That's interesting... I'd like to take a look at that, if you don't mind.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Artefacts - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Artefacts - Cathal
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Artefacts - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Artefacts - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Be my guest.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Protestant Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Protestant Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Not as much as some of the others will do, I'm certain enough about that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Protestant Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I know they don't have saints the same way that we do, though.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting to see such a range of faiths among the guests.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose that's what happens when you have people coming from all over the world.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: People don't always agree within the one church, after all. You can't expect everyone from all across the world to agree on one to start with.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Catholic Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Catholicism, Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Catholic Faith - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Enough, I should hope! I'd not be a good Catholic if I didn't know anything about it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ettiene's Influence - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand Mister Toussaint is quite influential.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ettiene's Influence - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I don't know much about it myself, but I've heard it said. It's strange... he seems to make Miss McLeod nervous, but he's very kind.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ettiene's Influence - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She says its because if she is misunderstood, being the real thing held up as a fake would be awful. I can understand that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Ettiene's Influence - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Come to think of it, I suppose the same could happen to me... but I can't find it in myself to worry about it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Surreptitious meeting - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It turns out that while Sunday services was being held, Miss McLeod was in the gardens talking with Mister Hunter.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Surreptitious meeting - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She was? Well, perhaps they didn't hold a service she would have attended.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Surreptitious meeting - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: What do you want? I don't think there's any great scandal there. And if there was, I don't think I would tell anyone.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Surreptitious meeting - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She was probably just asking after the horses. She was quite the equestrian as a child, I think she mentioned...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange dream - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could swear this place is giving me the strangest dreams.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange dream - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Really? I haven't noticed anything like that... I don't... think so, anyway. What's a strange dream when your dreams are always strange?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Strange dream - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: But... I can see how this place could inspire them. It's just that... something doesn't feel quite right here. Or... maybe I'm just hungover...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hedonistic Gala - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting anything like that ball.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hedonistic Gala - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: New to it, are you? I could think of people I'd rather have attended with, but it wasn't bad.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hedonistic Gala - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I did like the costumes; they were a nice touch. Although, the people who wore glitter ought to pay for the laundry. It gets everywhere.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hedonistic Gala - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I'm amazed with the... treats... provided. They were quite effecting.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hedonistic Gala - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I was able to see my... companion, but only in the distance.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Unknown Sigil - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about sigils? There's one I've been trying to identify: a spiral with four lines drawn into it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Unknown Sigil - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, I know some... but none that look like that. None with any spirals at all, I don't think.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been finding sketches of this symbol around. Does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: No... Should it? I don't think I've seen anything like that before.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angels - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about angels, Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angels - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: What a question! Plenty, if you must know. The Lord's servants, sent now and then to intervene and minister in our earthly matters.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angels - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Messengers of the higher power, not existing as we do, but as incorporeal beings just beyond understanding...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angels - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: They're beings of light and the very essence of all that's good... And very seldom seen. Maybe for that reason. Hah!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angels - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: If only I could say otherwise... I could swear there's one with me, but I can so seldom reach it...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/meeting with Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Please, Sir. Have some decorum, will you?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/meeting with Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It was an innocent conversation that you would do well to forget, lest you drag the poor girl's reputation through the mud.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/meeting with Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your meeting with Miss McLeod in the changing roo--

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/cathal's journal - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Where... where did you get this?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/cathal's journal - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't think it would be wise to discuss this.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane's room - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to recall which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane's room - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, she's... she's... she's beside mine. How did I forget that?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Deane's room - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I had... sort of forgotten she was here... How did that happen?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Aeon - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of an Aeon?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Aeon - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: A what? A... Oh, yeah, it rings a bell.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Aeon - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Something... Gnostic? Sorry, can't help more than that - you need to talk to an expert, my man.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel's name - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think your Angel's name is Suibne.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel's name - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Suibne? Alright, I'll try it. You'll come with me? See this to the end?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel's name - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Suibne? Alright, I'll try it. You'll stay, right? You couldn't possibly leave at this stage?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance general - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this séance?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Supposing they manage it, you mean.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, it seems as worthy an endeavour as any. Asking questions of the dead... why not?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: They're not being shy about who they recruit for it either, I'll give them that. Have you ever seen a turnout such as this one?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Séance general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Who knows, it might even be just a little fun. Though... I won't bank on it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any strange experiences around the manor, Mister O'Meara? I could swear I have.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: You're not the first person to ask me that, actually. It seems like everyone's seeing things in this place.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I haven't seen much... but I have this feeling that there are other people here. More than us guests. Don't you?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Ah... you mean ghosts?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed any... strange events around this place?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I've heard people talking about ghosts. I don't believe I've seen any ghosts, but there was something.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I had a glass of water by my bedside last night, and I woke up in the night to find it boiling.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I thought I'd dreamed it, but in the morning I found the glass empty and blackened.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Hauntings general - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: What sort of ghost does that? There's something about this place, I tell you.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you believe in the concept of guardian angels?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Very much so! And I'll tell you why - I have seen mine!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: When I had the accident that gave me this cane, I witnessed it in the peripheries of my vision! My own guardian angel!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And I've seen it since. I even know its name. Well, sort of...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I found allusions to it in dreams - old symbols, burnt into my mind.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Surely the angel put them there? Who else, after all?  Just... if I could translate it, I could call it here...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Angel sketches - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I know it all sounds a bit... well, crazy, doesn't it? Haha! That's faith for you.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Enochian magic, Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Hm? Oh, you've been talking to people, have you? Did they send you to me? Mm... Well, I'm no lecturer, but the gist of it is something like...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It's its own magical discipline, using rituals and ceremonies, to speak to angels or their like.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It was all developed some time ago... and it does work. Not so often as I would like but... you make do.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Angels don't speak our language, exactly, which is entirely another thing... but there are ways to work around that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It is almost enough just to have them answer.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Enochian magic - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Almost. But they don't stay for very long. I would know.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have quite the reputation, you know.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Mm... I've heard mention. I didn't think that was actually the case.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is it true you've had a number of near-death experiences?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: So it is true. I didn't know. It's nothing so grand, you know... Bad luck, and then... knowing that there's an angel waiting at the veil.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: If you saw such a thing, you would understand. A being made of nothing but light, so much that to gaze upon it is to feel it light you up...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Thrill seeker - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: You would understand, I think, if you felt it. It is almost worth the risk, meeting death, if I might find what it is that it wants. Almost, but... There must be another way...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Soul Jars - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about soul jars?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Soul Jars - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Practical magic and artefacts isn't really my sort of thing... but actually, as it happens, yes.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Soul Jars - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: They're used for holding - well, souls. Life essence, and what have you.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Soul Jars - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Damned hard to find. Or, so I am told...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this dotted paper lying about, but I've no idea what it could mean.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...Have you ever sent a love letter, Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Pardon?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Wrote one in lemon juice once. Hold it above a flame and the words appear like magic.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: This paper of yours sounds like that. Except, actually magic.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Coded Papers - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...I never told Margaret I'd used lemon juice, did I? Oh well.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drugged water - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any reason to think Miss McLeod's water might have been tampered with?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drugged water - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Tampered with? How'd you mean? As in, someone's put something in it? Ugh, who would do something like that?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Drugged water - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I don't know how you know that, but you'd best make use of knowing and tell her about it.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/drugs in room - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Can't say that I have. Is it any good? Do you have any?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/drugs in room - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of Quinine powder?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Memento Mori - cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Quinn family having... an unusual number of deaths?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Memento Mori - cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Ah. So she is one of those Quinns, is she? I didn't think there were any left to meet.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Memento Mori - cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Yeah, so I've heard that they bear a curse, one that's supposedly about a century old, now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/Memento Mori - cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It's done most of them in. I guess that explains her scars. She's very serious for one who's cards are marked. I'd be enjoying my final days.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara, did you fight with Miss Deane on Tuesday? In the hedge maze?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Right, okay. Yes. Yes, we fought.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is important.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is that why you didn't go after her later that evening?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Yes. I thought she had drank herself stupid, that she'd wake up in a hedge the next day and regret everything.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What did you fight over?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She... well, lots of things. She was drunk, when I met her. She'd been drinking all day.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She came to me, and said something or somebody was after her.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Not physically. Maybe... spiritually? Astrally? As I say, she was drunk and unclear. She couldn't see their face, she said, but that they had a "Christian aura" or something. She was specific on that point.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Why did she come to you?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: We... were engaged. Or rather I wanted us to be. I asked her to marry me. We'd been courting... I wanted to make it official.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She didn't want to be caged down. Didn't need a man to protect her. All of that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I chalked it up to overindulgence. Told her to go sober up in her room. She did not like that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: So, naturally when she came to me for help I threw it in her face and left.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: On seeing her later, I called out and she ignored me - still furious, I assumed - so I left her be.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Of course, I didn't expect to not see her the following day. I took some food up to her room, but, well... I forgot where she was staying.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Then I forgot that I forgot... Until I saw you at her door.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It all came back. And I panicked. I thought maybe I was responsible for her disappearance.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Then I thought maybe you would think that, but...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...I love her, Mister Ward. You should know that. I just want her safe.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/sparring partner - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll see to it that she is. Thank you, this has been helpful.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/gauge - cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you see that odd contraption in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Evidence Presents - Cathal/gauge - cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: The what? I can't say I have given much notice to anything in that room.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can I presume you've met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Presume? Why would... I mean, ah, I have.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: They are quite the pair, aren't they?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: What a man wouldn't give...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I have, her and Missus Lau.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She's been telling me about spiritualism and séances and that sort of thing. The parts I don't know myself.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It's kind of her to take the time...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ivy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Hm? Miss McLeod? Well, it would have been impolite not to introduce myself. She's a lady, after all...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Varley - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much to the manager?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Varley - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Hmm? Oh no, I haven’t spoken with him much since I arrived. He gave me all the necessary details and went about his own affairs.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Varley - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Whenever I pass by him, he looks a touch sour, but I gather he’s fretting over the cost of throwing this whole event together.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Varley - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: God, can you image having to worry about that kind of thing!?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Lan Fen - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been introduced to Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Lan Fen - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Yes. Or, I might have been the one to introduce myself, I can't remember.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Lan Fen - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Anyway, I've met her. Being that she chaperones Miss McLeod, she's always around if I'm to talk to her.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Lan Fen - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: An absolute bore. Of course she prefers the sciences - of which I care little.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Lan Fen - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Miss McLeod speaks very fondly of her, though, and I am sure I can adjust.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Briefly. He introduced himself to me. Seems to know some family of mine. Seemed to know me too, but I don't recall him.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Yes. Well, he introduced himself to me... but we haven't spoken very much.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I just haven't got it in me. My mind falls right off the conversation.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And for his part... I think he finds me distasteful. Let him, I suppose...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Skerritt - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I've tried to place him - I asked about his family, but it seems he has none. He went a bit quiet then, so I left. I didn't come here to see an old man reflect on his wasted life.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Met her, yes, but I haven't spoken with her much. It seems like she's very caught up in... whatever it is she's doing.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose when one's days are numbered, there is a drive to get the most our of them.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Numbered?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: The family is cursed. Or so they say. Certainly their numbers are dwindling at an alarming rate.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Corentine - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I think Miss Quinn is one of only a handful left.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I have, a little. She asked where I was visiting from, and when I told her, she asked me about a woman that works a few doors down from me.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She wanted to know how she was getting on, after... I don't remember. The woman she asked about is doing fine as best as I know, at least.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Missus Joyce said she was a friend of a friend, or something like that. A friend of a cousin?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, yes. She asked where I was visiting from, and then who my parents were, and then all other sorts of things...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Seems to want to know just about everything there is. And then, unfortunately for her, she got me.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, yes. She asked where I was visiting from, and then who my parents were, and then all other sorts of things...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Caitlin - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She seems to think I'm too pretty to be mixed up in all this. Occasionally, I wonder if she's right.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Darragh - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the stable master?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Darragh - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I may have said hello in passing, but I haven't much cause to talk to him. I don't go for so many walks or ride often, what with this cane.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Darragh - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Miss McLeod likes him, though. Apparently they're old friends, of a sort, so I hear good things. You'd have to ask her.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Seamus - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the porter?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Seamus - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: That bum, Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Seamus - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: This place might run a bit better if he spent more time porting and less time flirting with the guests.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Seamus - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I have half a mind to take this cane to him...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Not that I'm old money, Mister Ward, or of some ancient, grand heritage.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It just so happens my grandfather was a very wealthy man, and my father after him.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And now... here I am. Generally disappointing them both, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A bit less like myself, then. What's a well-to-do kid from the Southside doing here?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well... I've an interest in this kind of affair. And, as you say, the money to attend them.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're a Dub, like myself.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinon on Cathal - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: True enough. I'm from Ballsbridge.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ettiene - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have spoken with Mister Touissant?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ettiene - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: He's some sort of scientist, or another, isn't that the case?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ettiene - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Anyhow, he introduced himself, and asked what brought me here. I told him, of course.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ettiene - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, his reaction! Not only does he not believe in angels but I got the distinct impression that he did not like the church itself!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ettiene - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I am used to ridicule about what I have witnessed, but the Church! The Church is infallible! Beyond question!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ines - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ines - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Over breakfast, once. She wanted to know if I was from nearby - she's interested in the local population records.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ines - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I was offended - to take a look at me and think I'd be interested in historical data!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ines - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: But she didn't care - she doesn't seem to give a damn if a person has money behind them or not. I admire that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to have met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: We've talked a bit. She was telling a few of us about other séances she's been to. The worthwhile ones, she said.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I take it they're common in London. But, anyway, when we talked it was mostly about that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, well, we talked a bit. She was telling me about other séances she's been to. The worthwhile ones, she said.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Though she also mentioned she'd had an argument or two with people at them. I didn't know it was all so... contentious?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Have I! I mightn't have shown my face if I knew Evelyn was here... But why should I suffer for her lack of decorum?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Miss Deane turned down a marriage proposal I made her a year or two ago. And there was not a second thought to it!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It'd have been one thing if it were just an offer of convenience, but I thought... No, nevermind. I'm not giving it anymore thought...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...Ha. I was stupid enough to ask if she'd mind me switching to Room 16, you know. Just to be near her.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...At least I was there to overhear her and Miss Quinn arguing in the corridor the other evening!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you, by chance, met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Have I! I mightn't have shown my face if I knew Evelyn was here... But why should I suffer for her lack of decorum?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: It'd have been one thing if it were just an offer of convenience, but I thought...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Miss Deane turned down a marriage proposal I made her a year or two ago. And there was not a second thought to it!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Evelyn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Honestly, Corentine needs to let it go - Evelyn just makes use of people. It's just how she is.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Dupré - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré at all?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Dupré - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Oh, I have, actually. He was curious as to my reason for being here. Everyone wants to know what everyone else is doing, it seems...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Dupré - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Anyway, when I told him, he seemed quite intrigued by the idea. He said something about matters of life and death being one, and that's what angels are?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Dupré - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Agree to disagree, but... I suppose those in his line of work tend to associate death with everything good in the world.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on D'Arcy - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on D'Arcy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She's... oh, she's the authour. Of all sorts of dark and sordid tales, she said.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on D'Arcy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: We talked a little at breakfast. She said I'd suit as a hero in one of her novels, and I don't know what to make of that.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on D'Arcy - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I'm going to hope it's a good thing, for the sake of my pride.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Hazel - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Hazel - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Yes, I believe so, but we haven't really talked.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Hazel - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Funny, I thought a woman who speaks with the dead might have more time for me. Apparently not...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Hazel - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Too Catholic for her, maybe.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Coventry - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Coventry - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Once or twice over drinks. He's fascinated with everything this place has to offer.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Coventry - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Including Miss Deane... Sly old dog took a shine to her, I think. Harmless at his age, but Evelyn shouldn't have led him on by going to his room...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ruairí - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ruairí - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I have. Of all the doctors I've met, and there have been a few, he's one of the most pleasant.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ruairí - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...That was probably helped by the fact we were talking about something other than my health, to be fair to the others.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ruairí - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: And who doesn't like a doctor who's worth their salt in the occult? Much more interesting than the usual sort...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Not too self-important for one so famous. I talked to her to learn about the parameters of séances.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: How many are needed, is a medium required, can something more than ghosts be communed with.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She answered my questions calmly and thoroughly.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Then she drew me a card and warned me to be careful in dealing with the unknown.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Carmela - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: A real show-woman to the end.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Fiadh - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Fiadh - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I've actually heard her name before, you know. Miss Deane spoke of, but I've never met her until now.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Fiadh - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: We have spoken some - she's very kind. Though she doesn't seem to think much of this séance thing, I'll say that...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Fiadh - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She's more the old fashioned sort - herbal remedies and well scrying, that sort of thing. I guess someone has to keep that up.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Saoirse - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the young cook, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Saoirse - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: No but I've seen her about. She's very interested in all this magical guff, isn't she?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Saoirse - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I guess that must be what Evelyn saw in her...

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Arwa - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Arwa - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: We've done some business actually.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Arwa - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I wanted something from her homeland - nothing fancy or rare, mind you. I don't think she would trade such things.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Arwa - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: She was very sharp on paper but somewhat distracted in person.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: We didn't talk for very long, but we've met. He asked me what brought me here.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: So... I talked with him about angels. He asked me some questions but grew quickly bored by my responses.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...Ah, but there's Sunday mass at twelve, isn't there? So much for that, I'll see him then.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I've been avoiding him since. Imagine, boring a priest!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Campbell - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the Reverend?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Campbell - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I haven't. Should I have...? I can't imagine what we'd talk about.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Higgins - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've seen a man around here, not a guest or staff, with a strong build - might have been talking to Father Sinnot?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Higgins - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Can't say I have, no.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ó Finn - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ó Finn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Imagine in this, the year of our Lord 1897, not believing in angels!

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Ó Finn - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: I suppose I should have expected that kind of backwards thinking from a hermit.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about our host, the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Certainly, I have heard of him. For a while, he was all anyone would talk about. When his wife died, many ambitious families tried to pawn their daughters off on him.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: He had no interest, it seems. Shame. I can't see the line lasting beyond him and the boy.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Walter Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Marquess Blake's son?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Walter Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Well, I know all this will be his when his father passes. The last surviving Blake. If you can call his state surviving.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Character Presents - Cathal/Opinion on Walter Blake - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: ...not that I can comment on anyone's physical health.

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/Walks leaning on a cane - Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your cane, I hope it's nothing too serious?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/Walks leaning on a cane - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Ah, I was showing off while horse riding. What was I going to do when the mare spooked?

conversation: Cast/Cathal O'Meara/Analysis Presents - (to) Cathal/Walks leaning on a cane - Cathal
speaker: Mister O'Meara
en: Scared the daylights out of everyone, but I came out of it alright - aside from this. With luck I'll be shot of it eventually.
