conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/large brooch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is an odd question, Mister Coventry, but have you noticed Missus D'Arcy's brooch?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/large brooch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I have, yes. Hard not to spot a piece like that in my trade. But I must say it seemed familiar to me somehow.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/large brooch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I can't quite place why, though...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/The Grand Séance - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard of séances being performed, but I don't believe I've ever heard of such an event.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/The Grand Séance - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: It's supposed to be the first of its kind! What an exciting thing to be a part of.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/The Grand Séance - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Despite the central conceit being rather grim, I can't help but find myself enthralled by it all.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hedonistic Gala - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What did you think of the masked ball?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hedonistic Gala - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I've never been to anything like it! When you get to my age, you think you've seen everything.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hedonistic Gala - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Evidently, I was wrong - I saw a great many things. I had conversations with all manner of near-human things.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hedonistic Gala - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: It should have been terrifying, but it was all so exhilarating!

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Hedonistic Gala - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I am left entirely drained by it today, though.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Strange Dreams - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've found I'm having the strangest dreams ever since I got here. Have you had anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Strange Dreams - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Dreams? Em... no, nothing interesting, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've seen this symbol about the place - here, does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: My dear boy, I don't have the first clue about these things. Perhaps you should ask someone else.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Unknown Sigil - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw some sort of... rune, in my dream. A spiral with four lines intersecting it, one at the top, three at the bottom. Do you have any idea what it might be?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Unknown Sigil - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Me? No. But perhaps one of the fine folks here might be able to help you?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is a fine location, is it not? I only wish I knew how to capture it. Do you paint, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: ...In fact, I do! It helps keep my hands steady, which is useful for work.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you painted much while here?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Not as much as I'd hoped. There is so much happening that I'm not left with the energy.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What have you painted? A landscape?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Ah. I couldn't say, Sir, it is work that was done in confidence.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Oh, a commission?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/painting of deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Something of the sort, but I couldn't say more. It wouldn't be gentlemanly.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You mentioned you are a jeweller?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I am, or rather I was.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Eventually I wound up with my own shop in London. Did a tidy trade, earned enough to live well. No small feat in that city.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I sold up when my wife passed. It didn't fill me in the same way it did before that.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I still do enough to cover my needs - select clients and all that - but not a whole lot more.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I ended up in London alone as a young lad. Nothing to my name. But my mother had loved jewels and so, as a result, did I.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I found work cleaning a shop, at first. I was a well spoken lad and, as I say, I knew my stuff so in time I was raised to sales.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/jeweller  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: One thing led to another and time passed by all too quickly.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You mentioned losing your wife - my condolences, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I did, yes. Lillian. Earlier this year.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: She turned quickly. We had access to doctors, but they could do little to ease her suffering.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I'll confess, I am lost without her. Which, foolish as it sounds, is how I ended up here.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Her illness took everything from me. The little I had left I spent to come here, on the hope that the claims about this séance are true.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/dead wife - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: If I could see her, hear her, then I'd gladly give it all - down to the very shirt on my back.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/locket - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is a strange one, Mister Coventry, but I found a dropped locket in the southwest corridor - which I believe you are staying in?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/locket - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Oh - ah! Why, that belonged to my dear dead wife. From before we married. Dabny, she was. Elaine Dabny.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/locket - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is a strange one, Mister Coventry, but I have dropped a locket. It's a gift for my beloved, Elaine Donnelly, and bears her initials - might you have seen it?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/locket - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I have not, but I shall keep an eye out. Hopefully, these old eyes will be of some use!

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/locket - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I'm here hoping to speak with her, you see. I'm told something personal can help anchor the ghost. I must have dropped it. Thank you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/no mementos - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your wife, would you have a picture I could see?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/no mementos - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Ahhh, those are in my room - I'll remember to take one when I'm next there, to show you later on.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The young Master, Walter Blake - do you know much of the lad?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Hmm? Well... Not a whole lot. He was in a carriage accident some years back. The one his mother died in.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I gather it left the boy scarred both mentally and physically.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: One couldn't be too lonely, I suppose, in a large house surrounded by staff.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He doesn't come out when the hotel has guests.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/will - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I... relate to him, in a way. I lost my mother when I was young, too, so at least he is not entirely alone.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/sleep pills - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I find I just cannot sleep well here. I hope you are faring better...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/sleep pills - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Ah, well, I have pills that help with that sort of thing. I'd wager I could fall asleep on a battlefield once I've taken them.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/sleep pills - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Or at least, I certainly don't recall anything in the mornings.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/sleep pills - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Nothing, not even dreams get through.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spotted anything of note on today's schedule?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: The talks look interesting! I'm especially interested in hearing the Marquess talk about the building and its history.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: And after a spot of lunch, Miss Callaghan's talk on the Otherworld, I think it's called, might be worth hearing.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Then a spot of dinner at 7 before the fancy dress ball this evening.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I must confess, I hope that doesn't run too late. Partying into the wee hours is behind me these days. As for tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: And I am interested in attending the silent dinner at 8pm.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Other than that, I'm going to play against myself in a game of chess. I am exhausted after last night's gathering and need to recover - should anyone need me, I'll be in a nice nook I found in the upper west corridor.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Anything planned for today?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Timetable - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I hope to make the Doctor's talk at 3pm. And, of course, I am giving my own talk at 5pm - "History of the Region".

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Deane's room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Deane's room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Hmmm, why? Do you have business with her?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Deane's room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Anyway, I cannot help you. It wouldn't be right to share that sort of information.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/gauge - coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The device in the atrium is a strange one, no?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/gauge - coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Everything here is strange to me! But yes, that one really stood out.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/gauge - coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I'm told it measures our readiness for the séance. How I do not know.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/gauge - coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: But now it is decreasing. I hope that isn't anything to worry about...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/washer woman - covo
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: You mean... the housekeeper? Missus Joyce? I assume she does all that work in the basement? Certainly, I've seen none of it anywhere else.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/washer woman - covo
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This may sound odd, but have you seen a woman washing clothes on the grounds?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/wife name mismatch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Sorry, what was your wife's name again?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/wife name mismatch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Eh... Lillian Coventry. Smith, before we married.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/wife name mismatch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Oh, you told me her name was Elaine Dabny.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/wife name mismatch - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Ah. Well, that was my first wife. A man my age has history, you see...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Cigar Burn  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: One of the armchairs in the library seems to have suffered a few cigar burns.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Evidence Presents - Coventry/Cigar Burn  - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Nothing to do with me dear boy, I can assure you! I abstain from that kind of thing.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ivy - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ivy - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: A charming girl, by all accounts. I'm surprised she's allowed to be here, though.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ivy - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I wonder what her father thinks of all this... And that dazed look in her eyes - you'd swear she was under the influence.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Varley - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the manager?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Varley - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Mister Varley? Only in passing. He's taken every opportunity to ensure I'm well, but doesn't make much conversation outside of that.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Lan Fen - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Lan Fen - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Miss McLeod's chaperone? Only through her companion. She seems as out of place here as myself!

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Skerritt - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Skerritt - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: The freemason? Oh, I think I'm not meant to let that slip - then again, he told me in no great confidence. I think he wanted to impress me.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Skerritt - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He seems a fine enough chap. I'll make sure to get a business card from him; can't hurt to get in with that crowd!

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Corentine - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Corentine - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Not too much, she always seems so engrossed in her work that I thought it best to leave her be.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Corentine - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: But we did have a brief chat about poetry one evening. I hope she enjoyed the break from her work.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Caitlin - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Caitlin - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Missus Joyce? Chatty woman, very likeable.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Caitlin - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Missus Joyce? Chatty woman. No love lost on our resident mystics, certainly.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Caitlin - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Word to the wise, don't ask her about Miss Mantovani. I think it very nearly killed her...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Darragh - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Darragh - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He collected me off the train and brought me over. Fine fellow. Seems to know a bit about magic himself, which took me by surprise.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Seamus - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the porter?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Seamus - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Doyle is his name, isn't it? I don't want to spread rumours, but I think he might have been drunk or something when he took my bags.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Seamus - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: But, I suppose, we all have our crosses to bear.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ines - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ines - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Happily! I caught her for a few moments while out walking on one of the less damp days.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ines - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I've never met anyone from Brazil before, so I was rather pleased to.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ines - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: She seemed interested in the local area and its history, which I happened to have read up on a bit for this trip.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ines - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I was no help to her, really, but it was nice to talk about something... normal while here.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ettiene - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Touissant?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ettiene - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: We first met at dinner a few evenings back. Once he learned I wasn't - what did he call it? - a practitioner, he softened toward me.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Cathal - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me anything on Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Cathal - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Oh. Ah- Well, we spoke, but he quickly grew bored, I'm afraid. I'm not very versed in all this magic stuff, you see.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Dupré - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Dupré - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He seems like a good man. And doing quite well for himself, if I do say so. It was nice to talk to another genuine businessman for a while.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Dupré - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: And, well, we discussed our recent bereavements too - I hope he finds a good resting place for his friend.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on D'Arcy - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any dealings with Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on D'Arcy - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: That one's a firecracker, that's for certain! She seems friendly with Mister Dupré - questionably so, for a married woman. I gather some people expected her husband here, but he couldn't make it in the end.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Mister Coventry.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Are you sure? I'm not nearly as interesting as the other guests.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wouldn't say that. I don't find anyone here uninteresting.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: You're too kind, Mister Ward. I'm not sure there's much to say about myself; I'm but an ageing jeweller. Making do, but not on par with many other guests here.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I love a good read and, even at my age, I can recall a fair bit of most things I've taken in. It's left me something of an armchair historian.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: If it concerns Britain or Ireland in the past five hundred years, I can likely tell you something about it.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: In fact, I'm giving a talk tomorrow on the "History of the Region", at 5pm.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Why, I gave a talk on the "History of the Region" earlier today.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Coventry - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: In fact, I'm giving a talk today on the "History of the Region", at 5pm.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Hazel - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Hazel - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Not much - I think she's more interested in speaking with the other magicians.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Hazel - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I don't mind, I can't blame her for it.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ruairí - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ruairí - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I have indeed - a fine fellow. We've had some discussions about the whole idea behind this event. The nature of séances, and such.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Ruairí - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I must say, I'm surprised to meet a doctor who's both that and any sort of magician... but that just goes to show how much I have to learn.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Not really, no. Every time I see her, she is exhausted from her day.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I suppose this is an important event for her. Even though I don't know the woman, I can tell she's a big fish in this pond!

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Deane - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I'm sure she'll find time for me by the time all this is over.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Carmela - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your thoughts on Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Carmela - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I gather she is very well-respected in the field. She's quite the catch for an event as far off as this - indeed, I think she's the sole reason so many have come this far!

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Carmela - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: She gave me a reading. It all sounded very impressive, but didn't make all that much sense to me, I'm afraid...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Arwa - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Arwa - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Devastatingly bright, that woman - though she seems to get distracted mid-conversation.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Arwa - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: We were talking about the claiming of artefacts from occupied territories and she just... went cold.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on O'Finn - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on O'Finn - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: We've not properly met. An odd fellow to see at a gathering like this.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on O'Finn - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: But then, what do I know about gatherings like this?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on O'Finn - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Quite the character though. He's strikes a mighty portrait, wouldn't you say?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Fiadh - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Fiadh - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Not so much. She spends a lot of her time out in the maze, but my knees aren't up for that - not in this weather.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Marquess Blake yet?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: The things he's suffered - the loss of his wife, injuries to his son...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I can see why he'd invest in an event like this so heavily.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: A few times, the poor man...

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Saoirse - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the cook, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Saoirse - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: No, no. I don't see a need to distract her from her duties.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Walter Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If I understand correctly, the Marquess has a son living somewhere in the manor.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Walter Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He lives in their private residence off the east wing, I believe.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Walter Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Having lost his mother at such a young age, that is understandable.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Walter Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I saw him once, being wheeled through the grounds - but that was only from a distance.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Walter Blake - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I gave him a wave and he returned it, but I'll admit it was lacklustre. Not used to people, a bit of a recluse.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Sinnott - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Sinnott - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He's a curious sort, isn't he? Very... stern. Though, I suppose in some ways this is a rather serious event... so truthfully I can't blame him for it.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Character Presents - Coventry/Opinion on Sinnott - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: He spends a lot of time wandering the grounds. Blessing it, for what is to come, he tells me.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Analysis Presents - (to) Coventry/Scuffed Clothes - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have some dust on your suit, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Analysis Presents - (to) Coventry/Scuffed Clothes - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Ah, so I do! How did that get there? Perhaps the housekeeper is not so fastidious as she should be, eh?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Analysis Presents - (to) Coventry/stains on hands
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your hands, Sir - they are stained?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Analysis Presents - (to) Coventry/stains on hands
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Ah, so they are! My apologies - I must admit, I took some work with me.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Analysis Presents - (to) Coventry/stains on hands
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: I was working on some pieces in my room before I stepped out. I should have done a better job cleaning up after myself.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Ward in room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Wh- Mister Ward? I didn't invite you here, did I? And how on earth did you get into my room?

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Ward in room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If... If I might-

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Ward in room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: No, no - I'm sure you can explain it to the manager, dear boy.

conversation: Cast/Simon Coventry/Ward in room - Coventry
speaker: Mister Coventry
en: Wh- Sir? I didn't invite you here, did I? And how on earth did you get into my room?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Oh. A new face? So late in the proceedings...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Mister Ward... You need to talk to me?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Then who are you, Sir, that would peer into a house with the veil halfway lifted?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Scoundrel, or scholar?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Neither, I confess. I'm more of an interested party than anything else, Miss...?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Arwa. My name is Arwa Hisham. I am a scholar. An archaeologist from Cairo. And you, what is your name?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm Declan Ward, Miss Hisham. Pleased to meet you.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll leave you be.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: May Allah guide you.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: If you find the artefact, Mister Ward, you must break it. Leave nothing but powder and dust.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Cursed? If you're trying to dissuade me, you will need to choose more than the hysteria of...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: ...you are serious.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm afraid so.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The thing hasn't left my mind since I first discovered its existence...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Every moment I am awake... even when I am not - I think of that vase. If I am very still, I feel it pulling me away from myself.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Not just obsession, then.... I will not be subject to such a thing. Will you help me? Will you find and destroy it?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Normally, I would not condone the destruction of something so ancient... But such a thing should never have survived this long.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And always, always... I hear a song, in the back of my head, I have never heard before. I wrote it down, though I do not know what for.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Here. Do you see? I am not myself. And yet it seems so important...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And take the music, too, in case it helps you.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: You found your way down here, too, then?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: This is... not what it looks like!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I was hoping to find more of interest down here, but it seems long abandoned. You?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Wait, you are also not meant to be here.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The same, looking for something of interest. I think, in my case, I found it. You would be?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The same, Miss Hisham. Though I think I, too, am hitting a dead end.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It seems our path is one. Maybe we can keep one another's discretion?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What brought you down here?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I... am seeking a vase. This vase.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It was stolen from my people and I want to bring it home. You?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I am... searching for somebody.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Who? Is it Evelyn Deane?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your friend, Evelyn Deane.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me, Miss, did you hire me to search for her?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: No, but I am glad somebody did. I am also looking for her, while I search for my vase. If I find anything, you will be the first to know.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was hired to find her.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Music? I wonder if I can find somewhere to play this...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...How did you know?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I am glad to hear that. I am also looking for her, while I search for my vase. If I find anything, you will be the first to know.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Arwa conversation
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She is missing, is she not? I have not seen her in days! She is my friend.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Bridge Game  - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand there was a bridge game on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Bridge Game  - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes, though I was not there. I was taking a walk in the gardens, and then I retired to my room.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Arwa Statement - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me anything else about what you saw when you were in the gardens?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Arwa Statement - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have told you all I know; I only saw, I did not overhear.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Arwa Statement - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Maybe you could ask the priest yourself. Are you feeling brave?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/News clippings - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Missus Joyce has quite the interest in the affairs going on in Dublin.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/News clippings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Ward. I know... I know the name.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/News clippings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Of course I know the name. So who are you, Mister Ward? A friend? A brother? Or a liar?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Leaving letter - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event and checking out from the hotel.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Leaving letter - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Before the séance? She can't have cared for it much after all.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Cathal Statement - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara mentioned that he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night, and that he thought she might be under the influence.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Cathal Statement - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Oh? Well, there is plenty of drink here, for those who partake. Couldn't that have been exactly the case?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Bedroom skeleton key - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: ...Disgusting.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Doyle's Statement - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle mentioned he overheard Miss Deane arguing with a man on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Doyle's Statement - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Let it not be said she doesn't have spirit.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Doyle's Statement - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: ...oh, do you want to know who she was arguing with? You and me, both.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Dead End - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems, when Miss Deane left, she wandered into the hedge maze... but after a certain point, there's no sign of her at all.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Dead End - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And so, the manor adds disappearing women to its repertoire?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Dead End - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Somehow, I am not surprised. A dog's tail will never straighten itself, after all.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Entertainment schedule - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's quite the number of events going on here, this week.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Entertainment schedule - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Events...? Yes, I suppose there are. I've barely noticed.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Entertainment schedule - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Is there something specific you are interested in?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Staff area key - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: For what purpose do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Telegram draft - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Missus Joyce had the intention to hire a detective to look into where Miss Deane has gone.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Telegram draft - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: More than an intention, no?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Telegram draft - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: How fares the search? You, such a stranger to this place...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Money - Arwa
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER HER THE MONEY. ]

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Money - Arwa
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP THE MONEY. ]

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Money - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Oh - I don't need this. Keep it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Money - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Alcohol - Arwa
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER HER THE ALCOHOL. ]

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Alcohol - Arwa
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP THE ALCOHOL. ]

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Alcohol - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Ah. No, thank you. It is against my beliefs to drink alcohol. But I appreciate the offer.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Alcohol - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Silks - Arwa
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER HER THE SILKS. ]

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Silks - Arwa
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP THE SILKS. ]

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Silks - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Oh - this is lovely. Really, very kind of you. I... Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Silks - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Photograph of Deane - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Photograph of Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: That is... her name is Evelyn Deane. She was here, before.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Photograph of Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have not seen her for some time.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Map of the Region - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It's a map. What of it?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Séance Advert - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems they've spared no expense to put on this event.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Séance Advert - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Of course. It would have been cheaper to host it in your Dublin. Or London.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Séance Advert - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But then the house itself is the draw.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Séance Advert - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The house and its inhabitants. I suppose they do not travel...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Telegram for Ms Barbosa - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: This is not for me.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Telegram for Ms Barbosa - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: ...And if it were, I'd be angry.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Blake Family - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I think they lived well, for a time, on the profits of blood and theft. But Al-Mal Al-Haram always brings misfortune with it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Blake Manor - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This house must be very old.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Blake Manor - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Old enough, but not so much that the bones it was built on are yet gone.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Edward Blake - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Edward Blake?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Edward Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I understand he is a man who did some terrible things. I will give him no further credit. Allah yihdih.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hauntings - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen anything... strange around the manor? Like, perhaps, ghosts?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hauntings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Ah. So, you see them, too?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hauntings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: They do like to wander... the dead. Those of them who can.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hauntings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It is strange to note that ghosts carry their physical plights at death.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hauntings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: You would think they would... heal or something, but no. Why is that?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Freemasons - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Freemasons - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have heard the name, but I have not been able to find much information about them.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Second Sight - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about the Second Sight?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Second Sight - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: A Celtic tradition, apparently differing in nature per region, or at least per person.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Second Sight - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It is thought to bestow foreknowledge upon its keeper, letting them lift the veil.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Second Sight - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But this is not my area of expertise. You are better off asking someone else. One of the women who claims to bear it, perhaps.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Ritual Markings - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There appears to be evidence of a ritual in one of the upstairs bedrooms.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Ritual Markings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I cannot speak to the choices made by the guests or the hotel's inhabitants.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Ritual Markings - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But if there is to be a ritual, why not upstairs?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything strange happening around the manor? Unexplainable phenomena?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Do you - does everyone see such things, then? I thought, my eyes...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The worst thing were the bones...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I lifted it to find the bones of a small hand.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I went to grab the housekeeper, but when we returned, the bones were gone.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I thought she would think I played a trick on her, but she told me this was not the first time - that made it all the stranger.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange occurences - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: A few nights ago, I stepped on a carpet and felt a crunch.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Staff say Deane left - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley said Miss Deane left some time ago.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Staff say Deane left - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: One less person to keep track of...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Mysterious figure in window - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've noticed someone watching the goings on from one of the upstairs windows?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Mysterious figure in window - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have not been outside much to notice it, but it would not surprise me.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Mysterious figure in window - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I wonder what sort of thing is watching us?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Mysterious figure in window - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What sort of... thing?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Mysterious figure in window - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Hm?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Fae - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you know anything about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Fae - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Not especially. They do, however, remind me of tales of Jinn - Spirits and Afarit.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/The Fae - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Jinn, like your fae, love to meddle in human affairs. It is, in fact, their favourite thing!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hermetic Order - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hermetic Order - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: They are a society interested in ritual magic. This alone... is harmless.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hermetic Order - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The only part of their goings-on I am concerned with it their appropriation of Ancient Egyptian elements into their practice.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hermetic Order - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Europeans are fascinated with our culture, which is one thing - but they just never seem to keep their hands to themselves.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hermetic Order - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I am curious as to how much that is also true of organisations like this "Hermetic Order".

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Arrival conflict - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It would seem the Father is lying, wouldn't it?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Talks schedule - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you plan on attending any of the talks?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Talks schedule - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Mm… the one on the manor, I think, and perhaps Mister Dupré’s, if I find the time.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Laudanum - Arwa

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Protestant Faith - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Protestant Faith - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I know that it was formed after disagreements within the Catholic church spurred a fitnah among followers.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Protestant Faith - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: After which there was the creation of new churches with differing forms of worship, but I don't know know specifics.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Faith - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There seem to be a great many different faiths practised amongst the guests.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Faith - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: More than you expected? That is understandable.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Faith - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: This part of the world is by and large Christian, after all.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Faith - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: You would find that is not true for other parts of the world. But I am visiting you, after all.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Catholic Faith - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know much about Catholicism, Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Catholic Faith - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have a general understanding of the faith, but I am no scholar of it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Old Catacombs - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What brought you to the catacombs?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Old Catacombs - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Curiosity, the same as you. But I have not had much luck.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Old Catacombs - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: What a terrible place. What things took place down here? What might be down here, still?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Old Catacombs - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: What a terrible place. What things took place down there? What might be down there, still?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange dreams - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've had some strange dreams while I've been staying here.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange dreams - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: This place... It gets too easily into one's head...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Strange dreams - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I haven't tasted a good night's sleep in... a very long time.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Sketches of Vase - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been drawing a particular artefact as of late?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Sketches of Vase - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: A vase... or an unlidded urn, found decades ago and just as quickly "lost." I have a personal fascination with it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Sketches of strange symbol - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've seen sketches of a symbol around that I don't recognise. A spiral intersected with four lines... Does that sound familiar to you?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Sketches of strange symbol - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I do not recognise it, no.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Séance's purpose - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the intentions of this séance?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Séance's purpose - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I think it is best that the dead are left to Allah. But if they are already restless... what harm?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hedonistic Gala - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you expecting the masquerade ball to go... like that?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hedonistic Gala - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: This would not be the first culture to employ the use of hallucinogens in their spiritual practice, and it will not be the last.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hedonistic Gala - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Was I expecting it? Miss Deane warned me but I do not drink so I was not in danger of being poisoned.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hedonistic Gala - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It was interesting, almost infectious, to be among you all as the drugs took effect. I think I lost myself a little.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hedonistic Gala - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The things people described seeing - dancing figures, a horned giant, old women watching from the rafters. I saw none of that.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Hedonistic Gala - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I am almost - almost - jealous.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The Vase of Nectanebo. It was found in a tomb excavation among the canopic jars, where one would expect the jar containing the entombed's heart.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about this vase you're looking for?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: This jar - vase, as it's commonly called - contained not the expected heart, but wood ash.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Its hieroglyphic markings offered little indication of why this might be.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It represents a fascinating deviation from standard burial rites... But the room was found during an expedition attended by Western gentry.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: One of the earlier Blakes. And the vase was taken as spoils... Which makes my job much harder.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase history - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Another gift from our glorious English occupiers. But, then, you would know all about that, yes?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Unknown Sigil - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this symbol mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Unknown Sigil - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Hm. No, it is not any symbology or script I recognise.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Deane's room
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Deane's room
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Of course, I visited only a few days ago... Wait, I cannot recall? It was only a short walk from my room... How could I forget?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Deane's room
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You were visiting her?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Deane's room
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes, we had been corresponding about some of my research. She invited me to this event. We are friends, I would say.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Drawing - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you much of an artist, Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: As much as I need to be. Diagrams are often helpful in my line of work, where photography is not sufficient..

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have been making sketches of a specific vase I have been interested in.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been drawing a vase?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The Vase of Nectanebo. I can see it when I close my eyes.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Long buried, and then long-lost... It should be somewhere, here, in these halls.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But it is not here to see. Someone has hidden it away.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But where? The basement? The church? Blake's own residence?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I can find nothing. If only I could find some records!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Vase drawing - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: ...Excuse me. I am just... passionate...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Fascination with vase - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This vase you're studying, is it an artefact you have a particular interest in?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Fascination with vase - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I discovered it had been "acquired" by a member of the Irish gentry a few years ago.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Fascination with vase - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And as is true of so much of our history in Egypt, it was taken from its rightful home and kept as a souvenir.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Fascination with vase - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Supposedly, it's stored somewhere among the Blakes' possessions.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Fascination with vase - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I would be interested in... seeing it...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Melody - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I keep hearing these notes in my mind. Over and over, clear like the blue sky.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Melody - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have some idea that they are connected to the vase I am looking for, but I am not sure how.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Melody - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is this melody?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Manor Maps - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Some but I'm keen to see it all. Not all of it is open to the public.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Manor Maps - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you explored much of the Manor?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Manor Maps - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I wonder how upset they would really be to find me outside of those bounds? What harm could come from curiosity?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Hah, say "owner" if you like. But don't expect me to call a thief by any other name.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that Lady Wilhelmina Blake was not the finder, but the last known owner of the vase.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But if she was the last to have it... Maybe she stored it somewhere in this place.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: That could be so, Mister Ward, but I haven't been able to find any written documentation that confirms it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The vase you're looking for, I think it may be similar to the one Lady Wilhelmina Blake seems to be holding in her portrait in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Lady W Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: In any case, she is long gone. Perhaps it has been stored somewhere in her absence...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for Saturday?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Well, I do not think I can miss the Ball this evening. I want to know what is considered to be a party over here.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Until then, I am interested in the history of this manor, so I will attend the Marquess' talk at eleven.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And I'm meeting Mister O'Meara for lunch at one. As for tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Social obligations aside, I intend to explore the Manor. Quite an interesting building, and so large. I'm sure it holds many secrets...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I hear the graveyard is opening up, too. I may pay it a visit around eleven.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Timetable - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And of course, I do not think I can miss the séance...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Soul jars - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the term "soul jar" mean anything to you, Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Soul jars - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Well, it's not technically my field of expertise, but they are jars used to capture the essence of living beings.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/Soul jars - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Not all of them, of course. Soul jars were part of funeral rites in the East, and no, um, real-world effect. But I suspect, here, you are asking about the magical type I outlined.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen this map of the catacombs underneath the manor?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have not, but I would like to.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It seems I have not missed anything. Mafawetesh No'ta.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Shukran, Mister Ward. Rayaht bali. You've... put my mind at ease.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/catacomb map - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It doesn't look like there is anywhere to hide items of value, but it might not hurt to check.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/gauge - arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/gauge - arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Eventually. I didn't notice it under the stairs until one day I saw a few guests gathered around it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/gauge - arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: They had noticed its gauge increasing and were wondering why. I did not care, so I left them to it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How are you feeling now?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I feel... like myself again. Like when a cold has passed by. I am restored.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But the vase - what magic was that? How does something like that work?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: What did "Wilhelmina" get up to when she left here?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Was it Nectanebo who had taken hold of her body at the time, or some Jinn? - and what damage have they done?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Evidence Presents - Arwa/reflection - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I feel like these things may become my next obsession...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Skerritt - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Skerritt - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The opportunity? That is not what I would call it. But no, I haven't spoken to him beyond a cursory 'hello'. I don't believe he is interested in talking with a person like me.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Corentine - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Corentine - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The poet... Yes. She seemed tired so I brought her a coffee.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Corentine - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: We sat and talked a while. We have both studied this area. Me, the house, and her, the region.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Corentine - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I cannot say we pushed along each other's agendas, but it was nice to find overlaps nonetheless.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ivy - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ivy - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: A strange girl with two faces!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ivy - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She needs to decide which to wear, before she's left with nothing between her ears.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ivy - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: We spoke only once, and it was nonsense she spoke - but there was enough between the lines.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes. She walks more comfortably in this world than I, but it's still not home to her.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: We got on well, until I told her I was friends with Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She kept her composure, but she pretended to get cold and quickly left.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Why she has such issue with Evelyn I do not know, but I could tell her blood was boiling just under that cold surface.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Lan Fen - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I gather that my friend has that effect on people...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Varley - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Varley - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: The poor man. I have him hounded with questions about the place. He is good to entertain me, but more tight-lipped in his answers than I want.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Varley - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I was hoping for a tour of the more private sections of the house, but the man is a stone wall!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Varley - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Really, what do they have to hide!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Caitlin - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Caitlin - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It seems we have a mutual disinterest in conversation. Except for once when she demanded to know why I was here, but...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Caitlin - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I wonder, why does she care?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Darragh - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the groundsman?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Darragh - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Not much... but we spoke when he brought the carriage to the station for me.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Darragh - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: He's a friendly face. More than some people here, that's for sure.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Darragh - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I'd love to know what is in his safe. I saw him hurriedly deposit something there one evening last week. I wonder if it's a key?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Seamus - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the porter?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Seamus - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: He talks more than my old Auntie! I asked him a bit about the ground, and could have written a book with what he shared.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Seamus - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: He even offered to lend me his keys so I could see more of the grounds for myself, but then realised he had lost them.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Seamus - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Such a shame.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Ah, the only woman who has out-travelled me.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I confess, I like her. No formal education in such things as we scholars study here...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: How do you say... Betgeeb mel-akher? - she gets right to the point. It's very refreshing.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Like me, she is more interested in this area than the séance.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ines - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I suppose you need a stronger reason to come so far.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ettiene - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've spoken with Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ettiene - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: As it happens, I have. A scholar of magic and religious ritual, he said, and their misuse.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ettiene - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: An intriguing topic. And a startlingly pleasant man. Which is why it pains me to see him so concerned.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes. In fact, we corresponded before the event. His father deals in antiques, and I have found myself working as a go-between.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: That has put me in touch with some members of the Golden Dawn who seek more... mystical wares...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Many of them are satisfied with any pot if it's old enough, and the merchants in Cairo are always happy to relieve them of their gold.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I... am rambling. Mister O'Meara reached out through a previous client and wanted something more interesting.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Cathal - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
