en: An interesting challenge that I happily overcame.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Dupré - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Dupré - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes. We have spoken. He is a perfect gentleman.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Dupré - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And yet, he had the strangest look on his face... and the questions he asked... I could not answer.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on D'Arcy - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on D'Arcy - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I might even consider her a friend of sorts, provided she wouldn't be put out by the familiarity.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on D'Arcy - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I see something of myself in her, and I think the feeling is mutual. We're two halves of the same bean.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on D'Arcy - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Besides, she makes me laugh.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Coventry - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Coventry - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have. He is also a student of the past. He is fascinated with his British Empire and we did not see eye to eye when it came to stolen goods.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Coventry - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: He had a 'might makes right' attitude. If something can be taken, then take it - by any means.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Hazel - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Hazel - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes. I have, yes. A show-woman to her core. She was trying to impress me with her knowledge of the seven elements, the eye of Horus, the concept of Ma'at, and other things she no doubt learned skimming through a book.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Hazel - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It would be like me trying to impress you by listing the ten commandments and your three most popular Saints.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Hazel - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I do not think I would break salt and bread with this woman.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: He introduced himself to me, and it became clear that we have almost nothing in common.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Almost. Once we moved past magic and mysticism and got into politics, then the conversation flowed.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: In Egypt, we have been under British occupation for fifteen years. Not that they would admit it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Yes, a drop in the ocean compared to what you have suffered but it is good to hear after all this time and all these tragedies, you have not lost your fight.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Doctor Callaghan assures me there are movements forming - who knows, perhaps in your lifetime you will know freedom!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I only hope my people see it soon, too.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ruairí - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: True, it is not a formal occupation, but they've put enough money and troops into my country to start their own nation, so I'm not too concerned with what they want to call it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Arwa - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about yourself, Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Arwa - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I am a historian and Egyptologist, and I am here to see how the adoption of ancient Egyptian culture and symbology is being used in... 'magic'.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Arwa - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I think there are arguments to be had about the nature of this magic, but I would not invite myself to those arguments.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Arwa - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Otherwise... otherwise, I am the eldest of three daughters, and I would very much like to see my sisters soon before they run off and marry the first pretty poet boy they meet.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Arwa - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Hopefully, I will not be kept too long in this part of the world. It is lovely but my bones were not made for this cold.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She is... an acquaintance. No, a friend. We have been writing to her for some time.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She is the reason I came here; she invited me. Based on my work, my... research.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But I have not seen her in a day or two. At first, I actually forgot she was here. My friend, who brought me here - It's like forgetting to eat or drink!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Then I found some of our correspondence and it reminded me she was here. But I can not find her now.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Deane - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I am worried for her.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Carmela - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Carmela - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She seems... like a good woman. She has quite the skill in showmanship. Seems that she fills people's eyes more than any other guest.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Carmela - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: After all, if you believe in all this magic, then why are none of these other magicians hosting? Surely one among them might match her.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Carmela - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I'm sure she's talented, but she has a way of speaking that makes you want to listen to her, and that, I think, is the heart of it.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Fiadh - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Fiadh - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She looks at me as if there is a gecko on my head.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Fiadh - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It makes me uncomfortable, and so I avoid her.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Sinnott - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Sinnott - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Christians have been coming to my land for as long as there have been Christians.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Sinnott - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: But it has been getting worse recently. Since the British occupation, more and more missionaries have come.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Sinnott - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Father Sinnott, however, did not seem to care about my faith. He asked, shrugged, and then talked about lost tombs and buried sites.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Sinnott - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I do not trust him, of course, but I appreciated the conversation and the lack of religious interest.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Saoirse - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Saoirse - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: ...The resident cook? We've run into each other a few times.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Saoirse - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: She always looks worried about something, but I can never tell what for all her stammering.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ó Finn - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ó Finn - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: People will stare at me less, now, so long as he is around to fill their eyes.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Ó Finn - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: We have not spoken yet, not properly. I will try make time later on, once... well, when I am freed up.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Campbell - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the Reverend?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Campbell - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Why would I? I am not looking for religion; I have my own.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Higgins - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the man you saw Father Sinnott talking to?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Higgins - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: What do you expect me to make of him? I only saw him from a distance.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Higgins - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: He looked strong, like a labourer, but he was not very remarkable, otherwise, and I heard nothing from him, so I cannot form an opinion on his manner.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Higgins - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: All I can do is wonder why he was here at all.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Blake - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the chance to speak with the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Not so much as I would like - I have a lot to say to that man about his ancestors and their sticky fingers.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I'd say half the things in this house have been stolen from overseas.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Opinion on Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: With the other half, of course, having been stolen from the natives here.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Walter Blake - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the Young Master at all?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Character Presents - Arwa/Walter Blake - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: No, nor have I seen him. But then, why would I?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Tired eyes - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had trouble sleeping of late, Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Tired eyes - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: And... if I have? It is a strange place where up is down, down is left, and God-only-knows where right is. Is that not to be expected?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Tired eyes - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I have not slept properly in... some time, now. Maybe even before I came here...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Restless hands - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been drawing?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Restless hands - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Ah, the charcoal... yes, it gets everywhere. It is useful for sketches of artefacts, shading...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/Restless hands - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: To manipulate the values of light and dark and bring life to a still image... But still, to never match the real thing.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/headdress - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your headdress, Miss Hisham - does it carry any significance?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/headdress - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It is a tarha. Headdresses are a symbol of my faith and devotion as a Sunni Muslim. I am thinking, perhaps, you do not get so many of us over here?

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/headdress - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I must confess, you would be the first I met of that ilk.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/necklace - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your necklace, it is an unusual design...

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/necklace - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: It is made from pottery I have excavated. The pottery was not actually old or valuable, a modern pot covered in countless sandstorms.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Analysis Presents - (to) Arwa/necklace - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: I wear it to remind me to stay in the present - there is beauty to be found here, as much as in the past. Something I find myself struggling with these days.

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Ward in room - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: What do you think you're-? Get out!

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Ward in room - Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Hisham-

conversation: Cast/Arwa Hisham/Ward in room - Arwa
speaker: Miss Hisham
en: Bara! In fact, let's get out together - and we can see what the manager thinks of this behaviour.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Mister Ward. You've come back to me.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And you are?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: My name is Declan Ward.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Recently arrived?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Yes, Miss...?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What brings you here?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm interested to see this Grand Séance... I saw the advert, and I have to admit, it intrigued me.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Ah, then you're among company. Everyone is here for the séance, I believe.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Why would you be sorry about that? I haven't told you.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Don't look so concerned! My name is Olivia D'Arcy, Mister Ward. A pleasure, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A fair point.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That was all. Good day, Missus D'Arcy.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Good day, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I... what a dark horse you are, Mister Ward. But for what purpose? Why go to all this trouble? Would you mock me?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...Or do you mean something worthwhile by it? I - I confess, I killed my husband. I did. It seemed to me there was nothing else I could do.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Everything he put me through... I saw nothing but red until he was cold in the ground. And then I thought, it wasn't only him who wronged me...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: There was the woman, too, who had caught his attention. She must have known. Our Evelyn Deane.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: So yes, I came here under his name, intent on finding her. To this forsaken backwater on the west coast of nowhere. To... to do something terrible to her. But now... Well, now, I don't think I wish as much vengeance as I thought.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But since I've been here... I didn't really believe in ghosts and magic before all this, you know. But I'll tell you this; I do now. My husband is haunting me.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I don't want vengeance, but I do want to be rid of him. And maybe he'll be content if he has her for company. If that is what it takes...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's no need to resort to such things, Missus D'Arcy. Let me see if I can do something about your husband.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Chance would be a damn fine thing.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/D'Arcy conversation
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: You might well recognise my name from my work? I'm a known writer of  thriller novels.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hiring telegram - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this, Missus?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hiring telegram - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Is this some sort of joke?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hiring telegram - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: You're here to look for Miss Deane, because she's missing? Then why is no one talking about this?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Do you mean to report me then? For murdering my husband?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I am not a police officer. I have no legal obligation to do so.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What about a moral one?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... know what happened. Between you. To you. I can see how you ended up where you did.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Mister Ward, it would have taken a mystic to see where I was to end up.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: If there is any consolation in it, it is not something I would do again.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: A haunting changes one's perspective on such things.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How about this, then - a second chance.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I will monitor the news where you live and only intervene if any husbands go mysteriously missing. Does that sound fair?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I don't know, Sir... Mister Baker from number 11 is an awful bore. If I need to listen to him talk about his bay trees one more time...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/resolution - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I shouldn't joke, I know. It is fair, Sir. Thank you for your kindness to me through all this.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Photograph of Deane - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Photograph of Deane - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Mm. Oh, that's Miss Deane, isn't it? She was around here just a little while ago...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you suppose the séance will be successful?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I would hope so. It's a long way to come for a failure.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But I'm sure all these experts - how hard can it be?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'm still struggling to understand the significance between asking a medium to tell me a ghost's name, and asking the ghost itself?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What is the difference, really, between asking a ghost their name and asking one to stay a while?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance advert - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It's all the same to me as long as the ghost leaves afterwards. That's the part I am interested in.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Marriage talk - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear that one of the young women in attendance is looking for a suitor.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Marriage talk - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Really? Poor darling, she should spare herself the trouble.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement Mister Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The manager says that Miss Deane checked out by means of a letter on Tuesday night.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement Mister Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And she's gone, just like that? Who leaves without a word of goodbye? For God's sake...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hauntings - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been hearing talk that this manor is haunted. Have you seen anything like that yourself?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hauntings - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I... If you had said that to me not two weeks ago, I'd have rolled my eyes at you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hauntings - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But this place... has changed my mind on ghosts...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance's purpose - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you suppose the séance will be successful?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance's purpose - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: They've been conducted before, why not this one?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Séance's purpose - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What is the difference, really, between asking a ghost their name and asking a ghost to stay a while?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Leaving letter - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event, it seems.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Leaving letter - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: So she's really gone, then? So much for goodbyes.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/The Freemasons - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: How could I? I am, after all, a woman.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/The Freemasons - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Second Sight - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard anything about Miss McLeod's Second Sight?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Second Sight - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It would make for a compelling story...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Second Sight - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But a compelling truth? I would say less so.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Ritual markings - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've found evidence of a ritual being conducted upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Ritual markings - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Well, what's the point in that? Coming all this way just to be secretive about it?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Ritual markings - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I don't understand some of these people...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Skeleton key - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What in God's name - get away from me, will you?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange occurences - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't help but feel like strange things happen in this place.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange occurences - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Tricks of the light and imagination, Mister Ward, most certainly.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange occurences - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I mean... aren't they?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement, Mister Doyle - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone late on Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement, Mister Doyle - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I cannot say I'm thrilled at the idea that the staff are talking about our business.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Statement, Mister Doyle - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I mean, of course, they are, but they could have the decency to pretend that they're not.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mysterious figure - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've noticed a figure in the upper windows when I'm outside... I don't suppose you've seen it too?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mysterious figure - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I... I have. And I wish I hadn't. What is watching us?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Dead End - DArcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she never actually left the grounds. Her trail ends in the gardens.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Dead End - DArcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: This is beginning to sound uncomfortably like a murder mystery.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Dead End - DArcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hermetic Order - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hermetic Order - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh. Well, Mister Ward, I'm not sure I should say anything at all. I wouldn't want to betray their trust in me, you understand.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Indeed, I was. And I got roundly thrashed, so I don't want to speak anymore about it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...I suppose I will say that we eventually managed to convince the Doctor to play, after no small amount of badgering.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He was a good sport about it - and surprisingly good at the game itself, come to think of it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: His aunt was there too, of course, as was Miss Quinn, Miss Barbosa, Missus Lau, Mister Coventry and, of course, the Marquess.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Bridge game - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry, but I must ask - did many attend?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Locked doors - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems they keep even the unused guest bedrooms locked.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Locked doors - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Why wouldn't they?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Written complaint - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you submit a complaint about Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Written complaint - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I did. I mean, it was ridiculous! I know we're all terribly interesting, but I felt like I was the suspect in some awful penny dreadful.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Talks schedule - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think of these talks that are going on?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Talks schedule - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I suppose I'll go to one or two - they'll do for inspiration, if nothing else.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/entertainment schedule - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Quite the range of events. All very pedestrian, mind you. I suppose I'll go to one or two - they'll do for inspiration, if nothing else.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/entertainment schedule - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Did you have an interest in any particular event or time, Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/cigar burn - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed there are cigar burns on one of the library armchairs.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/cigar burn - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, that oaf, Skerritt, fell asleep while I explained the rules of bridge to Miss Barbosa. He nearly burned the house down with his antics.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Stylised ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Here, Missus D'Arcy - do you happen to recognise this ring?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Stylised ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Where - where did you get that?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Stylised ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found it around the hotel. Does it mean something to you?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Stylised ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Not anymore. It was my husband's, the dog that he was. No, keep it - I won't look at that awful thing.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Silks - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, how pretty. The colour isn't bad, either...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Silks - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Silks - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Silks - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Flowers - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It's good to see something so fresh and bright in this dreary place.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Flowers - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Flowers - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP FLOWERS ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Flowers - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Grimoire - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, no thank you. I've had enough academia for a lifetime.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Grimoire - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Grimoire - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Grimoire - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Sweet treats - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Don't get any ideas, Mister Ward. I'm not some swooning damsel. I am not here to be wooed.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Sweet treats - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Sweet treats - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Sweet treats - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Artefacts - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, no, keep it. I'm more about the theory than any practical application, which is what this looks like to me...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Artefacts - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Artefacts - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Artefacts - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Trinkets - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: If you're not careful, Mister Ward, people will be able to accuse you of having an eye for these things.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Trinkets - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Trinkets - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP TRINKET ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Trinkets - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Trinkets - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It is lovely, and I will take it, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Cigars - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Hah! Oh, not for me, no thank you.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Cigars - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Cigars - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Cigars - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Laudanum - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: With this, I might finally get some decent sleep. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Laudanum - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Laudanum - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Laudanum - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Faith - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems there are a number of faiths practised amongst the guests.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Faith - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, yes, but who’s keeping track? That’s not what we’re here for. That would be dull.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Catholic Faith - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know much about Catholicism, Missus Darcy?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Catholic Faith - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Almost nothing at all. Why should I?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Protestant Faith - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Protestant Faith - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Enough. Despite what people might say, I’m not a godless woman. I am, however, not especially interested in talking about the minutiae.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Surreptitious meeting - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that while the services were being held, Miss McLeod used her time to visit Mister Hunter.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Surreptitious meeting - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, is that intrigue I sense?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Surreptitious meeting - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What sort of business could Miss McLeod have with the groundskeeper?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange Dreams - Darcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've had the most peculiar dreams since coming here...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange Dreams - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Really. Please do tell me more about your half-remembered slumbers...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Strange Dreams - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Honestly, Mister Ward... there are so many real and tangible things happening here, and you want to discuss dreams?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Vial of Poison - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: In your stories - has anyone ever been poisoned?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Vial of Poison - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Of course! I've used them all - arsenic, cyanide, strychnine - but my real favourite is thallium.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Vial of Poison - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It's tasteless and odourless, you see, so it's very believable that a victim could ingest it without knowing.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Vial of Poison - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And, as it's a relatively new substance, the reader can believe it when a doctor misdiagnoses it as severe gastroenteritis!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hedonistic Gala - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever been to a party like last night's, Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hedonistic Gala - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: No, and I hope not to again! If this is the kind of thing Cecil was getting up to with his club...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hedonistic Gala - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: *ahem*

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hedonistic Gala - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Now and then, something will turn up. But it's never had that sort of gravitas before.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hedonistic Gala - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Perhaps I should agree to broach the veil of life and death more often. Or find out what they put in the wine.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Hedonistic Gala - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I think I would rather speak about something else, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Sketches of Strange Symbol - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing drawings of this same symbol around the place... does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Sketches of Strange Symbol - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Should I? It doesn't look like anything I've ever seen before.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Unknown Sigil - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing a sigil around the place... a spiral with four intersecting lines. Have you seen anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Unknown Sigil - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Well... No, nothing comes to mind.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mister D'Arcy's Letters - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have reason to believe that your husband was writing to someone he shouldn't have been before his death?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mister D'Arcy's Letters - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, do I! My Cecil was quite the wordsmith; it was what had me fall for him in the first place...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mister D'Arcy's Letters - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Now, if only he'd had the decency to save those love letters for me...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Medicial Certificate - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has your work given you any expertise on medical documentation?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Medicial Certificate - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh goodness, no! The odd time I would need to include something like that, it's off to the library for me. Or I might pester my cousin, who has, himself, become a doctor.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Possessed Ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think you'll do with that ring, now?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Possessed Ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I wish I was vicious enough to say that I will wear it... but I'm not.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Possessed Ring - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: No, if this is Cecil's fate, then I will hide it away somewhere, out of sight. Or perhaps I will throw it into the sea on my way home.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Medical Code - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever written about miscarriages in your work?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Medical Code - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I... No, I... it's not something I think I...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Medical Code - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...frankly, Sir, given how the topic is dealt with in the real world, I do not think publishers or an audience would care for it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I shall ask around and try to find a way to exorcise your husband's ghost from you.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...please. I like ghost stories in books. In reality... less so.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Detective Ward
en: About the exorcism...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: After that ritual, it should be that you've seen the last of your husband.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: You actually... My God, you both actually went to all that trouble on my behalf.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Yours, and Miss Deane's.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Miss Deane's, of course...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'll forget it all, Mister Ward. For whatever it is worth, you have my word on that. It's done. I am free of my late husband, and that's all I need.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Thank you. Sincerely.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Exorcism - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: This place is positively crawling with experts on death, so hopefully...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus D'Arcy, I'm sorry to ask - but was your husband unfaithful to you?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Marriage vows don't mean an awful lot to some people, as it turns out.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He doesn't even have the decency to honour the bit about death parting us.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He didn't even have the decency to honour the bit about death parting us, after all.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever used an affair or infidelity as a plot point in a book?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: You know, if you just read my books...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But yes. I did once. A woman's husband cheated on her, and their... reconciliation night was his alibi for a murder.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Mistress - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: In hindsight, I do not think I did justice to how devastating it can be... If I were to revisit that story now, he would need another alibi.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Deane's Room - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to recall which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Deane's Room - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Near me, I know that. I overheard her and Miss Quinn arguing the other night. Not sure of the actual room. I don't recall seeing her coming or going from any room in particular.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I suppose to work hard and play hard, Mister Ward, so after all that I shall pay the bar a visit in the evenings too. Then, on Sunday...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'll keep things light, I think. Church at eleven, for my sins. Then back to my room for some writing before and after lunch at one.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans while you're here, Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'll be in attendance for Mister Blake's talk at eleven and Miss Mantovani's at five, certainly.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I suppose I'll have to make time for lunch at one, and I plan to retire to my bedroom for some writing at three.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And, of course, I don't know if I can face the séance without some liquid courage first...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/timetable - Darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And since I am not going to the séance anymore, I might as well have a few glasses of wine before I turn in early.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Drawings of a young woman - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you recognise the woman Mister Dupré has been drawing?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Drawings of a young woman - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I... Is that... Evelyn Deane? Why would he be...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Drawings of a young woman - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: No, no, I am sure it must be his Laura. It must be.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Drawings of a young woman - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He has recently lost a friend, you see. She was some sort of pagan fire priestess. I think that is why he is so fond of the fire pit in the maze.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Drawings of a young woman - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...but really, that is not my story to tell.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Their relationship - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you aware that Miss McLeod and Mister Hunter know each other? It seems they're quite close.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Their relationship - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Do I seem to you like some common gossip monger?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Their relationship - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'm not. Which means I didn't know, and I'm quite upset about that. How darling!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/Their relationship - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, but you could start trouble with that. I'll bet Miss McLeod's lord father wouldn't like competition in the way of a stable master of all things.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/gauge - darcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of that strange contraption in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/gauge - darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: The garish green tube? You can tell this place lacks a woman's touch.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/washer woman - darcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Why would I see that? Are the laundry services broken?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Evidence Presents - D'Arcy/washer woman - darcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been witness to anyone washing clothes in an odd place, like the fountain?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ivy - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ivy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: The Scottish girl? I have, a little bit.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ivy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'm not entirely sure what she's doing here, but girls like her have a tendency to find the strangest places for themselves.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ivy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Couldn't stop talking about this book she has either. What was it about? Lucent dreams?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ivy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Honestly. As if there aren't enough problems in the world without dreaming up new ones.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the manager?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: As much as I can, but he is very tight-lipped. I think he suspects I may use anything he says in a story.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And he is right! He seems like a perfect villain for a story, don't you think?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Silent as he may be, I've been watching him. He has an old key he caresses from time to time.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Varley - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It is probably just a master key to the place, but I will embellish on that point when I make use of him as inspiration.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Lan Fen - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Lan Fen - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I wish I'd had a chaperone like her before I was married. A friend - rather than an uptight, old aunt of mine.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Lan Fen - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: She might have steered me better, in the end. Or perhaps not.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Lan Fen - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: For all the thought we put in, flights of fancy do have a way of seizing a girl.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Skerritt - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Skerritt - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I have nothing to discuss with opinionated old men like him.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Skerritt - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I wouldn't even make sure of him in a story.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Corentine - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Corentine - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Thankfully! Well, she's busy with something, but we have spoken.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Corentine - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I do appreciate having someone with a wit around. It always makes things more interesting.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Corentine - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: And then there's the fact that she's supposed to be a noble of some sort, but she turns herself out in that fashion? It's just delightful.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Caitlin - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Caitlin - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I don't usually talk much with the staff. I like to think we have a mutual understanding of not bothering each other.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Caitlin - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'm not always so lucky, but it's a nice thought.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Darragh - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the groundskeeper?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Darragh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: We're not really talked. I have no cause to, I don't really want to brave the weather out there.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Darragh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Perhaps he's made of sterner stuff than you and me. Well, me anyway.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Darragh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He reminds me of a gravedigger podding around in his large boot, with a shovel over his shoulder. Though I can't imagine he is doing much planting at this time of year.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Seamus - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had reason to speak with Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Seamus - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: No, I don't think so?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Seamus - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Seamus - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Well, I think I might have gently suggested he be more careful with my bags.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Seamus - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I mean, it is his main function. He should be good at it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ines - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ines - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: We have spoken briefly. Her journey here is almost unbelievable.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ines - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Certainly, if I robbed it for a tale, I think I would have a hard time selling a reader on it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ines - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: To think all that action and travel only to spend her days here waiting by a telegraph machine!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ettiene - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ettiene - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: The thing about Frenchmen is that they're either much more fun than their English counterparts, or twice as insufferably straight-laced.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ettiene - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...And I can't yet tell which our Mister Toussaint is.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Cathal - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Cathal - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: A little. Good God, have you ever seen a boy look more like he's stepped out of a painting? He's practically cherubic.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Cathal - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I hope, for his sake, he never follows the trend of all this and goes to London.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Cathal - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, he may not agree, but I'm sure they would eat him alive.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Dupré - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been speaking much with Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Dupré - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Have I indeed - I've been spending the most of my time here with him.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Dupré - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He's a good man. And unlike most people, he's usually able to tell when I'm joking.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Missus D'Arcy.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Well now, have I not made introductions? Or is this an attempt to charm me? Let's see...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: My name is Olivia D'Arcy, as you know, and I am visiting from London. Moreover, I am sorely missing the city.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I am best known for my novels, which have been described alternately as "breathtaking", "whip-smart"...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...and "horrendously macabre", which I must say, I was quite pleased with.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on D'Arcy - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It is very... clean... here. Quiet too. I am going to appreciate the city so much more when I get home.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Coventry - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Coventry - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I didn't find him all that interesting until I learned he was a jeweller. That piqued my interest!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Coventry - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I have arranged to go see him when all this is over. I have a number of men's items to pass on.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Hazel - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Hazel - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I have. She's alright... In brief doses. She can be a bit much.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Hazel - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: A bit too eager to showcase her talents for my liking.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ruairí - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ruairí - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I have indeed. It will be the guests that save this whole event for me, you know, Mister Ward - with Doctor Callaghan among them.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ruairí - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: You don't know - or perhaps you do - what time without decent conversation can do to a person.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ruairí - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I was expecting it least of all from some local doctor, but it turns out he could give my Londonite sort a run for their money.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ruairí - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: They will be furious if they meet him. How wonderful!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Deane - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Deane - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Miss Deane is...?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Deane - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, her. I know of her, but I can't say I know her personally - but she did make herself known the other day, arguing with Miss Quinn outside my door.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Deane - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I might have minded more, but honestly, it was quite the story.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Carmela - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Carmela - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Yes, well, I did briefly. She's the star, after all. Would seem rude not to.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Carmela - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: She asked me a lot of questions, as if I am to know more than her?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Carmela - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: She's the one paid to be here, I'm the one paying. Honestly.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Fiadh - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Fiadh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: A bit - I try to avoid her.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Fiadh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It's all doom and gloom with her. Not much of a party vibe, is it?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Fiadh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: On the other hand, her nephew is quite the optimist - look to the future and all that.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Fiadh - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: His contraption is interesting - not that I'll be going near it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinon on Saoirse - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy, the cook?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinon on Saoirse - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Is that the girl in pink? Good Heavens, I was wondering what she did around here!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinon on Saoirse - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Thankfully, her cooking has more personality than her.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Arwa - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Arwa - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: She should be fabulous company. Having come so far on her own, I was expecting at least some interesting conversation.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Arwa - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But there's something wrong with her, there's no other way to say it.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Arwa - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: It's like she's possessed by something. I wonder if one of the ghosts has got to her early.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Arwa - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'm only joking! ... I mean, I think so...

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Sinnott - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Sinnott - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, him? Yes, we talked a while. Long enough for him to pass judgement. He suggested I repent and leave.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Sinnott - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Why would I listen to him? I'm not here looking for religion, and I'm certainly not here to confess my sins.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Blake - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Marquess Blake?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Blake - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Oh, only a little. He joined us for bridge the other evening, but said little outside of the game.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Blake - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I know his type - the quiet, stoic nobleman. Not exactly the type to host a large event such as this.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ó Finn - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ó Finn - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: That man is a savage. He smells like a wet dog and has the manners to match.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ó Finn - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I thought this was to be a civilised event, but then in walks the local reprobate.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Ó Finn - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: He just... he feels like he is in the wrong story!

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Campbell - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the Reverend?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Campbell - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: No, no, but he's very respectable, I'm sure.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Higgins - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've seen a man in the grounds - of a large build, not staff or a guest?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Higgins - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Why, who would that be?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Higgins - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't know, actually - that's why I asked.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Higgins - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: You know, I like this place less and less by the day.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Walter Blake - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you aware that there is a Master Blake?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Walter Blake - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Was I aware? No, I can't say I was. Why would I be?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Character Presents - D'Arcy/Opinion on Walter Blake - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Fathers have sons, families have heirs... what is there to say?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Tan line - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you... recently removed a ring, Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Tan line - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I may, or I may not have. In either case, it's none of your concern.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Large brooch - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's an interesting brooch you have there.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Large brooch - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Yes, well, it's actually very important.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Large brooch - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'd tell you, but it's, eh, secret. One of those hush-hush secret society things, you see?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Tightly held purse - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You seem unimpressed with something, Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Tightly held purse - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Do I? I suppose you want to know if it is with you? Hmmm?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Analysis Presents - (to) D'Arcy/Tightly held purse - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: Well, you can rest easy. Since coming here, I have a great many things on my mind, and none of them are to do with a man I just met.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Ward in room - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What the hell-?

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Ward in room - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I'm sure I don't know what you're doing, Mister Ward, and I'd rather not find out.

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Ward in room - D'Arcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus D'Arcy-

conversation: Cast/Olivia D'Arcy/Ward in room - D'Arcy
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: For your own sake, I rather think it best you stop talking. We'll see what the manager thinks about this.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Ah, there you are now.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: And you're back. What can I do you for?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it that you have come for the séance?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I should go.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Only do something if you want, not because you "should".

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...I'm sorry, Sir, but do I know you?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Haha, no no, but I ne'er said such. Just plainly, there you are. And, you are.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have me there, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Sir? I'm no knight. I'm Domhnall Ó Finn, and you can call me such. I'm a proud Traveller and protector of these lands.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Noted. I am Declan Ward. Also, not a knight.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Haha! Good to meet you, lad.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Ahhh... Yes and no. I am here because of the séance but not for it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I have no urge to speak to the dead, I doubt they have much comfort to offer up.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: What interests me is those people who do want to speak with the dead. How they intend to do it, and more, what they will be doing afterwards to clean up their mess.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/OFinn conversation
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: These rich people! They think because they forced themselves on these lands, they can do what they want to them. It won't stand! The land won't let it, and neither will I.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Bridge Game  - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Nah, I wasn't here then. Wouldn't have played even if I had been. I don't like bridge - gimme a game of Twenty-five or Irish Don anytime, though.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Bridge Game  - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you play the bridge game that was on last Tuesday evening?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/The Grand Séance - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Oh, very exciting to talk to a ghost. I'm sure the dead have lots to say. "Oh no, my god isn't real", "I wasted my life", "so and so didn't show up for my funeral". Riveting.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/The Grand Séance - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I'm more interested in the mad fellas who think death is more interesting than life. And the stupid things they'll do to prove it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/The Grand Séance - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your thoughts on the séance?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Ritual Markings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: What's this? Some kinda glyph? A sigil? What does it mean - one in, three out? Can't say for sure, but it feels old and Irish.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Ritual Markings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I can't say much beyond that.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Ritual Markings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Reminds me of an evil eye curse. Not that it is one, but it looks to be focusing someone or something on, well, whoever it's cast on.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Ritual Markings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen markings like these before?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Occurrences - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Hmmm, there's whispering coming from my fireplace - that strange enough for you?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Occurrences - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Probably just the old chimneys, but it sounds like it's asking "home?".

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Occurrences - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you witnessed any strange occurrences since you got here?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Dreams - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Strange dreams? Funny, you say that. I don't recall the dream, but I woke this morning with both a wanting to stay and a wanting to get the hell out of this place.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Dreams - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any odd dreams since getting here?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Strange Dreams - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Sure, how am I meant to do both?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Map of the Region - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: What's this? A local map with nothing useful or interesting marked on it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Map of the Region - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: You try to leave here with that and you'll be found dead - if you're found at all!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Map of the Region - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Why do you even have this? Hahaha!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Hauntings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen any ghosts since coming here?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Hauntings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: ...have you not?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Hauntings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
