en: My least favourite was a woman who crawled in through a window last night.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Hauntings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Thankfully, a flash of thunder and she was gone.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Hauntings - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Damn near soiled myself.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of fetters?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Oh, right. This I know. Some folk believe that ghosts are anchored to this world.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Either by a feeling, an incomplete task, or an object. Usually an object of importance to the ghost, but often times something powerful.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: There are some who believe a place like this, with more ghosts than seems right might, itself, be a fetter

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: A load of old horse apples. There are more ghosts here because more bad things happened here.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Such as?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Battles, blood spilt, massacres, and a nest of Blakes for 250 years.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Fetters - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Enough misery to raise a graveyard.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Druid  - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You say you're a druid?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Druid  - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Ah, as much as anyone can be. The Catholics didn't leave much trace of the old ways, but I've pieced together a tradition that feels alright to me and called it 'druidism'. No more made up than anything else, mind.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Druid  - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: For the most part, I just treat all natural things as equal in value - people, plants, animals, and places. Real places - the wild and such. Not manmade intrusions like this manor. Bloody eyesore!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Code - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is the code you live by?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Code - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: It's nothing fancy. I try to treat all people, creatures, plants, and places as equal. I leave no trace, I burn safely, and I leave my share for the Other Folks.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Shadowy Figure - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... think I have seen something... something stalking the manor grounds... a large, ghostly figure?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Shadowy Figure - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Oh, lad, if you've seen the Tuatha Dé Danann, then you're a lucky man!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Shadowy Figure - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: The old Gods... Get an education in your heritage, lad. They walked this land a long time ago, before disappearing into the Otherworld.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Shadowy Figure - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Shadowy Figure - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: But fragments still exist. Like the way you say it - large, ghostly forms.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Apparently, Miss Deane is the descendant of a powerful Milesian ancestor.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Is she now? She and I ought to have a chat, in that case.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Magical Grimoire - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this book, Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Magical Grimoire - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Now, where'd you find a thing like that, lad?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Magical Grimoire - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I can't read the words - never learned letters - but those markings in the columns? That is Ogham, and that I can read.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Magical Grimoire - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: It's of the meaning of gateway or door - but not quite. It's something akin to both, but less mundane than either.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Chimney Charm - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on a walk about the grounds. What do you make of it?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Chimney Charm - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: No need to be so vague, lad. You found it in someone's room. Don't worry, I'll pry no further.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Chimney Charm - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: It's a binding charm, stops the target from having any magical effect on someone else. It only works if it stays close to the person it's targeting, though.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Witchcraft components - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like the components of some sort of charm to me.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Witchcraft components - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I'd say that's about right. Couldn't say what kind of charm, though, without seeing it assembled. A lot of the magic's in the making of the thing.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of Goibniu?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Anyway, Goibniu is not only a smith - he was the hospitaller of the Tuatha de Danann.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I wouldn't mind some of that protection going into winter, ha!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I have, aye. Mincéir - Travellers, that is, call him Galyōn. Or we call our god Galyōn, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: We believe the world was forged out of metal.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: And since Goibniu is a smith god, well, there is a natural comparison gets made there.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Goibniu - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: You could drink at his feast and not get a hangover, and the food you'd eat -  it'd protect a man from both sickness and decay.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/fae - O Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/fae - O Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Surely you know this yourself?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/fae - O Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/fae - O Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Right, well, in basic terms, they're spirits of the land. Or, they are the land.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/fae - O Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: People say they can't be trusted or they're tricksy, but that's applying human thinking to them. And you don't want to do that.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Tuatha Dé Danann - ofinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me much about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Tuatha Dé Danann - ofinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Nothing you won't find in a book. They are the old gods of this land, gone underground after being tricked by us mortals.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Tuatha Dé Danann - ofinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: What they think of us now, I can't say - and even as a man who walks their path, I'm not always sure why I do.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Tuatha Dé Danann - ofinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Do they hear us, talk to us like the Christians think their god does?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Tuatha Dé Danann - ofinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I can't say. They connect me to this land, and my heritage is all I know. Just feels right to light a fire for them from time to time. They've never asked for more than that.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Brid - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know the Goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Brid - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Aye. Her father was the chieftain of the Tuatha Dé Danann. She's a powerful and versatile god.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Brid - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Her realm is up in Faughart by Dundalk. A modest shrine but, then, I think that's how she'd like it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/morrigan - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Could you tell me anything about The Morrigan?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/morrigan - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I couldn't. Not with all these crows about to report it back to her.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Cailleach - OFInn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me much about the Cailleach?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Cailleach - OFInn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: An Cailleach? Fiadh'd know more on that, now. Did you know Cailleach means hag? Sort of a thing we both respect and revile.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of Tír na nÓg?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Nothing that you shouldn't. One of the many Tíortha, or lands, of our Otherworld.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: There's many Tíortha - like Tír fo Thuinn, the lands under the wave; Mag Mell, the plain of delight; and Emain Ablach, the isle of apple trees.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: They say that on a clear day you can see it, past the plain of honey, on the horizon where the sun settles.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Mind you, I've never seen a clear day on this blasted rock we call home.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: You can get there underground too - like the Tuatha de Danann eventually did. There's plenty of old passageways in the dark corners of places of power.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: None of them is safe. Guarded by fae things. Or worse - not guarded and you can get in.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I know a woman once who got near, saw her own death, and only because she had kids, was let leave.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I have no kids - none I know of - so I won't be risking it, thanks.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/tir na nog - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Tír na nÓg means lands of the young.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the term Milesians mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Humans, lad. They're humans. Our ancestors.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Legend is that they came here over nine waves and battled the gods so they could settle here.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Didn't end well for either group but you could say we came out on top.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: That's a good joke on account of us dividing the land and them getting the bottom half.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/Milesians - OFINN
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: You'd have appreciated that if you knew your history.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Any plans for this weekend, Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I'm told there's a big party on later. I'll go to that, I guess. Fancy dress - I reckon that means they'll dress like me and I'd dress like them, no?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I'm told there's proper history - good history in the gardens, so I'll go there while it's bright, then head off to the bar when it's dark.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Not sure what else there is to do. I'm told there are talks, but talking - to me - is a two-way thing. Not sitting down so somebody can tell you about their hobbies.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Ah, who knows? Tomorrow's too far away to be worth thinking about today. There's the séance, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Hah - and for Sunday?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Could spend some time getting on Fiadh's nerves, though - that's always fun.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: She said she'd be doing some work with the well after lunch - might stick my face in and see how she's getting on.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/timetable - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I'll wander the hedge maze after lunchtime, I think, and go get a gāter in the bar before the dinner bell.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Last night, as I arrived, I saw a woman washing clothes in the fountain.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Ack, I knew there would be death here.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: You saw a bean nigh, lad. Spells trouble. Of the life-ending type.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: She's a portent, you see - an omen. One that means death and grief have come to your house.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Somebody will die here this weekend. Possibly more than one. Certainly no less.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/washer woman - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane... Am I too late?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/gauge - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen the strange device kept off to the side in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/gauge - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I have, and I don't like it. It has a bad energy off it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/gauge - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Whatever it's measuring, it's part of this séance, and that means I don't trust it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/deane's room - OF
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was in?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Evidence Presents - OFinn/deane's room - OF
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Who? I don't know how to find my own room in this place, ne'er mind whoever that is. Sorry, can't help you.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Pagan Crown- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's an unusual crown you wear.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Pagan Crown- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Crown? That's the Pale speaking in you, lad. It's a circlet.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Pagan Crown- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: It's a sign of my station as a druid, a protector of this land and its inhabitants.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Pagan Crown- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: *tsk* Crown...

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Wild Hair - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You sport an... uncommon look.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Wild Hair - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: A man is only truly free when he is free of the opinion of others.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Staff - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What does your staff signify?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Staff - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: It, eh, signifies that I'll bash you if you come near me or mine.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/Staff - O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: No, you mind what they say, lad, there are still plenty of snakes in Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/belt- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have quite the ornate belt.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/belt- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Do you like it? I killed and skinned the deer myself. My cousin, Conor, helped me shape the tin.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Analysis Presents - (to) OFinn/belt- O'Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: That man is fierce handy with a ball hammer.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Ward in room - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Oh lad...

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Ward in room - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Ó Finn-

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Ward in room - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Sorry, now, but I won't hear it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Ward in room - OFinn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: This is against your ways, I know that, so you're up to something. Come on, let's go see the manager.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Blake
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your thoughts on the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Blake
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: This isn't his land, and he doesn't belong here. More so, he's not welcome. Him or his.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Blake
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I've made my views known well enough. I'm surprised I was invited.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Coventry
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Coventry
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Not yet. I keep missing him. As I'm entering a room, he's leaving it! It's almost as if he's avoiding me!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on O Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Me? I'm a druid, as much as anyone can be these days. I wander the land, making sure it's not too abused by ye buffers.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on O Finn
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I've a special place in my heart for this part of the land, though. My people are from here, as much as anyone is really from anywhere.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on O Finn
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Mister Ó Finn.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Mantovanni
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met our hostess, Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Mantovanni
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: She's the madwoman who kept showing me that card with a hermit on it?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Mantovanni
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I like her, if not the company she keeps.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Mantovanni
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: She'd do well to stop singing Blake's tune and leave this séance in the dust.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Fiadh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Fiadh
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Fiadh. Now her, I know. Good woman - lots of overlap with my work. Won't take any of my bull, and I like her all the more for it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you talked with Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Dupre
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Ah, we talked about his ways and mine. We kept at it a while, but he was hitting off my accent. He was fierce polite about it, mind.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Darcy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Darcy
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Oh aye. Best of friends, her and me...

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Darcy
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: No, you'll be shocked to know she wants nothing to do with me. No skin off my nose.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Father sinnot
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Father sinnot
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: A bit. I don't know the man, but I've no time for anyone with 'Father' in their title. He's no father to me or the people of this soil.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Cathal
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Cathal
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: He seems to think there's an angel on his tail. Whatever it is, I'd say it's no angel.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Hazel
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Hazel
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: She's all spectacle and no substance. I'd be surprised if she could tell a ghost from a table lamp.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me of Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Not a lot. He's for making and breaking reputations, that lad, and I neither have nor want one.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Arwa
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Arwa
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Not as well as I'd like.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Arwa
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: She's too focused on something she's lost and not focused enough on, well, me. Hahaha!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Wee Ruairí's a doctor now? That's time that would've been better spent on his real studies, to be sure he's ready for when Fiadh winters. Doctor? Pfft, what's he trying to prove?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ines
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Aye, she likes a walk outside, so we've had time to talk. She has no truck with all this stuff. A wonder she's here, but what business is it of mine, eh?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you dealt with Miss Murphy much?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Nah. She keeps leaving towels at my door even though I try to tell her not to. Poor lamb means well.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ivy
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Ivy
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Oh no. The people up there don't like the people down below, like myself.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your thoughts on Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Varley
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: The Blakes' hound? How does a man think so little of himself that he becomes a dog to somebody else?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any experience with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Any experience? Like what? I don't think I've met a 'Lau', but you make me think that maybe I want to.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Him? He needs a slap. Knock some sense into him. He's so focused on what's behind him, he's missing what's ahead.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Corentine
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you talked to Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Corentine
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: That lass seems to think I'm gonna know everyone in Ireland and their literal ancestors.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Corentine
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Sure, I barely know where I come from!

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you dealt with the housekeeper at all?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Her? If she's going to search around my room, she should be sneakier about it.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: No harm in her, she just wants to make sure us crackpots aren't up to the "divil's" work.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: And in fairness, some of us might well be.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: That the horse fella? I made my own way here, so I've not spoken with him much. Good honest work, looking after horses. I admire that.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Anything you can tell me about Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any dealings with the porter?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Seamus? Aye, good fella. Well... absolute mess of a fella, really, but he'll share his stash and I like that in a man.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Walter Blake
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen young Master Blake?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Walter Blake
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Master? Isn't he meant to be nine or ten?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Walter Blake
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Who's calling a child master? Are ye under a spell or something? Get some sense into you, lad.

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Deane
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Domhnall Ó Finn/Character Presents - OFinn/Opinion on Deane
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Who? I've not met anyone with that name yet.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm Declan Ward, Miss. Who might you be?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: S... Saoirse Murphy. Just the cook, Sir. I don't think there's anything I can help the likes of you with.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll leave you be.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: A-alright, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You... But how did you...?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: With her gone, I thought Father Sinnott might know something about my daughter. Or he might know someone who does, but-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But I can't ask. I've tried! I can't make myself do it - I can't say the words. What if he says no?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I don't know what I'd do then. I just want to know she's alright...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If you'd like... I could ask him for you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Y... You would do that? You have no idea what that would mean to me!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can certainly see about it, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Thank you. Oh, thank you, Sir, I- Here! In case this helps. A picture of my girl. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I don't know magic or have powers like you folks... Maybe things would be different if...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: S... sorry, Sir, I lost the run of myself.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh... Lord. You know. You know about my little girl - you know I was learning magic so I could see her, you...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I... I thought we were doing so well, a-and then she just left!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I can't do anything without her...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss, it's alright. You're not in any trouble, not at all. Miss Deane was teaching you, wasn't she?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Missus Joyce was right, wasn't she? Oh when she found out, she--

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Please... don't lose it, Sir. It's all I really have of her...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I won't. I promise.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Saoirse conversation
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You know about Miss Deane... That she was teaching me...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hiring telegram - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hiring telegram - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Sh...So she did disappear. No one's talking about it, but she did.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hiring telegram - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I thought I hadn't seen her.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hiring telegram - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Photograph of Deane - Saoirse

en: Is she...a friend of yours? Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Photograph of Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She's a friend. I was hoping to have met her here.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Photograph of Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, no. Just interested in her work.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Photograph of Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She's...a guest here. Haven't seen her in a while.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Luggage - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Mister Doyle should take care of that for you.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/A map of the region - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there much to do in the local area, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/A map of the region - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, no. 'S nice to look at, but not much for doing, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/A map of the region - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: The young 'uns mostly leave or take to drinking, 'cause it's better than being bored.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/A map of the region - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: The mountains are fierce beautiful, though... Miss Deane told me they're even prettier up close, you know?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Alcohol - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I- I've got no want of this, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems they've spared no expense in putting this event on.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Seems that way, Sir...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But, oh, isn't it nice to see the place so full? 'Specially with people we don't much see the likes of out here.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Folks with the power to shape their own fate, and-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Must be nice, is all.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance advert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram for Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram for Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: S a letter. Not mine. Not for me to read.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram machine - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Mister Varley or Mister Hunter could help, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram machine - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would I be able to send a telegram?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Blake manor - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you like working here, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Blake manor - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, it's... home to me, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Blake manor - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Missus Joyce, Mister Varley... You know how you can love people so much it hurts? 'S how I feel about them, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Blake manor - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: This place has its ups and... oh, definitely downs. But I'd not leave them for the world, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Blake manor - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: All the staff, really.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Edward Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Edward Blake?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Edward Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: That's history, Sir. And the world's better for it.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hauntings - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard talk of hauntings around this place from the other guests. Have you seen anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hauntings - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Well, Sir, I try very hard not to see much, but it doesn't seem to help. I mean, just this Friday-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hauntings - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, don't go to the fire pit in the hedge maze. Right, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Skerrit statement - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Skerritt mentioned that he'd met another Blake in London - do you know who that might have been?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Skerrit statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Only Blake I knows is the one I cook for, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Cigar burns - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've noticed there are burns on the armchair in the library.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Cigar burns - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, how could?!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Cigar burns - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...S-sorry, Sir. Only, upsets me to see people disrespect the library, so. I'm learning to read, and they just take it for granted.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Cigar burns - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I'm sure Missus Joyce would know - she keeps the place, after all.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Second Sight - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think of this Second Sight of Miss McLeod's?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Second Sight - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Missus Joyce told me about that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Second Sight - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Wonder what she senses about this place.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Markings - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like someone held a ritual in one of the empty rooms.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Markings - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: A...ritual?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Markings - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well, there's a marking on the floor, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Markings - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh for-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Markings - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...S-sorry. Wish I weren't helping with the cleaning this week, is all.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Cathal Statement - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night - and that he thought she'd been drinking.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Cathal Statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I...Don't think that's my business. Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ines statement - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand Miss Barbosa is waiting on a telegram.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ines statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She's been waiting a while, now.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ines statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Bedroom skeleton key - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I- I'm...Goodbye, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Occurences - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen anything... strange, lately?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Occurences - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: S-strange? Oh, I'm just the cook, Sir. Couldn't be involved in any sort of strangeness if I tried.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Occurences - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...I mean more in the general, ghostly sense, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Occurences - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh! Oh. Seen far more than I'd like, then, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Occurences - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Air's so thick with ghosts I sometimes worry 'bout mixing one into the soup.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Small key - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Hm, that sounds like a key for one of the bathhouse lockers...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Small key - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a little key dropped in the hedge maze, Miss. Small, gold, with a little number on it?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Small key - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I've not heard about anyone losing theirs, though - I'm sorry, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Doyle statement - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with a man on Tuesday night.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Doyle statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: He did? B-but who would she... Oh, maybe it was that Coventry. I-I mean, Mister Coventry!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Doyle statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Oh, ignore me, Sir. Sure, my gut's lying to me as it usually does.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Doyle statement - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well, what's it saying?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Doyle statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It's saying... He's a gross old man who had no business having Miss Deane in his room every other day.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Doyle statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...S-see, haha? Such a fibber, this gut. I'm sure he's perfectly nice.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mysterious figure - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: As I was walking back to the house, I could have sworn I saw a figure in the upper window. Do you know who it might have been?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mysterious figure - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No one I'd like to think about, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Giobniu - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the name Goibniu mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Giobniu - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Nothing, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Fae - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me anything about the fae, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Fae - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Ssh...!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Fae - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: 'S bad luck to talk about the Sídhe, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Fae - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: 'Specially at this time of year. Samhain's when they come a-callin'. It's why people wear masks then, so-as they can't tell who's human and who's one of them. Keeps us safe...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, the old gods...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: F-for Missus Joyce's sake, I'll not speak of them - blasphemy, she'll say. But I'm sure others will be able to tell you more, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Old Anvil - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there a story behind that old anvil, out in the grounds?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Old Anvil - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Been there a long time. Longer than anybody remembers.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Goddess  Bridget - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/The Goddess  Bridget - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Saint of poets, dairymaids, blacksmiths, cattle...Must keep her busy.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Dead End - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Deane headed into the hedge maze on Tuesday... but there's no sign of her after that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Dead End - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No...no, that can't be right.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Dead End - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She's fine, I'm sure. She's fine.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Front door - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do the staff lock the front door at night?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Front door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Just in case anyone wants to steal the furniture, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Entertainment Schedule - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Seems the hotel offers quite the array of activities.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Entertainment Schedule - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Mister Varley would know more about that than me, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Bridge Game - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you attend this week's bridge game?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Bridge Game - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Not sure that would've been proper, Sir. Could you imagine?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Bridge Game - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: 'S all battling with your wits and dancin' with the patterns, and making squeeze plays and devil's coups and...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Bridge Game - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, Miss Deane made it sound really exciting. But then, she's played with champions, Sir!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Bridge Game - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It's too bad she didn't attend...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Statement Mister Dupre - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear Mister Dupré went for a reading with Miss Mantovani.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Statement Mister Dupre - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She... a reading, you said?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Statement Mister Dupre - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I wonder if... N-no. No, she wouldn't. Not for me.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/News Clippings - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen these at all, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/News Clippings - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: That's...Am I in trouble, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram Draft - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have a feeling that Missus Joyce hired me to look into Miss Deane's disappearance. Would know about that, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram Draft - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She...You...Well. I've no idea, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Telegram Draft - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...But I'm glad someone cares enough to look for her.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Staff Innocent - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Seems like you and the other staff couldn't have had anything to do with Miss Deane's disappearance...any ideas about who might?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Staff Innocent - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I'm sorry, Sir. I've no idea.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Staff Innocent - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...But by God, I wish I did.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Stall Door - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Seems one of the stall doors in the stable had to be fixed recently. I wonder what happened?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Stall Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: M-Mister Hunter would know more than me, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Stall Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Varley Statement - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley mentioned updating the rotas during that bridge game last Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Varley Statement - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: U-um, yes, Sir - so I understand it. Missus Joyce would have been with him, though, and not me.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: P-please Sir! No talk of that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Keeps me up at night, what he did to those two. I keep imagining it were me, trapped in there, just...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Lord, no, I can't bear it. 'Sides, you'd have better luck in the library. There's books on him there, Sir - records on the whole line.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Him?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: P-percival Blake, Sir! Now please, no more?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The door to Room 15, it's... missing? Has it been walled over?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Walled, Sir? No, it's not. Unless...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Would that be a kind of magic you folks can do?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Missing Door - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: There's an old rumour of a Percival Blake walling some of this place up - I wonder if he was a magic user, too?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Sigil - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this symbol, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Sigil - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: H-how did...Where did you see that ungodly thing?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Sigil - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No. Don't answer. The less I know, the better.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had any strange dreams of late, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Ah, none worth your time, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Just me then?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I... Agh. S-sometimes, it's like I'm confused who I am in my dreams. I dream I'm minding horses, or working over numbers, or that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It's not an animal at all I'm hunting. It's a woman! Oh, I shouldn't say such things. Only... I wanted to tell you to know you're not alone in it.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: And sometimes I'm a critter in the maze, only... much bigger. I can see over the hedges. Not flying, mind you. Just... tall...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Then I see my prey... and it's. Oh Sir, I don't know...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Strange Dreams - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's okay, Miss Murphy, please go on.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance's Purpose - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of all this Séance business, Miss O’Connor?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Séance's Purpose - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Shadows linger long enough, Sir. Shouldn’t be asking them to stay.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter from Mister Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think of this?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter from Mister Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Tch. Of course, he…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter from Mister Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well. S’not my business, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter from Doctor Callaghan - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about this?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter from Doctor Callaghan - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: …D-don’t think that’s something I should know about, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter to the Manager - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter to the Manager - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter to the Manager - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter to the Manager - Saoirse

en: M-Miss… Saoirse. Are you alright?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter to the Manager - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

speaker: Mister Ward
en: It’s okay, it’s alright, Miss - I'll not hear another word of apology.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Letter to the Manager - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry for bringing it up.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Guest Requests - Saoirse

en: I imagine the staff must be besieged with requests from all the guests.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Guest Requests - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Nothing worth worrying about, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Marriage Plans - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: …R-right. Well, that’s none of my business.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Marriage Plans - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But I’m sure you’ll be a candidate...Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Marriage Plans - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, that’s not what I-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Marriage Plans - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Of course not.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Medical Cert - Saoirse

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Medical Cert - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: O-oh. Glad she’s made a full recovery, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mary Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you remember what the lady of the house was like? Before…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mary Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...W-we didn’t speak much, Sir. Not socially, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mary Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But she was kind to her boy and made the Marquess happy.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Exorcisms - Saoirse

en: Do you happen to know anything about exorcisms, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Exorcisms - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, yes. I like to do them right in that sweet spot between lunch and afternoon tea.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Exorcisms - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: …Was that a joke, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Exorcisms - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I…y-yes, Sir. S-Sorry.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Paper - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this, Miss O’Connor?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Ritual Paper - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, Sir. I don’t.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Angels - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think about angels, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Angels - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-not much, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Angels - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Be nice if someone were looking out for me.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This photo of your daughter, Miss Murphy, it must have been taken when she was very young.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Just a day. They let me have her for less than a day.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's alright, Miss. I'll see what I can do.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This photo of your daughter, Miss Murphy, it must have been taken when she was very young.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Sometimes I think I’ll see her lying in her crib, out the side of my eye.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: And then I’ll look at it head-on, and it’ll just be a towel, or a sheet, or a patch of sunlight.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The Magdalene Laundries?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: …If I asked Marquess Blake about her, that’s where I’d be headed for sure.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I’m just sorry she was born a girl. They could have sent her somewhere awful.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But I try to look at it all from the side, Sir. It’s better that way.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy child - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Just a day. They let me have her for less than a day.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this while taking a stroll about the manor. You wouldn’t happen to know who it belongs to?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No, I don’t! I don’t know a single thing about her!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I don’t know where she is…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it this belongs to you, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No, Sir. It’s hers.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Mister Varley said he’d take it to her, you know. If he ever found her.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How did he find out?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: The father told him, though I’d spill my guts before I call him that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Said I’d seduced him. Said I should be fired and the “ungodly” child taken away. Untruths, the lot.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Mister Varley couldn’t stop them taking the child but…he vouched for me.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I’d never see anyone else run this place. He’s the kindest person I know.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hand Carved Rattle - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...She?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this look familiar to you at all, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Aah! N-no, no! I won’t look at that, Sir, please.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Only seen things like that in my nightmares, and I’d rather they stay there.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Well Scrying - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you know that Miss Callaghan does well scrying, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Well Scrying - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You think she could help me, Sir? Help me see my little girl?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Well Scrying - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: O-oh God, I don’t know if I have it in me to ask…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Well Scrying - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: R-really? You’d-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Well Scrying - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh. Please, Sir. That would mean more than you could possibly imagine.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Well Scrying - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could ask her for you. If you’d like?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a note lying about the hallways, Miss, but I couldn't make out all the words.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: O-oh, just rubbish, Sir. I'll dispose of it - where did you say it was?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Such a stupid, stupid idea...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this note…Were you hoping to ask Father Sinnott for help?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, where did you- Never mind. I suppose you were trying to help.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You’re right. I was hoping he might know where they took my little girl.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I must’ve tried at every mass to ask him, but it’s like the words won’t come out…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Badly Written Note - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like someone was hoping to ask Father Sinnott for help.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have a little one, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Hah. H-haha, of course not? How could you... you...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That crib in the laundry room…it was for your child, wasn’t it Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It was. Sometimes I think I’ll see her lying in it, out the side of my eye.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: And then I’ll look at it head-on, and it’ll just be a towel, or a sheet, or a patch of sunlight.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The Magdalene Laundries?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: …If I asked Marquess Blake about her, that’s where I’d be headed for sure.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I’m just sorry she was born a girl. They could have sent her somewhere awful.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I-I'm sorry, Miss. I’d thought it something to celebrate.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But I try to look at it all from the side, Sir. It’s better that way.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, I don't! I don't, alright, I... I....

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's okay, Miss. We'll speak no more of it, alright?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Murphy Crib - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, Sir, of course you did. God, of course you did...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Please forgive me for prying - but it seems as though you're trying to speak with Father Sinnott.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Was there something you’d hoped to ask him?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Please forgive me, but I've noticed your attempts to speak with Father Sinnott.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You wanted to ask him about your child, didn’t you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Y…You have a keen eye, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Well. I can’t forgive myself if I don’t at least try.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I’ve been hoping he's heard something. But would...would he even want to help me?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Trying to Talk to Priest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-nothing that wouldn’t be better left unasked, Sir...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you being paid adequately, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, I can put food on the table, Sir. Our table, I mean, not just everyone else's, haha.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course. It's just... I heard the hotel has been struggling financially.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Where did- Would you stop spreading that around, Sir? Mister Varley has it hard enough as is.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: That man would do anything to keep the hotel running.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hotel finances - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: The last thing he needs is for folks to think poorly of it.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/parcel of money - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Don’t you find it strange that Missus Joyce seems to have acquired a parcel of Miss Deane’s money?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/parcel of money - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/parcel of money - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, I’d trust Missus Joyce with my life. You’re mistaken, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/parcel of money - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That, or she had a good reason for having it…

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/parcel of money - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I must admit, I feel a little abashed about the…methods of my payment.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/parcel of money - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Don’t, Sir. I’m sure Miss Deane will find it a small price for her safety.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hunter statment - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you see Mister Hunter fixing the stall door last Tuesday evening?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hunter statment - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Did I see... Oh, yes. I was bringing the young master his supper and saw him working away in the yard, yes.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/hunter statment - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Must have been around nine in the evening. Awful cold evening for work like that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Deane's room - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to recall which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Deane's room - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Deane's room - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: B-but how could I not remember? Just the other day, we were in there for...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Deane's room - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N... Never mind.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Shadowy Figure - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever seen anything... large on the grounds?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Shadowy Figure - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: L-large? Unless you're meaning a horse, then no. But... I've heard other guests... talking of giants? Not sure if that's what you mean... Maybe there's something of use in the library?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/12 Luggage Ticket - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are there tickets for the luggage room, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/12 Luggage Ticket - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...It's a luggage ticket. Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/12 Luggage Ticket - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know what it's for?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/12 Luggage Ticket - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Yes, Sir. We had to number the luggage room bays. Stops the bags being confused, see?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mysterious Object - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There seems to be a strange object stuffed inside the luggage room vent.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mysterious Object - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: What? But why on earth would someone...?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mysterious Object - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Oh, if I question it, I'll lose my last marbles, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Mysterious Object - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Mister Hunter's got tools for this kind of thing in the stables, don't you worry. It'll be sorted.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Miss Deane's Invitation - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear tell that Miss Deane was personally invited to the manor.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Miss Deane's Invitation - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Was she?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Miss Deane's Invitation - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: That makes me happy, Sir. The manor's a better place for having her in it - 'fore she left, I mean. 'Cept...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Miss Deane's Invitation - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Go on?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Miss Deane's Invitation - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...W-well, I don't think it would've mattered, Sir. Whether she were invited or not.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Miss Deane's Invitation - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: All that talent, and I'd guess there's not a thing on this earth that'd make her feel worthwhile...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Treasure Map - Saoirse
