speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Treasure Map - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, I'm sure I couldn't... Ooh, what's this?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Treasure Map - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Autumn. That's interesting. I wonder if...No. No, it's nothing.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Treasure Map - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, I heard Mister Hunter say he was "scrubbing the seasons" once, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Treasure Map - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Autumn might be something you can...scrub. Or touch? S-stupid idea, Sir, I'm sorry.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Treasure Map - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If it's all the same to you, I'd like to hear your thoughts, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Witchcraft components - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like components for some sort of charm to me, but I'm not sure.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Witchcraft components - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Hmm... Oh, yes, I see! If you stick that bit over there, and loop this 'round that, and then put this over here, you'd...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Witchcraft components - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, you'd get a lovely thing for the Christmas tree, wouldn't you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Witchcraft components - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You should ask Mister Hunter, Sir - he's always making little trinkets and the like.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds... Do you make anything of it?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: That's... Ooh, what's this?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It looks like something you'd... hang? I wonder what effects it has? Or how you'd make it? Or...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: A-actually, I think I've seen Mister Hunter working away at little things like this, Sir. Sure, it's just a bauble or somethin' - you could ask him?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Hmm... Oh, yes, I see! If you stick that bit over there, and loop this 'round that, and then put this over here, you'd...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You should ask Mister Hunter, Sir - he's always making little trinkets and the like.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Chimney Charm - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, you'd get a lovely thing for the Christmas tree, wouldn't you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Arwas Drawing of Vase - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, that's pretty. It looks a lot like the one from that painting in the atrium, too. The one of... Hm, I know this!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Arwas Drawing of Vase - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this vase look familiar to you, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Arwas Drawing of Vase - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Lady Wil-hel-meena Blake! That's who it is. Been practising the family names with the young master, so I remember.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Arwas Melody - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: La, la, la... La- Oh, no, let's not try that again - tone deaf as a spider, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Arwas Melody - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You could try playing it on a piano, if that'd help? Only... Not sure there's any left up here...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Arwas Melody - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't seem to get this melody out of my head, Miss... might you recognise it?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Lady Wilhelmina - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, she was before my time, Sir. Heard she up and left middle of the night.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Lady Wilhelmina - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I wonder what happened to that poor woman...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Lady Wilhelmina - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the Lady Wilhelmina, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Saint Brigid's Cross - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has anyone been putting up Saint Brigid's crosses about the place?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Saint Brigid's Cross - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, um, that sounds like Missus Joyce, Sir. She said she'd be doing something like that. 'S nice of her.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh... only cook's plans, Sir. Some housekeeping too, us being so busy...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I've got to... I have mass, first thing.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for this weekend, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Anything planned for today?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I'll be about the upstairs corridors and atrium all day, cleaning 'round the bedrooms...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh! Missus Joyce is gonna help me with the North East Corridor at eleven, so that's nice.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: And of course I'm in the kitchen at twelve and six every day, preparing for meals. I'll get to rest in the dorms at seven.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Then more work, Sir. Nothing exciting... Sorry...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: By the time it hits eight, I think I'll be half asleep over my meal in the servants' hall!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Tomorrow is much the same...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I've got to... I have mass, first thing.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Your séance, I'm sure that will be exciting...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/timetable - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I don't envy you lot having, to be out in that weather for you séance.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think you'll meet Miss Callaghan to well scry again?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Yes! Definitely!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She has been so kind to me, and...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You arranged it, didn't you? So you have been, too. Thank you. You didn't have to... to-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Don't mention it, Miss. I'm glad I could help.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I'm just so glad to see my little girl again.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think you'll meet Miss Callaghan to scry again?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Yes! Definitely!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She even said she'd be willing to... to keep teaching me what she knows. I'm so filled with thanks, I...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You arranged it all, didn't you? Thank you. You didn't have to... to-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Don't mention it, Miss. I'm glad I could help.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I'm just so glad to see my little girl again.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/End of quest - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I could see my little one any time I'd like. And with magic... I-I might finally have some say in my own life now, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Drawings of a Young Woman - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Was Miss Deane rather close with Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Drawings of a Young Woman - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Miss Deane? No, Sir, I hardly think they talked.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Drawings of a Young Woman - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She spent more time with Mister O'Meara so far as I could tell. Oh, and poor old S...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Drawings of a Young Woman - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...W-well she could really run circles 'round Mister O'Meara, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hedonistic Gala - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The drinks at last night's ball were somewhat... ah. Unexpected.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hedonistic Gala - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, Lord, I heard about that, Sir! It weren't me, I swear, I just poured the champagne but I didn't... Well.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hedonistic Gala - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...What was it like? Did you see anything? Feel anything? Did it change you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hedonistic Gala - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: W-well, ah. I think it nearly changed the contents of my stomach from being on the inside to the outside?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Hedonistic Gala - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the catacombs underneath the manor?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Only what I know from rumours and nightmares, Sir. Or, it was just one nightmare, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I was searching for treasure in these strange tunnels - only I never found it, and the tunnels didn't end.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Map of Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know where this map leads, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Map of Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: That... Oh that's so curious...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Map of Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Map of Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, looking at the size of the rooms and how the doors are put, it looks like this leads to a passage out of... the ballroom?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Map of Catacombs - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, I'm just being silly - there's no entrance there. Sure, I'm just reading it wrong, Sir...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Written Complaint - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear there have been complaints about Missus Joyce's conduct, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Written Complaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: R-really?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Written Complaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, she don't deserve it, Sir, that breaks my heart.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Written Complaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You won't tell her, will you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/Written Complaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: All that kindness, to be treated so poorly...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/statement toussaint - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you bring food to Mister Toussaint in the north east corridor on Tuesday night? While the bridge game was played?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/statement toussaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...I did, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/statement toussaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I remember the time as I was bringing the young master his supper then. 'Cause of that, it was half cold by the time I got it to him.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/statement toussaint - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: He didn't complain, bless him. I think he was happy he got to stay up a little later.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/gauge - saorise
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/gauge - saorise
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, I don't know, Sir... The Marquess has been working on it in his lab since the séance was announced, though.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/washer woman - saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...What?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/washer woman - saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you or Missus Joyce ever have washed clothes in the fountain?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/washer woman - saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Why would anyone do that, Sir? Even if the laundry was broken, there are bathtubs and sinks across the place.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Evidence Presents - Saoirse/washer woman - saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No sane person would be doing that, would they? Maybe no person at all? I-if you'll pardon my bluntness, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Unfortunately...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, I've no excuse, Sir, sorry. I just shrivel like a prawn when he walks in the room.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-which is to say that u-unfortunately, he, ah...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Skerritt - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It's the way he is around Miss Deane, Sir. Like the way Master Walter can get when a young lady visits the place.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Corentine - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Corentine - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, Sir. She’s nose to the books.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Corentine - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Wish I could read that way. Looks no harder'n breathing for her...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ivy - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ivy - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Only a bit, Sir. But she seems... amazin'. Good blood, talented and still so kind to the staff.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ivy - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: We did try to talk once but... W-well, truth be told, I got the shakes.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Lan Fen - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you talked with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Lan Fen - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Only a little, Sir. Never met anyone from China - or, anywhere, really.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Lan Fen - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She seems so... nice. Like anyone else.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinon on Varley - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you often speak with Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinon on Varley - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: He’s… a good man, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinon on Varley - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I'd never see anyone else run this place.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinon on Varley - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Kinder than any other I've met.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Caitlin - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Caitlin - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, she's very nearly a mother to me, Sir. Kept me right all these years. Though sometimes I worry that...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Caitlin - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...It's okay, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Caitlin - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Sometimes... She may not be my mother, Sir - but sometimes I worry I'm not a very good daughter to her.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Caitlin - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: If she knew that I... W-well. It doesn't matter now.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Darragh - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you often speak with Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Darragh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh he's not inside much, Sir - there's little chance for it. When I'm not in the kitchen, he's with the horses.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Darragh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I like talking to him though, when there's time. S'like he knows how to make all your problems feel small.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Darragh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: You can get the feeling that there's nothing, nothing he'd not do to keep you safe.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Seamus - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you speak often with Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Seamus - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I, um. Didn't use to, Sir. Not after the last porter... W-well, I wouldn't talk to him for love nor money.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Seamus - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I feel awful bad about it now - but I've been trying to be better, and I think he's...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Seamus - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I was going to say he's a good man, but no. He's annoying, Sir - just in a good way, haha.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Seamus - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: He looks out for me, and I'd not see a hair harmed on his head.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Seamus - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: 'Sides, Miss Deane seems to think he's okay, so... that makes me feel better 'bout using my words with him more. Braver.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-we've only talked a little, Sir. She's travelled far - braver than I am for sure, but...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh but can you believe she's no interest in learning magic? Said magic just means "living fully", or somethin' like that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well... Is she not right, in a way?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ines - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well... It doesn't make sense, Sir. How can you live fully if you don't learn magic?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ettiene - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ettiene - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Sometimes he asks for food, Sir - that's about it. He's, um... French, isn't he?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Cathal - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Cathal - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Was 'round Miss Deane an awful lot. Always off gabbing with the angels, she said.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Cathal - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Think she was meaning that faraway look he's always got on his face...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Dupré - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: O-only a little. He seems a bit sad to me, though he's always got a smile on. Don't know what to make of it.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Dupré - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Dupré - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...All the way from America. And I'll never in my life leave Connacht.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on D'Arcy - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on D'Arcy - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well, I brewed her tea once, if that counts. She was reading one of her tales to Mister Dupré.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on D'Arcy - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Wonderful things she does with words. Made it hard not to listen.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Coventry - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Coventry - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No, Sir, I've not. Doesn't seem all that interested which is normal enough - it's good, even.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Coventry - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...no offence, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Coventry - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No, Sir, I've not. Looks like he's been having a grand old time though with...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Coventry - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well that's none of my business, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Hazel - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Hazel - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She's.... not the sort who'd really speak with me, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Hazel - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Once asked if I'd seen ghosts 'round here, though. I'd no stories for her, anyway - or any I'd like to talk about.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Hazel - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But it was nice to be asked...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Happy to be around his Aunt though. She's lovely.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, not really. Do I seem ill, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, no, just making conversation.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairí - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh... W-well, happy enough to be around his aunt! She's lovely.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It's just, well, she... doesn't feel like a guest! More like someone's aunt.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Which, I suppose, she is - haha.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She... W-well, she took tea with us the other day, Sir. In the servant's quarters, yes.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's alright, Miss. I don't see the harm.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I-I know s'not proper Sir, I'm sorry, we-

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Mister Callaghan... sorry, Doctor Callaghan is so lucky to have her as a mentor!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Fiadh - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Must be good to have somebody so wise to turn to...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh mostly from afar, but I dare say I... I'm a little jealous of her.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: No, no I mean... What’s that like, seeing the future?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: What other things can she see? What else can she do?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's certainly a question... Though, is something troubling you, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...O-oh, nothing to concern yourself with, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Carmela - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She's certainly achieved some amount status, hasn't she?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think of Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, well, she...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Magic just flows to her, she weaves it like it were nothing more than wool round a hook, she-!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Um. That's what I've heard, at least, Sir. Truth be told, I haven't seen her in a while.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You think something happened to her?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, 'course not! Nothing could get Miss Deane. Mores like she got sick of... Oh, never mind.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I-it's like she sees the world in a whole new way to us. Like it's made of these threads we'd never see - but she can!

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You sound quite familiar with her. Had you met her before?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Deane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, no. No. We got to talking is all. She's good like that, doesn't look down on the staff.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me about yourself, Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh! U-um... Not sure if I've much interesting to say, Sir. Just the cook, again.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh! W-well... I'm a little skittish - though Missus Joyce says not to point it out or I'll be easy pickings.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh! And I'm too curious for my own good - Missus Joyce said that too.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I should like to hear more about this cook, Miss - if you're alright with that.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: S-sorry, Sir, this is why I usually stop at "cook"...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Saoirse - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But it's only been this bad since... U-um...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find it, working for Marquess Blake?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I... He's given me a home, I s'pose.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: But this isn't the life for me. Not anymore.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I don't have many dealings with him directly, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: He's...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: H-he's given me a home, I s'pose.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on JBlake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I... We don't speak much, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Arwa - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met with Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Arwa - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, couldn't help meeting her if I wanted, Sir. Keep finding her in all sorts of rooms you wouldn't expect.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Arwa - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Always looks a little dazed too... Truth be told, I'm worried 'bout her. Just hope she's alright.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Campbell - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Mister Campbell?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Campbell - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Not really, Sir. S-seen... Seen Father Sinnott about a few times, though.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Declan- Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If I might ask…what do you make of me, Miss? I must confess I feel quite out of my depth.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Declan- Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: A-ah. Well, you don’t look it, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on O Finn - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on O Finn - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-not much, Sir. You know he sleeps on the floor instead of in bed?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on O Finn - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I keep leaving him towels in the hopes he'll at least use those if he doesn't want blankets, but I think I've only vexed him...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think of Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: W-well… Haven't spoken to him much, Sir, at least for now.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It's only... I thought I might ask him...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, never mind.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairi - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairi - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-no, not really. Do I seem ill, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairi - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, no, just making conversation.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Ruairi - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh... W-well, happy enough to be around his aunt! She's lovely.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Walter Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you spend much time with the young Master?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Walter Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Some, Sir. We work on ours words together, but in truth he helps me more often than I help him...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Walter Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: It was Missus Joyce's idea, that we could help one another. I don't think he tells his father, mind. Might be part of why I've been let stay... Bless him.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Character Presents - Saoirse/Opinion on Walter Blake - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I can just about read, Sir. Only small words - enough to get by. I'm learning to write alongside the master.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Hand on pocket watch - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley always seems to have that pocket watch of his in hand.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Hand on pocket watch - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Lots to do, Sir. Just doesn't want to fall behind, likely.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Unhappy expression - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is Mister Varley upset about something? He looks rather... dour.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Unhappy expression - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Sure he's got a lot on his mind, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Recently altered dress - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks to me as if Missus Lau's dress has been taken up at the hem.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Recently altered dress - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...I think she looks quite fine in it, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Scars on hands and face - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I find myself wondering how a woman like Miss Quinn ended up with injuries like hers...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Scars on hands and face - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: She seems poorly, Sir. Sure she wouldn't want us talking about it.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Cross around neck - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it Missus Joyce is quite devout.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Cross around neck - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Seems so, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Open, eager pose - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce seems like a friendly sort.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Open, eager pose - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Lucky to work with her, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Sly, knowing smile - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you get the impression that Missus Joyce... might have some interest in the goings on of this event?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Sly, knowing smile - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Not sure what you mean, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Foreign style - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Barbosa is picking up some of the local fashions in her time here.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Foreign style - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I think it all looks nicely on her, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Windburned skin - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems the weather's got the better of Miss Barbosa.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Windburned skin - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Maybe you could lend her a scarf, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Walks leaning on a cane - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I thought Mister O'Meara might have that cane of his as a fashion statement, but now I think he has it for practical reasons.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Walks leaning on a cane - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...I'm sure those reasons are his own, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Dressed well not expensively - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara is dressed well, although the fabric isn't the quality I'd expect...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Dressed well not expensively - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...I wouldn't know about such things, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Sunken, red eyes - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think Mister Doyle might be lacking some sleep?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Sunken, red eyes - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...I don't know anything about the bellboy, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Shaky hands - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you happened to notice Mister Doyle's hands shaking?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Shaky hands - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...I don't care to notice much of him, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Unusual Celtic Cross - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the cross Mister Doyle is wearing looking strange to you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Unusual Celtic Cross - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Haven't noticed, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Fine clothes and jewellery - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré is cutting quite the figure. I almost feel underdressed.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Fine clothes and jewellery - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Almost, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Friendly expression - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré seems like a friendly sort.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Friendly expression - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Maybe, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Friendly expression - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tan Line - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems as if Missus D'Arcy has recently removed a ring...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tan Line - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Would think she's better off for it, too.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Scent of antiseptic - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I find Doctor Callaghan still has the scent of antiseptic about him...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Scent of antiseptic - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Haven't been close enough to say, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Good quality suit - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Doctor Callaghan's suit is nice, but it might have seen better days.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Good quality suit - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Sure, we can mend it if he sends it down, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Celtic Cross tie pin - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed the tie pin Doctor Callaghan is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Celtic Cross tie pin - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Don't think so, Sir, no.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Dusty, scuffed clothes - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't know how he's done it, but Mister Coventry has got dust on his suit.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Dusty, scuffed clothes - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Sure he'll send it in for a wash, Sir. At some point.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense body language - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Missus Erickson seem tense to you?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense body language - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Did you pick up on that yourself, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense body language - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well, I...Hmm. What do you mean by that, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense body language - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I...n-nothing, Sir, sorry. Sorry.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense body language - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's alright, Miss...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Spiritual jewellery - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The amount of jewellery Missus Erickson is wearing is quite eye-catching.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Spiritual jewellery - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Quite fanciful Sir, yes.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Averted Gaze - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you very busy, Miss? You seem as if your mind might be somewhere else.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Averted Gaze - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: S-Sorry about that, Sir! I've a hard time asking it to stick around all day, haha.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Averted Gaze - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: 'S like... sometimes my head gets ahold of a problem and I can't get it out of the clouds 'til I solve it.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Averted Gaze - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Ah, that's alright, Miss. I was worried that I might be making you uncomfortable instead.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Averted Gaze - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Averted Gaze - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...N-no, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you alright, Miss Murphy? You seem nervous.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh! Oh no, I'm sorry, Sir, I was hoping it weren't obvious.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Not at all. I'm on edge enough here myself, truth be told...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I-it's not you, Sir, really! 'S just someone messed me around a bit, see, and now--

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: Oh, it's stupid! S'like I just haven't shaken his voice out my ears, like...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Oh, I wish my mind was faster than my mouth, Sir. You don't want to hear about all that - I'm sorry.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: ...Oh, I wish my mind was faster than my mouth, Sir. I'm sorry.

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: I-it's not you, Sir, really! 'S just there being so many men about the place...

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Tense Shoulders - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: N-not that there's anything wrong with a perfectly good Sir, or Mister, of course! It's just in the past--

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Burn scars - Saoirse
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you burned your hands?

conversation: Cast/Saoirse O'Connor/Analysis Presents - (to) Saoirse/Burn scars - Saoirse
speaker: Miss Murphy
en: A-ah, it's alright, Sir. Can't be a cook without some burns to show for it.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Terrible weather out, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: We meet again, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Really ruined my morning walk.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Still, we're safe enough from it in here.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Where are my manners? I'm Michael Skerritt, over from London.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Declan Ward. The pleasure is mine.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Good day, Mister Skerritt.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Good day.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And you mark my words, young man - that's a name everyone will remember by the end of this event!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And what would you have me do, Mister Ward? You seem to have all the answers.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Aha! And what a plan, yes?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I've come here to put the capstone on my legacy, the final feather in my cap, as such. A pleasure to meet you.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: People across the globe and the ages will know this moment, this piercing of the veil, and with it, they will know the name Michael Skerritt!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Impressive, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Frankly, Mister Skerritt, it turns my stomach.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Wha... What?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That the best way you can think to see out your days is by ending them in the hope of impressing... who, exactly?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The others here at the event? Businessmen back home? Or historians in the future?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Such a pointless sacrifice. And you don't even know if it will work!?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Perhaps she can. And she will get all the accolades for it, too.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I... I believe it will work... Miss Mantovani can pull it off.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know Louis Pasteur for his vaccines, or Joseph Lister for his antiseptic sprays, but not the people these were tested on.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Even if this works - a substantial 'if' given the undertaking and the volume of ghosts already present in this God-forsaken manor - then it will be Miss Mantovani who is remembered.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You will be a footnote, subject number 1, as she continues to perform the ritual, unlocking more secrets from beyond the grave. And have no doubt she will do it again. Perhaps immediately.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You'll be newly dead, unable to answer a single question beyond "has this worked". You'll be tossed back so they can catch a bigger fish.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Some legacy.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: You answer me that and I shall stand down. You have my word.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Yes, I am old. Yes, I have no legacy to speak of. How would you see me change that path if not at the séance?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: With his resources and connections, there has to be something more meaningful he can achieve with the time he has left.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en:
No! That's not fair! I would have given everything, the ultimate sacrifice! 
They have to remember me! Love me!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is nothing about this that anyone will love. Anyone who does dig into your story will only unearth your lifetime of failures.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I need to find proof of a person being immortalised through their charitable deeds - perhaps there is a monument or a record of such somewhere here?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wonder if the charitable works of the late Marchioness could offer some inspiration?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Something that will get the recognition he so craves - whether he deserves it or not, he could do some real good in this world...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Terrible weather, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Skerritt conversation
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I might well move indoors before it gets any worse!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Marriage talk - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: How do you mean?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Marriage talk - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wouldn't know if she can expect success at an event like this, but I wish her luck, all the same.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Marriage talk - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Miss McLeod? She's a noblewoman, I understand. She could have her pick, but for her consorting with our strange types!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Marriage talk - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I might go and speak with her at some point… Surely she would do well with someone to give her introductions.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Marriage talk - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The young Scottish lady is apparently here in the hopes of finding herself a suitor.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Marriage talk - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wasn't aware there'd be so much socialising at an event like this.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: They have a reverend coming in for a service at 11am in the graveyard church. Somewhat of a way to atone for the night before.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well now... I plan to attend a few talks today. Namely those of our hosts, Miss Mantovani and the Marquess.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Then a quick drink at the bar at 6pm before the ball at nine.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Then I intend to rest up in the bar until the silent dinner, whatever nonsense that is - one last meal before the big event, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Then tomorrow, if I get enough sleep...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/timetable - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Then I intend to rest up in the bar until the silent dinner, whatever nonsense that is. After that, I'm retiring to my room for the evening and good luck to anyone still attending the thing!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hiring telegram - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Oh! Well, if something's happened to the good woman, it's right that there should be someone trying to find out what it's all about.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hiring telegram - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: What could have happened, I wonder?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Photograph of Deane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Yes, yes - It's Miss Deane. We have met.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance flyer - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It's a remarkable idea, isn't it? Not just to commune indirectly with a ghost, as many have, but to compel it to answer directly itself!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance flyer - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this whole séance business?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance flyer - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Of course, they'd get further, no doubt, with a willing participant, but it all depends on what spirits are in the area when the ritual happens.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance flyer - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I'm sure there is no end to the things fettered to this place, after all.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance flyer - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Think of what we could learn, all questions about the afterlife answered!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance purpose - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It's a remarkable idea, isn't it? Not just to talk to a ghost, as many have, but to compel it to answer questions about the afterlife.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Séance purpose - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I just hope that woman they have as a medium is capable of it.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Deane's signature - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed you signed in just before Miss Evelyn Deane. I suppose you met her?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Deane's signature - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I did, I did. Quite the young woman. Certainly knows her stuff about what it is we do here.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Deane's signature - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She said she'd travelled from London. I suppose that makes a few of us!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Land Records - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would this mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Land Records - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Land records? Who's looking at a thing like this at an event such as this?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Regional research - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: If someone wants to know about the history of the place, I could tell them!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Regional research - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: There was a battle here, you know! In the 1500s. Or was it the 1600s?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Edward Blake portrait - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Quite a formidable painting they have in the hallway.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Edward Blake portrait - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah, of the first Marquess? Edward Blake was his name, wasn't it?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Edward Blake portrait - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Yes, quite the man, it seems. Had this whole place built, so they say!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Leaving letter - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane actually left a few days ago - she left a letter excusing herself.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Leaving letter - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She did, did she? That's a terrible shame; she seemed like an interesting woman.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Manor's contemporary history - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I get the impression this place has a lot of history to it.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Manor's contemporary history - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well, yes, and I've done a bit of reading about it, you know.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Manor's contemporary history - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: The manor was built after the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland, on lands won from the natives.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Manor's contemporary history - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And then, I believe, it was passed neatly down through the Blake line.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/The staff say Deane left - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The staff mentioned that one of the guests has left already - Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/The staff say Deane left - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She did, did she? That's a terrible shame; she seemed like an interesting woman.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ghosts - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could swear there's already ghosts around this place, even before the Grand Séance.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ghosts - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Do you think so? Perhaps there are. It would explain the voices I heard outside my room last night.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ghosts - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I went to ask them to quiet down, but when I opened my door, there was nobody there - and suddenly, total silence.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ghosts - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Happened two or three more times throughout the night.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Cigar burns - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know where the cigar burns on the library chair came from?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Cigar burns - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And why would I know that?!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Cigar burns - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...Has somebody said something? No? Then away with you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Second Sight -  Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was speaking to the young lady - Miss McLeod - about her ability. Have you heard of this Second Sight of hers?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Second Sight -  Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah, I think I've heard mention. She's a seer, is she not?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Second Sight -  Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Fascinating stuff. One wonders if we even need the Séance at all - perhaps she could just tell us how it will go!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Freemasons - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would you be a member of the Freemasons, Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Freemasons - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah! Well, that, I'm afraid, is not something I could speak on.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Freemasons - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Not to a man that himself is not - if you catch my meaning.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Blake family portraits - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: From the portraits they have up, I'd have to assume the Blakes have quite a lineage.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Blake family portraits - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Used to be. You'll note they're mostly of ancestors. Not so many modern paintings.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Blake family portraits - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I met another Blake some years ago in London, I think, but I'm not even sure they were related.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Other Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you say you'd met another Blake in London?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Other Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Quite some time ago, yes. He was... Harold, or... Henry, or something of the sort.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Other Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But then. I don't see the man in any of the family portraits. Perhaps he was Burke or Black, instead? It was such a time ago...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ritual markings - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across some sort of ritual set-up upstairs, though God only knows what it's for.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ritual markings - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Haha, I'm sure it's not the first you'll stumble upon at an event like this.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Ritual markings - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I wonder what sort it was? No, you wouldn't know, would you? Hmm...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Cathal saw Deane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara said he saw Miss Deane late on Tuesday night. He said she was out of sorts, like she might have been drinking.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Cathal saw Deane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well, the boy ought to keep such things to himself - it's hardly his business.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Cathal saw Deane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: If Miss Deane had had a drink too many - well, that's her business, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bedroom skeleton key - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Why in God's name do you have that, man?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange occurences - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard talk that this place is haunted, but I could swear there's more than just apparitions around the manor.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange occurences - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: No matter how well I latch and lock it, my door keeps managing to get itself open.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange occurences - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I would think it's one of the staff doing it as some sort of joke, except I just can't catch anyone at it.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange occurences - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It only seems to happen, anyway, when I'm already in the room.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bloodied towel - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ugh, what do you have that for? Give it to the housekeeper.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Mysterious figure - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could have sworn I saw a figure standing in the window on the way back to the manor...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Mysterious figure - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Some unknown occupant of the house, perhaps? Or, more intriguingly, perhaps some long-since passed occupant of the house.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Mysterious figure - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It wouldn't be the first ghost seen in this house, that much is clear...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Goibniu - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard the name Goibniu about. Would you happen to know anything about him?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Goibniu - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Hm? Who's that? One of those old Pagan gods, is he?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Goibniu - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Pay the whole thing no mind, Mister Ward, there's nothing to all that.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/The Fae - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/The Fae - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Hah! The fae? Pagan drivel. Absolute nonsense that only the weak of mind would buy into.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the name the Tuatha Dé Danann mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: No, no. And it doesn't sound like something I'd have an interest in, if you catch my drift - haha!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bridget - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise the name Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bridget - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I don't know anybody by the name.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bridget - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Rather, I meant the goddess. Or perhaps the saint?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bridget - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah. No, that sort of thing is... not something I concern myself with.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Dead End - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I went to the trouble of seeing where Miss Deane went, out of concern for her... And I found that she seems to...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Dead End - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Well, strange as it sounds, she seems to have gone missing. There's no sign of her beyond the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Dead End - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Gone missing? Don't be absurd, man. She probably took a turn before she left - you know how women are.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It does not give me the same clearness of path as my original plans did.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you feel about your decision?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But... there is relief in no longer facing my end at the séance tomorrow evening.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But... there is relief in no longer facing my end at the séance tonight.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Perhaps I was too eager for a grand gesture. A final attempt at success.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I think Miss Deane saw my pain and guided me as best she could.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But she and I are from a world oblivious to the suffering that exists out there - a world perhaps too caught up in the metaphysical, and not concerned enough with this very real existence and its hardships.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: You, Sir, have given me another path. I will follow it earnestly and see where it leads.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: At least, for now, it feels promising. It feels good.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I think this is a better path to my goal.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It's not that far from what I do after all, except - and this is the funny bit - you don't expect the loan to be paid back.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I grew up thinking of that as a hand-out.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But now, I see it as a transaction. I pay money to buy legacy.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Oh, don't look at me like that, Mister Ward. The Catholics have been buying their way into heaven for centuries - this is the same thing but in a different hat.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: An old leopard can't change his spots. At least, not right away.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But who knows, maybe my mind will lead and heart follow.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/resolution - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And, if we all get our needs met, who cares what the underlying intention is, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ahhh...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Dare I say, Mister Skerritt, you must have built some legacy over the years!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well... a fellow at my stage always thinks that maybe he could do more...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I am the last of my line, you see. An only child who has had the misfortune to outlive whatever distant relatives I once had.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Of course, I have many friends and achieved no small success in business and brotherhoods I cannot mention.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And I have tried to further the esoteric studies as best as I could

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I think that is what really excites me about this séance - everyone is so focused on hearing a ghost, any ghost, speak.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Whereas I am fascinated by who the ghost will be.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: To us, it does not matter - yet. We're not summoning a specific ghost, you see. We're going to reach out and grab the closest.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And keep doing so until we find one who will talk to us.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And that ghost, tens - perhaps hundreds - of years after their death, will suddenly be a star!
