conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: We will all want to know their background, their life - in death, they will be famous! Forever!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Entire teams will dig into their past - their death, their life. Books will be written on them, and their first words from beyond the grave will be immortalised.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: We will all want to know their background, their life - in death, they will be famous! Forever!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: A lot of pressure, then, to make sure the name Skerritt carries on once my time comes...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/legacy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Now that is a legacy worth dying for!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bridge game - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday night?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Bridge game - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Oh, I don't think so. On Tuesday? No, I was relaxing fireside in the library.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Rendevouz - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It would seem that Mister O'Meara and Miss McLeod skipped the bridge game in favour of a meeting.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Rendevouz - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ugh - does no one have any sense of decorum these days? What terrible behaviour.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Rendevouz - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Miss McLeod ought to know better than to debase herself like that. She'll never find herself a husband at this rate.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/entertainment schedule - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah yes! Lots on. Is there a particular event or time you are interested in discussing?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/talks - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: We are blessed to have such a lineup of topics, are we not?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/talks - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Masters of their craft, gathered here to share knowledge.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/talks - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: With such powerful mystics, there is no way that the séance can fail!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Memento Mori - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard anything about the Quinns having... an unfortunate number of deaths in the family?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Memento Mori - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Oh yes! I have. Terrible business, that. Really done a number on the line.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Memento Mori - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Something about rooting out Irish rebels against the Crown, I think. A curse is a small price to pay for service to Crown and Country.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Freemason Correspondance - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: STOLEN

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Freemason Correspondance - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: STOLEN

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Letter from Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you in correspondence with Miss Deane, Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Letter from Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Why yes, I was. I have taken a shine to her, I won't deny.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Letter from Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...Not in that way, you understand.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Letter from Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I should hope it's not so much "were" as "is", my good man.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Letter from Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Miss Deane is quite the magician, so they say. I'd be interested in working alongside her.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Letter from Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She has opened my eyes. And I intend to repay her kindness this weekend.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hedonistic Gala - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do events such as these usually have that sort of party?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hedonistic Gala - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Only the very best of them! Was it a shock to you?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hedonistic Gala - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Haha, don't worry. It was a bit much even for me, and I've been to a few. Usually, one knows everyone at such a party, so there is more trust.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hedonistic Gala - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Not a great idea to ingest as we did in that space. A lot of untrustworthy sorts, here, after all. But, you only live once!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Hedonistic Gala - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: You'll get accustomed to this kind of thing, once you spend enough time with the sort of people worth knowing.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've found I've had the strangest dreams since coming here. Have you noticed anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But... Yes, I do dream that I am walking these passageways. Seeking... Well, what I am seeking doesn't matter to you.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: The strangest thing is that I can walk properly in them - hahaha!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I cannot figure out how to pass them, so I am trapped until I wake, which feels as if it takes time I do not have.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But there are doors - magical doors.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: That's what my dreams feel like, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But... not one's earthly home. A call back to Our Lord's divine palace.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Strange Dreams - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: You mean, a strange calling to home?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've come across drawings of this symbol... I made a copy, here. Have you seen this before?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I can't say I have - I'm not much of a scholar.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Unknown Sigil - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing the strangest symbol in my dreams - a spiral with four intersecting lines. You wouldn't know where it might be from, would you?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Unknown Sigil - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I wouldn't know about that sort of thing. Maybe that Quinn girl will know?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Deane's Room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Deane's Room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She's in... Oh... It's slipped my mind, old chap!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/Deane's Room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I'm fairly sure her old paramour, O'Meara, was by her?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I drew some tarot cards for myself, but I cannot make out the meaning.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And you want my help? Naturally, of course. Tell me, then - what cards did you draw?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: And the message is clear - the cards are saying there is an important moment in our futures. One in which we can greatly influence things to come, but at some great cost to ourselves.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Will we make that sacrifice when the time comes? That is hard to know but speaking for myself, I intend to!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: 'The Hanged Man', the 'Ten of Pentacles', and the 'Death' card... Is that... good?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: By Jove! I've had a similar spread myself recently.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Great cost? Is that what the 'Death' card implies - the cost of one's life?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/skerritt's cards - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well, it's not always that literal - but it's certainly one interpretation, yes!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But there is another way to interpret it: Instead of sacrificing your life, your remaining time - sacrifice your money.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have so much wealth, so many connections - you could really do some good with the time you have left.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mary Blake - she undertook numerous charitable deeds and has statues erected for her. And more than that, people speak fondly of her.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She is remembered and loved.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have the resources to do the same - don't throw your life away. Refocus it. Do some good in this world. Finally.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Marchioness Blake's good reputation did reach as far as London, and was mourned even there as a result...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I... suppose there has been a gap to be filled since her passing. Perhaps I can do something to help there.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It is a better bet than death...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I know about the tarot reading that you received, and I know how you interpreted it.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...You make a compelling case, Mister Ward. But... would people not see it as disingenuous?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Genuine or not, you can make a much-needed difference. And that will be celebrated - you will be celebrated.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And perhaps along the way, you will find you actually enjoy the good work.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: When I return home, I will reach out to any foundations that suffered from the Marchioness' death and loss of funding.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...Hmmm...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Alright, so! I gave you my word, and I stand by it now.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: This could bloody well work, you know! Good chap!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 2 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/gauge - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/gauge - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah yes. A spirit gauge, I think? Monitors the amount of spectral activity in the area. More ghosts, better séance.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/gauge - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...is that right?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Had a few glasses, have you, Mister Ward? Ready to set the world's wrongs to right, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you... are you ready for the end, Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It's quite alright. It doesn't bother me.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I onl--

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I've had to face up to it, of course. I am not getting any younger.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It absolutely terrified me, of course. Death.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Whoever is ready? Really ready?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well... I suppose I am. Now.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I spent a fortune looking for ways out. Mundane or magical.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Sadly, not something money can buy.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: But in the pursuit of a spell, amulet, or ointment to buy myself more time, I met one of the other guests who is now here - Miss Evelyn Deane.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: We talked. She listened to me, gave me readings - she helped me realise what I was scared of.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She convinced me that I didn't have to be scared anymore. She showed me a path to controlling the fear.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/dagger - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: So yes, thanks to her, I am ready for the end.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 1 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I believe I know how you might assure your legacy, Mister Skerritt. At least without--

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 1 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: If this is another dressing down, then I'd prefer it be less public.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Evidence Presents - Skerritt/philanthropy part 1 - skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Come. To my room.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Varley - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the manager?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Varley - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Of course, who else would I complain to when things aren't right?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Varley - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Wait... do you mean... socially.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Varley - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ahahaha!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Caitlin - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Caitlin - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Missus Joyce? Good woman, kind woman. Does what's asked of her. Can't ask for more than that!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Caitlin - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Missus Joyce? Good woman. Does what's asked of her. Can't ask for more than that!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Caitlin - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...Though she could brighten up a little, I dare say.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Seamus - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've spoken to the porter?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Seamus - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: How a chap like him gets hired in a place like this... Then again, if everyone is a lazy drunk, what choice do you have?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Darragh - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Only on the ride here. No other reason to. When you get older, Mister Ward, you'll understand - I'm not one for horse riding, not with these bones!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Darragh - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had cause to speak with the stable master?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Darragh - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: He's no spring chicken himself, of course, but I must say I was impressed with the ease he took my bags off the carriage and inside the manor.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Corentine - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've made Miss Quinn's acquaintance?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Corentine - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: We've met before. Now tell me Mister Ward - are all those scars paper cuts?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Corentine - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Or is she less of a bookworm than this event would suggest?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Corentine - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: A spot of powder and a dash of colour and she might even find a man to help her repopulate the Quinn family, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Corentine - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: As head of her household - by default, I might add - she could do with covering some of those up, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ivy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the young Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ivy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I have, I have. Lovely girl. She made for thoroughly entertaining conversation for a while, though she seems easily distracted.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ivy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Awfully familiar with that groundsman too - and hides it badly. Disgraceful behaviour on his part.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ivy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Still, I should like to discuss the séance with her some more - I gather she has insights into such things.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ivy - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I suppose he must find her a step up from the horses, eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Lan Fen - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I suppose you've met Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Lan Fen - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: The woman accompanying Miss McLeod? Well, I was introduced, rightly enough...

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Lan Fen - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I thought she was nothing more than the help.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Lan Fen - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: What the McLeods were thinking in picking her as a chaperone, I do not know.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Lan Fen - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Do her people even understand our customs?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, Mister Skerritt, tell me about yourself.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Hah! Now, I don't know how much there is to say, my good man.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I was fortunate enough to be born to a family of not insignificant means, and now I use those means to further our understanding of the spiritual world.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Which is how I find myself at an event such as this!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Skerritt - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I'm a London boy, born and raised. I live there still, of course, though I do enjoy some time in warmer climates. Not a luxury afforded to us right now, of course.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Evelyn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Evelyn Deane?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Evelyn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Know her? Yes, I know her.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Evelyn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Our paths have become intertwined, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Evelyn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I shan't say another word on the matter. I've already said too much.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Cathal - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the chance to meet Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Cathal - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I have, long before this. I know his uncle, you see. Same circles.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Cathal - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: He's of good stock, but he needs to calm himself down. A fraction of my age and already using a cane!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Cathal - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I gather it's not even showing off. Pushing himself for something or other. The pure thrill of it, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ines - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Oh, yes. Nice enough girl, I suppose. She's come an awfully long way for this!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ines - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was talking to Miss Barbosa earlier... have you had the chance?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ines - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: One has to respect that, I suppose, even if she's... perhaps having some trouble fitting in.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ettiene - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had cause to speak with Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ettiene - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Ah, the Frenchman. I've been introduced, but I haven't had cause otherwise.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ettiene - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: He's a professional sceptic, after all. What use is that to a gathering like this?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ettiene - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Plus, one does hear things... So no, I haven't made the time. The French can keep him, as far as I'm concerned. Hah!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Dupré - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Dupré - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Why would I talk to him?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Dupré - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: You know he burnt his friend, and carries her ashes around with him?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Dupré - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Some black magic hoo-doo, I'd wager. Barbarian behaviour, if you ask me.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on D'Arcy - Skerrit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on D'Arcy - Skerrit
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: The harlot? This is meant to be a serious event, for the educated. Not some... carnal hullabaloo.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on D'Arcy - Skerrit
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Where is her husband? What was his name, Cecil? Should he not be here keeping her in line?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Coventry - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Coventry - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I have, I have. Lovely fellow. A little out of his depth perhaps, but very pleasant.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Hazel - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Hazel - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Never before this séance, but I have heard her name before.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Hazel - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: A spiritualist - not as good as Miss Mantovani, they say, but she should make for relatively interesting conversation all the same.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ruairí - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ruairí - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: The Doctor? Good for him, trying to dig himself out of this mudpit. Shame he can't wash the Irish off.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Ruairí - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: ...Er, no offence.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Carmela - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Carmela - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I have made my introductions, of course!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Carmela - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I hear great things about Miss Mantovani, you know. Great things!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Carmela - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: You know she has read for Queen Victoria? What skill that speaks to!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Carmela - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: It's a pleasure to have finally met her. I cannot wait to be a part of her work!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: How he could have had so many marriage proposals and still be single is beyond me.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Did he not see the girls being laid out before him?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Certainly, a good path to forget his wife would be a newer, younger one, eh? Eh?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: *ahem*

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: She must have been a remarkable woman for him to hold her in such regard.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Walter Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Marquess Blake's son?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Walter Blake - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: What? The boy died in the carriage accident with his mother, no?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Arwa - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Hisham, yet?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Arwa - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: What on earth would I have to say to her?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Saoirse - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the cook?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Saoirse - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I sent her for drinks once, if that's what you mean? Not that she ever came back with them. Such a skittish little thing - I don't see what else we'd talk about.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Saoirse - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: What has Miss Deane so interested in that one, I don't know. She should know better than to fraternise with the help.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Fiadh - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Fiadh - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: A peculiar woman, that one! More forthright than she ought to be, I think. It's little wonder she hasn't found herself a husband.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Sinnott - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much with Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Sinnott - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: He doesn't seem like much of a talker. If I were to guess, I'd say he's just here to observe.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on Sinnott - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Perhaps there's some sort of Catholic doctrine against this sort of thing. I wouldn't know.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on O'Finn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on O'Finn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I know we're here to deal with the supernatural... but I can't comprehend what that man's gotten into his head to present himself like that.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Character Presents - Skerritt/Opinion on O'Finn - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: The savage leave a trail of mud everywhere he goes!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Mysterious crest - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: May I ask what the crest on your necktie represents?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Mysterious crest - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Aha - I would love to, Mister Ward, but that would rather defeat its purpose.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Mysterious crest - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I'm afraid I must leave you in the dark.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Scent of whiskey - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to be a smoker, Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Scent of whiskey - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Well, a man must be allowed a vice here and there, don't you think?

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Ornamental cane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's a very handsome cane you have there.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Ornamental cane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Why, thank you. I'm rather fond of it.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Analysis Presents - (to) Skerritt/Ornamental cane - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: I'm not so frail as to need it, but I've always been partial to the effect a nice cane provides a good suit.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Ward in room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Mister Ward! How dare-

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Ward in room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Thought you'd rob me, eh? Yes, I know your type. You'll regret crossing me, you thief.

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Ward in room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Skerritt, please, I was merely, eh-

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Ward in room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Mister Varley! MISTER VARLEY!

conversation: Cast/Michael Skerritt/Ward in room - Skerritt
speaker: Mister Skerritt
en: Sir! How dare-

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Sorry to alarm you, Miss. I'm Declan Ward. I'm a late arrival.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh, the guy Quinn called out this morning. That must have felt good, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: This place is boring and cold, but the boat over from Brazil was worse, so I won't complain.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: More questions?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have to be off.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Sure.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hey!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Don't sneak up on people like that!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Who are you anyway?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Well... yes. That's about it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And I think that appears to be going well for me, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Still...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: If you were the porter with my telegram, sure - but no, just some guy getting too close.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm Ines Barbosa.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You said you wanted a word?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I wanted to thank you, really. While you were tracking down the O'Connors for Miss Quinn, you did me something of a favour, too.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: The family crest... it looks like this one I have here. I think it might be somewhere to start looking.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have roots here, in this country. At least, that's what I'm told. It's good to... it's good to know something of them. It's somewhere to start.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Sorry, you startled me. I thought you were maybe the porter with a telegram for me...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Never mind all that. When did you get here? I haven't seen you before, and I've been here a while.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm awaiting something important, but they're taking their sweet time replying to me...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I only arrived last night, Miss...?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Barbosa. I'm Ines Barbosa. I'm here all the way from Brazil... you wouldn't think it would be a telegram to foil my plans now!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: ... So, who would you be?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm Declan Ward, Miss. It's a pleasure.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh! If you see that lazy porter, tell him I want my telegram.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Do you think... do you think I could see him somehow?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have learned much about the summoning of ghosts...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ines conversation
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And I have my father's name, now...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm glad to be outside again. That house... The air is heavy in there.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Likely the spirits.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes, I know. I'm not used to being near so many.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, it is the sort of place where they would be common.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: They are more than common, here. What has happened in this house?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I suspect the same thing that happens everywhere people have power and no consequences.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Eavesdrop, Ines and Dupre, hauntings
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Sim. In that way this place does feel like home...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Here, Miss, this is addressed to you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hm? Oh, thank you. I've been waiting for...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What's this? Why is it covered in ink? Who was so damned careless as to drop it in ink?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: They know I've been waiting on this, who would even... Agh, maybe I can make it out if I put it under a lamp...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Soiled telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Then maybe I'll find out who was so disinclined to care… Sorry, Mister Ward, please excuse me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hiring telegram - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this, Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hiring telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hm. That doesn't... bode well.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hiring telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I haven't seen Miss Deane around for a while, but I thought it was a coincidence, or that she'd left.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hiring telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Good luck with the investigation.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Photograph of Deane - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know who this is?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Photograph of Deane - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That's Miss Deane. Evelyn Deane, isn't it? I've met her, she's a guest here.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Photograph of Deane - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Or, was, anyway. I haven't seen her in a few days.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Map - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER HER THE MAP ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Map - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP THE MAP ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Map - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think you might have a use for this?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Map - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I think I would. You mean for me to have it?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Map - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Thank you, this should be helpful.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Map - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold on to this for now...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Séance purpose - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: You know, it might be a vain hope, but while I'm here...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Séance purpose - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I really think I have to give this whole thing a try, you know?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Morse code book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I almost have Morse code committed to memory. I thought it would be useful.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Morse code book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But it turns out, mostly, other people will do the transcribing for you, so I've never needed it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Morse code book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: In this place's case, one of the staff deals with messages.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Telegram machine - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how to use the telegraph machine?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Telegram machine - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: No, it's the staff who use it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Telegram machine - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Probably for the best, or I'd be standing over it myself. I'm still waiting on a telegram...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Here, I think this got mislaid. It's addressed to you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh! I wonder when it came in. Thank you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Here, Miss, this is addressed to you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hm? Oh, thank you. I've been waiting for...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What's this? It's... late...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: They know I've been waiting on this, who would even...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: If I find out who was so disinclined to care… Sorry, Mister Ward, you will have to excuse me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: This will set my work back months!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was going by the telegraph room, and this was waiting for you. I thought I'd bring it to you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hmmm. You did not read it, I hope?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Let me see... Dammit.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: In truth, I do not care much for your ghost stories - we have plenty back home. But this hotel, it has a lot of records for this area, so I come.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...is everything alright?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Fine. It's... fine.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: This event suits me. If I came here alone, I would be the main attraction, yes? Now I am just one more who plays drums in the carnival. There are so many, nobody pays attention

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I know it sounds foolish, but that is why I am here. Once I heard of this event, I thought... I thought that maybe I would get a chance to see him. Look at his face, in his eyes, and know him as best I now can.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I was hoping somebody would have a record of my father. Of his name... If I had his name, I might find a photograph.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It doesn't seem like that much of an ask, to know who your father was, or what he looked like... except in my case, apparently.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Fine. It's... fine. I just, I wrote to the local authorities, hoping they might have some record...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Ah... My time in Brazil had come to an end - what does one do in that case? Well, my father was from here, so it made sense to come this way.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I am researching everything I can find about the area. Census data, birth records, emigration records - your people have badly kept records! My room is full of this stuff, but can I find a thing on him?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ines' Telegram - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Ai, this is a foolish thing. I know only his first name, Shay, and when he left this country - in 1864, like so many others.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Blake statue - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen the statue in the library?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Blake statue - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Almost stares you down, doesn't it?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Blake statue - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: All in memory of a man who directed a slaughter and built upon the tragedy.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Blake statue - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It might be that it isn't that eerie at all, and it's just that I hate it. I really do.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghosts - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm beginning to think this place really is haunted, you know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghosts - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And why not? Everywhere people have been ends up haunted.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghosts - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What makes you think this place is different?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Séance advert - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But it suits my purposes, so I come.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Séance advert - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You've come a long way for this event.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Séance advert - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Have I? No, I came a long way to get to Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Séance advert - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: The event I saw advertised while searching for something else.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ritual markings - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, I found the remains of a ritual upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ritual markings - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: You did? Well, isn't that something?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ritual markings - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Maybe these folk really do know what they're doing... I mean, I thought they did, but I wasn't sure, you know?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Waiting for a message - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You mentioned you were waiting on a message?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Waiting for a message - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes... Do you think the porter's lost it? I wouldn't put it past him... I mean, look at him...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Waiting for a message - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I wish the manager were less busy, so it was him handling it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Bedroom skeleton key - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Why in God's name do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange occurences - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed any... strange happenings around the manor?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange occurences - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Mmmm. I suppose I will confess to you that the footprints seem strange.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange occurences - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: When it rains, sometimes I see footsteps on the floors.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange occurences - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But never coming in from outside. They're always leaving.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange occurences - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I assume somebody has turned around for something, but still, it is strange.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Statement, Mister Doyle - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle tells me he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday night.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Statement, Mister Doyle - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh. Well, that's none of my business. Nor is it yours, really.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Mysterious figure - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You've spent some time in the gardens, haven't you? Have you noticed anyone in the windows?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Mysterious figure - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I mean... You don't mean the other guests, do you? No, of course you don't, I think I know that look.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Mysterious figure - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Whoever that boy is, up in the window, I've seen him too.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Dead end - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she only went to the hedge maze... but there's no sign of her from there.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Dead end - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm... I'm sorry, does that mean she's missing?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Dead end - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It would certainly seem so.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Dead end - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That's... That's not good. I hope she's alright, wherever she is.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silks - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Pray tell, what use do you think I would have for this?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silks - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silks - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silks - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cash - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER MONEY ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cash - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP MONEY ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cash - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What is this for?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cash - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Actually, never mind your intention. I can put this to good use. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cash - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this. I thought you might want it before anyone else sees it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: How did you get this? Did you break into Deane's room?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does that matter? I suggest you take it and dispose of it before anyone else sees it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: You are right, of course. She told me she had it, tried to make use of it over me. She must have seen the fire in my eyes because she left me and has avoided me since.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It is a foolish keepsake. I was an idiot to take it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I... I was captured. Taken by the man who killed my mother.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I do not know his plans for me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And I had no intention in finding out.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I had no plan. I was lost. By the time I got to Rio, my face was on posters, so maybe not all of his people burned. A shame.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And so I started a fire. I would rather have died in a blaze than let him choose my fate.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But maybe my mother was watching over me because the way the fire went, I was able to escape instead.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: My captor and his crew were not so lucky. And good for them.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That is when I decided it was time to leave Brazil. I go to the port a few hours later. There were posters there, too.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So I took one before I left. A souvenir. A stupid, dangerous souvenir.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... hope that was a one time thing?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: The fire? Sim, it was just that one time.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Good. I implore you to keep it that way. Otherwise, I will bring you in myself. Understood?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: ...Understood.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: My mother, she was in prison. She liked the monarchy. I suppose it was what she grew up with. Ingrained.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So after the coup, she was on the wrong side of things.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She was arrested. Then, after a few years, she became sick.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Also, I had no plan. I was caught escaping. I only got away because I bit the guard who found me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Pneumonia. They did not even try to treat her. They let her slowly die in prison.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So after she died, I set fire to their prison.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have not done this kind of thing before, so it was not a good job. Only a little damage was done. Certainly, not enough.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That is when I decided it was time to leave Rio. I go to the port a few hours later. The posters were up by then.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So I took one before I left. A souvenir. A stupid, dangerous souvenir.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... hope that was a one time thing?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: The fire? Sim, it was just that one time.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Good. I implore you to keep it that way. Otherwise, I will bring you in myself. Understood?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/wanted poster - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: ...Understood.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Entertainment schedule - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I caught a glimpse of the schedule for the event - there's no shortage of things to do this week, it seems.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Entertainment schedule - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I would say I don't really care about it... but when the weather's really bad, it's nice when there's something to retreat indoors to.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Entertainment schedule - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Why do you ask? Was there something of interest to you happening at one of the times?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Bridge game - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you at the bridge game on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Bridge game - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. D'Arcy taught me how to play - this is how bored I was.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Bridge game - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Eh, aside from D'Arcy and I were the Callaghans, Quinn, Lau, Coventry, and this man who owns the place, Blake.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Bridge game - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did many attend?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/News clippings - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Missus Joyce has quite the interest in the gossip columns.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/News clippings - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Anything worthwhile? Let's see...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/News clippings - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: "A local detective by the name of Ward is credited with the resolution of the O'Leary case..."

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/News clippings - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Fancy that.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Telegram draft - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think Missus Joyce has sent for help looking for Miss Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Telegram draft - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh? Let's see...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Telegram draft - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Is this... some sort of joke? Or are you just stupid?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hermetic Order - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hermetic Order - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I can't say I do.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Talks schedule - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you plan to attend any of these talks people are putting on?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Talks schedule - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hmm... The one on the history of the manor, and the one on ghosts, I think.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Talks schedule - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm hoping I'll learn something. And if I don't, I've had worse afternoons.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cigar Burn - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know who left those cigar burns on the armchair in the library?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Cigar Burn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I recall... I think it happened while we played bridge. They were meant to join us but I was so focused on not forgetting the rules I, I have forgotten who. One of the others might remember.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Laudanum - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Always comes in useful eventually. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Laudanum - Ines

en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Laudanum - Ines

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Laudanum - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Well, if you're offering. This seems quite fine, as well! Thank you, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Faith - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There’s quite a few different faiths practised amongst the guests here.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Faith - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So long as no one’s asking us to agree on it, I don’t think that’s an issue.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Catholic Faith - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Catholicism, Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Catholic Faith - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Well… That’s a big question, you know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Catholic Faith - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But we worship the Lord God, his son Jesus as his form made manifest, and the Holy Ghost, each as part of the Holy Trinity and distinct entities.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Catholic Faith - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: We also place more emphasis on the Virgin Mary than other traditions seem to.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Catholic Faith - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: How's that for you?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Protestant Faith - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about Protestantism?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Protestant Faith - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Not much. Brazil is largely Catholic.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Secret Rendevouz - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that Miss McLeod and Mister O’Meara were taking a walk together while the bridge game was being held.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Secret Rendevouz - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Aw, that’s nice. Careful who you mention that to, though. People get uptight about these things.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Secret Rendevouz - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Though speaking of - Missus Lau was at the game. Why on Earth didn’t Miss McLeod have her come with them? I thought that was the point.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Surreptitious meeting - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that while the Sunday services were held, Mister Hunter and Miss McLeod were talking in the gardens.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Surreptitious meeting - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh. Well, what of it? Who am I to begrudge them a friendship?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange Dream - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you experienced any strange dreams since coming here?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange Dream - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I walk the halls of this place - well, not these halls. They look similar, but longer, taller.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange Dream - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: There are doors. Blocking the corridor itself. I had to move... something like light to unlock them, I think? I do not understand that part. Eventually, I am at the séance and can go no further.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange Dream - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Just the one dream since coming here, which is odd enough itself, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange Dream - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I try find a way out, a way home I think - even though I myself will not return to Brazil.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Strange Dream - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Do you mean something like that?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I thought this might be useful to you, Miss.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What? But this is... There is so much detail here. Where did you get this?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's Miss Quinn's work. She's been researching the O'Connor family for a ritual she wants to conduct.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The woman she's focused on, a 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor, had a son who emigrated.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, do you think she might borrow that brooch of yours for her purpose? If she is right, it would not only help her but also confirm we have the right man.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Then how can I refuse? Come, let us find the Quinn woman.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's research of the O'Connor family. I noticed it bears the same crest as your brooch.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It does not. But Miss Quinn says her ritual is a matter of life and death - and that she requires an item from that family.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was hoping you would check the date of his departure against that of your father?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes, yes, they line up.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But his name is Seamus O'Connor, not Shay. A cousin maybe?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Which, it turns out, may be your family.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So this doesn't mean...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Hang on... I can't believe I didn't make the connection before now, but Shay is often used as shorthand for Seamus.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: So I have been looking for the wrong name?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It is possible, or we may have the wrong man altogether.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family research - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Wait, isn't Shay often used as shorthand for Seamus?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silent dinner - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you plan on attending the Silent Dinner?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silent dinner - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Mm, I do. I think I might prefer the idea to the séance.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silent dinner - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: If I understand it right, we can all invite someone specific to the dinner, and I would really...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silent dinner - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'd like to see my father. I've never seen his face. I'd like to spend some time with him, even if we can't talk.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Silent dinner - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It would be nice to know he's nearby, even if it can only be for a little while.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/O'Connor Crest - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: By my reckoning, Miss Barbosa, that brooch of yours has the O'Connor crest on it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/O'Connor Crest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It was my father's. It was all he left with my mother before he went to war. Well, this brooch, and me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ticket - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Doctor Callaghan is a practitioner of spirit photography, and has agreed to try and get you a picture of yourself with your father.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ticket - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: He told me to give you this.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ticket - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Really?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ticket - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That's kind of you. It's kind of you both. I'll go and talk to him, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a book of family crests, and it would seem the crest on your brooch is the O'Connor family's.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That would make sense... meu mãezinha always said my father left it with her, after all.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: O'Connor? Shay O'Connor. That's... It's good to know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm just damn glad it really was a crest. That it was something. Not just some dead end, or worse, wishful thinking.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Thank you, Mister Ward. This is good to know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I thought you might like to take a look at this.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Hm? Why's that, then?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ SHOW HER THE O'CONNOR CREST ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That's interesting, I suppose... but it doesn't mean anything to me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That's interesting, I suppose... but it doesn't mean anything to me. I'm not sure it's got anything to do with me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm not only here for this séance, you know. In the country, I mean. My father's side of the family is Irish, or that's what my mother told me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I wanted to see where he came from... That sort of thing. The name O'Connor... it is a start.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ SHOW HER THE O'CONALEIGH CREST ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ SHOW HER THE O'CONNELL CREST ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ SHOW HER THE O'CULLEN CREST ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ SHOW HER THE Ó DÁILAIGH CREST ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Family crest book - Ines
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ SHOW HER THE O'DEORAIN CREST ]

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Land Records - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this book mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Land Records - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I was reading it, looking for information on the families that used to live around here.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Land Records - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Quinn gave it to me, but it was no help. Still, she was good to offer it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Now you know your father's real name.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And now I know my grandmother's name, too - Eve.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I am Ines Eva Barbosa. A tribute to her, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
