en: For what she has done for me this day, I will certainly carry on as if that were true.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. Seamus - ironically like the porter who annoys me so much.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: My mother said my father was also an annoying gringo - cheeky, she said. But she said it with a twinkle in her eye.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Shay O'Connor - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She never really let him go, I think...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghost Photography Machine- Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Doctor Callaghan has a camera that he's modified for taking pictures of spirits.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghost Photography Machine- Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: A camera can do that? I was right - this is a house of miracles.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghost Photography Machine- Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Have you asked him how it works? Would it... work for my father?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghost Photography Machine- Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could ask him.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Ghost Photography Machine- Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Obrigada.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/O'Connor Family Crest - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The O'Connor family has a crest, as it turns out: one with a tree in its centre.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/O'Connor Family Crest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: A tree? Do you suppose that... Might my brooch have one belonged to the O'Connors?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/O'Connor Family Crest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Maybe that's wishful thinking...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hedonistic Gala - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That was... quite the party.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hedonistic Gala - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: When I was told to bring something to wear for the ball, I joked it would be like Carnaval.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hedonistic Gala - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Then to find I was not too wrong - Valha-me Deus!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hedonistic Gala - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I almost expected it to end in rutting!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Hedonistic Gala - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I... went looking for Ó Finn but he seemed to leave early. A shame.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Unknown Sigil - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've seen a drawing around, of... it looks like some sort of a rune to me. A spiral, with four lines intersecting it. Do you know what it is?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Unknown Sigil - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Can't say I do. Have you tried asking one of the scholars? I mean, it has to be something magic, right?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this symbol mean anything to you? I found a drawing of it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: That doesn't look like much of anything to me. It doesn't look like any sort of written word, even. Like...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Ai, what's the word in English? This is much too specific for me to know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: When a picture represents something, you know? Or maybe it's just made up. You never know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Deane's room - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Deane's room - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She was -

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Deane's room - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: No, wait. I thought.... Hm. I can't remember.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Deane's room - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Funny. I went there to... get something back, but now I cannot recall where it is...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I will spend some time in the telegraph room. It is peaceful there, even when I'm not waiting on a message.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I will spend the morning recovering from the party, I think.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for this weekend, Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: There or thereabouts - I like the lobby or atrium, too. There you see people's comings and goings.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'm meeting Dupré in the gardens at twelve. Then I will see Fiadh's talk at three. I think she will spend it telling everyone they are wrong to be here - that I want to see.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: After that, I will rest in my room before Mantovani talks at five, which I intend to see - maybe it can make some sense of all this!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Except, gah! There is mass at twelve.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: ...And then there's the silent dinner at eight. What to expect from it and the séance? I do not know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I think I'll take an hour in my room beforehand, I think, to prepare myself.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: After which is dinner, then the masked ball. Imagine my surprise to find a mini Carnaval here! Then on Sunday...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Mister Coventry's talk at five, I will go to. Before that, lunch.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: ...And then there's the silent dinner at eight. What to expect from it, I do not know.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/timetable - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Then after that, I'll go to my room for the night and leave you all to your séance.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think you'll do when the séance is over?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I only hoped to learn my father's name - but to see him!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have what I came for and more.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And I like it here... I like knowing that I am in my father's homeland - and I have met some people that I might one day call 'friends'.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Forever? Who knows. This event has changed my world, and I need time to process all of that.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And now I have the inheritance from Corentine. This is more than the fresh start I came here hoping for.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/End of quest - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But all that matters is right now, yes? And right now, I'm happy here. I have answers and a home. I cannot ask for more.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have much in the way of family back home?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: None. My mother was an escaped slave. She raised me in a Quilombo.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I lived there my whole life - almost entirely not leaving until slavery was abolished in 1888. Even then, we were slow to trust the outside.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But last year, my mother and I went to Rio to see Christmas there. She was nervous, but I, I was excited!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry to hear that. It's not long since I lost my last remaining family.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is a certain type of loneliness in having no family that no friendship or lover can remove.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. I feel... adrift in the world. Maybe someday I will find something good in that freedom. But... not yet.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She was all I had and, now, she is dead.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is a certain type of loneliness in having no family that no friendship or lover can remove.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. I feel... adrift in the world. Maybe someday I will find something good in that freedom. But... not yet.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: None. My mother bedded a gringo, so she was cut off from her people.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He then went off to war and died.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm sorry to hear that. It's not long since I lost my last remaining family.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: We ate oranges and sugared nuts. Despite the heat, we even tried a mulled wine.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: As a gift we took a photograph. I am glad we did. It is all I have left of her.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: A man saw us that day, a Captain of the Forest who had run-ins with my mother and her camp.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: His job was to recapture slaves, back when slavery was in full force.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Bitter at having never found our settlement, he followed us back that day.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Then he returned that night with some friends, all of them drunk.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: They began to shoot up the place, killing many - including my mother.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Those they did not kill, they captured. And so my home was destroyed, and my family killed and scattered.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Death certificate - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: My Lord! That is awful!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Father's Ghost - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You hope to see your father's ghost?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Father's Ghost - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. And why not? This is a house of miracles, no?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Father's Ghost - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Before coming here, I had no money, no land, and only a nickname for my father.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/Father's Ghost - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Maybe if I keep asking, this house will keep giving?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/gauge - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/gauge - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Of course, of course. It is made similar to the odd contraption in the telegraph room. Perhaps they are both made locally?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/washer woman - ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Sim, but that is one of the staff, no? What is her name, Caitlin?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/washer woman - ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This might sound strange, but have you seen a woman on the grounds? Washing clothes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/washer woman - ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I called out to her to see what she was washing in the horse's trough, but she did not reply.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Evidence Presents - Ines/washer woman - ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I left her to it, I do not know the customs of this place.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ivy - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ivy - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I talked to her and her chaperone - a grown woman with a chaperone!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ivy - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I do not know what to make of these noble types, but that is new to me.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Varley - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the manager?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Varley - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: There was no one to talk to but the staff when I first arrived, so yes.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Varley - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I think this job, this event, is hard on him. I could see his demeanour darken as the week rolled on.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Varley - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I stopped asking him for help with my telegrams to give him, um, space. But then I got stuck dealing with the idiot boy, Mister Doyle.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Imagine a person like her watching your every move. She is like the McLeod girl's shadow.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She would be hard to get anything passed, I think, and God help anyone who does.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I see a fire in her. I think she could do regrettable things to protect her charge.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Skerritt - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Skerritt - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He asked me about the Amazon and how deep in it I lived.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Skerritt - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I am thousands of miles away from it. I have never been. I do not think he meant offence, he is just old and ignorant.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Corentine - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to talk to Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Corentine - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: The girl with the books, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Corentine - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Briefly -  we sat together at a meal.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Corentine - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I mentioned my father was Irish, and she gave me a book of local records. A strange gesture, maybe, but not a bad one.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Caitlin - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Caitlin - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Bumped into her sweeping once. She had all sorts of questions. More than usual, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Caitlin - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Less than you, though.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Caitlin - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I did not mind it. I have been here a while. Overbearing conversation is still conversation.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Darragh - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the stable master?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Darragh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He brought me here in the carriage, so yes. And I see him around the grounds.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Darragh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have asked him about the area, but he is Scottish and does not know the history. I thought it was just a thick Irish accent.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Darragh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He was not offended. Your people are close enough, he says.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Darragh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Anyway, a pleasant sort.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Seamus - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about the porter?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Seamus - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I know he is bad at this job! He is too busy fawning over that witch, Deane, to get anything right.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Seamus - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Ah... I should not be too hard on him - his eyes are glassy and sad like the people I hid with on the boat out of Brazil.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Seamus - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Of course, he'd fall for anything to offer him a distraction.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Seamus - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He should get out of here, it is not good for him.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ines - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Miss Barbosa.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ines - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What is there to tell?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ines - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have already told you I am from Rio. Well, I said Brazil, but Rio was my home.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ines - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I suppose I am a drifter, now. I have a drifted a long way, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ines - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But home is different since the uprising. Mostly good but not all good. Isn't that the way of such things?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ines - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I decide, now is a good time to travel. See the world.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Cathal - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Cathal - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes, he tried to... hmm, what do you call it... "woo" me?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Cathal - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I would break him worse than his horse riding accident.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Cathal - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But, I admire his confidence.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ettiene - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ettiene - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He has the most sense of anyone here.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ettiene - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Open but questioning. I like that.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ettiene - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He does not ask personal questions. I like that even more.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Evelyn - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Evelyn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: No more than I know you, but already I do not like her.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Evelyn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She knows too much, what business is it of hers to know so much?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Evelyn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She is like, like a spy, or a thief! Or maybe she has spies and thieves in her employ.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Evelyn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Whatever the case, she is a sneak to be watched!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Dupré - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Dupré - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Oh yes. We have much in common, me and him. He makes for easy company.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Dupré - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He knows so much about Irish culture and mythology but when I asked him about this area and those who lived here? He knows nothing practical, that man.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Dupré - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Still... he understands grief well.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: A wicked woman. I like her a good deal.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She pretends to be into ghosts and magic but she is a normal person, really.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Coventry - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Coventry - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. He knows a good deal of this area and its history. I'm interested in that.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Coventry - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He is what I imagine talking to a grandfather is like - including the musty smell.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Hazel - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Hazel - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have. She's offered to give me a private séance, but I do not want such a thing.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ruairi - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Doctor Callaghan at all?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ruairi - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes and no. It was good to talk to someone actually from the area.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ruairi - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: They gave me much advice and much to think about.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ruairi - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But I did not get much sense of the doctor himself in these talks. His aunt does not give him much room to be.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ruairi - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I asked him about his camera, but she kept dismissing it as modern nonsense, so I learned nothing.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ruairi - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I hope he finds a way to get her off his back. It is not good to have bad relations with family.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Carmela - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Carmela - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Yes. I wanted to know more about this séance, so I asked her.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Carmela - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She had more time for me than expected. She is good with people.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Carmela - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And we talked about tarot, of course. When I told her I didn't want a reading, she laughed, and said that it was alright.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Carmela - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She said to enjoy the here and now, instead. With that, I agree.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Fiadh - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Fiadh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Wherever you go - Brazil, Ireland, anywhere - there's always aunties sticking their nose into things.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Fiadh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: But I cannot help but like these women. Society says, "This is not for you, you are an old lady with old ideas."

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Fiadh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And they say, "Try, then, to keep me out".

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Fiadh - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: My mother was not an aunt to anyone, but in this way - she was an auntie.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Saoirse - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the cook - Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Saoirse - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She is a quiet girl, so not much talking with her. She seemed upset that I am not one of your, eh, feiticeira. Eh, a magic... person.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Saoirse - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I said to her, magic is done by living fully... taking the moments that come to us as openly as we can. Well, she did not care for that.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Arwa - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Arwa - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have. I do not like her - she makes the hairs on the back of my neck stand up.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Arwa - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It is not anything she does or says. Just...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Arwa - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I do not know what it is. If you told me she was a ghost herself, I would almost believe you!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I am a Catholic; of course we have spoken! But what would a priest want from a thing like this?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Surely he, more than anyone, has enough authority on what lies after death?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've spoken to Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: Am I going to ignore such a man as him? I do not think so.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And what a relief, to talk to a man with a sense of humour. I'm getting so tired of everyone being so polite.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Blake - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the Marquess at all?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Blake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I have. I wanted some guidance on the history of this area, of the people from it.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Blake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He was polite but brief. Sent me to the libraries, which was helpful but not very friendly.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you aware that Marquess Blake has a son?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: The boy in the paintings, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Character Presents - Ines/Opinion on Walter Blake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I don't suppose a child has much business being here. It is no wonder he is kept away from all of this.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Foreign fashion - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice you're picking up some of the local fashion.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Foreign fashion - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I left in a hurry and packed light.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Foreign fashion - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What would you have me do, freeze?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your brooch, it looks to carry a story?

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It was my father's, or maybe his mother's? He didn't bring much with him when he left Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: And he had even less on him the day he died, defending my mother.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: My mother took this and ran. She passed it to me so I would have something of his.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: She kept it and gave it to me. It feels right to wear it here.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: It was my father's, or maybe his mother's? He didn't leave much when he went to fight, but he left this.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: He told my mother he would be back for it, but he never returned. He did not make it out of Paraguay.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Irish keepsake - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: gringo

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Windburnt Skin - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can see the weather here is not agreeing with you...

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Analysis Presents - (to) Ines/Windburnt Skin - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: You can tell, eh? I'm not used to all this wind and rain; it has more bite than the dogs back home.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ward in room - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: What the-?!

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ward in room - Ines
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Barbosa-

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ward in room - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: No! There are enough strange things creeping around the manor without you in the mix.

conversation: Cast/Ines Barbosa/Ward in room - Ines
speaker: Miss Barbosa
en: I'll be informing the manager of this immediately.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Un moment, Monsieur?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hello again, Monsieur Ward. Can I help you?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Take care, Monsieur.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's all.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Quite right. Excellent.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I had planned to do it myself, but once I saw you, I knew you would have to help, Detective...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So you do know who I am?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Indeed. I'm an investigator of my own sort, you see? It would be foolish of me to enter a new country and not read the papers, n'est-ce pas?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: As for my own investigation, I have focused on Madame Hazel Erickson.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'll get to the heart of it. She is an out-and-out fraud. About this, I have no trace of a doubt.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But... My belief alone is not quite enough - I still lack evidence.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Here, take this key. It will let you into room 19, Madame Erickson's room. There you can find something that proves the case, of this I am sure.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What makes you think I'd do a thing like that?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That's your job, is it not? And... you would want to keep your presence here quiet, no?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You won't hear a thing further about your presence once you have aided me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Here - the key. I shall see you back with evidence inside the hour, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And how do you expect me to get into Missus Erickson's room safely?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I believe I heard her discussing her plans with Monsieur Ó Finn. You might consider listening in...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Allow me to even the playing field.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I am Etienne Toussaint, a debunker of fraudulent mystics.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And it is the topic of fraud I wish to speak with you on...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You would be... Declan Ward, correct?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's all.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I think not, Monsieur. We are not done talking yet.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Otherwise... Well, I will have to make an announcement at breakfast. You'll be out not long after, I assure you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...But I thought you didn't believe in the whole idea? Ghosts, mystics - aren't you out for us and all our dealings?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Au contraire! I am quite the believer. I think you would agree that disproving all this would be quite the task, eh?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I am sceptical - of this, you are correct. I concern myself with the falsified cases - which I believe to be the majority of cases.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But to deny it all? Especially in a place such as this? Impossible!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: That is not what I want to hear! I was hoping for assurances that it was all smoke and mirrors, as they say.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: But not the staff, even - some little boy!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: What I want from you is something about 'mould in the walls', making my brain rot to the point of hallucination.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Would a rotting brain be of more comfort, hmm?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: ...He was a very creepy child.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Hauntings, eavesdrop
speaker: Missus D'Arcy
en: I could have sworn there was someone in my room last night, when I was almost asleep.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Photograph of Deane - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Photograph of Deane - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That would be Mademoiselle Evelyn Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Photograph of Deane - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She's attending the event, though I haven't seen her for some time... Perhaps she's taken to her room?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Séance advert - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think the séance's claims could be true?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Séance advert - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That they can actually summon a ghost and talk to it directly?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Séance advert - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You ask the wrong man, Monsieur!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Séance advert - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But many things were considered impossible until they were done, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Séance advert - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have witnessed many strange things in my line of business. From what I know of her, if it can be done, then Mademoiselle Mantovani can do it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Marriage talk - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've overheard it said that one of the young ladies here is hoping to find a suitor.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Marriage talk - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Here? What a thought... But I suppose, one looks for those they have a kinship with, given the chance. Hm.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Marriage talk - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well... Should it ever come up, I'll have to give the young lady my best wishes in the matter.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Telegram for Ines - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'm something of an investigator, Monsieur Ward, but I am decent about it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Telegram for Ines - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This is best delivered to the mademoiselle herself.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The staff say Miss Deane left - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was talking to the staff, and they said that Miss Deane checked out last Tuesday.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The staff say Miss Deane left - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: They - she did? That seems... I don't know the lady well myself, but that does seem out of character.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The staff say Miss Deane left - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I do hope she's well...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ghosts - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Increasingly, I think I see strange things around this manor.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ghosts - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: The power of suggestion will do things to the mind, Monsieur Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ghosts - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Figments of the imagination, perhaps, but perhaps we'd best err on the side of a believer for now, and leave them be, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Séance's Purpose - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What's your opinion on the intent to trap a ghost?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Séance's Purpose - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: There seem to be two beliefs on the matter among the mystics. Either that it will make for an interesting evening, or that it is playing with fire.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Séance's Purpose - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Everyone has their reasons, I suppose. If I were a mystic, I would hope mine were good, to attempt such a thing. Or perhaps I simply wouldn't care.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Séance's Purpose - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But as it is? It's an interesting study.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Séance's Purpose - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hm, I'm getting predictable. I can hear it, too.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Freemasons - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Freemasons - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: They're a fraternal order valuing ritual and secrecy, and they require initiates to be male - hence, fraternal - and believe in a higher power.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Freemasons - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Perhaps I could tell you more, but for their secrecy.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Freemasons - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Whether they actually dabble in the great powers of the universe, or are just another gentleman's club, depends on who you ask.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Freemasons - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: As for what I think? I won't do you the disservice of belabouring the point.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Second sight - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about Miss McLeod's second sight?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Second sight - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah, Mademoiselle McLeod. I don't doubt something troubles her - or even that she interprets it as visions. I know about this, of course.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Second sight - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But, I find it more likely that she's suffering from some sort of chronic nervous fits than that she is spontaneously gaining foresight.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Second sight - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: My telling her so will do no good - but I wonder if introducing her to the idea might do some good.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ritual markings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found some evidence of a ritual conducted upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ritual markings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Is that so? Hm, that's curious. That will be one of the sincere practitioners, most likely.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ritual markings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Someone intent on putting on a show would do just that... or at least leave evidence it was them. Did you find any such thing?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ritual markings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No, I didn't.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ritual markings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Then it would see you stumbled onto something that wasn't meant for you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cathal saw Deane - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Apparently Monsieur O'Meara saw Miss Deane wandering the halls on Tuesday night. He said it seemed as if she'd been drinking.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cathal saw Deane - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That's... odd. I spoke to her on Tuesday evening, and she had a drink or two, but not enough that you would notice it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cathal saw Deane - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well, I suppose I saw earlier on. That could well have changed by whenever Monsieur O'Meara saw her.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bedroom skeleton key - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You had best hand that back to the staff, Monsieur Ward. Immediately.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange occurences - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything strange happening about the manor?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange occurences - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have noticed handprints on my mirror as if it were cold. Not the strangest thing - or, at least, I have seen stranger through my work.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Soiled telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'm something of an investigator, Monsieur Ward, but I am decent about it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Soiled telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This is best delivered to the mademoiselle herself.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Soiled telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Or, perhaps... a legible copy.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's leaving letter - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane left a letter excusing herself from the event... Apparently, she had to be somewhere.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's leaving letter - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Is that so? That's... hm. She seemed so set on this Séance...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's leaving letter - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I suppose it must have been something urgent.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Mysterious figure - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to have seen a figure in the upstairs windows?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Mysterious figure - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Mm. Perhaps it's another member of the family...?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Mysterious figure - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I suppose, unless they visit the event or Marquess Blake confirms it, we won't know for certain.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Fae - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the fae, Monsieur Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Fae - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I know they are a prevalent cultural belief in the region.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/The Fae - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But if you want the specifics, you'd be better asking someone who very much believes in them.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Dead End - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I looked into where Miss Deane left to, and it seems she... hasn't. Rather, she seems to have somehow vanished part-way through the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Dead End - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'm... sorry, do you mean this to be some sort of joke?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Dead End - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Non. Non, you don't. She's really missing, just like that?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Dead End - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Something ought to be done for her, then!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Silks - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hmmm. The air here has my nose runny. Perhaps something soft would be of use. Yes, I will take it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Silks - Ettiene
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Silks - Ettiene
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SILKS ]

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Silks - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Silks - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hmm. This is... quite fine, are you sure? Well, I'm not going to turn down something like this when it's so cold out.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/resolution - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: The depravities of mankind are not new to me. I've seen - indeed, experienced first hand - magic and its beliefs used to justify many terrible things.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/resolution - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Was it worth it? You have Erickson, but at the cost of learning what she would have done...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/resolution - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But what shakes me in this case is the reasoning.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/resolution - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That she would do such a thing in the hopes that it might grant her something as trivial as magic?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/resolution - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Her own humanity meant so little to her. This is what upsets me. But, it is done.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Sherry - Ettiene
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Sherry - Ettiene
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ALCOHOL ]

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Sherry - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I appreciate the offer, but I don't want it while I'm working. Thank you all the same.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Sherry - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Entertainment schedule - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's quite the number of events on throughout the week.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Entertainment schedule - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Mm. There are. They are, perhaps, more for the traditionally interested guests rather than for people such as myself, or Mademoiselle Mantovani...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Entertainment schedule - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: If you are interested in specifics, I cannot help you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You didn't happen to attend the bridge game on Tuesday evening?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Tuesday evening? No. No, I wasn't. I was waylaid by Mademoiselle Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you mean by waylaid?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah... I published a paper, half a year ago, you see, on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years. In it, I took his process apart.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. She decided to let me hear exactly what she thought of it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And so, I did not make the bridge game, no, I was fielding that instead. I confess, I was... almost concerned for the woman.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Concerned? How come?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well, she let me hear exactly what she thought, certainly - but she half apologised afterwards. She said she was on edge...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She seemed convinced of some "male presence" following her in the house.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I tried to ask, of course, but she hadn't forgiven me enough by then to feel like elaborating, and I didn't get anything more.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I did not. I'm not really one for socialising.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I suppose you might call it a fight, though I would say it was more one-sided than that.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Forgive my forwardness, but might I ask as to why?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: So... I published a paper, half a year ago, you see, on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years. In it, I took his process apart.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. She decided to let me hear exactly what she thought of it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And so, I did not make the bridge game, no, I was fielding that instead. I confess, I was... almost concerned for the woman.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Concerned? How come?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well, she let me hear exactly what she thought, certainly - but she half apologised afterwards. She said she was on edge...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She seemed convinced that somebody meant her harm - somebody with a "Christian aura". She was specific on that point. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I tried to ask, of course, but she hadn't forgiven me enough by then to feel like elaborating, and I didn't get anything more.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I correct in believing you fought with Miss Deane last Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This house. It doesn't seem to agree with her. Bad dream, then bouts of no sleep. Thinking back on it, I haven't seen her leave her room since then.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Now that you've drawn my attention to her absence, maybe I should check in on her...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you find anything more interesting to pass your time?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She seemed convinced of some "male presence" following her in the house. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah, I see. Now I'm starting to get a sense of your true investigation here now, Detective.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: The cook, Mademoiselle Murphy - I had asked her to bring me a sandwich that evening. She can attest to my whereabouts.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But we are not friends yet, Monsieur. Come, let us talk on other matters for a while. Specifically, the matter of fraud, oui?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah... I suppose we are friends now that you have done me my favour, yes?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: The answer is a boring one. I sat the event out. I found a pleasant nook in the north east corridor and read.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But you do not need to trust me, Monsieur, though it is the truth.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And you did not think to share this for my investigation?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And as discussed, there is information I want.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah... You are probing! I have something you want, no? Information, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Bridge game - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Once you have helped me with Madame Erickson, I will tell you anything you want...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Secret Rendevouz - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that Miss McLeod and Mister O'Meara were meeting up when the bridge game was on.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Secret Rendevouz - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Mm? Without Madame Lau? That's the makings of a scandal.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Secret Rendevouz - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I will forget the information immediately, for their sakes.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/News clippings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce does really seem to have an interest in gossip.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/News clippings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And a pointed one, as late. Tell me, Detective, what news of Mademoiselle Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/News clippings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think it's best I don't say anything until she's good and safe.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/News clippings - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Correct.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Drafted telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems as if Missus Joyce went to hire a detective when Miss Deane disappeared.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Drafted telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Went to. And did. Did she not, Detective?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Drafted telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Telling anyone, however, is a terrible idea, for someone's responsible for Mademoiselle Deane's appearance, and if you tell them, who knows what they'll do?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Drafted telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Be thankful it wasn't me, and from now on, keep that particular card close to your chest.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Drafted telegram - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And, for whatever it's worth, good luck with your case, Detective.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hermetic Order - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hermetic Order - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: They are a society of, primarily, people interested in studying and performing high magic.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hermetic Order - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That is, ritual magic, often invoking some form of higher power. It's the most popular sort among high society types.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hermetic Order - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Although whether that is a matter of who is drawn to the practice, or who the society accepts in the first place, is probably to be given some thought.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Talks schedule - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: An interesting chance to hear many perspectives on what is happening here.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Talks schedule - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/record - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I discovered this interesting old record.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/record - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hmmm. That might be a good aid for lucid dreaming. Perhaps I could borrow it when you are done?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Grimoire - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It might help to have something to reference against. That's if there's anything pertaining to spirits in here... Hm...

en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Grimoire - Ettiene

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Grimoire - Ettiene

speaker: Mister Toussaint

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Artefacts - Ettiene

en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Artefacts - Ettiene

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Artefacts - Ettiene

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Faith - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems there are many more faiths practised among the guests than just Christianity.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Faith - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: A great deal of them, certainly - and in my case, none at all.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Protestant Faith - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the Protestant faith?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Protestant Faith - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Not a great deal. I was raised Catholic, and I am not a theologian.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Catholic Faith - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about Catholicism?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Catholic Faith - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Rather too much, as it happens. If you want any sort of useful answer, however, you might ask someone else.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ettiene's Influence - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand you're quite influential in certain circles.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ettiene's Influence - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Really, that depends on who you ask... but I will admit, I have made something of a name for myself.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ettiene's Influence - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That in itself is not special. Plenty of people here have influence and renown, in their differing forms.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Ettiene's Influence - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It just so happens I do something that no one else here does.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Surreptitious Meeting - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears Miss McLeod didn't attend a service on Sunday - she was talking with Mister Hunter, instead.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Surreptitious Meeting - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hm? Well, that's curious. I suppose they must know each other better than they have initially let on.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Surreptitious Meeting - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It's not out of the question. Outside classicism might pressure them not to interact openly.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I suppose you might call it a fight, though I would say it was more one-sided than that.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Forgive my forwardness, but might I ask as to why?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: So... I published a paper, half a year ago, you see, on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years. In it, I took his process apart.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. She decided to let me hear exactly what she thought of it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And so, I did not make the bridge game, no, I was fielding that instead. I confess, I was... almost concerned for the woman.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Concerned? How come?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well, she let me hear exactly what she thought, certainly - but she half apologised afterwards. She said she was on edge...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She seemed convinced that somebody meant her harm - somebody with a "Christian aura". She was specific on that point. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I tried to ask, of course, but she hadn't forgiven me enough by then to feel like elaborating, and I didn't get anything more.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I correct in believing you fought with Miss Deane last Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This house. It doesn't seem to agree with her. Bad dream, then bouts of no sleep. Thinking back on it, I haven't seen her leave her room since then.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Now that you've drawn my attention to her absence, maybe I should check in on her...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And you did not think to share this for my investigation?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She seemed convinced of some "male presence" following her in the house. It doesn't seem like her, but maybe she's locked herself away from whatever it was?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah, I see. Now I'm starting to get a sense of your true investigation here now, Detective.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Deane was overheard arguing with someone the other night, while the bridge game was being held.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Am I right in thinking it was you she was arguing with?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah, that was overheard? Yes, it was me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But I... don't see how that's of your concern. Especially as you've chosen not to involve yourself in such matters as those that I'm concerned with.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah... well, I suppose you've done me a favour, it's only fair.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: If you were to reconsider doing me that favour... then I might consider talking about it. How about it?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: So... I published a paper six months ago on a spiritualist by the name of Marcus H. Watson. He was something of a mentor to Mademoiselle Deane.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: He was also about the most perfect master of emotional trickery I've ever met. The paper took two long years to write. In it, I took his process apart.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I wrote about just how he appeared to speak to the dead. It was very, very difficult, and I will confess, I am immensely proud of that work.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Despite all Monsieur Watson's work, once his manner was laid plain, it was no longer difficult to see. He was disgraced, just as he deserved.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: However, Mademoiselle Deane's association with him... Well, any benefit to her was dashed. And I thought that was what our conversation was going to be about.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Instead, it was more like she was trying to rope me into some new scheme. I still don't understand it, if I'm perfectly honest.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She came to me, telling me she thought she was being followed by some hoax, and wanted me to disprove it, as I had disproved her mentor.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I don't know... I just couldn't believe it. It felt as if she was trying to set me up for something.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: So I refused her, and she wasn't happy to hear it at all, she rather let me have it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Etienne and Deane fighting
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And I suppose that was what was overheard. Does that help you?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Memento Mori - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know about any... unusual deaths among the Quinn family?
