conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Memento Mori - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Yes. I've heard it said that the Quinn family is cursed, but you've met Mademoiselle Quinn...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Memento Mori - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She seldom talks about it, and certainly not for any sort of gain, and so I don't consider it my business in any professional sense. However...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Memento Mori - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'll say this; I don't know about any sort of magic tied to it, but if the Quinns believe they are cursed, whether they are right or not, it's not without reason.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Memento Mori - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: From what I've gathered, the family has been the victim of tragedy more times than they can count.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cigar burns - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know where the cigar burns in the library came from?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cigar burns - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I can't say I do. And I don't smoke, so you needn't look at me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Cigar burns - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Someone ought to tip the housekeeper for the trouble, though.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hedonistic Gala - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting a party of that sort.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hedonistic Gala - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah, did it take you off guard? I cannot say I am shocked.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hedonistic Gala - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You would be surprised just how uncivilised high society events can get. At least you'll know, now, to brace yourself should you attend another.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've found I have the strangest dreams staying here.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: My data would suggest you are not alone.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Data?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Oui. But it's too early to comment. I am still gathering data and undertaking experiments. Perhaps when I am done, we can talk.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What data is this? Where would it be kept? His room, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I feel my technique is solid. I have suitable music and I keep the dream in the forefront of my thoughts, but still - no luck.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Perhaps I could try this technique and use the knowledge of the shared dreams as my anchor? I could use Miss Deane's journal to represent that.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Aha. You do not seem to be alone. I say you, but I, too, have had recurring dreams since coming here.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have been trying to induce a waking dream state in myself to see if I can explore the dreams, but I have had no luck.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Strange Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have heard that having an anchor to focus on what you hope to achieve can help. I should try that tonight.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Unknown Sigil - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this sigil about... a spiral intersected by four lines. Do you know anything about that?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Unknown Sigil - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I've never come across it, no.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's Room - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's Room - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Yes, she is in the room... No, I have forgotten.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's Room - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hmmm...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's Room - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: How unlike me to forget something like that. Suspicious.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Deane's Room - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Let me check my notes. Here, Room 15.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Erickson has confessed to me quite a gruesome plan.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well, look at that. That is unfortunate... I almost pity her. Maybe I would if she weren't deceiving innocent people.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This is excellent, Monsieur Ward. Thank you. Your secret is safe with me, I swear it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This... I knew I was right about her being a fraud, but I didn't know about this.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This will do fine, I'm sure - but that hardly matters. Someone has to stop her.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: No doubt she won't hear anything from me... but you might have a chance to talk some sense into her, Detective.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And as for your profession, no one will hear about it from me, you have my word.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: These might help you - some proof that she's not so subtle as she thinks.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She is indeed a fraud - she has no magical powers. She seems to be incapable of using magic, in fact.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Something that plagues her to the point where she will perform a ritual to steal the heart and magical prowess from another here.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: What? Non! It cannot be!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She is in dire need to feel magic, to have it, it seems.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But also, she fears that the reason she cannot use magic is a flaw in her soul.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She is blinded, of course, by her desires. Anyone who believes in a soul would also believe that there is no eternal bliss for them after murder.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Especially in a manner so foul. What's more, now you and I know her plan.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Here, take my notes. Let her know that if she does this, not only would it stain her in her god's eyes for eternity, but also, we will see her hanged and raced to this oblivion she fears so much.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She would be better served getting off this path now and finding more mundane solutions to finding her god's favour.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I am told one can cleanse the soul with coin? My records show she's certainly conned enough of that in her time...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: As for you and me, Monsieur Ward, our business is done. Whatever reason you are really here, your identity is safe with me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And as for this place? News of her plans has turned my stomach. I've had enough mysticism for this trip. I shall be sitting the séance out.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof about Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Now, if you will excuse me, I have notes to make in my quarters. Au revoir, Monsieur.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a ritual in her room - it talks of eating a person's heart to steal their magical abilities.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That is... ominous. Rather too ominous.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Madame Erickson is a fraud, Monsieur, but I have trouble believing her capable of such a deranged act.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You'll no doubt find many here studying strange things. But reading a book on sacrifice is not the same as performing it, correct?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: If we are to know this is her plan, and not academic in nature, then she would need to confess.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She is unlikely to confess to me...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Surely this is nonsense, Sir? Such a thing cannot be real. What's more, she cannot intend on doing this?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Certainly, such rituals exist. Do they work? I cannot say. Would she do it?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's notes - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: ...but you? Perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this scrap of paper indicating that Missus Erickson is a pariah. I thought it might interest you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It does, and if the page were complete and she was named on it, perhaps it would suffice.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: ...but, ah, the state of it. I don't think I could convince anyone this isn't a forgery, however real it might be.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Then, it will not suffice. I do not think we could convince anyone it isn't a forgery, however real it might be.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It does. But a scrap, you say? Is the page complete? Is she named on it?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a scrap of paper indicating that Missus Erickson is a pariah. I thought it might interest you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's letter - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...She is not.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I discovered a list in her room with names of guests on it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Interesting, but it doesn't prove anything in itself. A list of marks for her fraudulent ways? A list for something more? Who can say off this alone?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your name was marked off.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: How insulting! A list of people she does not like, maybe?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Evelyn Deane's name was circled. At the top was written 'Targets'.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's list - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Interesting. Speculation, yes, but perhaps it is that I do not use magic, whereas Mademoiselle Deane - she is rumoured to be a studied woman.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You said you wanted to see Missus Erickson in action? But isn't Miss Carmella Mantovani the mystic of honour at this séance?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah yes. I have heard tales of her work from... less than

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: They are not always correct in this, and unfortunately, any skilled enough liar can make use of that.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I don't believe Madame Erickson truly is communing with spirits on her clients' behalf. I think she is a practised fake, taking advantage of vulnerable people.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, it's Missus Erickson you're looking into?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: The thing about mediums is that their clients must take what they say on faith; they assume that the medium is more capable than them.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: They are not always correct in this, and unfortunately any skilled enough liar can make use of that.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I don't believe Madame Erickson truly is communing with spirits on her clients' behalf. I think she is a practised fake, taking advantage of vulnerable people.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Target: Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You are correct, Monsieur, but that does not interest me. Mademoiselle Mantovani's talents are known and tested many times over. I am sure she will do a fine job.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What sort of proof would suffice to show someone to be a fraud?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Any number of things, Monsieur. Catching them in the act, of course. But a record of their methods, a letter admitting they are faking it - even a confession would do, if witnessed by somebody of standing.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Proof - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'm sure you will know it when you see it...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Searching out fraud must be easy work at an event such as this.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Au contraire, Monsieur. Many of the guests are true magical practitioners.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, is that your purpose at all events like this, searching out the fraud?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It's certainly not the company. Well, that's unfair. It's not consistently the company.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How did you come into a profession like that?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Just like you might imagine. A fraud decided I would be a perfect specimen on which to prove his abilities. I won't get into the specifics.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But you can imagine it inspired a certain drive to expose such cases, and the people behind them.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, is searching out fraud your purpose here?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: At a gathering such as this, there is likely to be somebody looking to take advantage of the more vulnerable attendees.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: In what way, Monsieur?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It is a séance. Surely everyone involved in running it is a charlatan and the rest naive fools.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraud - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But at a gathering such as this, there is likely to be somebody looking to take advantage of the more vulnerable attendees, those who merely believe.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's key - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How did you get this key?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Hazel's key - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Watching for sleight of hand lends a certain capacity for it, I've found.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Notes on Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think these notes will be enough?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Notes on Hazel - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: To prove her a fraud? With what we've learned now, I believe so. To convince her to stop this madness? I could not say.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraudulent attendees - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you really suppose there are people here that might be frauds? Other than Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraudulent attendees - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I haven't looked so thoroughly at the others as I might have if I weren't so interested in Madame Erickson's attendance, honestly.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraudulent attendees - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But there are few who strike me as disingenuous here. Anyone here who claims any magical talent certainly believes it themselves.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Fraudulent attendees - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: That sort of thing - in the case they are disingenuous - is more difficult to discern, and... rather sad. I like that sort of work much, much less.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you learned much about exorcisms in your work?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have, and they can be real. But, Monsieur Ward, they are more often not.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Like any tool of the church, you must be very sceptical.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Any undesired behaviour can be deemed to be demonic possession - the discovery of unfavourable sciences, a wilful woman, a child who struggles to conform.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Even those of... different sexual orientations are fair game for a fiery priest and his inhumane methods to chase the 'demon' out.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/exorcism - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Like witch burnings before it, it's a form of punishment for being different. Be wary of it, Monsieur Ward, and of those who use it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Buried Messages - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The dream - it contains buried messages!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Buried Messages - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah! That makes sense. What is the message?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Buried Messages - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: In short, attend the séance. But, for reasons I do not yet understand, it is coded with imagery of home.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Buried Messages - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Strange, I would have said dreaming of home might make me want to return there. But that is not the case.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Buried Messages - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Perhaps this speaks more to the source of the dreams - maybe they convey a feeling moreso than a directive?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... I believe that something about the dream is reshaping how we see the hotel.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I shook it for only a moment - just enough to realise it - before the veil dropped again.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw pictures of my homelife instead of the manor; people and places I love.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Would that not become obvious? As we point out aspects that do not align with one another's experiences?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Interesting. As if this place wants you to feel at home? Or perhaps something is trying to communicate a feeling through this?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think it is... more subconscious than that. I saw, for a moment, familiar images underneath the art in my room.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Altered Reality - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I wonder, then, what might anyone who's been under its influence for longer be experiencing?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Lucid Dreaming - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me more about this lucid dreaming?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Lucid Dreaming - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah, Les Rêves Lucide. I have only a passing familiarity with the work of Marquis d’Hervey de Saint-Denys. I had to research what I could in the library here to try it myself and so far, I have had little luck with it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Lucid Dreaming - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Perhaps the record I am using isn't suitable, or my technique is otherwise flawed? We shall see.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Lucid Dreaming - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I am told Madame Lau is a psychologist - perhaps she would know more. Or the doctor - this seems up his alley, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Shared Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I suspect many of the guests are experiencing the same dream.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Shared Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Oui. I am coming to that same conclusion, but as yet I do not know the why of it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Shared Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Is it, perhaps, an echo of something from the past? A communication? Are we actually trapped in the one dream? If so, whose?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Shared Dreams - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I am working on a lucid dream, but I'm not making the headway I would like. I am missing something, but what?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Coded Paper - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this pattern ring any bells for you, Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/Coded Paper - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: ...Intriguing. I do not recognise it exactly, but it certainly seems mystical in nature.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/guests - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You suspect someone, then?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/guests - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I believe most attendees are legitimate practitioners, but yes, I have my suspicions.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/guests - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: My intent is to gain the proof that will discredit them.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Talks?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: In the drawing room. One at eleven, one at three, and one more at five if you wish to join me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I plan to attend the drawing room talk at three. Then the bar at five, I think, to unwind from all this.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Other than the ball this evening, I hope to attend the talks.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'll want to eat before the séance at 9, but I have no interest in the silent dinner, so I'll need to corner the staff and make arrangements for beforehand.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you have any plans for today?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And tomorrow, let me see...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/timetable - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I've no interest in the silent dinner or the séance, so I'll need to corner the staff and make arrangements to eat beforehand.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Excuse me but did you say there are people here who think they can perform magic?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Non.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I said there are people here who can perform it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You are, I know, not of this scene, but believe me when I tell you - magic, rituals, ghosts. It is all real.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It is hard, of course, and expensive in what it takes. So it is not commonplace.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Easier for some to... fake.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is ridiculous!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: To you right now? Maybe. But you are here now, and you will soon see many unexplainable things.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/magic - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: We shall see, then, how "ridiculous" it all is.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/identity known - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know me, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/identity known - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Not quite. I know of you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/identity known - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It remains to be seen if you truly are the man I have read about.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/gauge - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you studied the strange device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Evidence Presents - Ettiene/gauge - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have, and it is strange indeed, but this place has other similar devices. I'm unsure if it means anything or is purely for display.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ivy - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ivy - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have. Quite the ability she claims to have. Convenient that her time here has dampened it, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ivy - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Certainly, something has her distracted. What would be of greater importance to her than this event, eh?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Varley - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the manager?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Varley - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Monsieur Varley? Not extensively.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Varley - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I don't take him as one for idle conversation. My kind of man.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been introduced to Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah! How pleasant to find a psychologist in our crowd, and one so shrewd.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And such a watch she keeps on her companion! I can see why she was chosen as a chaperone.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Skerritt - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Skerritt - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have. We did not, how you say, bond...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Skerritt - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: How could I put this? He is not a fan of Oscar Wilde.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Mademoiselle Quinn and I first met some time ago, in London. It was a pleasant surprise to see her again.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I haven't wanted to interrupt her work, whatever it is she's doing, but when there is an opportunity, I enjoy talking to her.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She has some unique insights into this culture of ours. She's also friendlier to me than many.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I understand why people are wary of me, but that's not to say it isn't a welcome break to have a proper conversation now and then.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Many people here are, perhaps understandably, wary of me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Mademoiselle Quinn, not so. She does not care to impress others with her work, so she does not care if I believe in her or not.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Corentine - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: As such, we get on reasonably well. Sadly for me, she is so preoccupied with her research.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Caitlin - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Caitlin - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Of course. At a gathering like this, the staff are a great resource. Overlooked but everywhere!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Caitlin - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I asked her many questions, and she was happy to oblige.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Caitlin - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Perhaps both?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Caitlin - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'm unsure whether she's intrigued by the events of this weekend, or horrified at its "godlessness".

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Darragh - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the stable master?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Darragh - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It is well he is such a gentle soul - a man of that size would be hard to overpower if it came to that, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Seamus - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met the porter?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Seamus - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I had a question or two for him, but I can tell you I didn't learn much.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So, Mister Touissant, tell me about yourself.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Hm. Shall I presume that no one's told you anything of their own accord? I will, I'll be charitable.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I'm an academic with a particular interest in the supernatural - what of it can be proved or disproved.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Enough people work to prove its existence, but not so many try to mark where fraud begins.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: What else? I am from Reims, studied the classics first, and... if I tell you any more, I'll become very boring.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Where is he visiting from?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you come far for this event?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Some distance, I will confess. I'm accustomed to travelling to England - London especially - and this is significantly farther West.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Where are you visiting from, if not England?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: France. Reims, more specifically. Have you ever been?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've never left Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Well, I hope someday you have the opportunity. In the meantime... your country is quite beautiful, so no harm there.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Some distance, I will confess. I'm accustomed to travelling to England - London especially - but this is significantly farther West.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Where are you visiting from, if not England?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've... never left Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I hope someday you have the opportunity. In the meantime... your country is quite beautiful in its own way.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it, from your accent, you have travelled far to be here?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinon on Ettiene - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: As for my origin - France. Paris, nowadays, though I was born and raised in Reims. Have you ever been?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Cathal - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Cathal - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah... that I have. To say I am concerned for him...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Cathal - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You will find a great many people, Monsieur Ward, when misled, will speak of angels.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Cathal - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: And the way it has him... I only hope he is not beyond help.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ines - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ines - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She plays her cards close to her chest. So mistrusting.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ines - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She has nothing to fear from me, she not only does not claim any skill in all this, she actively disbelieves.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ines - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: How she finds herself here, I am most interested to find out!

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Evelyn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Evelyn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: We have met once or twice, but never exchanged anything more than small talk.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Evelyn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She came off as pleasant, though I suspect there was more to her than she let on.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Evelyn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Certainly, I was right, as it is clear to me now that many guests have complex relations with the woman.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Evelyn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: What an interesting life she must lead...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Dupré - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Dupré - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I have not had the opportunity to talk to him as much as I would like.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Dupré - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I've never met anyone from New Orleans before... I'm curious as to what brings him here.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She is the Englishwoman out of her depth, oui? A sharp tongue, but it cannot hide her ignorance of what we are surrounded by.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Coventry - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Coventry - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: We sat together at one of the meals, but not much was made of it. We did not find much overlap.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Coventry - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: How he ended up here is a mystery to me - he says he has come to speak with his dead wife, but how did he come to learn of the event?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Hazel - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is your opinion on Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Hazel - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I think I have made that clear, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ruairí - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ruairí - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: A few times. He, too, is a man of science and so we have crossed paths at events more of that ilk in London.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ruairí - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It is interesting to see him here, on his home turf. He seems... je ne sais pas... smaller? No, compacted.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ruairí - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: He is less his own man here, more an accessory for his aunt. A formidable woman, so that is perhaps not a surprise.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ruairí - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I hope he can decompressed before the pressure makes him... snap?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Carmela - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Carmela - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Mais bien sûr! How could I not have crossed paths with her?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Carmela - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: In fact, two years ago I investigated her. She is, as they say, the real deal. A bona fide mystic.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Carmela - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: If the mad goal they have for this event can be done, she is the woman to do it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Fiadh - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Fiadh - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I believe she's made it her business to get the measure of everybody attending, so oui, we have talked.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Fiadh - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She would do well in my line of business, I think.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Saoirse - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Saoirse - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I... try not to. It is clear that Mademoiselle Murphy would be happier if avoided by the men here.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Saoirse - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Very occasionally, I'll ask for food. Otherwise, I do not bother her.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Arwa - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to speak to Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Arwa - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Tsh, I had hoped for a good academic discussion, but I have found Mademoiselle Hisham unable to hold a proper conversation.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Arwa - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: She is distracted, non? More than once, I have found her staring at the lady's portrait in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Arwa - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Perhaps that is the next mystery I will look into here?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Sinnott - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Sinnott - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Non. I do not trust priests. In fact, I do not think anyone who seeks power should be given it.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Sinnott - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But with the church? There is no due process, no... how you say, no punishment given to them.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Sinnott - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: We are conditioned to defer to men in white coats, black frocks, and blue uniforms. They will protect us, oui?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Sinnott - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Maybe, at least until they decide you are the type of person who needs to be protected against, non?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Quite the character. It's unusual to see someone in that style who doesn't make their way as a showman.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Ó Finn - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: A true hermit.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Blake - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you meet the Marquess?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Blake - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Oui. I dined with him the night I arrived. A pleasant discussion, though he seemed bewildered with my being here - frustrated, almost.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Blake - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: I am, of course, used to such receptions.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Walter Blake - Etienne
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met the Marquess' son?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Walter Blake - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: The boy in the portraits? No, I have not.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Character Presents - Ettiene/Opinion on Walter Blake - Etienne
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: This séance is no place for a child - it is better he is kept away.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Notebook in pocket - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you always carry that notebook with you, Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Notebook in pocket - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: More often than not.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Notebook in pocket - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: There's a lot to record... best I don't chance it to something fragile like memory.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Notebook in pocket - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: You agree, non? I have seen you making notes in your own journal, oui?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Society of Psychical Research - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If I might ask... what does that crest you're wearing indicate?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Society of Psychical Research - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Ah. It's the emblem of the Society of Psychical Research - a grouping of curious individuals who try to apply academic rigour to paranormal situations.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Society of Psychical Research - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: It's a mixed set. Some believers, some sceptics, some in-between...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Society of Psychical Research - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: But I find it suits me to have some like-minded people to share my work with.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Discerning gaze - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have the impression, Mister Toussaint, that nobody here could get a thing past you.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Analysis Presents - (to) Ettiene/Discerning gaze - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: When dealing with charlatans, Monsieur Ward, it's all in the sleight of hand. The best thing against that is a keen eye.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ward in room - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: ...Monsieur Ward?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ward in room - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Could I-

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ward in room - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Non, non. You are in my room, and yet I gave you neither key nor permission.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ward in room - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Of course, all things considered, this should not surprise me. But it does offend me.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ward in room - Ettiene
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: Come, we shall speak with Monsieur Varley on the matter.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Day 2 Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I should think on what he said to me and return to him.

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Day 2 Ettiene conversation
speaker: Mister Toussaint
en: A moment, Monsieur, if you would?

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene quest win or lose
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've run out of time to find Mister Toussaint his evidence...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene quest running out of time
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm running out of time to find Mister Toussaint his evidence...

conversation: Cast/Ettiene Toussaint/Ettiene quest running out of time
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It is nearing breakfast. I need to find that evidence for Mister Toussaint soon...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is she really laid to rest?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She is, thanks be to Maman.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And thanks to you and Missus Joyce, of course.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And that means... You will not see her again?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Not in this life, no. Why are you asking?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: My brother. He is dead, but since coming here I... I wonder how final that really is.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: My brother. He is dead, but since coming here, I have learned he is still with me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Unfinished business of his own, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But how do I find out what it is and free him, before he becomes trapped like your Laura?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Perhaps it is just this place, but I think I feel him with me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/resolution - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: That I do not know, Mister Ward. But if Laura found a way to get you to free her, I am sure your brother can too.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Photograph of Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this woman?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Photograph of Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Why, of course. That's... No, sorry, that's Miss Deane - isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Photograph of Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I should be able to make the distinction. I should.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Map of the region - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Map of the region - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It would be very useful if you were to go out walking.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Map of the region - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I've been, but I haven't left the roads for fear of getting lost, haha!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Alcohol - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I thought you might like a drink.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Alcohol - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ah, thank you. This looks wonderful.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems this séance is more welcoming than I might have expected for something all the way out here.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Isn't it just? I can't say I was expecting that...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It was a surprise, but a pleasant one.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think about this whole binding a ghost idea?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The real issue would be if you intended to keep a ghost bound, I would think...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Holding it for just a moment in our mortal plane won't do it any harm.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The real challenge will be getting it to cooperate.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Yes and no. As interested in the séance as I am, it would have been hard to justify the journey for it alone.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ireland is an interesting place, but it's the banshees, dúlacháns and bánánachs I find the most interesting.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And, while I'm here, I want to delve into your mythology. Fascinating stuff.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Our mythology interests you?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You've come some way for a séance?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: No, I have some personal business to attend to on this little island of yours.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Death is death everywhere, but spirits and spectres of death? Those are different everywhere you go.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Has he been to an event like this before?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Here, though? I couldn't resist it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: They hold them back home, of course, but they're not usually my sort of thing.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But it's the first one of this sort. I've never attended a séance of this style before.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is this your first event of this sort?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance advert - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I suppose you could say so. It's not the first gathering I've been to with spiritual or, if you prefer, supernatural aspects.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Edward Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about Edward Blake?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Edward Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have learned a little, since I've been here.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Edward Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He was a commander in the conquest of Ireland by General Cromwell, and built this manor when the conquest was done.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Edward Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He was the sort of man, I understand, that history would be better without.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hauntings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard a lot of talk about this place being haunted... Have you experienced anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hauntings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, the manor is haunted, alright. There's souls around every corner.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hauntings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Some are more upset than others, but none of them are doing very well... they wouldn't be here if they were, after all.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hauntings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There is whispering in many of the rooms if you just listen for it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hauntings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: They'll be kept here by some fetter. Some unfinished business, or important artefact. The question is what that fetter is...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance's purpose - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you think about this whole binding a ghost idea?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance's purpose - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The real issue would be if you intended to keep a ghost bound, I would think...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance's purpose - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Holding it for just a moment in our mortal plane won't do it any harm.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Séance's purpose - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The real challenge will be getting it to cooperate.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Freemasons - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Freemasons - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hm. No, I don't believe I do. That might be an Irish thing... or an English one?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Second Sight - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard about Miss McLeod's Second Sight?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Second Sight - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It was mentioned to me, though I was hesitant to ask her about it. Happily, she brought it up herself.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Second Sight - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's not the first I've heard of such an ability, but I've never heard that name used for it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Second Sight - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's a tricky thing, foresight. Useful it may be, but some things are better left in the future.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ritual markings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, there's evidence of a ritual upstairs.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ritual markings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Is that so? What would that be for, I wonder?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ritual markings - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Perhaps someone's attempting to talk to one of the ghosts in this place...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Bedroom skeleton key - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...You should put that back where you found it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange occurences - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed anything strange while you've been staying here?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange occurences - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It would be the place for that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange occurences - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I keep finding ash on my clothes. I don't have the faintest idea where it's coming from.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange occurences - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Admittedly, I was afraid that...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange occurences - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, I've brought an urn with me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange occurences - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Thankfully, the lid is on tight.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Statement, Mister Doyle - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle said he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone on Tuesday night.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Statement, Mister Doyle - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He did? Did something happen to her? I'd been looking everywhere for her, but...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Statement, Mister Doyle - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...But I hope she's alright.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Mysterious figure in window - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I couldn't help but notice a figure in the window on my way back into the manor.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Mysterious figure in window - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: That's curious. A child of the house, or another ghost, perhaps?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Fae - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me anything about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Fae - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: You know, every culture has its name for the things that live on the edge of our understanding.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Fae - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The Japanese call them Yōkai, the Persians have Peri, the Russians call theirs Leshy - and so on.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Fae - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Each one is shaped by their climates and the reports influenced by the human cultures, but I think perhaps they are all the same thing.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Fae - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Whatever that ultimately is.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about The Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ah, yes. They were the old gods of Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The mythical race that came before humanity, some say.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The old Anvil - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The anvil outside must have been there for quite some time.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The old Anvil - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I was thinking that, myself.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The old Anvil - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I wonder what's so special about it that it's been left alone for so long?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dead End - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems that when Miss Deane left on Tuesday, she wandered into the garden... but there's no sign of her from there.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dead End - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: How can that be?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dead End - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I do hope she's safe, wherever she is.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hermetic Order - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hermetic Order - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I know they're a society interested in magic... but I'm afraid I don't know anything more specific than that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Bridge Game - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you attend Tuesday’s bridge game?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Bridge Game - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Almost. But the lovely Miss Mantovani offered me a reading. How could I refuse? So I skipped the game.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Entertainment Schedule - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you joined in any of the activities on offer?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Entertainment Schedule - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, believe me, Mister Ward, I’ve been tempted.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Entertainment Schedule - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But with such conversation to be had, and so little time, I’ve found not a second to spare.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Statement: Mister Dupre - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You said Miss Mantovani offered you a reading.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Statement: Mister Dupre - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Indeed, she did. For her astonishing showmanship, I am astounded that she hasn’t grown more of an ego.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/News Clippings - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/News Clippings - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, I never imagined…you’re quite prolific, aren’t you Mister Ward?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/News Clippings - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: If I’m under investigation, I do hope you’d have the decency to say it to my face.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Telegram Draft - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Someone hired me to investigate Miss Deane’s disappearance. I think it was the housekeeper.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Telegram Draft - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: You mean to tell me that in all this, that young woman has been missing?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Telegram Draft - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I hope you find her, Mister Ward. This hotel has enough ghosts as it is.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Talks schedule - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's quite the number of talks scheduled.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Talks schedule - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I do hope you'll find time to stop by for some of them - mine especially, of course. I'm rather proud of it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré, might you know much about exorcisms?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll try to find something that could work.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus D'Arcy believes she is being haunted by her late husband, and she seems to be... at her wits' end.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand you're well-versed in such matters - do you think you'd be able to help her?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: My... I had the impression there was something troubling her, but I didn't know it was... quite that serious.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I can help, of course, but I'll need an item of Mister D'Arcy's - something that would have been of considerable emotional value to him.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Let me know just as soon as you have it. It'd be better not to let this linger.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: What do you need?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Tell me... Are you asking theoretically or actually?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Actually.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...I do, for my sins. Actual banishment is hard. Death failed to remove the spirit; what can we do more than her?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But, when that is not an option, which is often the case with angry spirits, then we trap a soul and take that fetter to a faraway place.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The Gulf of Mexico is littered with ghosts. They are harmless to us, there.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Laying a soul to rest is the easier, and kinder, method of being rid of one.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Exorcism - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: What do you need?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have been having the strangest dreams of late.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Have you now? I'll confess to some strange patterns, yes.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Mine started with classic Celtic iconography around the hotel - standing stones, spirals - all that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But the more often I dream it, the more I'm seeing the same elements, but in my funeral parlour at home.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That sounds unnerving.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: At first, I found it quite comforting - the views of home are crystal clear and helped with my homesickness. But once I realised I could not reach home?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It was all in the manor walls, at first.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Then, yes. Unnerving. I could only ever find my way to the séance - or, what I took to represent that, at least. It's... given some apprehension about attending, I cannot lie.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Strange Dreams - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I've already been here the longest - at least from the guests. Any longer, and I fear this place will get its claws in me for good...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sigil - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this symbol?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sigil - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hmm...can't say that I do, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sigil - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It looks vaguely Celtic, but beyond that, I couldn't say.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/stylised ring - Dupre - he does not want it
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/stylised ring - Dupre - he does not want it
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Let me see... It looks much like that brooch Missus D'Arcy wears. Other than that, no, it means nothing to me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your feelings on this Grand Séance, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I must tell you, Mister Ward...I am no stranger to death. Assuredly no stranger to spirits.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But never before have I heard one speak. And as compelling as that may be, the chill in my bones endures.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You believe there's a risk?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
