en: Oh, I'm sure Miss Mantovani will take good care of us.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...But I am an undertaker, Mister Ward. I have welcomed the rageful dead - those unwanted, those "unclean" or too in between to find their gods.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/The Grand Séance - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And I fear we forget that people after death are simply themselves with nothing left to lose.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Urn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Someone mentioned to me that you had an urn with you when you arrived at the manor, Mister Dupré.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Urn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Indeed, I do, Mister Ward. It contains a being of true menace.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Urn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I speak, naturally, of my dearest friend. She'd wanted her ashes scattered in her home country, you see.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Urn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I must admit, however, that I'm taking my time. I still have hope that I might see her one last time before laying her to rest.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Urn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Really?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hedonistic Gala - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What did you make of last night's ball?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hedonistic Gala - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Why, it wasn't dissimilar to Mardi Gras back home. Less soulful, but when you are as homesick as I find myself to be, it was a welcome distraction.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hedonistic Gala - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Did you spot the quartet? Apparently, that four piece were killed here over one-hundred years ago by the Marquess of the time so nobody else would hear how finely they played.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Hedonistic Gala - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: They just placed some instruments and let those lost souls find them - quite macabre but also fascinating.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this remind you of anything, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Strange.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I cannot recall seeing it, and yet I feel a sense of...nostalgia? No, perhaps a darker shade of remembrance.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: My body knows it, even if my mind does not.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about fetters?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Chains, Mister Ward. Physically, yes - and spiritually.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: A ghost can no more escape its fetters than we can chains in a cell. Unless, of course, there's a key - ha!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Fetters are impermanent, then? Can they be undone?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, yes! Some spirits need simply release their sorrow. Many need help to do so.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But some ghosts are chained to worldly objects. In those cases, permanence is likely the intent.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're saying fetters can be made?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Fetters - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I've made them, Mister Ward. Though only ever as a last resort.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Possessed ring - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I do wonder if keeping this ring on my person is a terribly bright idea.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Possessed ring - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Worry not, Mister Ward. You have my assurance that Mister D'Arcy is firmly confined - poor devil.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Possessed ring - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Still. I wonder about the others.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Possessed ring - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: A place with this much history...surely there are spirits trapped within its walls? If one knows where to look.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Possessed ring - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I doubt many of them deserve it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Death Certificate - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Barbosa seems to have suffered a great loss indeed.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Death Certificate - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: So she tells me, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Death Certificate - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Grief is an old friend in my line of work, but it still does me no good to see her visit a warm-hearted soul like that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Father's Ghost - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Barbosa hopes to see her father at the séance. Do you know anything that could help her find him?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Father's Ghost - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hmm...This is a large séance, Mister Ward. Multiple people, countless desires overlapping like ripples.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Father's Ghost - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Now, Doctor Callaghan - he could help you! I've heard he can work wonders with spirit photography.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Father's Ghost - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I fear that seeking out one specific spirit may prove quite a feat.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Drawings of a Young Woman - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Were you close with Miss Deane, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Drawings of a Young Woman - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Drawings of a Young Woman - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: No. No, I dare say she looked right through me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Drawings of a Young Woman - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She looks uncannily like my dearly departed friend, you see. Each time I see her, it's like... Well, the grief feels fresh.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/well scrying - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard Miss Callaghan is a master in the art of well scrying.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/well scrying - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: So I have heard. In fact, I have made plans to visit her myself.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/well scrying - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: To be able to show a person their loved ones while separated - what a gift.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/well scrying - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She is indeed. I had some time with her and she was able to show me the people back home.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Deane's Room - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Deane's Room - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Miss D'Arcy mentioned overhearing a fight between Miss Deane and Miss Quinn outside her room, room 13. I cannot help beyond that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/stylised ring - Dupre - he wants it
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré? Would this work? For Missus D'Arcy's needs?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/stylised ring - Dupre - he wants it
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Come, let us first find Missus D'Arcy and then a secluded area to perform the rite.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/stylised ring - Dupre - he wants it
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Let me see... You know, I think it will.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Shadowy Figure - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of, well, ghosts that are larger than normal?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Shadowy Figure - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hmmm... I've heard of a great many things, and many cultures claim to have had giants walk their lands in times passed. But no, I've never seen or heard of it, at least nothing that makes me believe.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Shadowy Figure - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But other things? That is possible. Perhaps not a ghost, but an angelic visitation or other godly figure, maybe?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Shadowy Figure - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: This land's old gods, the Tuatha Dé Danann, would have been described as "larger than man", for example, and the mythology here references many giants in that vein.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Magical Grimoire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this book mean anything to you, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Magical Grimoire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It does not, Mister Ward, and for that I am glad.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Magical Grimoire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I would not trifle with the energy it holds - nor the magic those symbols have to offer.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I heard recently that Miss Deane descends from a powerful bloodline of Milesians.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Good for her. I've been told she is a talented practitioner.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'm not sure that her bloodline plays any part in that, but it sounds impressive.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...hopefully not so impressive that some lunatic comes looking for her blood.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Don't look at me like that, Mister Ward. People have done worse for the promise of less.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Coded Papers - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Coded Papers - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hm. The paper certainly seems to emanate some sort of energy.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Coded Papers - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I couldn't tell you what it's hiding, but hiding is what it seems to be doing.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Coded Papers - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: That sigil is keeping a secret from you, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Carmela's Health
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Mantovani seems unwell...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Carmela's Health
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Indeed, someone who works so regularly with such forces takes a risk.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Carmela's Health
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But it's not my place to say anything more.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Carmela's Health
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The way she speaks of it, and writes of it. It clearly takes a toll.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Carmela's Health
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: We have... made some arrangements, her and I, just in case. I'm hoping it won't come to that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brat Bhride
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know what a Brat Bhride is, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brat Bhride
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Indeed, I do. In simple terms, it is a powerful cloth, endowed with the blessing of Saint Brigid.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brat Bhride
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I've known those who make them to be among her most devoted and loving followers.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've found the third aspect.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Mister Ward, I could not be more grateful that Maman has delivered you to me this day. Who is it?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's... Caitlin Joyce. She gave me a brat bhride that should hopefully be a suitable demonstration of her devotion.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...The housekeeper? I was given to understand I frighten her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Truth be told, Mister Dupré, you probably do. But she's willing to learn, to repent for...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...past misgivings.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Then by all means, Mister Ward. Lead the way.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But I'm certain she'll be willing to help.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm grateful that Laura was seen off safely.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Third Aspect
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Not as grateful as I am for you and Missus Joyce, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Forgive me for prying, Mister Dupré, but... I heard tell that you'd lost someone close to you recently.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You needn't speak to me about it, of course. But I wanted to let you know that you could.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, she was originally from Ireland. I'm primarily here to scatter her ashes, in fact. She was a priestess of Bríd, and I a follower of Maman Brigitte.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: W-well, yes, I suppose I have lost her - at least to some degree. I don't like to say it out loud, but my best friend is...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, she's dead, Mister Ward. But I still have hope this séance will allow us to speak, just one last time.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Two adepts of close beliefs? I can imagine that was something truly special.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hah! You talk as if we were professionals - but my favourite thing about her is how phenomenally stupid she made me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: We met in a bicycle shop, you see. She convinced them to sell to us, and then insisted on racing me down the steepest hill I've ever seen.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: We both wound up with scrapes, and a bit less bicycle than we started with - but it made me feel like a child again. That's her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Dupre's Deceased Friend - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What was she like?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think spirit boards have any practical use, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh yes, Mister Ward. Rather too often, they're dismissed as toys. I've even brought one here myself.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there some communication you wish to make beyond the boundary?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...My dearest friend. I brought her ashes here to be scattered in her home country - but also that we might speak once more.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The spirit board will allow us a few words, at least. But this séance may actually allow us to speak, to-

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well. I've not found her, but no doubt she's near a place of fire - I've checked everywhere but I cannot find her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Sometimes I think I have lost her to this place and... other times I wonder if she is not speaking to me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Knowing her, she's floating in some ridiculous twist or turn, like it's a game of hide and seek. Playing through it all, lest she face it head-on...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But, when she sees what I have planned is for the best, too good an opportunity to...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ouija Board - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Forgive me, Mister Ward, I lost the run of myself there...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... communicated with a ghost in the hedge maze using a spirit board.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It said "Help me or I'll be trapped here forever".

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...How would one go about freeing a spirit from this manor, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Unfortunately, Mister Ward, I suspect it's rather too late for most of them.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: For spirits only recently bound to the manor, however, there may still be a chance.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I used the spirit board to speak with your friend's ghost.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She said "Help me or I'll be trapped here forever".

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Trapped here? But I thought she wanted to be freed in Ireland. I don't understand, Mister Ward, can you give me more context?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Unfortunately, Mister Ward, I suspect it's rather too late for any spirit here...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Unless they were only recently bound to the manor - in which case there may still be a chance for them.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...What do you know about transferring souls, Mister Dupré? Specifically into living bodies.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Wh...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...I know it to be an unforgivable act. The erasure of one life to prolong another beyond its natural years.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghostly Desire - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: P-please may we dwell on it no further?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Maman Brigitte
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I take it you're close with Maman Brigitte, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Maman Brigitte
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Deeply, Mister Ward. When grief is a constant companion, she is there to remind me that both the living and the dead need healers. I am devoted to her and her teachings.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across a ghost who seems like she has something to say to me, Mister Dupré.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how I might go about communicating with her?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She must have a powerful soul if she can appear before you so, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: For a spirit strong enough to take visible form, even a spirit board would be enough.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across a ghost, Mister Dupré. One, I suspect you have ties to...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I don't think I follow, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...could it be? ...Laura? Come, you must show me right away.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: At the firepit.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How are you faring, Mister Dupré? What with Laura...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She'd never encourage my wallowing, Mister Ward. I'm as well as she'd like me to be.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Perhaps I'll say that again, sometime, and believe it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I came across a ghost, Mister Dupré. One, I suspect you have ties to...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...I don't think I follow, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: You... N-no. No, you must be mistaken.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Ward
en: At the firepit.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Ghost at Firepit
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Please, Mister Ward, may we speak of something else?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Plenty, Mister Ward! Though I have an especially busy day tomorrow - so I think I'll take today a little easier.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Quite a lot, it would seem!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Any plans for this weekend, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are you up to today, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And then we reach the big moment - the Grand Séance! I assume I will see you there?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'll spend some time wandering the gardens. I've felt a strange calling to the outdoors since coming here, and I can't help but feel I must answer.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: If I'm not there, I'll likely be in the drawing room, attending talks or discussing them with other guests.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Before then, a walk in the hedge maze before attending Miss Callaghan's talk at three, I think.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Then tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I also have a scrying session with Miss Callaghan at eleven - and I'm attending her nephew's talk at three.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'll certainly join the silent dinner at eight. There's... Well, I'm hoping a certain spirit might attend.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There's lunch in the dining room at one, and I think I'll take a late nap at five. I suspect it will be a long evening!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I don't want to wear myself out before the ball, so I won't do much more than that, today.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, first of all - how could resist a talk from our resident mystic, Miss Mantovani? I will be in attendance at 5pm.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/timetable - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And then we reach the big moment - the Grand Séance! I will admit, I am happier attending under Laura's watchful eye.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Goibniu - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about the god Goibniu?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Goibniu - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He's a smithing god, yes? I don't recall much about him - perhaps one of the Callaghans or Mister Ó Finn can be of more help?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard of the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The old gods of Ireland. Not defeated by mankind but tricked by them.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: If you are keen, I believe the library stocks a few books on the matter.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Tuatha Dé Danann - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I always wondered if they lurk about plotting their revenge.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know of the goddess, Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I do. A friend of mine was a priestess of hers. Bríd was not one of the sovereignty goddesses, but in some ways, she should have been.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: When the Catholic church came here, she alone was deemed too powerful to be swept under the rug. And so they canonised her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Saint Brigid of Kildare, she became. A lot of the same domains - husbandry, midwifery, healing. You may have noticed her crosses hung along the walls of the manor?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: My own Loa, Maman Brigitte, is said to be the part of the old goddess that fled the church and was changed in that journey.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Brid - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's interesting, isn't it? Three versions of the one goddess, all distinct yet so similar, all back together under this roof. So to speak.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/morrigan - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you learned much about the Morrigan?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/morrigan - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: A triple sister goddess associated with war and fate.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/morrigan - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Some say she is the bean-nighe, the washer woman who appears before a tragedy to wash the clothes of the soon to be dead.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/morrigan - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's funny you mention her, one of her triad is named Babd, which is also the Gaelic word for crow.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/morrigan - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Which I find funny given how many of the damned birds are here at the moment. It's a murder, many times over.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Cailleach - dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about the Cailleach?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Cailleach - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: No, not a lot. I know that she predates the Tuatha Dé Danann, but nothing more than that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Cailleach - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's scary, isn't it, Mister Ward, to think that there are things out there older than gods?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/tir na nog - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard of Tír na nÓg?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/tir na nog - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have. The old Irish Otherworld serves as home to the gods, realm of the fae, and, sometimes, an afterlife for mortal folk.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/tir na nog - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It is both geographical and a-geographical in that it is said to be under Ireland but also an island off to the southwest.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/tir na nog - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Many stories exist of heroes sailing there on Immrams - voyages that transcend the physical rules of the sea.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Someone's been putting Saint Brigid's crosses around the manor, haven't they?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: So I have seen, but I am not sure who.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I tried to ask the housekeeper, but she gave me the filthiest glare and rushed off.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I suspect that she'd rather die than have anything to do with magic, ritual, or myself...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ah, yes. That would be the housekeeper, Missus Joyce.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Saint Brigid's Cross - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I tried to compliment her on them, but she gave me the filthiest glare and rushed off.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Milesians - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard of the Milesians?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Milesians - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The Irish. Or, what your ancestors were called. They were said to come from the Iberian Peninsula.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Milesians - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Itself populated thousands of years before when Homo sapiens left Africa.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Milesians - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: See, Mister Ward? We are practically cousins.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/soul jars - dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about soul jars, Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/soul jars - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well simply put, Mister Ward, they are as they sound.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/soul jars - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: They're jars for storing souls - and not something I'd see used beyond the most extreme of circumstances.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/gauge - dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré, have you seen that odd machine in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/gauge - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Of course! It's a most wondrous thing. I don't have the faintest idea what it is, but it's very impressive.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/washer woman - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Not I, but I believe there is a creature here, a variant on the more well-known Beansidhe.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/washer woman - dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I witnessed a person washing clothes in the fountain when I arrived, and I am wondering if you experienced anything like this?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/washer woman - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Instead of keening or singing to forewarn of death, this other creature washes the clothes of the doomed soul.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/washer woman - dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I think she is called the bean nigh, or washer woman. I suspect there are entries on her in the library.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me more about this ritual, Mister Dupre?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: My goddess has three aspects - Maman Brigitte, the goddess Bríd, and the Saint Brigid.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Mister Ward, you represent Bríd. I believe Laura chose you to play that part when she presented herself to you.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I would represent Maman Brigitte, naturally.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: To help Laura pass we need to bring them together, allowing me to combine their powers and release her from this place.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And so we need one to represent the final aspect - Saint Brigid...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Evidence Presents - Dupré/Missing Aspect Ritual
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But who? Can you think of anyone who would be willing to help me with this?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ivy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ivy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have. She's a charming woman - reminds me of an old friend of mine.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ivy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Miss McLeod, I think, steps a little more carefully - but they have... had, I mean, a similar upbeat attitude.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ivy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's been a pleasure to make her acquaintance.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Varley - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much to the manager?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Varley - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I wouldn't say much, but enough that I can say he seems like a decent fellow.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Lan Fen - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Lan Fen - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: A little. Though, she seems to keep company more with the scientific types. I spoke more to her friend, Miss McLeod.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Lan Fen - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Not that I mind - a lady is entitled to her choice of company, after all. Miss McLeod speaks very highly of her, too.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Skerritt - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Skerritt - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: To him? No.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Skerritt - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: To men like him? Every day, back home.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Skerritt - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Some people are so full of self-loathing they can't keep it to themselves. It spills out and hits everyone around them.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Corentine - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Corentine - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have, but at least initially, I felt it best to leave her to her own devices. There is... There is an air of death that follows her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Corentine - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: As far as I can tell, she knows it. Indeed, I think that is why she is so preoccupied.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Corentine - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Happily, though, it seems she has made time to talk with me, and I'm glad - I do enjoy her company.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I certainly tried, my friend! I'm not sure I've ever seen someone scurry away from me so fast.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I get the sense that the presence of all these practitioners, myself included, leaves her quite shaken.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Darragh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the groundskeeper?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Darragh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He even gave me some recommendations as to where I could go if I wanted to do some walking.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Darragh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The nearby town is too far, of course, but there are local forests, a brook, that sort of thing. He mentioned one fairy fort I will not be going near.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Darragh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I haven't braved the rest, though. Not in this weather.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Darragh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have! He helped me find some good places inside and out of the grounds.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Seamus - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the porter, Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Seamus - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Of course. He runs the bar in the evenings, and I've enjoyed the odd drink there.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Seamus - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He's not much company and seems uncomfortable taking tips, but he seems harmless enough.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ines - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ines - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ah, that I have. She's an interesting woman. She said she's got some business in the country, apparently.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ines - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Though, you'd have to ask her for the details. We ended up talking more about Ireland than our own affairs.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ettiene - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Toussaint?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ettiene - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I heard about him first - after that, meeting him was a little underwhelming.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ettiene - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He was actually very pleasant when he spoke to me. So, either the rumours are exaggerated, or I got his better side.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ettiene - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Between you and me, I think it might be the former. I certainly hope so. But my, he's ruffled some feathers.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Cathal - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Cathal - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have. I've heard it mentioned that his particular niche is speaking to angels.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Cathal - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I don't know about that, exactly... but, you know, somehow I get the feeling he's onto something, whatever it is.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Dupré - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Mister Dupré.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Dupré - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Let's see. I run a funeral home back home in New Orleans, but I have come to Ireland to handle a personal matter.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Dupré - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have an interest in your mythology and, well, Voodoo. It's not uncommon, back home but I know it scares outsiders.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Dupré - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: So an event that mixes both? How could I not attend.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Dupré - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I wasn't expecting to end up at a thing like this while here, but when I learned of the event, it seemed like something I couldn't miss out on.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on D'Arcy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on D'Arcy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have indeed. She's a wonderfully sharp and dry woman.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on D'Arcy - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Talking to her is a sparring match and I enjoy that immensely.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Coventry - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken much to Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Coventry - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He approached me with a question or two about the séance. I answered them as best I could.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Coventry - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But they were... quite elementary, anyway. I wonder if he has any idea he's getting himself into.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Hazel - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Hazel - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have indeed! She wanted to know what sort of... interest I had in all these supernatural affairs.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Hazel - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And she had all sorts of questions once I told her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Hazel - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She's from New York, she tells me, and they prefer their séances, so we exchanged some notes, so to speak.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ruairí - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak to Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ruairí - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have. He's quite agreeable, and I've certainly met my match in him as to the scholarship side of things.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ruairí - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Though my knowledge is purely academic, whereas his is lived and learned the hard way.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ruairí - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The poor boy deserves a great deal more confidence in himself.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Ruairí - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Though with all the comparisons to his aunt, I'm not surprised that his pride has taken some hits.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I believe I have met everyone here.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I don't know her particularly well - everyone here is new to me - but I gather she is a powerful practitioner.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Deane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And a woman with... complicated connections to many here. I suppose that is to be expected when one is at the top of one's game.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Carmela - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Carmela - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I made a point to, yes. Her work has brought her to America - I have not seen her, but I knew her name.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Carmela - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There is a lot of similarities in what we do - we each provide guidance to those faced with death - so the conversation was easy.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Carmela - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'm interested to see her work here this weekend.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Carmela - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I only hope her health holds for it all...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...I found her outside my room holding a friend's urn I have with me.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She was... almost feverish... She thought it was some vase.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I had to wrestle it from her before she opened it and spilt the ashes all over the corridor.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She settled once I had it but had no idea where she was or why.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Or how she got the thing from my otherwise locked room.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Arwa - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Sometimes I worry this place is going to drive us all insane...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Sinnott - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Sinnott - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I have. Many times in many places. Though his face is never the same, his need to control and judge his fellow man is.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Sinnott - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Some people are simply disposed to judge. And some of them call it holy.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Saoirse - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Saoirse - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, yes. She seems like a sweet girl. Shy, perhaps...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Saoirse - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Though if I'm used to two things, Mister Ward, it's grief and distrust.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Saoirse - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: That wall of hers smells more of the former than the latter.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met with the owner of the manor?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Marquess Blake? Indeed, I have. He was perfectly cordial.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: But even so... in my line of work, you get a sense for grief. And that man has it in spades.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Walter Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear the Marquess has a son.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Walter Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: So I gather. He was in a carriage accident, I think?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Walter Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I don't mean to sound insensitive, but I get a shiver down my spine anytime I realise he's watching me from his room.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Walter Blake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's not just the weather that keeps me from the gardens...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Fiadh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you feel about Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Fiadh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: A lovely woman! Certainly, it's people like her who make this event feel so worthwhile.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on Fiadh - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Rather unfortunate, since I understand she's quite against the whole thing.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on O'Finn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on O'Finn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: So rarely do you meet people whose charms are matched by their honesty.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/Opinion on O'Finn - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I could spend hours in his company, though I'd be lying if I said I understood every word he said.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/UPDATED Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How have things been with Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/UPDATED Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Good, I believe! Before, I sensed only a dam of fear from her - and now it's as if it's burst.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/UPDATED Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There was a wellspring of curiosity behind it all, I think. I can barely keep up with her questions! Not that I mind.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/UPDATED Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'm grateful, in fact. It is a tumultuous time for both of us - me without Laura, her with the new uncertainty of her beliefs.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Character Presents - Dupré/UPDATED Opinion on Caitlin - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: In times like these, there's no better thing than a friend.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of oats and sugar - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I catch the scent of what I think might be sugar from the groundsman.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of oats and sugar - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: If it weren't for the clothes, I might mistake him for a baker.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Proud bearing - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss McLeod has quite a regal pose about her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Proud bearing - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She reminds me of someone in that... an old friend. Not a gentlewoman, but she held herself the same way.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mourning cameo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed the necklace Missus Lau is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mourning cameo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I understand it's a mourning tradition over here, is it not?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mourning cameo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She must have lost someone...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Pen in pocket - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I haven't yet seen Miss Quinn without that pen she keeps with her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Pen in pocket - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, you know how artistic types can be!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Pen in pocket - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: While they do have their way about them, I'm really only joking. She seems like a lovely woman. Completely without airs.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mysterious crest - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know what the crest Mister Skerritt is wearing is?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mysterious crest - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I can't say I do, although I think I might have seen it somewhere before...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Mysterious crest - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Or perhaps not?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of whiskey - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you catch the scent of whiskey around Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of whiskey - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Well, I wouldn't like to comment on it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of whiskey - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...But I don't believe you're imagining it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ornamental cane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice Mister Skerritt's cane is ornamental.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ornamental cane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I never have liked that fashion.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ornamental cane - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I cannot trust a man who carries a cane he doesn't need for walking.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Open, eager pose - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The housekeeper seems friendly.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Open, eager pose - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She does, as a matter of fact. She seems like a lovely woman.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Irish keepsake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Miss Barbosa's brooch?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Irish keepsake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It looks like something she's had for a long time, I think. Perhaps even something someone else had before her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Irish keepsake - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And for her to keep it all this time... it must mean something special to her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Dreamy look in his eyes - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Mister O'Meara seem distracted to you?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Dreamy look in his eyes - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The young man's got something on his mind, there's no doubt about that.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Dreamy look in his eyes - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The question is whether it's to do with this séance, or Miss McLeod.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Dressed well, not expensively - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of how Mister O'Meara is dressed?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Dressed well, not expensively - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: What do I make of it? Why, I'd say he's very well turned out.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Dressed well, not expensively - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: He might not have a lot of money, but he's got a good eye.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Unusual Celtic Cross - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to recognise the cross Mister Doyle is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Unusual Celtic Cross - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'm sure I've seen its type before... but where, or what it meant, I can't remember.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Fine clothes and jewellery - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You know, Mister Dupré, I can't help but admire your clothing. It's quite fine.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Fine clothes and jewellery - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Haha, why, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Fine clothes and jewellery - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I run a funeral house back home. It is not glamorous work, but it's more than worthwhile...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Fine clothes and jewellery - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: And I'm lucky enough to do quite well for myself these days.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Friendly expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I must say, of all the guests here, you're easily one of the most approachable.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Friendly expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ah, well, there'd be little point in attending this if I weren't going to socialise.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Friendly expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There are such interesting people here, after all.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That's an unusual tattoo; might I ask about it?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, this? It's Maman Brigitte's Veve - her mark.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Consider it... a devotional symbol. I'm an oungan of hers... a priest as such.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She's our Loa of life and death - I suppose, your analogy to a Loa would be 'Saint'.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I guess the journey changed her, for want of a better way to explain it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Curious tattoo - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She is... born of your pagan goddess Brigid. Her believers... 'took' her with them when they fled to America.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Tan line - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems as if Missus D'Arcy has recently removed a ring...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Tan line - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It does - but it would be improper of me to ask about it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Large Brooch - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise the brooch Missus D'Arcy is wearing?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Large Brooch - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's the crest of some society, isn't it? I haven't asked, and she herself hasn't offered the information, so I don't know for sure.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ink stains - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know if Missus D'Arcy has been writing much recently?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ink stains - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Haha, I would expect all that ink to be a permanent fixture.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Ink stains - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: She tells me she's a writer, after all.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of antiseptic - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you catch the scent of antiseptic from Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Scent of antiseptic - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Ah, I do. I know it's a little strange, but I like it - it reminds me of my place back home.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Celtic cross - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed Doctor Callaghan's tie pin?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Celtic cross - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: It's a cross, isn't it? You see a number of them, I'm not sure I took particular note of it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Thoughtful expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Coventry seems to have something on his mind.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Thoughtful expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I got that impression. I suppose it will have something to do with the séance.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Thoughtful expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: We're, potentially, about to be faced with answers to some very grand questions.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Thoughtful expression - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: To be distracted is quite understandable.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Musty scent - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Coventry's cologne is... strong.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Musty scent - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Yes, I find it is best used to... subtler effect.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Tense body language - Dupré
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Missus Erickson seem tense to you?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Analysis Presents - (to) Dupré/Tense body language - Dupré
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Yes. Though a house full of ghosts is not a very relaxing environment to most people, so I can't blame her.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Ward in room - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: What's this? I don't recall inviting you here, Mister Ward...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Ward in room - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I think you can tell me why you have a key to my room on our way to see the manager...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Ward in room - Dupre
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: What's this? I don't recall inviting you here, Sir...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hello there, friend. I don't believe we've met?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Hello again, my friend.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: We've not. My name is Declan Ward.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Lloyd Dupré. I presume you've just arrived, correct? I've been here two weeks now, and I think I've met every other guest a few times over!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Correct. New Orleans, to be exact, where I am a funeral director. And let me tell you, I am in no rush to make the journey again. It took all of eleven weeks with the storms.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Incredible. This séance must truly be a special affair for you to travel so far.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Yes and no. As interested in the séance as I am, it would have been hard to justify the journey for it alone.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've taken enough of your time.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Not at all, Mister Ward – but I won't keep you.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Indeed, I have. And, if I'm not mishearing your voice, I take it you're here all the way from America?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: No, I have some personal business to attend to here - joyous as it's been to fascinate myself with your mythology and your spirits.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Are you telling me that this blighted place has taken my dearest friend captive!?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She's not lost yet, Mister Dupré. Not... entirely.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, sweet... Damnation. This is my fault. All of it.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She communicated a message to me. "Help me or I'll be trapped here forever."

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I was foolish - selfish - enough to want one last adventure together. I should have laid her to rest before coming to this place.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is still time, Mister Dupré. At least, that is what I think she's trying to tell us.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...You are right, of course. I'll have years without her for my self-pity.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There is a ritual. I do not know if it will work, far as we are from Maman's reach, but we must try.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'm sorry, Laura. I hope you'll forgive an old friend his folly...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Are... Are you telling me that you found her?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It might be, Mister Dupré. I suspect the spirit of your friend is haunting the fire pit in the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Of course. Of course, it was her in the hedge maze. I knew I felt her presence there. But why couldn't I see her, reach out to her. How did I lose her?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Is that why I couldn't see her in the hedge maze? She is lost to me...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Laura, yes? I believe I met her spirit at the fire pit.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I was foolish - selfish - enough to want one last adventure together. I should have laid her to rest before coming to this place.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: There is a ritual. I do not know if it will work, far as we are from Maman's reach, but we must try.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I'm sorry, Laura. I hope you'll forgive an old friend his folly...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Oh, sweet... Damnation. Maman, how could I keep the company of such dark thoughts?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I didn't do it - I could never! It goes against everything that I- that we...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Then take heart, Mister Dupré. You haven't acted yet. But I must ask you as a matter of urgency - are these thoughts your own?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I- I don't know. I've felt a heaviness here these past few days. Something in this place that feeds on grief... drives obsession.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: The moment you spoke, it felt as if you'd broken a spell... But I'm worried - terrified, that it could return just as suddenly.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Then we must act quickly. Have you any idea how we might break this hold on you?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: I... Oh, Mister Ward! I must lay my friend to rest! I should never have delayed it to begin with...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: You... you saw her? I thought I felt something there. And yet - she's been taken from my sight... Ha.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is still time, Mister Dupré.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: ...Yes, you are right. Of course, there is!

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Dupré conversation
speaker: Mister Dupré
en: Though I didn't expect to find myself here for quite so many days...

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Post Quest - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I would give anything to speak to Eamonn again, to apologise…

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Post Quest - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: But to summon his spirit in flames?

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Post Quest - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can see the comfort it brought to Mister Dupré.

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Post Quest - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It would be so easy to see you again, but I don’t think I have it in me to call you here this way…

conversation: Cast/Lloyd Dupré/Post Quest - Dupre
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I’ve dragged you through fire before. Never again.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Could I trouble you for a moment more?

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Hello, Mister Ward. How's the day treating you?

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: You can. Is there something I can do for you?

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll leave you be.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Farewell.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: If you'd hold a moment… I'm just looking for something...

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: You figured that out, did you? Why I'm nose-deep in all these godforsaken books?

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: You're right, of course. I will - well, you have a look about you that says I don't have to plead the veracity of my case. Is that right...? Thank God.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: That's what all my work is about. I'm trying to lift the curse before it kills the last of us - but, just our luck, I've reached a dead end.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: After everything, all this work, all this death, it couldn't just be simple. God forbid! God forbid I actually manage it.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: I have it, you know, the name of the woman who cursed my family - 'Biddy' Eve O'Connor. And if I could only speak to her, I might be able to appease her.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: But there are too many spirits with her name. And without some item from her, I just cannot reach her. And I can't see what else I could do about it.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: I will keep trying, of course. But I think my fate is sealed. Mine, and my little sisters'. We'll all die like the rest of my family because of the cruelty of my ancestors.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Bastards, all of them.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: ... And that's that. What else is there to say about it? I just - I don't want to talk about this any longer.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Without it, I - without it, damn it, I'm at a dead end.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Fine, fine - just looking for a book. I know I had it just a few days ago, but now it's nowhere to be found.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you alright, Miss?

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Would you tell me if you see it? It's a book on local land records from late last century. It has to be around here somewhere - unless... another guest has taken it? Hmmm...

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll see what I can do.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ GIVE THE RECORDS BOOK ]

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP THE RECORDS BOOK ]

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Fine, fine - just looking for a book. I thought maybe I left it here when I last had it.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: But - look, take this. If you find anything to do with it all, tell me, would you? God knows there's nothing else for it.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: With the ritual complete, am I to understand that the Quinn family is free of their curse?

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: I've instructed my solicitor to transfer all the deeds to Miss Barbosa. If 'Biddy' O'Connor keeps her word... yes, I think it's done.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Finally. Finally.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: If I might ask... will you and your family be alright? Losing that much land and the money from it must mean you're losing most of your assets.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
en: Oh, almost everything - we will be significantly poorer, there's no doubt about that. It will not be easy.

conversation: Cast/Corentine Quinn/Corentine conversation
speaker: Miss Quinn
