conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/News clippings - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Missus Joyce has quite an interest in the social affairs going on in Dublin.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/News clippings - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: There, and everywhere else. I don't need to see that, I don't care what sort of rag she's reading.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Telegram draft - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a telegram Missus Joyce was writing...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Telegram draft - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Doesn't anybody mind their own business around here? Good God.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Staff innocent - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce hired me to find Miss Deane, and she said that you would be willing to help me with it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Staff innocent - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...With Miss Deane? Really?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Staff innocent - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I mean, alright. I can tell you what I know.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Guest requests - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard the guests have made a number of requests.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Guest requests - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Nothing unreasonable so far... Hopefully it'll stay that way.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Locked bedrooms - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are the unused bedrooms kept locked?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Locked bedrooms - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Yes. Mostly so people can't wander in and mess them up, I think.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Written complaint - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like Missus Joyce has earned herself some ire from a guest.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Written complaint - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Someone finally said something about it? Might teach her. Nothing good'll come of how she carries on...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Written complaint - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...who wrote it? Was it Miss Deane? I think she caught Missus Joyce riffling around her room last week...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Talks schedule - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these talks they're putting on?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Talks schedule - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'm not going to go out of my way to look in on any of it, put it that way.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/resolution - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Everywhere, I hope.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/resolution - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Where will you go?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/resolution - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I was looking at France. We had a French couple come here once. They were really... different. Didn't care what anyone else thought.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/resolution - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: But this week? I've met - well, in the loosest sense of it - people from so much further.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/resolution - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Maybe I'll go to all their countries...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/resolution - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ha, imagine they bumped into me! I wonder if they'd even know who I was...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle... what was the nature of your relationship with Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...Why do I get the feeling I should answer you straight on this?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: We, eh, we knocked boots a few times.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Started with her getting me to steal some wine from the bar and bring her to restricted areas.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: It ended about when her ex, Cathal, showed up. I guess she was embarrassed to be seen slumming it with the bellboy.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: She's been avoiding me since. No big deal, stuff like this happens all the time.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hankerchief - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...Maybe don't say that to Mister Varley.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Grimoire - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't have any use for this.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Grimoire - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Grimoire - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP GRIMOIRE ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Grimoire - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sweet treats - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: You can keep those. I think you'll probably like 'em more than I do.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sweet treats - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sweet treats - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP SWEET TREATS ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sweet treats - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Artefacts - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: You keep that. I don't think I know what it is, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Artefacts - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Artefacts - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP ARTEFACT ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Artefacts - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Cigars - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh, well - thanks.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Cigars - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Cigars - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP CIGAR ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Cigars - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Laudanum - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Thanks, Sir. Always good to have something like this around here.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Laudanum - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ OFFER LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Laudanum - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP LAUDANUM ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Laudanum - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll hold onto this for now.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Fiadh at stables - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Callaghan was out at the stables while the ball was being held.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Fiadh at stables - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don’t know why you’d miss a party to go and stand in the cold with the horses.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Fiadh at stables - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Maybe it’s the company here.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Telegram machine - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems the telegraph machine wire has been broken or disconnected somehow.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Telegram machine - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: That is- That…

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Telegram machine - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Maybe I should see about that…

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Horses sick - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The horses have taken ill.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Horses sick - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Suppose they’ve caught a cold and spread it between themselves. ...Can horses get colds?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Front gates barred - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I tried the front gates earlier. They won’t open, it’s like they’re barred.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Front gates barred - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Can’t see… I don’t know why someone would do that. They’re probably just stuck.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arrival conflict - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: According to Miss Hisham's sighting of him, Father Sinnott was at the manor long before he signed in.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arrival conflict - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/The Ghost of Edward Blake - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I could have sworn I saw an apparition of Edward Blake.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/The Ghost of Edward Blake - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: So he's stuck here too, with the rest of us? Hah.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Catacombs - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of the catacombs under the manor?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Catacombs - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah, I've heard they exist, but I've never been able to find them.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Catacombs - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Wait... How do you know about those?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Catacombs - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Huh... for a moment there, a real want to know crept up in me, but it's gone again. Odd.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Catacombs - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Wait... How did I know about them?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Missing Door - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Is this about that Blake that walled up those two lovers?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Missing Door - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'd say he did it. I saw his painting there in the tower, and he looks the sort.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Missing Door - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This sounds ridiculous, but I could swear there's a door missing in-

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Missing Door - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The door to Room 15, it's... missing? Has it been walled up?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Missing Door - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Walled up? What? Oh, like that old Blake who walled up that couple?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Missing Door - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Room 15 shouldn't be closed off though. I guess I'll go talk to... the manager? Mister Hunter? I dunno, first time dealing with a wandering door...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Strange dream - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The night I got here, I had the strangest dream, like I was trapped in a long hallway somewhere in the manor.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Strange dream - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Things like that... happen here. I don't wanna talk about it. My suggestion is a stiff drink before bed. Or two.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sigil - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm trying to identify a sigil... It looks like a spiral, with four lines intersecting it. Does that sound familiar to you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sigil - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Yeah, all too familiar... Eh, what I mean to say is that this place - lots of old stuff lying around with carvings on 'em.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sigil - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Maybe it's something like that you're after...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Séance Purpose - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of the goal of this séance?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Séance Purpose - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: It's not really my business, is it?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Séance Purpose - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's quite the undertaking, you must have some opinion.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Séance Purpose - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I suppose, Sir, if there's a spirit out there that'll answer every question they might have for it, it might be worth hearing.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Séance Purpose - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't know about this tying it down idea, though. Seems about the worst thing you could do, doesn't it?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter from Mister Doyle - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather you and Father Sinnott have a correspondence?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter from Mister Doyle - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Did he tell you that? He's tried telling me the same thing but...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter from Mister Doyle - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I dunno. Like it rings a bell, and also means nothing to me. Like waking up and not being able to hold onto a dream but having a feeling of it instead.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wouldn't have expected the manor to put on a party such as that ball.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: They act so high and mighty, these people... but there's not much difference between them and us.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: They just like to pretend there is, that's all.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...Was it good?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ YES ]

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It was a new experience, if nothing else.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It... wasn't my kind of gathering...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ahh, lucky sod. Whatever was added to the wine seemed to kick things off for ye, at least.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Hedonistic Gala - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Shame, looked fun from out here.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter to the Manager - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've... heard Mister Varley mentioning a letter he received from the local bishop. What would they be writing to one another about?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter to the Manager - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I know he wasn't happy when he got it, and he told me not to tell the women.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter to the Manager - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not that I would. I stay out of all that, it's got nothing to do with me - and I prefer it that way.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Letter to the Manager - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Last porter got too involved with these people. Lost him the job. I'll not be doing the same.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinnott's Letters - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you used to know Father Sinnott? Beyond this event, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinnott's Letters - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: So, maybe I do? But it hurts to think on it too hard.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinnott's Letters - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: So, I don't. I do what I can not to. Harder to drown it out with him here, trying to talk to me.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinnott's Letters - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: But you can drown anything with enough water.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinnott's Letters - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Did he tell you that? He's tried telling me the same thing but...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinnott's Letters - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I dunno. It feels... familiar, but also means nothing to me. Like waking up and not being able to hold onto a dream - but still having the feeling of it, you know?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been seeing this symbol around - I copied it down here. Does it mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Why are you asking me? You've got all these magician types, why would I know something like that?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I-

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sketches of Strange Symbol - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Forget about it. What else?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Mary Blake- Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about Mary Blake?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Mary Blake- Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Mary-? Oh, you mean Missus Marquess? Not much, I never knew her. They hired me long after she died.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/crib - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's a crib in the laundry room. Do you know why it's there?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/crib - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah, I don't really care. Miss Murphy refused to have it stored, I think. Not ready to give it up, I guess. It's not like anyone but her really works down there, so no one argued with her.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/crib - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: The laundry room? Got lost, did you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/crib - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Em...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hotel finances - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I understand the hotel isn't doing well, financially.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hotel finances - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Doesn't surprise me. This whole event is insane. There's no way he's breaking even. The Marquess, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hotel finances - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Poor Varley looks like he's gonna have an aneurysm. As long as I'm getting paid, I don't really care.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/parcel of money - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a parcel of what seems to be Miss Deane's money... among Missus Joyce's belongings.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/parcel of money - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Well that's - huh.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/parcel of money - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Well, it's not like she'd have enough to pay you otherwise.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/parcel of money - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Can't imagine Miss Deane will mind too much, if it gets her found.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/parcel of money - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: That's... strange, actually. Missus Joyce is the nosiest woman I've ever met, but she's not a thief.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Deane's Room - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Deane's Room - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...Why are you asking me that?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Deane's Room - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Sorry Sir, only I've been trying to remember that for a few days now. I have something for her, but...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Deane's Room - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...what were we talking about?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hive mind - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Nah. Some of them are a bit close. To one another, I mean. I'm the newest here. Sort of an outsider.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hive mind - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I mean, you work with people and you end up finishing one another's sentences, having the same thoughts - nightmares. That's normal... right?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/hive mind - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you and the rest of the staff... particularly close?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/travel plans - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Me? No. You’d struggle to find a map small enough to show all the places I’ve been.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/travel plans - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: But some day... I want to... I just, I find it hard to leave this place. Even trips into town set something off in me. I can't explain it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/travel plans - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever travelled?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/lock box - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's no way to ask him about this that isn't a confession to my breaking into his room...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic symbol sequence - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: No, what do they... Actually, I do recognise the... Huhh!

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic symbol sequence - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Please! Put that away, it's... messing with my stomach...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic symbol sequence - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Somebody dropped this note, do you recognise the symbols so I can return it?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/black iron prison - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: A black... Ugh, I don't like the feeling that has... in my head...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/black iron prison - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know any thing about a Black Iron Prison?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/black iron prison - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I can see the bars! They slam down around us as the hour draws near. RUN DECLAN, RUN!

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/black iron prison - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ugh, I don't like the feeling that has... in my head...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/aeon - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you ever heard of an Aeon?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/aeon - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: That's like an angel, right? Is that right? How do I know that? I don't think I've ever heard that term before...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/aeon - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I can't find it Father - this place, it's... protecting...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/aeon - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ugh!

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/any gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about Gnosticism?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/any gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Gnosticism... I know... I know that...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/any gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: It's... No, I've lost it. I had something, but it is gone...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/unusual cross - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Does it? I've not really looked. Probably standard enough cross, right?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/unusual cross - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed Father Sinnott's cross? It looks a lot like your own...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/unusual cross - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh... Funny that. I'll take a look later, maybe...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/unusual cross - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's not one I've seen before. Seems quite a distinct style.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/men's dorm - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I guess? We've a dorm in the basement - men's and women's. Bigger than we need now, but I'm told this place had more workers back in the day.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/men's dorm - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Might I ask where the staff sleep?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Doyle's out - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Father Sinnott intends to continue on with your mission.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Doyle's out - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not our mission, his mission.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Doyle's out - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I won't change my mind on this, so let him know. Or don't, it's no longer my concern.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/burnt symbols - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There's no way to ask him about this that isn't a confession to my breaking into his room...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Shadowy Figure - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wanted to ask if you've ever seen anything here larger than a ghost? A shadowy figure.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Shadowy Figure - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Sir, I... Sorry, if you need help with something tangible, then I'm your man. This stuff? I... No...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/12 Luggage Ticket - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are there tickets for the luggage room, Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/12 Luggage Ticket - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah, yes. The guests are always losing those, Sir. You needn't worry if you come across one.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/12 Luggage Ticket - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Mister Hunter spent half a day nailing up those numbers in the luggage room.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/12 Luggage Ticket - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: 'Course it's not worth it if people keep losing their tickets...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Mysterious Object - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It looks like there's something crammed inside the luggage room vent.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Mysterious Object - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...What? Look, I don't know what you've heard, Sir, but it's not me this time.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Mysterious Object - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Mister Hunter will sort you out. I'd do it myself, but...Well, I'm not allowed near the tools anymore.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Miss Deane's Invitation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane was specially invited to the manor, wasn't she?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Miss Deane's Invitation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah, I wouldn't know about that, Sir. They keep me out of decision making. I dunno what they think they're hiding.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Miss Deane's Invitation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'm glad she was, though.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Treasure Map - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this little riddle mean anything to you, Mister Doyle?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Treasure Map - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Hmm...Well, it does seem to be saying you should spend more time outdoors?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Treasure Map - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I dunno. Might be better to ask one of the other staff.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's drawing of vase - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Huh. Good rendering, isn't it, Sir? It looks a bit like the one in the painting that's hung up in the atrium.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's drawing of vase - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of this drawing?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's Melody - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: You looking for somewhere to practice?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's Melody - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: There's usually a piano in the drawing room, but we moved it downstairs so you'd have somewhere to host your talks.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's Melody - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Didn't work anyway. I found a nice one in storage this week, though.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's Melody - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Hisham told me about this melody she's heard...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Arwa's Melody - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: But that's not much use to you, is it?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Lady Wilhelmina - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Hah, you haven't heard that story, Sir?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Lady Wilhelmina - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: She just ran off one day, soon after getting back from Egypt - never to be seen again.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Lady Wilhelmina - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Can't much blame her. I'd say once you get a taste of the outside world, it's hard to come back to... this.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Lady Wilhelmina - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It's quite the portrait they have up - of Lady Wilhelmina Blake, if I'm not mistaken?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Saint Brigid's Cross - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I wonder who's been putting up Saint Brigid's crosses around the manor?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Saint Brigid's Cross - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh, you'll be looking for Missus Joyce, Sir. She seems the type to do that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/map of the area - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not much fun, otherwise.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/map of the area - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is there much to do around here? Outside of the manor, I mean.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/map of the area - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Nothin'. It's mostly fields and farmland.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/map of the area - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Good fun if you're a sheep, I guess.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/map of the area - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: God, there must be more to life than this. What am I doing here?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/map of the area - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: There's a pub over in Gauford that sometimes has music, but you're hardly gonna trek out there.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/blake manor - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Argh, my head!

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/blake manor - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me much about the manor?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/blake manor - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I... I don't want to think much on this place, if that's all the same to you. Gives me headaches.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/blake manor - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: What do you want to know? It's an old place with all the secrets you'd expe--

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Anything interesting planned for the day?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Up to anything of note today?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'll be breaking my back all morning, lifting boxes into the basement storage from late deliveries, thanks to Varley getting his blasted telegraph machine working again - is that noteworthy?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Interesting? No. We don't get to go to talks and balls and all that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Most of today, I'll be floating around bringing drinks to rich folks. Very exciting...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Then at 4pm I open the bar, which sounds fun, but only really is once everyone else has gone to bed. And then tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: At least I'm back in the bar once it opens again.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: And there for the most part until the séance at nine.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Timetable - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: And while you lot try talk to the dead, I'm gonna pack my bag for my travels.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Map of catacombs
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is this a map of the catacombs?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Map of catacombs
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Huh. It could well be.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Map of catacombs
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I saw Miss Deane drawing something like that. Never twigged what it was.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Map of catacombs
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: But now, if you want to explore old, dusty tunnels full of dead people... Congratulations, you'd be the best equipped.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Map of catacombs
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Messers Varley and Hunter might even join you for the thrill of it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Altered reality - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think the dreams here, they alter our perceptions of this place, of reality.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Altered reality - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Dreams can't do that, don't be ridiculous.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Altered reality - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I've been here a year and I know... I know... what I know.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Altered reality - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Altering reality? What?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Altered reality - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...Do you think the longer a person is here, the more they...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Altered reality - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: No! This is stupid. I would know! I thought you were a normal bloke, Ward - not like the rest of the head cases in here! Christ!

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sinnot: Doyle - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You have some history with Father Sinnott, don't you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sinnot: Doyle - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: No, I don't. Do I? I don't remember.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Sinnot: Doyle - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't... why don't I remember?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Detailed sketches of a vase - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does this mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Detailed sketches of a vase - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Looks like the one Lady Wilhelmina had, before she went missing.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Detailed sketches of a vase - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I mean, if the stories are true, and the artist who painted her wasn’t making it up.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/Detailed sketches of a vase - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Whoever drew that probably took it from the portrait.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/drugs in room - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: No, doesn't ring a bell. Sounds medical, though. I've never heard of anyone taking it for, em, fun anyway.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/drugs in room - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Quinine powder?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gauge - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't know. We - Darragh and me - near killed ourselves bringing it over from the residence, though.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gauge - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What is the strange device in the atrium for?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gauge - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: The Marquess never explained what it does but it filled up the night you arrived.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic resaerch - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've been researching Gnosticism - it's a fascinating subject...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic resaerch - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I... please, I don't...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic resaerch - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Gnosis is all that can set us free. Only with that knowledge can we lift the lens of lies from our eyes and see what a truly empty place this is.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic resaerch - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Wha- what the hell was that!? I think I am gonna be sick...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/gnostic resaerch - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The belief that knowle--

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinott's gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think Father Sinnott might be a gnostic priest - does that mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinott's gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: No, does it mean anything to yo--

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinott's gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: We must infiltrate them, dear child, and learn the way into the sacred sanctum.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Evidence Presents - Seamus/sinott's gnostic bible - doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Wah! What just... Sorry, Sir, did you need something?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ivy - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ivy - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: The Scottish girl? No, Sir, on account of the fact I haven't got anything to say to her.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ivy - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not my place to be rubbing elbows with the gentry, is it? Even the pretty ones.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Varley
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working for Mister Varley?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Varley
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Uh, fine. He's not so bad. He's fair.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Varley
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He's on edge these past few days. Something has him shaken - he must have tripped the other day, cause I've seen he's broken his glasses.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I try not to. Spoke once and felt she was tearing me apart with her eyes. I'd say not much gets passed her.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Lan Fen
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I feel bad for Miss Deane - I've seen Missus Lau casting daggers at her a few times, alright.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Skerritt
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: The bigot? I have. Between you and me, Sir, I water down his drinks. He's lucky that's all I do.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Corentine
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Corentine
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: That's the lady with all the scars on her face, isn't it? I've met her.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Corentine
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Strange woman. Spends a lot of time in the bathroom up in the southwest corridor. Maybe the food isn't up to her usual standard.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Missus Joyce?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: She ought to mind her own, Missus Joyce. One mam is bad enough - I don't need another.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: You want something kept in confidence, you'd best make sure she don't hear it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Caitlin
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: You can have that one for free.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you get along with Mister Hunter?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'm just doing a job, Sir. Not much to be said for getting along with people. Not much interest in it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He's fine. Could do with dropping his big daddy routine and let me alone to spend my free time as I may.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Darragh
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Doesn't like to be told to stay out of things, though. Can get angry then. Maybe that anger is why he spends so much time outside by himself.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Mister Doyle.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not much to tell, Sir. I think. I... Oh, my head.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Sorry, Sir, what did you ask me again?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself - how how long you've been working here?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Me? I've been here a... about... Ah, I dunno. A while?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Since the last fella was let go. Not that long, I guess, but it feels like forever.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And are you from the region?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Like most people are, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: So you know a few people around here?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh. Well, no. Not that local. I'm from a couple of towns over. I'm here 'cause... Uhm. Y'know yourself... work.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Of course.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not sure how or why I ended up here. Mind you, you could say the same for the hotel.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Evelyn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Evelyn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Evelyn? Uh... Miss Deane, right? We talked a bit. She doesn't seem too uptight to hobnob with the working man, you know?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Evelyn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Or, she didn't at the time. Haven't seen her lately. Maybe she's avoiding me?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Evelyn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I keep meaning to just ask her, but I... what room was she in? Ah, doesn't matter. She'll talk to me if she wants to.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Evelyn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is she a regular guest to the manor?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Evelyn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I wish... Don't get many women like here around these parts. No, this was her first time visiting.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ines - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ines - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh, eh, I'm avoiding that one. I lost a telegram meant for her and don't want to tell her. I'm not paid enough...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Cathal - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Cathal - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Met him? Eh, yeah... We met.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Cathal - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Look, I meet a lot of guests. Sometimes you get on well with one, sometimes you don't.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Cathal - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: It's nothing more than politeness on both sides, you know - just people clicking.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Cathal - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Anyway, he's gotten a bee in his bonnet about myself and Miss Deane being... polite to one another.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Cathal - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ain't no need for it, Sir. She's not exactly gonna run away from her fortunes to elope with a workman like me...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ettiene - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you happen to have met Mister Touissant?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ettiene - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: That's the Frenchman, isn't it? He did, actually, come talk to me. Asked me all sorts of questions about the guests.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ettiene - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I told him I don't look into them that hard, but I'd be inclined to if he might pay me for the trouble.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ettiene - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He just laughed; told me if I hadn't noticed already, then it was fine - that he wasn't going to be indecent about it. Shame, really.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Dupré - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Dupré - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Not really. He seems alright. Has done well for himself.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Dupré - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I caught him drawing one of the other guests once but he hid it before I could see who it was.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on D'Arcy - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on D'Arcy - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I did. Dropped her bags, and she tore me a new one. Vicious temper, that one.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Coventry - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Coventry - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: The kindly old guy who's strangely smug under it all? Yeah, I met him.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Coventry - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He was buying drinks for Miss Deane like it was nobody's business.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Coventry - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Rich old guys love tossing their cash around to impress the ladies.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Hazel - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you happened to speak to Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Hazel - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: She seems like the poor man's version of the main lady, doesn't she? A lesser Mantovani.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Hazel - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I reckon she knows it, too.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ruairí - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Doctor Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ruairí - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: That guy. I asked him for something to help with, you know, headaches or whatever.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ruairí - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Instead of helping, he wanted to ask questions and get to the bottom of it. "Why, why why?" Only thing I wanted to get to the bottom of was a bottle of laudanum. Some doctor.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Carmela - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Mantovani?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Carmela - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: She seems the real deal, doesn't she? A great win for a place like this.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Carmela - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'd say the Marquess had to sell a few heirlooms for that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Fiadh - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Callaghan?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Fiadh - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Seems like a nice lady to me. Like an everyone's aunty.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Fiadh - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Miss Deane took a dislike to her, though, so maybe she's not all that nice and sweet.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Saoirse - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working with Miss Murphy?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Saoirse - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh, don't let her fool you - she's a right pain. Always getting herself into trouble, always hanging about with the wrong sorts.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Saoirse - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Nothing to say there. She wouldn't talk to me for love or money. I think it's the uniform. She's a good cook, though, I'll give her that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Saoirse - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'd like to say I've rubbed off on her but nah, she's a terror all on her own.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Saoirse - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah, but we couldn't do without her. Not that you heard it from me.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Saoirse - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Wouldn't have guessed it either. Couldn't even work up the nerve to speak with me for a while, you know.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Blake - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How do you find working for Marquess Blake?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Blake - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He doesn't deal with me much. He'll talk to Varley, who'll pass down commands from up on high.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Blake - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Suits me, I don't much like the idea of nobility pushing us about. I like forgetting about him and pretending I work in a normal hotel.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Blake - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Well... Maybe not normal.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Arwa - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Yeah, she's very interested in the logistics of the house, so she asked me a bunch of stuff. How the staff work, what's in the private areas and all that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Arwa - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Miss Hisham?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Arwa - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Told all I could. My first and probably last time meeting a woman like that, figured I'd stretch it as far as I could.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Father Sinnott?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I... No, not really. That's funny, isn't it? I don't even recall bringing his bags up...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Father Sinnott - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Boy... I should eat something. I feel a little lightheaded.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ó Finn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Don't suppose you've spoken with Mister Ó Finn?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Ó Finn - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh yeah. The life, the universe, the soil. All that crap you talk about when hig... when you, eh, just click with a person.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Campbell - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: How well do you now Reverend Campbell?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Campbell - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He's not a guest and I'm not a prod. What would I talk to him for?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Higgins - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've seen a man around the grounds - large of build, not a guest or staff?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Higgins - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Haven't seen anything, no.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Walter Blake- Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you often see Marquess Blake's son?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Walter Blake- Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Almost never. Every so often, I take a meal up for him, but mostly Missus Joyce or Miss Murphy do that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Opinion on Walter Blake- Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I try to stay clear. What do I have to talk about with a ten-year-old rich kid?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Chimney Charm - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found this on the grounds. What do you make of it?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Chimney Charm - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I've seen Mister Hunter with that kind of thing before. He's into that old-fashioned stuff.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Witchcraft components - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of these? They look like components for a ritual or charm of some sort?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Character Presents - Seamus/Witchcraft components - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I wouldn't know about all that, Sir. You could ask Mister Hunter. He knows about that sort of thing.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Hand on pocket watch - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice Mister Varley keeps his pocket watch in hand.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Hand on pocket watch - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He would do, he doesn't like anything running behind.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Hand on pocket watch - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: And God help you if it's anything more than a short delay.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Unhappy expression - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Mister Varley seem upset to you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Unhappy expression - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He always looks like that, Sir. Don't mind it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Scent of oats and sugar - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you notice that Mister Hunter has the smell of sugar about him?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Scent of oats and sugar - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He's got a bag of sugar cubes in his pocket, probably. Gives them to the horses. He loves those things.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Scent of oats and sugar - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't get it, myself. I don't like the way they stare.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Scars on hands and face - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I find myself assuming Miss Quinn must have suffered some sort of accident.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Scars on hands and face - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't know what a lady does to get all those. We've had soldiers through here with less.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Scars on hands and face - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Suppose it must have been some sort of accident.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Cross around neck - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Is Missus Joyce a very devout woman?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Cross around neck - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: If you heard what she talks about in the servants' quarters, Sir, about all this black magic, you wouldn't have to ask.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Open eager pose - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Missus Joyce seems friendly. Do you get along?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Open eager pose - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Friendly? No, Sir, she's just incapable of minding her own.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Sly, knowing smile - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does Missus Joyce pick up many rumours about the guests?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Sly, knowing smile - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: About everyone and everything she can. Nothing's sacred, I swear.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Sunken red eyes - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You look tired. Has the event been heavy on you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Sunken red eyes - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Tired, ha! Yeah, I guess you're right. Both counts. I am tired, and this event isn't helping.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Shaky hands - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Are you alright, Mister Doyle? You're shaking.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Shaky hands - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah... Don't mind it, I just need... Maybe I'll go see the doctor later, maybe he'd give me a little, em, pick-me-up...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Unusual Celtic Cross - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't recognise the cross you're wearing... Does it have a particular meaning?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Unusual Celtic Cross - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en:
I, eh, I don't know. I seem to always have had it. Don't care much for the church, God forgive me, but I wear this daily. It's part of me, I guess?
What is that about, eh?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Notebook in pocket - Seamus
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice Mister Toussaint always seems to carry that notebook of his.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Notebook in pocket - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Who carries a notebook at a party? It's damned strange of him, if you ask me.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Notebook in pocket - Seamus
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Do people even care that much? About all this? I suppose if they didn't, this thing wouldn't be happening...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Friendly expression - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Dupré seems friendly. Do you get the same impression?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Friendly expression - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: He does seem so, right enough. Not that I'm making conversation. Introduced himself, though. Don't see that a lot.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Curious tattoo - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of Mister Dupré's tattoo?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Curious tattoo - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I haven't met many people with tattoos before. And I've definitely not seen one like that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Curious tattoo - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: It looks good, I like it.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Dusty, scuffed clothes - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Coventry appears to have brushed up against something dusty.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Dusty, scuffed clothes - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Mm? Yeah, I suppose so. Hadn't noticed, really.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Tense body language - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't help but notice Missus Erickson seems tense...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Tense body language - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Hm. And for what? She ought to loosen up a little, if you ask me.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Stern expression - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the Reverend seem displeased about something to you?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Analysis Presents - (to) Seamus/Stern expression - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I wouldn’t know, I don’t talk to him.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Ah, well, what're you going to say to the manager? He hardly likes me, anyway.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Can I help you, or... whatever it is you want out here?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What is he drinking?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What is he doing out here?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What have you got there?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Hah... Well, I'm not letting you have any, if that's what you're at.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: God knows, this stuff's hard enough to get already. Anything decent is.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What has you out here, of all places?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'm less likely to be bothered when I'm on my break.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...Not completely safe, though, apparently. Well, from the likes of you.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Other people seem to forget that anyone could be in here at all, and when they take their arguments outside, forget they might be heard.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you heard anything interesting?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: ...fine. Fine. Deane...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Evelyn Deane?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Her. Last Tuesday. Work was quiet, so I slipped out here. I overheard her having a fight about... something.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What was Miss Deane arguing about?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Who was Miss Deane arguing with?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: What was the argument about?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I don't know.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Since we're good pals now, I'll tell you that I did try to get closer, but it was too risky.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Did you see who she was arguing with?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: No. All I could tell you is that it was a man. She was the one with the raised voice, mostly drowned him out.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This has been helpful.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Is this... is this why she's not been about the last few days?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me what you heard, and I promise this encounter stays between us.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: I'm Doyle, by the way. The porter. We met, but you didn't bother to say hello.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Detective Ward
en: Were you supplying her drugs?

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Then she stormed off. I dunno if he followed, but by the time I'd worked myself to a good vantage point, he was gone too.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Bloody maze.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Varley says she left, but... I dunno...

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't know, but I hope to learn.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Supplying? I'm not a dealer. I was sharing.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Christ.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: She didn't care what status you had, only what stash. Nice change for one of their lot.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Was fun for the few days it lasted.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Probably some of this magic stuff they're all so keen on.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: You'd need to ask him, I guess.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Well, if you're gonna be snooping about... It was 8pm they fought. I know because the bar was quiet with all the blue bloods playing bridge.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Hedge maze conversation - Doyle
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Standing outside Ward's room
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: This room's yours, Sir. Number 4.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Standing outside Ward's room
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Well... This is your room, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Standing outside Ward's room
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Breakfast is served at 9am in the East Wing Dining Hall.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Standing outside Ward's room
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: A nice chance to meet your fellow, eh, guests, that.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Standing outside Ward's room
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Oh, I also put your luggage inside, Sir.

conversation: Cast/Seamus Doyle/Standing outside Ward's room
speaker: Mister Doyle
en: Anyway. Sleep well and all that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A new face. You're a little late, but you haven't missed the main event, at least. Who might you be?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Mister Ward. What can I do for you?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: LEAVE

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have to be on my way.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Be well, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: My name is Declan Ward. Pleased to meet you, Mister...?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Doctor, as it happens. Doctor Ruairí Callaghan. And very pleased to meet you, too.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Detective Ward
en: CONFRONT!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Then maybe you can help? There has to be a way to prove to Fiadh that I am not a child anymore. I've learned her ways - I'm not as good at them as she is, yes, but I've gained new knowledge she does not have! I've forged my own path, and I am her peer.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: No... my older brother - he always overshadowed me. I began to take... risks at work. It was an effort to be seen, and in the end, it cost me dearly. It cost him dearly. I understand very well, Doctor.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: If not now, then when?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Take my research. Maybe she'll listen to you. Maybe there's another way to convince her. I no longer see a way forward - but I haven't entirely given up hope.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And yes, before you ask, I am related to Fiadh Callaghan. Her nephew and apprentice.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But I have taken what she has taught me and improved it through the application of science!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And this weekend I will prove the value of my approach, once and for all!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'm glad that you were in attendance, for Miss Barbosa's sake. It was good of you to provide her that photograph.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: What good are such things, if we don't use them where they're needed?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It only cost me a little time and some development materials. Compared to what it gets Miss Barbosa, it's nothing at all.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Magic is born from the need for its practical applications, after all. What good is it if it is withheld?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A thing that, I would say, really shouldn't need proving...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Ruairí conversation
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It probably seems ridiculous to you, Mister Ward - being so focused on getting her to recognise me...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Money - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...I have no need of this, Mister Ward, thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Map of the region - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: What use do you have for that?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Sherry - Ruairí
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ GIVE HIM THE ALCOHOL. ]

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Sherry - Ruairí
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ KEEP THE ALCOHOL. ]

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Sherry - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Oh, that's good of you. Thank you.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I notice this Séance is somewhat more welcoming than other events might be.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: There is a belief that women make better mystics. I don't know about that, especially, but there are certainly very talented female magicians.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It would be short-sighted to disallow them from this thing, certainly.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Historically, magic is the domain of the common folk, after all, not those who would limit its use.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think the séance is going to be successful?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: In terms of whether or not we'll be successful in binding a ghost?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I don't know exactly what method Miss Mantovani is planning on using, so I couldn't comment on that specifically...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But I would imagine we stand a decent chance.
