conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Or, it might be a disaster and unravel the fabric of reality. Either way, I should be here, whatever way it goes.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't help but wonder what a man of science such as yourself would want from an event like this.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Not that long ago, people mistook chemistry for magic. The same with medicine.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Just because we don't fully understand what magic is, or what ghosts really are, does not make them unscientific.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Séance advert - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: If this event can do what they claim it will, it could be a massive breakthrough.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Miss Deane's signature - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw that Miss Deane signed in some time ago when I was checking in.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Miss Deane's signature - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: "Didn't want to miss a moment of this thing," were her words, if I recall correctly.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Miss Deane's signature - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I do wonder where she's got to...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Marriage talk - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I couldn't help but overhear that one of the young women attending is in search of a suitor.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Marriage talk - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Here? Well! I wouldn't have thought it would be the first choice, but she'll know what she's getting into, I suppose...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Edward Blake - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'm no historian... But I believe he was an soldier of esteem in the invading force.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Edward Blake - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the man who had the manor built?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Edward Blake - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: He was 'gifted' the land by Cromwell. If one can gift something acquired like that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Edward Blake - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And favoured as he was by Cromwell, I can only imagine he was the sort of man best forgotten.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Statement, Mister Varley - Ruairi
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Varley says that Miss Deane signed out on Tuesday night by way of a letter.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Statement, Mister Varley - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Wait, are you sure? She's gone?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Statement, Mister Varley - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I would have thought she might say something...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hauntings - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've heard talk about this manor being haunted. Have you encountered anything of the sort?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hauntings - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have, yes. It's the crying in the hallways that bothers me the most.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hauntings - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That - and the damp patches in the wallpaper. That, I would attribute just to this being an old building... except that the patches seem to move...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Séance's Purpose - Ruairi
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think the séance is going to be successful?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Séance's Purpose - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: In terms of whether or not we'll be successful in binding a ghost?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Séance's Purpose - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I don't know exactly what method Miss Mantovani is planning on using, so I couldn't comment on that specifically...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Séance's Purpose - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But I would imagine we stand a decent chance.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Deane's leaving letter - Ward
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It appears Miss Deane really did leave a letter as her way of signing out.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Deane's leaving letter - Ward
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I suppose, whatever she was leaving for, it must have been urgent.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Second Sight - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about this 'Second Sight'?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Second Sight - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Miss McLeod's tradition, you mean?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Second Sight - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Usually you wouldn't see folk magic amongst the nobility... but I suppose, when it is an inherited gift, there's nothing to stop it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Second Sight - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: If you can call it folk magic if it's innate... I wonder. I suppose that might be a matter of opinion.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Second Sight - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Anyhow. I can't say I'm familiar with the Scottish tradition, but it sounds like... involuntary divination, I suppose.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ritual markings - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: There is evidence of a ritual being conducted upstairs, in one of the empty rooms.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ritual markings - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That's... bizarre. If a person wanted to perform a ritual, here, and wanted to do so privately... why not do so in their own room?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Freemasons - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you happen to know anything about the Freemasons?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Freemasons - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have no insider knowledge, if that's what you're asking. One needs an invitation to join, and that's not something I have.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Freemasons - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Besides, if I were a member, I couldn't tell you about it. I believe that's how it goes...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister O'Meara statement - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister O'Meara mentioned he saw Miss Deane on Tuesday night - and that she might have been drinking quite heavily, at that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister O'Meara statement - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Oh? He didn't check to see if he was alright?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister O'Meara statement - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather he didn't want to overstep his mark.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister O'Meara statement - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That's fair, I suppose... but I would feel better knowing she was alright.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Bedroom skeleton key - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Jesus Christ, Ward, why do you have that?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange occurences - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had anything... unexplainable happen to you while you were staying here?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange occurences - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Calling anything unexplainable might be a point of contention... but I won't pretend nothing comes to mind when you ask.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange occurences - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Unless someone is putting them there, which would be... unsettling... I keep finding the bones of small animals under the rug in my room.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange occurences - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Not many... but more than I can comfortably account for.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister Doyle's statement - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Mister Doyle mentioned that he overheard Miss Deane arguing with someone in the gardens.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister Doyle's statement - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I... have never worked as staff at a hotel, but it feels improper that the porter would be sharing gossip, no?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mister Doyle's statement - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Provided she wishes it to be so, Miss Deane's affairs are her own.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mysterious figure in window - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I noticed a figure in the window as I was walking back to the manor. It looked like a young boy.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mysterious figure in window - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know if the Blakes have any children?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mysterious figure in window - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I've lived in this area all my life, and worked here for a decade. I've never heard of the Blakes having any children - a son or otherwise.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Goibniu - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Does the name Goibniu mean anything to you?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Goibniu - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Certainly. He's one of Ireland's old gods. People focus on his smithing but he was also the hospitaller of the Tuatha Dé Danann.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Goibniu - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It's said one of his meals could protect you from sickness and decay. That he brewed an ale that would grant immortality to any who drank it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Goibniu - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: Aye, a smith god and hospitaller of the Tuatha. It's said one of his meals could protect you from sickness and decay.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Goibniu - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ó Finn
en: I wouldn't mind some of that protection going into winter, ha!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Goibniu - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Along with this, he was a healer of sorts. He crafted living metal limbs to bring mobility to any of the Tuatha who needed them.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Fae - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the fae?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Fae - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well, the name can refer to a few things. Generally, though, the fae are thought to be inhabitants of the Otherworld.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Fae - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It's unclear if they can cross over at will, or if they are trapped here looking for a way home.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Fae - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They are seen more often in the dark, rural parts of the land, where the cities and towns haven't invaded the land as throughly.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Fae - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They are most 'real', most present, on this plane at this time of year. Samhain. A worry for us, as Miss Mantovani and co. undertake to pierce the veil. Might they see this as a way home?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Fae - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Hopefully not.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know of the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Literally, it means The Folk of the Goddess Danú.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They are the race that preceded humanity in Ireland. While we know where they are now - or where they ended up, as such - where they came from originally is unknown.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They are somewhat analogous to gods, though that is more dependant on the specific character, rather than their race.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Tuatha Dé Danann - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Or maybe a better way to put it is they were all god-like, but what god-like means is subjective.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Goddess Bridget - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you know about the goddess Bríd?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Goddess Bridget - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: The goddess? Let's see... A member of the Tuatha Dé Danann, the goddess of wisdom, healing, poetry, livestock... Any number of things.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Goddess Bridget - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She's sometimes thought to have two sisters of the same name with other domains, and sometimes they're all attributed to the one Bríd.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Goddess Bridget - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: You'll find her linked to the Saint, Brigid, too. I can tell you that for free.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Dead End - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I took the time to retrace Miss Deane's steps from Tuesday night, and it seems that she never left at all. Her trail ends in the hedge maze.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Dead End - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Do you mean to say something happened to her?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Dead End - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Surely you must be mistaken... even a haunted manor does not just make people disappear.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Hermetic Order - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Hermetic Order - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They're a semi-secret society based in London, primarily interested in high magic.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/The Hermetic Order - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A number of the guests, as it happens, are members.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Stargazing - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you stargazing in the botanic house on Tuesday?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Stargazing - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I was. Why do you ask?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Stargazing - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I was wondering if you'd happened to see Miss Deane while you were there.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Stargazing - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: No, I didn't. I saw her at dinner, but we went our separate ways for the evening after that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Bridge Game _Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I hear there was a bridge game the other evening. Did you play?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Bridge Game _Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I did. Missus D'Arcy dragged me in on my aunt's suggestion. Mister Skerritt was meant to play, but he was preoccupied in the library and left them down a player on short notice.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Bridge Game _Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Enough for two tables. Miss Barbosa, Miss Quinn, and Missus Lau were there. Marquess Blake joined us, too, as did Mister Coventry.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Bridge Game _Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did many attend?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/cigar burns - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Thankfully Miss Quinn saw Mister Skerritt fall asleep and caught the cigar before it caused more damage than it did. I thought I was being summoned to check the old coot's health, but they wanted me to replace him at the bridge table instead...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/cigar burns - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Normally when I tell somebody to pull back on their drinking or their smoking lest they cut their life short, I don't mean it quite so literally.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/cigar burns - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know who might be responsible for the cigar burns in the library?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ent schd - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I must confess, I've not gone to much. Once the sun is down I've been watching the stars and during the day I've talked with whomever I could. Really, other than the bridge game on Tuesday I've gone to nothing.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/talk schd - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Ah yes. The talks. I though it would do the attendees good to know of our gods, the Tuatha Dé Danann.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/talk schd - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Given the magical nature of our gathering, I thought especially people might want to learn of the wrath of our war-witch and death goddess, The Morrigan.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/talk schd - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Or The Cailleach - also considered a witch - whose time begins on the eve of Samhain, when she ushers in the dark half of the year.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/talk schd - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course, they might take these things as mere tales, ghost stories for the night that is in it, and not warnings of the dangers of disturbing the natural order, but we'll see...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Medical certificate - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Doctor Callaghan, I was wondering if you would parse a medical code for me. What does the code U0.33 signify.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Medical certificate - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A code of U0.33 in records would indicate miscarriage, if the issue is not written out in full. I assume this is a purely academic enquiry?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Medical certificate - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It is.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Medical certificate - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Thank God for that. As you were, then.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Memento Mori - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the Quinn family having... an unusual number of deaths?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Memento Mori - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Ah. So Miss Quinn is one of the Quinns, is she? I presume that's why you're asking. What an awful hand...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Memento Mori - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Yes, the Quinns have the unfortunate distinction of bearing a curse, one that's supposedly about a century old, now.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Memento Mori - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'd heard they had a presence in these circles, but I couldn't be certain they and our Miss Quinn were the same.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Memento Mori - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And that they are... How awful.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Barbosa is after a photograph of her late father.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think that's something you'd be able to do for her?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how I might be able to get something like that?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: You're looking for spirit photography, there. And it just so happens I might well be able to help you.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course - but I will need her father's name to summon him for the photograph.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I'll find out what his name was.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Excellent. Let me know when you do.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines wants photograph - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I will need her father's name to summon him for the photograph.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/O'Connor research
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I recovered some information on Miss Barbosa's family, courtesy of Miss Quinn.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/O'Connor research
speaker: Mister Ward
en: It seems Miss Barbosa's father's name was Seamus 'Shay' O'Connor.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/O'Connor research
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well, better not to have me, of all people, spring that on her. Take it to Miss Barbosa, and see what she wants to do.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hedonistic Gala - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I can't say I was expecting a ball... quite like that one.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hedonistic Gala - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Me neither. Thankfully I got a whiff of the drink and knew something was off. Since they alter one's mind state, knowing you've taken a hallucinogen can lead to a very different experience than not knowing...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hedonistic Gala - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You didn't take it, then?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Hedonistic Gala - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That is... not what I said.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've found I have the strangest dreams staying here.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Mmm. You, as well? My aunt and I have found we're having overlapping thoughts from our dreams.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It's the séance, of course. I always end up there. Or maybe it's the house itself? Either way, it's fascinating and I intend to find out more.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And such strange symbols, too! Stuff we've not encountered before, but if we both draw the patterns without describing them to one another, they match!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Were you walking down a corridor? Sealed doors and improbable windows?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Strange Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I didn't recall anything like that before, but now that you've said it, I do.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Unknown Sigil - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I saw a sigil in my dream... a spiral with four lines intersecting it. Does that sound like anything you might recognise?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Unknown Sigil - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Nothing... comes to mind, no. Curious.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Curse - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do I understand right, that Miss Quinn's family is under some sort of curse?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Curse - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Ah. She's of the same Quinns, I take it?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Curse - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have heard something about that - a family cursed with misfortune and early graves.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Curse - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A damned shame it has Miss Quinn. I don't... especially enjoy her company, but she doesn't deserve that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Deane's Room - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recall which room Miss Deane was staying in?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Deane's Room - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I don't think so. No, if she ever mentioned it, it's slipped my mind.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Deane's Room - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Was she in the east wing? I feel like she wasn't that far from where we are?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Deane's Room - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: What an odd thing to forget...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cathal's Laudanum - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... saw Mister O'Meara taking some laudanum. No small amount, too. Is there a danger in that, Doctor?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cathal's Laudanum - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course there is, but I worry more about why he's taking it at that volume.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cathal's Laudanum - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Some people get a dependancy for the stuff, it's true. But he's using it to mask the pain of his various foolhardy risks.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cathal's Laudanum - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A riding accident here, a beating in an alleyway there - people talk, and it seems this poor young man has something of a death wish...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Shadowy Figure - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Any other place, or person, and you might find yourself in a white jacket.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Shadowy Figure - Ruairi
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Doctor - if I told you I had seen a large, shadowy figure on the grounds - what would you say?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Shadowy Figure - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But... here? Me? I'd say if it's truly large, then it's not a mortal's ghost. Perhaps you're seeing the echo of an old god, one of the Tuatha Dé Danann?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Buried Messages - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I believe the dream contains buried messages. Ones of home and of the séance. I think the feelings of the former are being applied to the latter.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Buried Messages - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Fascinating. I will say that neither Fiadh or myself had much interest in attending the séance itself, but now that we are here - we feel almost compelled to.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Altered Reality - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I entered the dream using the lucid technique - when I returned, the hotel appeared to have been altered.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Altered Reality - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Minor changes - some paintings in my room altered to reflect the dream, and it was only a short while before the illusion faded.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Altered Reality - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: So the dream is... altering how the dreamers see the place? To further enforce the dream's desire?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Altered Reality - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But where is it coming from and what does the source want?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Altered Reality - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: That was only my second experience of the dream.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What can you tell me about lucid dreaming, Doctor?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Funny you should say... I have a plan to try it here. I thought maybe it would help me understand these strange dreams.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have a record in my room that I borrowed from the drawing room towards that end... but I keep forgetting to ask the staff to bring a gramophone up to my room.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They had a second suitable record there, I noticed, should you wish to try it yourself?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Oh, and you should use an anchor - something to focus on to ensure your dream is what you want it to be.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Maybe Miss Deane's journal would work? That's what started me on this course, after all...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Lucid Dreaming - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A picture of a person, if you want to summon your mental image of them into the dream. Or a scent. Or, well, there are any number of things you could use - even a book on a topic could work!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Shared Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I believe that people at the manor are experiencing the same dream - shared to some extent.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Shared Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I think something similar. I had intended to try some lucid dreaming to get a better handle on the dream itself, but I keep getting sidetracked.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Shared Dreams - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I must get around to asking the staff for a gramophone. I found a record in the drawing room and I intend to use its music as a sleep aid. Fingers crossed something comes of it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Magical Grimoire - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you seen this book before, Doctor?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Magical Grimoire - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...No. Though there is some terribly strong magic in these pages, Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Magical Grimoire - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Whatever those sigils open or close, I cannot say - but they radiate power, even off the page.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Magical Grimoire - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: This is the kind of thing I'd leave for the experts. Speaking as an expert, of sorts.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Magical Grimoire - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well, Oscail means open. Dún would be close, or shut.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Magical Grimoire - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me what these sigils mean?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you know that Miss Deane comes from powerful blood?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...I didn't. Though I'd expect nothing less from a practitioner of her calibre.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Notes on Milesian Blood Magic - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Blood counts for more than it should, I know. But magically, certainly, hers seems unparalleled.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Coded Papers - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Has this pattern any meaning to you, Doctor?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Coded Papers - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Ah. I looks to be a sigil, Mister Ward. You can tell it was cast by a skilled practitioner, too, with so little trace shown. I must admit I am envious - I have not gotten quite that good, myself.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Coded Papers - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Whoever crafted it has almost certainly written something they didn't want read.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I've seen one of these before, at a fair. A... camera, I believe?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A good eye, Mister Ward, and only partially wrong.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It is a camera, yes, but one modified to work as a spirit camera.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well... I modified it to work better as one. Any camera, in the right circumstances, can capture a spirit, of course.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But my lens filters the image through complex geometry made of peridot, selenite, black tourmaline, labradorite, lapis lazuli and clear quartz stones to both bring out the spirit and protect against it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I thought, what better place to really put this device to the test than here.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: These halls and - dare I say, the people here - are likely crawling with spirits.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I've even set up a darkroom in my quarters so I can quickly develop images. This way people can take away a copy, should they wish.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Would you care for a picture? See who or what haunts you? Aha!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Excellent! Come. In my room I have everything needed to take and develop your picture quickly.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course. It is not for everybody. You know where I am should you change your mind!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Lead the way.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Detective Ward
en: [ YES ]

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Detective Ward

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/spirit camera - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I've even set up a darkroom in my quarters so I can quickly develop images. This way people can take away a copy, should they wish.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Carmela's Health
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you noticed, too, that Miss Mantovani seems unwell...?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Carmela's Health
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: You must know I can't discuss my patients' private medical information with just anyone.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Carmela's Health
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I keep their files well protected, so don't get any ideas. I won't be a source of gossip about the woman.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mary Blake - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Did you ever meet Marchioness Blake?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mary Blake - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Perhaps if I'd been back I'd have delivered the boy. Not sure who did in the end.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mary Blake - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: No, I was away for most of her time here. And when I wasn't, well, I don't really move in those circles.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mary Blake - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I mainly knew of her through her work at the Blake Foundation. I was especially impress with her efforts to raise literacy rates in the region.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Mary Blake - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She seemed a good sort. She, and her foundation, are greatly missed, no doubt.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me much about the Morrigan?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: The phantom queen. Look, Mister Ward, it's important to note that we have three sources for all this - the writings of Catholic Monks, so an agenda has to be acknowledged there...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: And the third?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: The second are followers who believe to have had encounters with the entities in question. Again, those with an agenda.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Pure fiction. Entertainment inspired by the first two sources. But the problem is they all become intertwined. And all are as true and false as one another. So take everything you hear with that in mind.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: So, the Morrigan. A powerful goddess and war-witch who can strike fear into the hearts of her foes and bolster the courage of those on her side.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Many a war was won or lost based on her favour. And that's how she is often painted - a war goddess. But she is more than that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/morrigan - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She is a triple goddess, so when all aspects are viewed together, a softer image comes up - a protector goddess. A fierce one, yes, but a protector nonetheless.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cailleach - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: An Cailleach - or, as she is sometimes unfavourably called, the winter hag. Her time is upon us - she rules from Samhain to Bealtaine.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cailleach - Ruairi
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you tell me much about the Cailleach?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cailleach - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Samhain being commonly known now as Halloween. Bealtaine is May first, and is ruled over by Bríd.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Cailleach - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She ushers in the cold, the dark, the wet. She guides the old and sick to the Otherworld in that time. Then come May, she is gone again to rest.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about Tír na nÓg?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'll assume that you know it's the old Irish afterlife, as such. Or, since you are a Catholic, our version of Heaven.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I say 'our' as Irish people, but also, this is what I believe in. So, do take what I say with that grain of salt.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: There are many things that separate it from Heaven, of course. I think the most significant is its accessibility.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Catholics have to die to get to Heaven, but we pagans can find a way to the Otherworld by less... final means.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It's not a truly physical place, of course, and defies physical rules. You can access it via the sea or via passageways on the land.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: To be clear, I am not talking mythologically here. Yes, there are stories of that - young Oisín of the Fianna went and came back hundreds of years later, of course.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But we, you and I, could hop on horses and get to a passageway by the day's end - and it would need to be day's end for they are stronger at night.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But going there and coming back are not the same thing. So, I have only gotten close, and that was enough for me.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Once mankind learns to fly - and mark my words, we will - we may find gateways up there, too.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have even experimented with entering it via the dream space - but, I digress.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have gotten close to the threshold to the Otherworld a few times. It's part of my training.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I can't recall quite which, but some faiths took the idea of Heaven is "up there" very literally, crossover between birds and angels, et cetera, et cetera.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/tir na nog - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Or, if Fiadh is right and this is a place of power then we could remove the need for horses, entirely.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Barbosa is after a photograph of her late father.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you think that's something you'd be able to do for her?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know how I might be able to get something like that?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: You're looking for spirit photography, there. And it just so happens I might well be able to help you.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course - but I will need her father's name to summon him for the photograph.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I will need her father's name to summon him for the photograph.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I have it already. His name was Seamus 'Shay' O'Connor.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ines' dad's name - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Seamus O'Connor? Alright then. Why don't we find Miss Barbosa and go get set up?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are your plans for this Saturday, Doctor?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are you up to this Sunday, Doctor?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'm glad you asked, Mister Ward. Perhaps I can rope you into joining the talks.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well, I plan to get some fresh air in my lungs.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...Though she does like to chat, so I suspect we'll be in the dining room until right before her talk.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Then it's back to the bar for a few hours to kill some time until the 'main event'.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'm attending all of them you know - there's ones at eleven, three and five today. I actually plan to spend much of the day in the drawing room.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Then there's Mister Coventry's talk at five. And before that, of course, mine! The drawing room at three, Mister Ward, if you wish to attend.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Oh, and my Aunt Fiadh is doing the one at three. You should attend. Ah, and I have lunch plans with her at one.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Otherwise, I think I'll be in the bar all evening. I need to get myself ready for the ball, so to speak. As for tomorrow...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have to wonder if my spirit camera might capture things my eyes will not...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I hope to get plenty of pictures in the stables. The horses certainly have a fondness for staring at empty space.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Timetable - Ruairi
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Thankfully, Fiadh and I are aligned now. I'm no longer worried about the séance.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí duties
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What are the duties of your role?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí duties
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It's somewhere between being a priest and a doctor. Some faith work, some healing. Really, it's helping people in whatever way they need.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí duties
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course, there is less need now. The old ways die more each year, and doctors are more commonplace. Still, everyone needs a trusted friend. In many ways, that's the real core of the work.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/seance aftermath - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Your aunt thinks the séance could be dangerous?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/seance aftermath - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She doesn't think that Mister Ward.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/seance aftermath - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She knows it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/seance aftermath - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They intend to unravel the order of the universe. Now, I am all for progress myself.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/seance aftermath - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But there is no scientific method, no rigorous testing.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/seance aftermath - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Just some good intentions and a lot of people to be caught in the crossfire if things go wrong.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Well Symbols - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the symbols on the well?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Well Symbols - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Ah, that's Aunt Fiadh's work. You should ask her about that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Well - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know anything about the well in the hedge maze?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Well - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I do. It's old, very old. From before this place was built. Probably not the only bit of antiquity around, either.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Well - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It's Fiadh's belief that the well is the lifeblood of this entire region. I am inclined to agree with her.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/aunt's shadow - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you been apprenticing under Fiadh for long?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/aunt's shadow - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have. For too long, in truth. I have learned everything she has to teach me but still I am an apprentice.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/aunt's shadow - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She does not like my modern approach to the role. She believes it distracts me from the work. But to adapt is the work!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/aunt's shadow - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: If only I could get her to see - modern problems require modern solutions!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/witchcraft materials - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I found a pile of twigs and horse hair - does this have any meaning to you?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/witchcraft materials - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Hmmm, either you have a magpie building a nest or somebody is practising witchcraft.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/witchcraft materials - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But horsehair... maybe the stables is a good place to check?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/witchcraft charm - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What does this look like to you?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/witchcraft charm - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A magical charm. It could be protective, but the rough materials, the way it is wrapped - my guess is a binding spell.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/record - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know much about using music to aid with dreams?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/record - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A bit. I'm actually trying something along those lines myself.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/record - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I... my dreams here. They are different to normal. So I am going to try and enter them more... consciously. It's a technique called Lucid Dreaming.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/fiadh componants
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Can you think of anything your aunt might be missing to help her with her work at the well?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/fiadh componants
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A hundred things, Mister Ward, but only one that matters - modernity.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/fiadh componants
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: The séance is modern magic. She cannot protect against it without modern tools.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/fiadh componants
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: If only she would accept my help!

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Milesians - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you know of the Milesians?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Milesians - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Know of them? I am one, Mister Ward. As are you, presumably.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Milesians - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: They are the race of men who came here and wrestled the right to settle from the gods.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Milesians - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I do love the country, but some days I wish our ancestors had sailed to somewhere warmer...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/ru letter to deane- Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Miss Deane mentioned that you offered to teach her some Irish magic?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/ru letter to deane- Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Not so loud! I, eh, don't want everyone looking for tutelage.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/ru letter to deane- Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...In truth, I did. And so you don't go digging around any further, I did so behind Fiadh's back. She was against it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/ru letter to deane- Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But, then again, she is against everything! It would have been a move that strengthened my own position in London, which in turn would strengthen what I could bring back to protect the land here in Ireland.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/ru letter to deane- Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: We cannot dig our heels in and hope the world doesn't outgrow us. To do so would be a failure in our duty.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/photo of miss deane - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Do you recognise this picture?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/photo of miss deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Of course I do, I took it. Maybe a week ago? Evelyn must have dropped it - you should return it to her.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/rejected request - ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I gather that Miss Deane was interested in learning Irish magic from your aunt?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/rejected request - ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...She was. Fiadh rejected her, though. That's all there is to that.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: You're Fiadh's apprentice?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I am. I am trained to handle all of her duties. Of course, I lack her experience. But I have my medical training and new techniques to give me an edge.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: When you take over, will you still be a Bean Draoí?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/bean draoí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...Of course not, Mister Ward. I would just be the Draoí.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ru's componants
speaker: Mister Ward
en: This is your bag of spells, then?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ru's componants
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Not sure I would refer to it as such, but it's not entirely untrue, either.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Ru's componants
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Please, do what I cannot and help me convince my aunt that I am ready to... I suppose you could say, graduate.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/drugs in room - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Oh, the malaria treatment? Well, malaria and fever, I suppose I should say.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/drugs in room - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Doctor, can you tell me much about Quinine powder?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/drugs in room - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Oh... It can cause all manner of side effects. Temporary blindness, confusion, dulled senses - unless a person is chasing that kind of thing, then I would say not.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/drugs in room - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Would a person use it for another reason?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/gauge - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: What do you make of that odd device in the atrium?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/gauge - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Now that is a thing. I've been studying it. The readings have been growing as we draw nearer to the séance.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/gauge - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: The veil thinning? Maybe...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/gauge - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But for that, I would have expected a steady grow. One that only peaked on the 31st.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/gauge - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: No, this has climbed by ones and twos. My theory is that its increases are linked to guest arrivals.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/gauge - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And I should note that it finally filled the night you arrived...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Hmmm... Well, assuming the staff haven't gone mad, then I would think what you saw was a bean nigh.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: When I arrived I saw the damndest thing - a woman washing clothes in the fountain.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Tell me, was she washing a garment?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: She was.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I... didn't think to check.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: A shame, it might have told us who was to die.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: The bean nigh, or washer woman, foretells the death of a person.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And those who see her... well, they too feel the touch of death.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That is to say they are still in mourning over death, however long ago it happened.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Since you saw her, well... I am sorry for whatever loss has befallen you.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: ...Thank you. But surely everyone should see her? We've all felt loss at some point in our lives?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Felt it, yes, but haunted by it? Perhaps 'haunted' isn't the right term, our location considered.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: When my father died, for example, I was sad. But I have let that go. I am still sad for his passing but I am not weighted down by it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That is the difference.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/washer woman - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: A shawl. I do not know whose it was.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well yes, but also no.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I think it is safe to say your methods worked.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: We succeeded not through my methods, but through Fiadh's and mine.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: There is a lesson there for me. I was too focused on the future.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But when we forget the past we don't learn from it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And we repeat the mistakes of it.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And! We only got there because you stepped in.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'm grateful, of course, but also deeply ashamed.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: That I might have let my duty to the land and its people down, because of ego...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: So, in all - I am proud of what we have achieved here, and I am proud of what it has taught me.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And, if you will do me the honour, I am proud to call you a friend.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Evidence Presents - Ruarí/Resolution - Ru
speaker: Mister Ward
en: The honour, Doctor, is all mine.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ivy - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Miss McLeod?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ivy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She was flighty until I promised I wouldn't try and diagnose her with anything.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ivy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She has the sight and I think that's left her in hot water with doctors before.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ivy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I told her Fiadh has similar, so I was well used to it. After that, she warmed up considerably.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ivy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She's a nice girl. I'm glad I've had the opportunity to meet her.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Varley - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the manager?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Varley - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I mean, in a manner of speaking.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Varley - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: He's busy, certainly, but he seems like a decent man.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Varley - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: His family are all like that, though. They're from up our way and everyone of them is less fun than a wake.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to speak with Missus Lau?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: We met over drinks. She is an intelligent woman. It's not often I meet a lady with an interest in science.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: True, she's more scholar than scientist, but that doesn't make the conversation much less interesting.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Lan Fen - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Sadly, she left in a hurry. Just as Miss Deane came to talk with me. Shame, I think they could have gotten on.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Skerritt - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to Mister Skerritt?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Skerritt - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: We have spoken some. I find he has a similar way about him to many gentlemen I meet in professional circumstances.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Skerritt - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Outwardly pleasant. Perhaps a little old fashioned...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Skerritt - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: ...some of the old fashions hold over better than others, wouldn't you say?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Skerritt - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'm not at all sure what Miss Deane sees in him but they seem to have some sort of dynamic going on.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Corentine - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Miss Quinn?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Corentine - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Yes. She had Fiadh and I to tea.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Corentine - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She is looking for some local history and hoped we could help.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Corentine - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Sadly we could not, but I am sure she'll find what she seeks in the libraries here.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Caitlin - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken to the housekeeper?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Caitlin - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Hah, that I have. She was very interested in the goings-on in Gauford. She is from there - she grew up alongside Fiadh, in fact.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Caitlin - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I told her Fiadh might know more - but she said she'd rather talk to me. She doesn't like the old ways much, I'd wager.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Caitlin - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I gave her what updates I had. All this "ungodliness" seems to infuriate her - it was rather entertaining.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Darragh - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Mister Hunter, isn't it? I've been out that way a bit to take some shots, so we're talked a bit. Seems a good sort. Fiadh likes him.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Darragh - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with the groundskeeper?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Darragh - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I'm sure she'd make introductions, if you wanted.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Seamus - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met the porter?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Seamus - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have. He was very friendly at first but cooled off when it became clear I wasn't the kind of doctor he was hoping for.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Seamus - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Which is one who is happy to dole out medicine freely and unquestioningly.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ines - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Barbosa?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ines - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: You hear so much about where our people have spread to these past few decades - it is fascinating to learn something firsthand.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ines - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: And what a journey her father has been on! Her too, for that matter.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ines - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She is here to dig into his past. I am sad to say I could be no help.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ines - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I did try to offer her a picture, but Fiadh stomped all over that...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ettiene - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you had the opportunity to meet Mister Touissant?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ettiene - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: As a matter of fact, I had a very pleasant conversation with him just the other day.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ettiene - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: His reputation precedes him, of course, but I found him quite reasonable.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ettiene - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Then again, I suppose I am not the sort of person he hunts. There is something to be said for turning out the fakes.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Cathal - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Mister O'Meara?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Cathal - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have spoken with him. It's an... interesting case, his, isn't it?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Cathal - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: He'd not be the first person I've met who has claimed to have spoken with angels. And yet... somehow...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Cathal - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Let me tell you this - I took a picture of him upon request. It... came out overexposed - or some of it did.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Cathal - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: But was it exposure? Or... did I capture the thing on camera? I think I might be inclined to believe the latter...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Dupré - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Mister Dupré?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Dupré - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have. He asked me if I knew anything about Irish mythology, and that's quite a topic.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Dupré - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I am impressed with his knowledge on the matter. He has some mind on him.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Dupré - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: He seems like a good man. You'll find that many people who take up a position like his are.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Miss Deane?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: We met in London some time ago. I had travelled for a conference, and attended a séance to meet an acquaintance.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I met Miss Deane there, and she was very interested to hear about my tradition. We've been in contact, by way of letter, since.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I was looking forward to talking to her more, here, I heard word that she had recently returned from some expedition in India, but I haven't seen her recently.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She wanted to speak to Fiadh, too, but she said she had no interest in taking her on as a student.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Well. Yes. We met once or twice. She asked me to tutor her. In Irish magic. Me, not Fiadh.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I turned her down, of course. Wouldn't be right. I turned her down, you see?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I know her, yes.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She's a gifted practitioner by all accounts but she is a bit full of herself, don't you think?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Deane - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I think she could stand to be taken down a peg or two.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you met Missus D'Arcy?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I have. It was a bit of a whirlwind. She's quite the personality.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I mean that as a compliment, mind you. Though I do get the feeling she was hiding something from me.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on D'Arcy - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She seems very much the sort who'd want her picture taken but she was dead set against it - she paled at the idea.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Coventry - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: I don't suppose you've met Mister Coventry?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Coventry - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Briefly - we didn't speak much. He's very polite, but I notice he can say a lot without sharing much.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Coventry - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: You see it in patients all the time. They think they can talk around why they want some mercury.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Coventry - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: It makes me wonder what he is trying so hard not to say.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Coventry - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: When all they need to do is admit they caught syphilis in a brothel.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Hazel - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Have you spoken with Missus Erickson?

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Hazel - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: I've said hello. Rather, she introduced herself. I don't usually interest myself in her brand of mysticism, but she seemed so earnest...

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Hazel - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: She told me she'd heard of me, even. She must have her ear to the ground... my tradition doesn't often get a second look in the city.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ruairí - Ruairí
speaker: Mister Ward
en: Tell me about yourself, Doctor Callaghan.

conversation: Cast/Ruarí Callaghan/Character Presents - Ruairí/Opinion on Ruairí - Ruairí
speaker: Doctor Callaghan
en: Hm... Really?
